### 变体演进：Infinite Witch Brooms (Mod 3830879982)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3830879982 (`Infinite Witch Brooms`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3830879982)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:witchbroom

AddPrefabPostInit("witchbroom", SetupBroom)
AddPrefabPostInit("witchbroom_living", SetupBroom)

print("[Infinite Witch Brooms] 1.3.3 loaded. Enchanted speed: " ..
    (SPEED_ENABLED and (SPEED_PERCENT .. "%") or "vanilla") ..
    "; water walking: " .. (WATER_WALK_ENABLED and "on" or "off"))


-- v1.3.3: Always-hover idle. Uses Klei's ACTUAL 2026 witch-broom animation.
-- In vanilla SGwilson and SGwilson_client, the broom uses the specialized
-- "run_flyingbroom" state (NOT "run") with "run_witchbroom_loop" animation.
-- We do not call a nonexistent GetCurrentAnimation or use debug strings.
-- Only a normal player "idle" is changed; locomotion and action states remain native.
local IWB_HOVER_ENABLED = GetModConfigData("enchanted_idle_hover_enabled") == true

if IWB_HOVER_ENABLED then
    local IWB_FLIGHT_ANIM = "run_witchbroom_loop"

    local function HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player)
        if player == nil or player:HasTag("playerghost") then
            return false
        end
        -- Exact check used by the ORIGINAL 2026 Klei flight stategraph.
        -- Prefer client replica on clients; component on the master sim.
        local replica_inventory = player.replica ~= nil and player.replica.inventory or nil
        if replica_inventory ~= nil and replica_inventory.EquipHasTag ~= nil
            and replica_inventory:EquipHasTag("flyingbroom") then
            return true
        end
        local inventory = player.components ~= nil and player.components.inventory or nil
        return inventory ~= nil and inventory.EquipHasTag ~= nil
            and inventory:EquipHasTag("flyingbroom") or false
    end

    local function IsOrdinaryIdle(player)
        return player ~= nil and player.sg ~= nil
            and player.sg.currentstate ~= nil
            and player.sg.currentstate.name == "idle"
    end

    local function ApplyHover(player)
        if not IsOrdinaryIdle(player) or not HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player)
            or player.AnimState == nil then
            return
        end
        if not player.AnimState:IsCurrentAnimation(IWB_FLIGHT_ANIM) then
            player.AnimState:PlayAnimation(IWB_FLIGHT_ANIM, true)
        end
        player._iwb_hover133 = true
    end

    local function ClearHover(player)
        if player == nil or player._iwb_hover133 == nil then
            return
        end
        player._iwb_hover133 = nil
        if IsOrdinaryIdle(player) and player.AnimState ~= nil
            and player.AnimState:IsCurrentAnimation(IWB_FLIGHT_ANIM) then
            player.AnimState:PlayAnimation("idle_loop", true)
        end
    end

    local function PatchIdleStategraph(sg)
        if sg == nil or sg.states == nil or sg.states.idle == nil then
            return
        end
        local idle = sg.states.idle
        if idle.onenter ~= nil then
            local vanilla_onenter = idle.onenter
            idle.onenter = function(player, pushanim, ...)
                -- Do not skip any original game safety, movement or action code.
                local result = vanilla_onenter(player, pushanim, ...)
                -- These special prediction parameters request no animation.
                if pushanim ~= "cancel" and pushanim ~= "noanim"
                    and not player:HasTag("nopredict")
                    and not player:HasTag("pausepredict") then
                    ApplyHover(player)
                end
                return result
            end
        end
        -- Vanilla SGwilson schedules funny idles every few seconds.
        -- With the broom we keep the flight idle instead.
        if idle.ontimeout ~= nil then
            local vanilla_ontimeout = idle.ontimeout
            idle.ontimeout = function(player, ...)
                if IsOrdinaryIdle(player) and HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player) then
                    ApplyHover(player)
                    return
                end
                return vanilla_ontimeout(player, ...)
            end
        end
    end

    AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", PatchIdleStategraph)
    AddStategraphPostInit("wilson_client", PatchIdleStategraph)

    AddPlayerPostInit(function(player)
        -- Equip an enchanted broom while already stationary.
        player:ListenForEvent("equip", function()
            player:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
                if HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player) then
                    ApplyHover(player)
                else
                    ClearHover(player)
                end
            end)
        end)
        player:ListenForEvent("unequip", function()
            player:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
                if not HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player) then
                    ClearHover(player)
                end
            end)
        end)
        -- Fallback only for ordinary idle, not attack/interaction/movement.
        -- Also catches already equipped saved brooms or unexpected idle resets.
        player:DoPeriodicTask(.6, function()
            if HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player) then
                ApplyHover(player)
            else
                ClearHover(player)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:witchbroom_living
AddPrefabPostInit("witchbroom", SetupBroom)
AddPrefabPostInit("witchbroom_living", SetupBroom)

print("[Infinite Witch Brooms] 1.3.3 loaded. Enchanted speed: " ..
    (SPEED_ENABLED and (SPEED_PERCENT .. "%") or "vanilla") ..
    "; water walking: " .. (WATER_WALK_ENABLED and "on" or "off"))

-- We do not call a nonexistent GetCurrentAnimation or use debug strings.
-- Only a normal player "idle" is changed; locomotion and action states remain native.
local IWB_HOVER_ENABLED = GetModConfigData("enchanted_idle_hover_enabled") == true

if IWB_HOVER_ENABLED then
    local IWB_FLIGHT_ANIM = "run_witchbroom_loop"

    local function HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player)
        if player == nil or player:HasTag("playerghost") then
            return false
        end
        -- Exact check used by the ORIGINAL 2026 Klei flight stategraph.
        -- Prefer client replica on clients; component on the master sim.
        local replica_inventory = player.replica ~= nil and player.replica.inventory or nil
        if replica_inventory ~= nil and replica_inventory.EquipHasTag ~= nil
            and replica_inventory:EquipHasTag("flyingbroom") then
            return true
        end
        local inventory = player.components ~= nil and player.components.inventory or nil
        return inventory ~= nil and inventory.EquipHasTag ~= nil
            and inventory:EquipHasTag("flyingbroom") or false
    end

    local function IsOrdinaryIdle(player)
        return player ~= nil and player.sg ~= nil
            and player.sg.currentstate ~= nil
            and player.sg.currentstate.name == "idle"
    end

    local function ApplyHover(player)
        if not IsOrdinaryIdle(player) or not HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player)
            or player.AnimState == nil then
            return
        end
        if not player.AnimState:IsCurrentAnimation(IWB_FLIGHT_ANIM) then
            player.AnimState:PlayAnimation(IWB_FLIGHT_ANIM, true)
        end
        player._iwb_hover133 = true
    end

    local function ClearHover(player)
        if player == nil or player._iwb_hover133 == nil then
            return
        end
        player._iwb_hover133 = nil
        if IsOrdinaryIdle(player) and player.AnimState ~= nil
            and player.AnimState:IsCurrentAnimation(IWB_FLIGHT_ANIM) then

        end
    end

    local function PatchIdleStategraph(sg)
        if sg == nil or sg.states == nil or sg.states.idle == nil then

        end
        local idle = sg.states.idle
        if idle.onenter ~= nil then
            local vanilla_onenter = idle.onenter
            idle.onenter = function(player, pushanim, ...)
                -- Do not skip any original game safety, movement or action code.
                local result = vanilla_onenter(player, pushanim, ...)

                if pushanim ~= "cancel" and pushanim ~= "noanim"

                    and not player:HasTag("pausepredict") then

                return result
            end
        end
        -- Vanilla SGwilson schedules funny idles every few seconds.
        -- With the broom we keep the flight idle instead.
        if idle.ontimeout ~= nil then
            local vanilla_ontimeout = idle.ontimeout
            idle.ontimeout = function(player, ...)
                if IsOrdinaryIdle(player) and HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player) then
                    ApplyHover(player)
                    return
                end
                return vanilla_ontimeout(player, ...)
            end
        end
    end

    AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", PatchIdleStategraph)
    AddStategraphPostInit("wilson_client", PatchIdleStategraph)

    AddPlayerPostInit(function(player)
        -- Equip an enchanted broom while already stationary.
        player:ListenForEvent("equip", function()
            player:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
                if HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player) then
                    ApplyHover(player)
                else
                    ClearHover(player)
                end
            end)
        end)
        player:ListenForEvent("unequip", function()
            player:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
                if not HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player) then
                    ClearHover(player)
                end
            end)
        end)
        -- Fallback only for ordinary idle, not attack/interaction/movement.
        -- Also catches already equipped saved brooms or unexpected idle resets.
        player:DoPeriodicTask(.6, function()
            if HasEnchantedBroomEquipped(player) then
                ApplyHover(player)

end
```

```lua
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
       return inst
    end
    inst:AddComponent("equippable")
    inst.components.equippable.equipslot = GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.BODY
    inst.components.equippable.dapperness = TUNING.DAPPERNESS_SMALL
    inst.components.equippable.is_magic_dapperness = true
    inst.components.equippable:SetOnEquip(onequip_repair)
    inst.components.equippable:SetOnUnequip(onunequip_repair)
    inst.components.equippable:SetOnEquipToModel(onequiptomodel_repair)

    inst:AddComponent("finiteuses")
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetOnFinished(inst.Remove)
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetMaxUses(600)
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetUses(600)
end)
```

### 变体演进：Mod 3810879235 (Mod 3810879235)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3810879235 (`Mod 3810879235`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3810879235)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:autoterraformer
--希望大多数情况下保持原本的流程
AddComponentPostInit("autoterraformer",function(self)
    local old_StartTerraforming = self.StartTerraforming
    function self:StartTerraforming(...)
      if self.inst.components.inventoryitem ~= nil then
        local owner = self.inst.components.inventoryitem:GetGrandOwner()
        if owner ~= nil and owner.components.inventory ~= nil and owner.components.inventory:EquipHasTag("jx_backpack_3") then
          return
        end
      end
      old_StartTerraforming(self, ...)
    end
  end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:antlionhat

AddPrefabPostInit("antlionhat", function(inst)
    if not G.TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
    inst:AddComponent("jx_autoterraformer")
    inst.components.jx_autoterraformer.onfinishterraformingfn = onfinishterraforming

    if inst.components.equippable then
      local old_onequipfn = inst.components.equippable.onequipfn
      inst.components.equippable:SetOnEquip(function(inst, owner)
          old_onequipfn(inst, owner)
          if owner.components.inventory ~= nil and owner.components.inventory:EquipHasTag("jx_backpack_3") then
            if inst.components.jx_autoterraformer ~= nil and owner.components.locomotor ~= nil then
              inst.components.jx_autoterraformer:StartTerraforming()
            end
          end
        end)

      local old_onunequipfn = inst.components.equippable.onunequipfn
      inst.components.equippable:SetOnUnequip(function(inst, owner)
          old_onunequipfn(inst, owner)
          if inst.components.jx_autoterraformer ~= nil and owner.components.locomotor ~= nil then
            inst.components.jx_autoterraformer:StopTerraforming()
          end
        end)
    end
  end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:bernie_inactive

AddPrefabPostInit("bernie_inactive", function(inst)
    if not G.TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
    local old_onentitywake = inst.OnEntityWake
    inst.OnEntityWake = function()
      if inst.persists == false then
        return
      end
      old_onentitywake(inst)
    end
    inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        if inst.persists == false and inst._activatetask ~= nil then
          inst._activatetask:Cancel()
          inst._activatetask = nil
        end
      end)
  end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

--栅栏击剑旋转地毯、洗手池
AddComponentPostInit("fencerotator",function(self)
    local old_Rotate = self.Rotate
    function self:Rotate(target, delta, ...)
      if target and target:HasTag("jx_rug") and target.rotatable_angle then
        local angle = target.Transform:GetRotation()
        target.Transform:SetRotation(angle + target.rotatable_angle)--不用delta参数
        if target.NOCLICK_Tag_Task then
          target.NOCLICK_Tag_Task:Cancel()
          target.NOCLICK_Tag_Task = nil
        end
        target.NOCLICK_Tag_Task = target:DoTaskInTime(target.NOCLICK_Tag_Task_Time or 5,function() target:AddTag("NOCLICK") end)
        self.inst:PushEvent("fencerotated")
        G.SpawnPrefab("fence_rotator_fx").Transform:SetPosition(target.Transform:GetWorldPosition())
      elseif target and target:HasTag("jx_frontdesk") then
        local angle = target.Transform:GetRotation()
        target.Transform:SetRotation(angle + 90)
        self.inst:PushEvent("fencerotated")
        G.SpawnPrefab("fence_rotator_fx").Transform:SetPosition(target.Transform:GetWorldPosition())
      else
        old_Rotate(self, target, delta, ...)
      end
      if target and target:HasTag("rotatableobject_matchphysics") and target.OnInit then
        target:OnInit()
      end
    end
  end)
```

```lua
AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
    local event = sg.events ~= nil and sg.events.knockback or nil
    if event == nil or event.fn == nil then return end
    local original = event.fn
    event.fn = function(inst, data, ...)
        local inventory = inst.components.inventory
        local crown = inventory ~= nil and inventory:GetEquippedItem(GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD) or nil
        if crown ~= nil and crown.prefab == "descendant_crown"
            and crown.components.armor ~= nil and crown.components.armor:GetPercent() > 0
            and crown.components.container ~= nil then
            for i = 1, 5 do
                local gem = crown.components.container:GetItemInSlot(i)
                if gem ~= nil and gem.prefab == "purplegem" then return end
            end
        end
        return original(inst, data, ...)
    end
end)
```

```lua
    -- patch_webdomain.lua 的周期任务往玩家身上写 _myth_webdef
    AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self)
        if not self.inst:HasTag("player") then return end
        local old_ApplyDamage = self.ApplyDamage
        self.ApplyDamage = function(self2, damage, attacker, weapon, spdamage)
            local def = self2.inst._myth_webdef or 0
            if def > 0 and spdamage ~= nil and spdamage.planar ~= nil and spdamage.planar > 0 then
                local sp2 = {}
                for k, v in pairs(spdamage) do sp2[k] = v end
                sp2.planar = sp2.planar - def
                if sp2.planar <= 0 then sp2.planar = nil end
                local any = false
                for k, v in pairs(sp2) do any = true break end
                if not any then sp2 = nil end
                return old_ApplyDamage(self2, damage, attacker, weapon, sp2)
            end
            return old_ApplyDamage(self2, damage, attacker, weapon, spdamage)
        end
    end)
```

```lua
    end

    local PushBloom = self.PushBloom
    function self:PushBloom(source, fx, priority)
        if source == "playerghostbloom" and fx == GHOST_BLOOM then

            return

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playercontroller
-- Hook playercontroller to intercept Left-Click when aiming
AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller", function(self)
    local old_OnControl = self.OnControl
    function self:OnControl(control, down, ...)
        if self.inst == GLOBAL.ThePlayer and self.inst._jayce_laser_aiming then
            if down then
                if control == GLOBAL.CONTROL_PRIMARY then
                    -- Left click: fire laser in aimed direction if not clicking on HUD
                    if GLOBAL.TheInput ~= nil and GLOBAL.TheInput:GetHUDEntityUnderMouse() == nil then
                        local mousepos = GLOBAL.TheInput:GetWorldPosition()
                        if mousepos ~= nil then
                            FireJayceLaser(self.inst, mousepos)
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                elseif control == GLOBAL.CONTROL_SECONDARY or control == GLOBAL.CONTROL_CANCEL then
                    -- Right click or ESC cancels laser aiming
                    StopJayceLaserAiming(self.inst)
                    return true
                end
            elseif control == GLOBAL.CONTROL_PRIMARY or control == GLOBAL.CONTROL_SECONDARY then
                -- Consume button release
                return true
            end
        end
        return old_OnControl(self, control, down, ...)
    end
end)

-- Hotkey registration
local function OnPressLaserHotkey()
    local player = GLOBAL.ThePlayer
    if player == nil or not player:IsValid() then
        return
    end

    if player._jayce_laser_aiming then
        StopJayceLaserAiming(player)
        return
    end

    if not IsValidHUDState() then
        return
    end

    if not LeapSkills.HasShockBlast(player) then
        if GLOBAL.TheFocalPoint ~= nil and GLOBAL.TheFocalPoint.SoundEmitter ~= nil then
            GLOBAL.TheFocalPoint.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/HUD/click_negative", nil, 0.4)
        end
        return
    end

    local inventory = player.replica.inventory
    if inventory == nil then
        return
    end

    local weapon = inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS)
    if weapon == nil or not weapon:HasTag("jayce_laser_weapon") then
        return
    end

    -- Check cooldown
    if weapon._laser_ready ~= nil and not weapon._laser_ready:value() then
        if GLOBAL.TheFocalPoint ~= nil and GLOBAL.TheFocalPoint.SoundEmitter ~= nil then
            GLOBAL.TheFocalPoint.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/HUD/click_negative", nil, 0.4)
        end
        return
    end

    StartJayceLaserAiming(player, weapon)
end

if GLOBAL.TheInput ~= nil and not GLOBAL.TheNet:IsDedicated() then
    local key_name = (GetModConfigData and GetModConfigData("JAYCE_LASER_KEY")) or "R"
    local hotkey = GLOBAL["KEY_" .. string.upper(key_name)] or GLOBAL.KEY_R
    GLOBAL.TheInput:AddKeyDownHandler(hotkey, OnPressLaserHotkey)
end

GLOBAL.package.loaded["jv_jayce_laser"] = M
return M

```

```lua
AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
    local old_GetAttacked = self.GetAttacked

    function self:GetAttacked(attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...)
        local armorbreak = self.inst.components.armorbreak_debuff
        local mult = armorbreak ~= nil and armorbreak:GetDamageMultiplier() or 1

        if mult ~= 1 then
            if damage ~= nil and damage > 0 then
                damage = damage * mult
            end

            if spdamage ~= nil and SpDamageUtil ~= nil and SpDamageUtil.ApplyMult ~= nil then
                spdamage = SpDamageUtil.ApplyMult(spdamage, mult)
            end
        end

        return old_GetAttacked(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...)
    end
end)
```

- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3425984772 (`左轮手枪(死亡舞步)`) 的生产级切面。

```lua
-- ============================================================================

local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat
function dst_lan:_hookCombat()
    AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
        self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers = SourceModifierList(self.inst)
        self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period = self.min_attack_period
        local p = rawget(self, "_")["min_attack_period"]
        local old_on_map = p[2]
        p[2] = function(self, map)
            if old_on_map ~= nil then
                old_on_map(self, map)
            end
            if self.inst.replica.combat and self.inst.replica.combat.dstlan_atkperiodmult then
                self.inst.replica.combat.dstlan_atkperiodmult:set(self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get())
            end
        end

        function self:SetAttackPeriod(val)
            self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period = val
            self.min_attack_period = self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period / self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get()
        end

        function self:SetAtkPeriodModifier(source, mult, key)
            self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:SetModifier(source, mult, key)
            self.min_attack_period = self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period / self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get()
        end

        function self:RemoveAtkPeriodModifier(source, key)
            self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:RemoveModifier(source, key)
            self.min_attack_period = self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period / self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get()
        end
    end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson
function dst_lan:_hookSG()
    AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
        local old_onenter = sg.states["attack"].onenter
        sg.states["attack"].onenter = function (inst,...)
            local res = old_onenter ~= nil and {old_onenter(inst,...)} or {}
            local combat = inst.components.combat
            local timeout = (math.floor(13/(combat.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get())))*FRAMES
            inst.sg:SetTimeout(timeout)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(combat.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get())
            return unpack(res)
        end

        local old_ontimeout = sg.states["attack"].ontimeout
        sg.states["attack"].ontimeout = function (inst,...)
            inst:PerformBufferedAction()
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag('abouttoattack')
            return old_ontimeout(inst,...)
        end

        local old_onexit = sg.states["attack"].onexit
        sg.states["attack"].onexit = function (inst,...)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(1)
            return old_onexit(inst,...)
        end

    end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson_client
function dst_lan:_hookSGClient()
    AddStategraphPostInit("wilson_client", function(sg)
        local old_onenter = sg.states["attack"].onenter
        sg.states["attack"].onenter = function (inst,...)
            local res = old_onenter ~= nil and {old_onenter(inst,...)} or {}
            local timeout = (math.floor(13/inst.replica.combat.dstlan_atkperiodmult:value()))*FRAMES
            inst.sg:SetTimeout(timeout)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(inst.replica.combat.dstlan_atkperiodmult:value())
            return unpack(res)
        end

        local old_ontimeout = sg.states["attack"].ontimeout
        sg.states["attack"].ontimeout = function (inst,...)
            inst:PerformPreviewBufferedAction()
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag('abouttoattack')
            return old_ontimeout(inst,...)
        end

        local old_onexit = sg.states["attack"].onexit
        sg.states["attack"].onexit = function (inst,...)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(1)
            return old_onexit(inst,...)
        end

    end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:health

AddComponentPostInit("health",
---comment
---@param self component_health
function(self)
    local old_SetVal = self.SetVal
    function self:SetVal(val,cause,afflicter,...)
        local res = {old_SetVal(self,val,cause,afflicter,...)}

        local victim = self.inst
        -- 当死亡
        if self:IsDead() then
            local wp = afflicter and afflicter.last_atk_weapon
            -- 是收集者击杀
            if wp and wp.prefab and wp.prefab == 'qhc_revolver_pistol' then
                -- 筛选
                if not victim:HasTag('wall') and not victim:HasTag('structure') then
                    if afflicter and S_QHC_REVOLVER:checkAlive(afflicter) and afflicter.components.sanity then
                        afflicter.components.sanity:DoDelta(db.kill_regen_san)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return unpack(res)
    end
end)
```

### 变体演进：Extra Equip Slots (Mod 3787042651)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3787042651 (`Extra Equip Slots`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3787042651)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:inventory

AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self)
    local _GetEquippedItem = self.GetEquippedItem
    -- Vanilla useable hats (bush etc.) call GetEquippedItem(HEAD) and index .useableitem.
    -- With armor on HEAD and bush on HEAD2 that crashes. Redirect only in the dangerous cases.
    function self:GetEquippedItem(eslot)
        local item = _GetEquippedItem(self, eslot)
        if eslot == EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD then
            local h2 = _GetEquippedItem(self, EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD2)
            if h2 ~= nil and h2:IsValid() and h2.components.useableitem ~= nil then
                if h2:HasTag("inuse") or h2:HasTag("hide") then
                    return h2
                end
                -- Load/transition: HEAD armor can be INLIMBO while bush listener still fires.
                if item ~= nil and item.components.useableitem == nil and item:HasTag("INLIMBO") then
                    return h2
                end
                if item == nil then
                    if h2:HasTag("inuse") or h2:HasTag("hide") then
                        return h2
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return item
    end

    local _Equip = self.Equip
    function self:Equip(item, old_to_active, no_animation, force_ui_anim)
        if item ~= nil and item.components.equippable ~= nil then
            AssignEquipSlot(self, item)
        end

        local ok = _Equip(self, item, old_to_active, no_animation, force_ui_anim)

        if ok and item ~= nil and item:IsValid() and item.components.equippable ~= nil then
            local eslot = item.components.equippable.equipslot
            if eslot == EQUIPSLOTS.BACKPACK and item.components.container ~= nil then
                item.components.container:Open(self.inst)
                self.inst:PushEvent("setoverflow", { overflow = item })
            end
            if IsRenderRelevantSlot(eslot) then
                OnEquipVisual(self.inst, item)
            end
            -- SoftRefresh of armor/clothes must not leave backpack closed.
            EnsureBackpackOverflowActive(self.inst)
        end
        return ok
    end

    local _Unequip = self.Unequip
    function self:Unequip(equipslot, slip, force)
        local item = _Unequip(self, equipslot, slip, force)
        if equipslot == EQUIPSLOTS.BACKPACK then
            self.inst:PushEvent("setoverflow", {})
        end
        if item ~= nil and item:IsValid() and item.components.equippable ~= nil then
            ApplyKindSlot(item.components.equippable, GetEquipKind(item))
        end
        if IsRenderRelevantSlot(equipslot) then
            OnUnequipVisual(self.inst, equipslot)
        end
        if equipslot ~= EQUIPSLOTS.BACKPACK then
            EnsureBackpackOverflowActive(self.inst)
        end
        return item
    end

    self.GetOverflowContainer = GetBackpackOverflow
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:equippable

AddComponentPostInit("equippable", function(self)
    self.inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function(inst)
        if inst:IsValid() then
            ApplyDefaultSlot(inst)
        end
    end)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:setbonus
-- so armor-side misroutes still form sets without breaking HEAD+BODY.
AddComponentPostInit("setbonus", function(self)
    function self:_HasSetBonus(inventory)
        local heads = {
            inventory.equipslots[EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD],
            inventory.equipslots[EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD2],
        }
        local bodies = {
            inventory.equipslots[EQUIPSLOTS.BODY],
            inventory.equipslots[EQUIPSLOTS.BODY2],
        }
        for _, head in ipairs(heads) do
            if head ~= nil and head.components.setbonus ~= nil then
                for _, body in ipairs(bodies) do
                    if body ~= nil
                        and body.components.setbonus ~= nil
                        and head.components.setbonus.setname == body.components.setbonus.setname then
                        return true, head.components.setbonus.setname
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:inventory_classified

AddPrefabPostInit("inventory_classified", function(inst)
    local function ApplyOverflowOverride()
        inst.GetOverflowContainer = ClientGetOverflowContainer
        for _, key in ipairs({
            "ReceiveItem",
            "GetOverflowContainer",
            "Has",
            "HasItemWithTag",
            "IsFull",
            "IsOpenedBy",
        }) do
            PatchOverflowUpvalues(inst[key], ClientGetOverflowContainer)
        end
        -- Catch any other attached fns that close over GetOverflowContainer.
        for _, v in pairs(inst) do
            if type(v) == "function" then
                PatchOverflowUpvalues(v, ClientGetOverflowContainer)
            end
        end
    end

    ApplyOverflowOverride()
    inst:DoTaskInTime(0, ApplyOverflowOverride)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HUD equip slots
-- Register slots BEFORE Rebuild, then force-fit the wooden background.
-- Vanilla only SetScale(1.22); without Image:Flow the bar stays too narrow.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
local INV_W = 68
local INV_SEP = 12
local INV_INTERSEP = 28

local function CalcInventoryBarWidth(num_slots, num_equip, num_buttons)
    local num_slotintersep = math.ceil(num_slots / 5)
    local num_equipintersep = num_buttons > 0 and 1 or 0
    return (num_slots + num_equip + num_buttons) * INV_W
        + (num_slots + num_equip + num_buttons - num_slotintersep - num_equipintersep - 1) * INV_SEP
        + (num_slotintersep + num_equipintersep) * INV_INTERSEP
end

local function FitInventoryBarBackground(invbar)
    if invbar == nil or invbar.bg == nil or invbar.owner == nil then
        return
    end
    local inventory = invbar.owner.replica and invbar.owner.replica.inventory or nil
    if inventory == nil or invbar.equipslotinfo == nil then
        return
    end

    local num_slots = inventory:GetNumSlots()
    local num_equip = #invbar.equipslotinfo
    local num_buttons = invbar.inspectcontrol ~= nil and 1 or 0
    local total_w = CalcInventoryBarWidth(num_slots, num_equip, num_buttons)

    if invbar.bg.Flow ~= nil then
        invbar.bg:Flow(total_w + 60, 256, true)
    end

    -- Reference scale 1.22 is vanilla self-inspect for 15 inv + 3 equip + 1 button.
    local ref_w = CalcInventoryBarWidth(15, 3, 1)
    local scale = ((total_w + 60) / (ref_w + 60)) * 1.22
    invbar.bg:SetScale(scale, 1, 1)
    if invbar.bgcover ~= nil and invbar.bgcover.SetScale ~= nil then
        if invbar.bgcover.Flow ~= nil then
            invbar.bgcover:Flow(total_w + 60, 256, true)
        end
        invbar.bgcover:SetScale(scale, 1, 1)
    end
end

local function EnsureExtraEquipSlots(invbar)
    if invbar == nil or invbar.equipslotinfo == nil then
        return false
    end
    if invbar._ees_slots_added then
        return false
    end
    invbar._ees_slots_added = true

    -- sortkey after vanilla HANDS/BODY/HEAD (0/1/2)
    invbar:AddEquipSlot(EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD2, HUD_ATLAS, "equip_slot_head.tex", 3)
    invbar:AddEquipSlot(EQUIPSLOTS.BODY2, HUD_ATLAS, "equip_slot_body.tex", 4)
    invbar:AddEquipSlot(EQUIPSLOTS.BACKPACK, HUD_ATLAS, "equip_slot_body.tex", 5)
    invbar:AddEquipSlot(EQUIPSLOTS.AMULET, HUD_ATLAS, "equip_slot_body.tex", 6)
    return true
end

AddClassPostConstruct("widgets/inventorybar", function(self)
    -- Add as early as possible (constructor already added HANDS/BODY/HEAD).
    EnsureExtraEquipSlots(self)

    local _Rebuild = self.Rebuild
    function self:Rebuild(...)
        EnsureExtraEquipSlots(self)
        local ret = _Rebuild(self, ...)
        FitInventoryBarBackground(self)
        return ret
    end

    local _Refresh = self.Refresh
    if _Refresh ~= nil then
        function self:Refresh(...)
            local ret = _Refresh(self, ...)
            FitInventoryBarBackground(self)
            return ret
        end
    end

    self.inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        if self.Rebuild ~= nil then
            self.rebuild_pending = true
        end
    end)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Vanilla exception gear: callbacks that hardcode EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD/BODY.
-- Retarget to the actual equipped instance so HEAD2/BODY2 never crash
-- vanilla (bush + armor hat was the known NPE).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function BlockListenDuring(inst, owner, should_block, call)
    local _ListenForEvent = inst.ListenForEvent
    inst.ListenForEvent = function(self, event, fn, source)
        if should_block(event, source) then
            return
        end
        return _ListenForEvent(self, event, fn, source)
    end
    call()
    inst.ListenForEvent = _ListenForEvent
end

-- Prefab -> SG state name while the item is actively used (skip StopUsing there).
local USEABLE_IDLE_STATE = {
    bushhat = "hide",
    plantregistryhat = "plantregistry_open",
    nutrientsgoggleshat = "plantregistry_open",
    inspectacleshat = "inspectacles_open",
}

local function PatchUseableEquippable(inst, idle_statename)
    local eq = inst.components.equippable
    if eq == nil or eq.onequipfn == nil or inst._ees_useable_patched then
        return
    end
    inst._ees_useable_patched = true

    local vanilla_onequip = eq.onequipfn
    local vanilla_onunequip = eq.onunequipfn

    local function stopusing(owner, data)
        if data == nil then
            return
        end
        if idle_statename ~= nil and data.statename == idle_statename then
            return
        end
        -- Generic: only stop while marked in use (covers hats without a mapped idle state).
        if idle_statename == nil and not inst:HasTag("inuse") then
            return
        end
        if not inst:IsValid() or inst.components.useableitem == nil then
            return
        end
        if eq:IsEquipped() then
            inst.components.useableitem:StopUsingItem()
        end
    end

    eq.onequipfn = function(i, owner, from_ground)
        BlockListenDuring(i, owner, function(event, source)
            return event == "newstate" and source == owner
        end, function()
            vanilla_onequip(i, owner, from_ground)
        end)
        i:ListenForEvent("newstate", stopusing, owner)
        i._ees_stopusing = stopusing
    end

    eq.onunequipfn = function(i, owner)
        if i._ees_stopusing ~= nil then
            i:RemoveEventCallback("newstate", i._ees_stopusing, owner)
            i._ees_stopusing = nil
        end
        if vanilla_onunequip ~= nil then
            vanilla_onunequip(i, owner)
        end
    end
end

-- Auto-patch every useableitem that can be a hat (covers future vanilla hats too).
-- Prefer immediate patch so equip does not register the vanilla newstate listener first.

        local slot = inst.components.equippable.equipslot
        local is_head = slot == EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD
            or slot == EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD2
            or inst:HasTag("hat")
            or inst:HasTag("hide")
        if not is_head then
            return
        end
        PatchUseableEquippable(inst, USEABLE_IDLE_STATE[inst.prefab])
    end
    try_patch()
    if not inst._ees_useable_patched then
        inst:DoTaskInTime(0, try_patch)
    end
end)

-- moon mushroom retaliation looks up HEAD only.
AddPrefabPostInit("moon_mushroomhat", function(inst)
    if not GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim then
        return
    end
    inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        if not inst:IsValid() then
            return
        end
        local eq = inst.components.equippable
        if eq == nil or eq.onequipfn == nil or inst._ees_moon_patched then
            return
        end
        inst._ees_moon_patched = true
        local vanilla_onequip = eq.onequipfn
        local vanilla_onunequip = eq.onunequipfn
        local TUNING = GLOBAL.TUNING

        local function tryspawn(hat)
            local periodicspawner = hat.components.periodicspawner
            if periodicspawner == nil then
                hat._moonspore_tryspawn_count = nil
                return
            end
            periodicspawner:TrySpawn()
            hat._moonspore_tryspawn_count = (hat._moonspore_tryspawn_count or 1) - 1
            if hat._moonspore_tryspawn_count <= 0 then
                hat._moonspore_tryspawn_count = nil
                return
            end
            hat:DoTaskInTime(TUNING.MUSHROOMHAT_MOONSPORE_RETALIATION_SPORE_DELAY, tryspawn)
        end

        local function onattacked(owner, data)
            if not inst:IsValid() or not eq:IsEquipped() then
                return
            end
            if inst._moonspore_tryspawn_count == nil then
                inst:DoTaskInTime(TUNING.MUSHROOMHAT_MOONSPORE_RETALIATION_SPORE_DELAY, tryspawn)
            end
            inst._moonspore_tryspawn_count = TUNING.MUSHROOMHAT_MOONSPORE_RETALIATION_SPORE_COUNT
        end

        eq.onequipfn = function(i, owner, from_ground)
            BlockListenDuring(i, owner, function(event, source)
                return event == "attacked" and source == owner
            end, function()
                vanilla_onequip(i, owner, from_ground)
            end)
            i:ListenForEvent("attacked", onattacked, owner)
            i._ees_onattacked = onattacked
        end

        eq.onunequipfn = function(i, owner)
            if i._ees_onattacked ~= nil then
                i:RemoveEventCallback("attacked", i._ees_onattacked, owner)
                i._ees_onattacked = nil
            end
            if vanilla_onunequip ~= nil then
                vanilla_onunequip(i, owner)
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- Red amulet rebirth SG: consume from AMULET (or legacy body slots).
local function FindEquippedAmulet(inv, prefab)
    if inv == nil then
        return nil
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs({ EQUIPSLOTS.AMULET, EQUIPSLOTS.BODY, EQUIPSLOTS.BODY2 }) do
        local item = inv:GetEquippedItem(slot)
        if item ~= nil and (prefab == nil or item.prefab == prefab) and IsAmulet(item) then
            return item
        end
    end
end

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
    local state = sg.states["amulet_rebirth"]
    if state == nil or state.onexit == nil then
        return
    end
    local _onexit = state.onexit
    state.onexit = function(inst)
        local item = FindEquippedAmulet(inst.components.inventory, "amulet")
        if item ~= nil then
            item = inst.components.inventory:RemoveItem(item)
            if item ~= nil then
                item:Remove()
                item.persists = false
            end
        end
        _onexit(inst)
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Migrate old BODY-equipped packs/amulets into dedicated slots after load
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function MigrateEquips(inst)
    if not GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim or inst.components.inventory == nil then
        return
    end
    local inv = inst.components.inventory
    -- Use raw equipslots so GetEquippedItem HEAD redirects do not confuse migration.
    local slots = inv.equipslots

    local body = slots[EQUIPSLOTS.BODY]
    if body ~= nil and IsBackpack(body) and slots[EQUIPSLOTS.BACKPACK] == nil then
        inv:Unequip(EQUIPSLOTS.BODY)
        body.components.equippable.equipslot = EQUIPSLOTS.BACKPACK
        inv:Equip(body)
    elseif body ~= nil and IsAmulet(body) and slots[EQUIPSLOTS.AMULET] == nil then
        inv:Unequip(EQUIPSLOTS.BODY)
        body.components.equippable.equipslot = EQUIPSLOTS.AMULET
        inv:Equip(body)
    end

    local body2 = slots[EQUIPSLOTS.BODY2]
    if body2 ~= nil and IsBackpack(body2) and slots[EQUIPSLOTS.BACKPACK] == nil then
        inv:Unequip(EQUIPSLOTS.BODY2)
        body2.components.equippable.equipslot = EQUIPSLOTS.BACKPACK
        inv:Equip(body2)
    end

    -- Non-armor head still stuck on HEAD -> HEAD2, etc.
    local head = slots[EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD]
    if head ~= nil and not IsArmor(head) and slots[EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD2] == nil then
        inv:Unequip(EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD)
        head.components.equippable.equipslot = EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD2
        inv:Equip(head)
    end

    -- Clears stale vanilla bush/plantregistry newstate listeners from saves / late patch.
    local h2 = slots[EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD2]
    if h2 ~= nil and h2:IsValid() and h2.components.useableitem ~= nil and not h2._ees_useable_rebound then
        h2._ees_useable_rebound = true
        PatchUseableEquippable(h2, USEABLE_IDLE_STATE[h2.prefab])
        inv:Unequip(EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD2)
        if h2:IsValid() then
            inv:Equip(h2)
        end
    end

    RefreshEquipmentVisuals(inst)
end

AddPlayerPostInit(function(inst)
    if GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim then
        -- Early pass: stop crash-loop from stale bush listeners before first newstate burst.
        inst:DoTaskInTime(0, MigrateEquips)
        inst:DoTaskInTime(1, MigrateEquips)
    end
end)

print("[Extra Equip Slots] vanilla-safe slots + HUD fit + render priority")

            or inst:HasTag("hide")
        if not is_head then
            return
        end
        PatchUseableEquippable(inst, USEABLE_IDLE_STATE[inst.prefab])
    end
    try_patch()
    if not inst._ees_useable_patched then
        inst:DoTaskInTime(0, try_patch)

end)
```

### 变体演进：Clockwork Parking (Mod 3813295767)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3813295767 (`Clockwork Parking`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3813295767)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat
-- Protect allied targets from clockwork hits, including already-fired projectiles.
AddComponentPostInit("combat",function(combat)
    local attacked=combat.GetAttacked
    combat.GetAttacked=function(self,attacker,...)
        if attacker and attacker.components and attacker.components.clockworkparking
            and parking.Friendly(attacker,self.inst) then return false end
        return attacked(self,attacker,...)
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:workable
-- Rook collision damage uses workable:Destroy, independently of combat.
AddComponentPostInit("workable", function(component)
    component.inst:ListenForEvent("onbuilt", function() component.inst:AddTag("cw_playerbuilt") end)
    local save, load = component.OnSave, component.OnLoad
    component.OnSave = function(self)
        local data, refs
        if save then data, refs = save(self) end
        if self.inst:HasTag("cw_playerbuilt") then
            data = data or {}; data.cw_playerbuilt = true
        end
        return data, refs
    end
    component.OnLoad = function(self, data)
        if load then load(self, data) end
        if data and data.cw_playerbuilt then self.inst:AddTag("cw_playerbuilt") end
    end
    local destroy = component.Destroy
    component.Destroy = function(self, worker, ...)
        if worker and worker._cw_tree_charge and (not self.inst:HasTag("tree") or self:GetWorkAction()~=G.ACTIONS.CHOP or parking.ProtectedScenery(self.inst)) then return end
        if parking.rook_protection and parking.IsFollowerRook(worker) and parking.ProtectedScenery(self.inst) then return end
        return destroy(self, worker, ...)
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playercontroller
-- Scope the filter to this search so force attacks and other combat checks still work.
AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller",function(controller)
    local original=controller.GetAttackTarget
    controller.GetAttackTarget=function(self,force_attack,force_target,...)
        local combat=self.inst.replica and self.inst.replica.combat
        if not parking.hide_owned_attack or force_attack or not combat then
            return original(self,force_attack,force_target,...)
        end
        if IsOwnedClockwork(self.inst,force_target) then force_target=nil end
        local cantarget=combat.CanTarget
        combat.CanTarget=function(c,target,...)
            if IsOwnedClockwork(self.inst,target) then return false end
            return cantarget(c,target,...)
        end
        local ok,target=G.pcall(original,self,force_attack,force_target,...)
        combat.CanTarget=cantarget
        if not ok then G.error(target,0) end
        return target
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playeractionpicker
-- Preserve inspection/Insight information when hiding the normal mouse attack.
AddComponentPostInit("playeractionpicker",function(picker)
    local original=picker.GetLeftClickActions
    picker.GetLeftClickActions=function(self,position,target,...)
        local actions=original(self,position,target,...)
        local controller=self.inst.components and self.inst.components.playercontroller
        local forced=controller and controller:IsControlPressed(G.CONTROL_FORCE_ATTACK)
        if parking.hide_owned_attack and not forced and IsOwnedClockwork(self.inst,target) then
            for i=#actions,1,-1 do
                if actions[i].action==G.ACTIONS.ATTACK then
                    -- Preserve a targeted primary action for native/Insight hover information.
                    actions[i]=G.BufferedAction(self.inst,target,G.ACTIONS.LOOKAT)
                end
            end
        end
        return actions
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:arrowsign_post_placer
local ranges = require("clockworkparking_range")
AddPrefabPostInit("arrowsign_post_placer", function(inst) ranges.Attach(inst, function() return parking.base_radius end, true) end)
AddPrefabPostInit("arrowsign_post", function(inst) ranges.Attach(inst, function() return parking.base_radius end, false) end)

local toggle = AddAction("CW_TOGGLE", "Park", function(act)
    local c = act.target and act.target.components.clockworkparking
    if not parking.individual_toggle or not c or not c:IsOwner(act.doer) then return false end
    if c.parked then return c:Follow(true) else c:Park(act.target:GetPosition()); c.resume_active = false; c.auto_exempt = nil; c.pending_recall = nil end
    return true
end)
toggle.strfn = function(act) return act.target:HasTag("cw_parked") and "FOLLOW" or "PARK" end
G.STRINGS.ACTIONS.CW_TOGGLE = { PARK = "Park", FOLLOW = "Follow" }

local command = AddAction("CW_ARMY", "Park army here", function(act)
    return parking.Command(act.target, act.doer)
end)
command.strfn = function(act)
    if act.target.prefab == "arrowsign_post" then
        return act.target:HasTag("cw_auto_enabled") and "AUTOOFF" or "AUTOON"
    end
    return act.target:HasTag("cw_army_parked") and "RECALL" or "PARK"
end
G.STRINGS.ACTIONS.CW_ARMY = { PARK = "Park army here", RECALL = "Recall army", AUTOON = "Enable base parking", AUTOOFF = "Disable base parking / recall" }

AddComponentAction("SCENE", "inspectable", function(inst, doer, actions, right)
    if not right then return end
    if inst:HasTag("cw_clockwork") then
        if parking.individual_toggle and inst._cw_owner and inst._cw_owner:value() == doer.userid then table.insert(actions, G.ACTIONS.CW_TOGGLE) end
    elseif inst:HasTag("cw_parking_sign") then
        table.insert(actions, G.ACTIONS.CW_ARMY)
    end
end)
for _, sg in ipairs({ "wilson", "wilson_client" }) do
    AddStategraphActionHandler(sg, G.ActionHandler(toggle, "doshortaction"))
    AddStategraphActionHandler(sg, G.ActionHandler(command, "doshortaction"))
end

for _, prefab in ipairs({ "knight", "knight_nightmare", "bishop", "bishop_nightmare", "rook", "rook_nightmare" }) do
    AddPrefabPostInit(prefab, function(inst)
        inst:AddTag("cw_clockwork")
        inst._cw_owner = G.net_string(inst.GUID, "clockworkparking.owner", "cwownerdirty")
        if not G.TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
        inst:AddComponent("clockworkparking")
        parking.ProtectCombat(inst)
        if parking.IsFollowerRook(inst) or prefab=="rook" or prefab=="rook_nightmare" then inst:DoPeriodicTask(.25,function() forestry.Update(inst) end) end
    end)
end
for _, prefab in ipairs({ "homesign", "arrowsign_post" }) do
    AddPrefabPostInit(prefab, function(inst)
        inst:AddTag("cw_parking_sign")
        inst._cw_offsetx=G.net_float(inst.GUID,"clockworkparking.offsetx","cwoffsetdirty")
        inst._cw_offsetz=G.net_float(inst.GUID,"clockworkparking.offsetz","cwoffsetdirty")
        if prefab=="arrowsign_post" then inst._cw_camera_heading=G.net_float(inst.GUID,"clockworkparking.camera_heading","cwoffsetdirty") end
        if G.TheWorld.ismastersim then inst:AddComponent("clockworkstation") end
    end)
end
AddPlayerPostInit(function(inst)
    if not G.TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
    inst:ListenForEvent("attacked", function(_, data) parking.Defend(inst, data) end)
    inst:ListenForEvent("working",function(_,data) forestry.Work(inst,data) end)
    inst:DoTaskInTime(3, function() parking.Bootstrap(inst) end)
    inst:DoPeriodicTask(1, function() parking.AutoPark(inst) end)
end)

-- Brain starts inside the native prefab before our parking component exists.
-- Always install the movement wrapper and resolve the component at execution.
for _, name in ipairs({ "knightbrain", "bishopbrain", "rookbrain" }) do
    AddBrainPostInit(name, function(brain)
        require("clockworkparking_brain").Install(brain, G, parking, forestry)
    end)
end
```

### 变体演进：【附魔-强化】 (Mod 3096210166)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3096210166 (`【附魔-强化】`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3096210166)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:health
end
AddComponentPostInit("health", function(self)
    self["hh_base_max"] = 0
    local oldSetMaxHealth = self["SetMaxHealth"]
    self["SetMaxHealth"] = function(self, amount, ...)
        self["hh_base_max"] = amount
        oldSetMaxHealth(self, amount, ...)
        self["inst"]:PushEvent("hh_change_max_health")
    end
    local oldDoDelta = self["DoDelta"]
    self["DoDelta"] = function(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ...)
        --制裁效果
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number")
                and amount > 0
        then
            if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:HasSpecialEffect("healthSuppressNum") then
                amount = amount * 0.1
            end
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number")
                and amount > 0
        then
            if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:HasSpecialEffect("healthSuppressNum") then
                amount = amount * 0.1
            end
        end
        local result = 0
        if oldDoDelta then
            result = oldDoDelta(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ...)
        end
        --攻击力大于0才能吸血
        if HH_UTILS:IsValidCombat(self["inst"]) then
            --吸血效果
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(afflicter, "hh_player") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(result, "number") and result < 0 then
                afflicter["components"]["hh_player"]:HandleBloodSuck(result)
            end
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(afflicter, "hh_monster") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(result, "number") and result < 0 then
                afflicter["components"]["hh_monster"]:HandleBloodSuck(result)
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    ----
    ---单独的真伤方法
    ---@param self:父类
    ---@param amount:伤害-必须为负值
    ---@param attacker:攻击者
    ---@param cause:伤害类型-中文显示
    ---
    self["DoHHDelta"] = function(self, amount, attacker, cause)
        if not HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number") or amount >= 0
                or not HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "combat")
        then
            return false
        end
        local old_percent = self:GetPercent()
        --官方限伤
        if self["maxdamagetakenperhit"] ~= nil and amount < self["maxdamagetakenperhit"] and not self["_ignore_maxdamagetakenperhit"] then
            amount = self["maxdamagetakenperhit"]
        end
        if HH_UTILS:IsHHType(cause, "string") then
            HH_UTILS:SpawnClientStrFx(self["inst"], cause)
        end
        local hh_cause = "hh_true_damage"
        self:SetVal(self["currenthealth"] + amount, hh_cause, attacker)
        --推送事件同步客机
        self["inst"]:PushEvent("healthdelta", {
            ["oldpercent"] = old_percent,
            ["newpercent"] = self:GetPercent(),
            ["overtime"] = nil,
            ["cause"] = hh_cause,
            ["afflicter"] = attacker,
            ["amount"] = amount
        })
        --实体死亡推送事件 用于兼容击杀掉落
        if self:IsDead() then
            attacker:PushEvent("killed", {
                ["victim"] = self["inst"],
                ["attacker"] = attacker
            })
            --兼容影怪san掉落
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "combat")
                    and self["inst"]["components"]["combat"]["onkilledbyother"]
            then
                self["inst"]["components"]["combat"]["onkilledbyother"](self["inst"], attacker)
            end
        end
        return true
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat

AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
    local oldGetAttacked_Internal = self["GetAttacked_Internal"]
    self["GetAttacked_Internal"] = function(self, attacker, damage, ...)
        local hh_inst = self["inst"]
        if attacker and attacker["prefab"] == "abigail"
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "follower")
                and attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
        then
            --温蒂
            local wendy = attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            --随从享受人物固定增伤
            local extra_leader_damage = wendy["components"]["hh_player"]:DoAttackDamage(wendy, hh_inst, damage, true)
            damage = extra_leader_damage
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "hh_player") then
            damage = attacker["components"]["hh_player"]:DoAttackDamage(attacker, self["inst"], damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "hh_monster") then
            damage = attacker["components"]["hh_monster"]:DoAttackDamage(attacker, self["inst"], damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") then
            damage = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:GetBlockDamage(self["inst"], attacker, damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") then
            damage = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:GetBlockDamage(self["inst"], attacker, damage)
        end
        --随从强化
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "follower") and attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
        then
            local atk_leader = attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            damage = atk_leader["components"]["hh_player"]:GetFollowerDamage(damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "follower") and self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
        then
            local inst_leader = self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            damage = inst_leader["components"]["hh_player"]:GetFollowerArmor(damage)
        end
        damage = math["max"](damage, 0)
        return oldGetAttacked_Internal(self, attacker, damage, ...)
    end
    self["GetBrambleFx"] = function(self, attacker, amount)
        if not HH_UTILS:NotIsDead(self["inst"]) then
            return false
        end
        if self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd"] then
            return false
        end
        --建筑不会受到反伤效果
        if self["inst"]:HasTag("structure") then
            return false
        end
        --反甲增加cd
        self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd"] = true
        if not self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd_task"] then
            self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd_task"] = self["inst"]:DoTaskInTime(0.3, function(hh_inst)
                hh_inst["hh_bramble_cd"] = false
                HH_UTILS:HHKillTask(hh_inst, "hh_bramble_cd_task")
            end)
        end
        if not HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number") then
            return false
        end
        --小于0不做处理
        if amount <= 0 then
            return false
        end
        if attacker and HH_UTILS:NotIsDead(attacker) then
            HH_UTILS:SpawnBrambleFx(attacker)
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") then
                if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:HasSpecialEffect("immuneBramble") then
                    return true
                end
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:GetHitByBrambleFxDamage(amount)
            end
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") then
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:GetHitByBrambleFxDamage(amount)
            end
            --处理各自的减伤
            amount = amount * self["externaldamagetakenmultipliers"]:Get()
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "inventory") then
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["inventory"]:ApplyDamage(amount, attacker)
            end
            if amount > 0 then
                self["inst"]["components"]["health"]:DoDelta(-amount, false, "hh_bramble_damage")
                self:SetTarget(attacker)
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end)
```

### 变体演进：【附魔2.0-重制版】 (Mod 3709314660)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3709314660 (`【附魔2.0-重制版】`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3709314660)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:edible
---
AddComponentPostInit("edible", function(self)
    local oldGetSanity = self["GetSanity"]
    self["GetSanity"] = function(_self, eater, ...)
        local old_value = oldGetSanity and oldGetSanity(_self, eater, ...) or 0
        local new_value = hookEdible(eater, "sanity", old_value)
        return new_value
    end
    local oldGetHunger = self["GetHunger"]
    self["GetHunger"] = function(_self, eater, ...)
        local old_value = oldGetHunger and oldGetHunger(_self, eater, ...) or 0
        local new_value = hookEdible(eater, "hunger", old_value)
        return new_value
    end
    local oldGetHealth = self["GetHealth"]
    self["GetHealth"] = function(_self, eater, ...)
        local old_value = oldGetHealth and oldGetHealth(_self, eater, ...) or 0
        local new_value = hookEdible(eater, "health", old_value)
        return new_value
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:health

AddComponentPostInit("health", function(self)
    self["hh_base_max"] = 0
    local oldSetMaxHealth = self["SetMaxHealth"]
    self["SetMaxHealth"] = function(self, amount, ...)
        self["hh_base_max"] = amount
        oldSetMaxHealth(self, amount, ...)
        self["inst"]:PushEvent("hh_change_max_health")
    end
    local oldDoDelta = self["DoDelta"]
    self["DoDelta"] = function(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ...)
        --制裁效果
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number")
                and amount > 0
        then
            if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:HasSpecialEffect("healthSuppressNum") then
                amount = amount * 0.1
            end
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number")
                and amount > 0
        then
            if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:HasSpecialEffect("healthSuppressNum") then
                amount = amount * 0.1
            end
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number")
                and amount > 0
        then
            local wound_heal_bonus = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:GetEffectValueByKey("woundHealBonus")
            if wound_heal_bonus > 0 then
                amount = amount * (1 + wound_heal_bonus / 100)
            end
            amount = applyRestRecoverBonus(self["inst"], amount)
        end
        local result = 0
        if oldDoDelta then
            result = oldDoDelta(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ...)
        end
        --攻击力大于0才能吸血
        if HH_UTILS:IsValidCombat(self["inst"]) then
            --吸血效果
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(afflicter, "hh_player") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(result, "number") and result < 0 then
                afflicter["components"]["hh_player"]:HandleBloodSuck(result)
            end
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(afflicter, "hh_monster") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(result, "number") and result < 0 then
                afflicter["components"]["hh_monster"]:HandleBloodSuck(result)
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    ----
    ---单独的真伤方法
    ---@param self:父类
    ---@param amount:伤害-必须为负值
    ---@param attacker:攻击者
    ---@param cause:伤害类型-中文显示
    ---
    self["DoHHDelta"] = function(self, amount, attacker, cause)
        if not HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number") or amount >= 0
                or not canApplyHHTrueDamage(self)
                or not HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "combat")
        then
            return false
        end
        local old_percent = self:GetPercent()
        --官方限伤
        if self["maxdamagetakenperhit"] ~= nil and amount < self["maxdamagetakenperhit"] and not self["_ignore_maxdamagetakenperhit"] then
            amount = self["maxdamagetakenperhit"]
        end
        if HH_UTILS:IsHHType(cause, "string") then
            HH_UTILS:SpawnClientStrFx(self["inst"], cause)
        end
        local hh_cause = "hh_true_damage"
        self:SetVal(self["currenthealth"] + amount, hh_cause, attacker)
        --推送事件同步客机
        self["inst"]:PushEvent("healthdelta", {
            ["oldpercent"] = old_percent,
            ["newpercent"] = self:GetPercent(),
            ["overtime"] = nil,
            ["cause"] = hh_cause,
            ["afflicter"] = attacker,
            ["amount"] = amount
        })
        --实体死亡推送事件 用于兼容击杀掉落
        if self:IsDead() then
            attacker:PushEvent("killed", {
                ["victim"] = self["inst"],
                ["attacker"] = attacker
            })
            --兼容影怪san掉落
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "combat")
                    and self["inst"]["components"]["combat"]["onkilledbyother"]
            then
                self["inst"]["components"]["combat"]["onkilledbyother"](self["inst"], attacker)
            end
        end
        return true
    end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self)
    local oldDropItem = self["DropItem"]
    self["DropItem"] = function(self, item, ...)
        if shouldPreventDisarm(self["inst"], item) then
            HH_UTILS:SpawnClientStrFx(self["inst"], "免疫脱手")
            return false
        end
        if oldDropItem then
            return oldDropItem(self, item, ...)
        end
    end
    local oldDropEquipped = self["DropEquipped"]
    if oldDropEquipped then
        self["DropEquipped"] = function(self, equip, ...)
            local item = equip
            if HH_UTILS:IsHHType(equip, "string") and self["GetEquippedItem"] then
                item = self:GetEquippedItem(equip)
            end
            if shouldPreventDisarm(self["inst"], item) then
                HH_UTILS:SpawnClientStrFx(self["inst"], "免疫脱手")
                return false
            end
            return oldDropEquipped(self, equip, ...)
        end
    end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
    -- 759423+: melee, area attacks and redirects use the internal entry point.
    -- Hook only one entry point so public GetAttacked calls are not scaled twice.
    local attacked_method = type(self["GetAttacked_Internal"]) == "function" and "GetAttacked_Internal" or "GetAttacked"
    local oldGetAttacked = self[attacked_method]
    self[attacked_method] = function(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...)
        -- nil damage is a vanilla notification/redirect, not a damaging hit.
        if damage == nil then
            return oldGetAttacked(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...)
        end
        local hh_inst = self["inst"]
        if self["redirected_from"] == nil then
            if attacker and attacker["prefab"] == "abigail"
                    and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "follower")
                    and attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                    and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
            then
                --温蒂
                local wendy = attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                --随从享受人物固定增伤
                local extra_leader_damage = wendy["components"]["hh_player"]:DoAttackDamage(wendy, hh_inst, damage, true)
                damage = extra_leader_damage
            end
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "hh_player") then
                damage = attacker["components"]["hh_player"]:DoAttackDamage(attacker, self["inst"], damage)
            end
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "hh_monster") then
                damage = attacker["components"]["hh_monster"]:DoAttackDamage(attacker, self["inst"], damage)
            end
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") then
            damage = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:GetBlockDamage(self["inst"], attacker, damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") then
            damage = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:GetBlockDamage(self["inst"], attacker, damage)
        end
        --随从强化
        if self["redirected_from"] == nil
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "follower") and attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
        then
            local atk_leader = attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            damage = atk_leader["components"]["hh_player"]:GetFollowerDamage(damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "follower") and self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
        then
            local inst_leader = self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            damage = inst_leader["components"]["hh_player"]:GetFollowerArmor(damage)
        end
        -- Vanilla marks redirected hits (mounts and multi-part creatures).
        -- Their outgoing bonuses were already applied at the first target.
        if self["redirected_from"] ~= nil and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "hh_player") then
            for _, key in ipairs({ "hh_pending_true_damage_lock", "hh_pending_damage_floor" }) do
                local pending = attacker[key]
                if pending and pending["target"] == self["redirected_from"] then
                    pending["target"] = self["inst"]
                end
            end
        end
        damage = math["max"](damage, 0)
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "hh_player") and attacker["hh_pending_true_damage_lock"] then
            damage = 0
            spdamage = nil
        end
        local old_health = HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "health") and self["inst"]["components"]["health"]["currenthealth"] or nil
        local result = packCombatResults(oldGetAttacked(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...))
        applyPendingDamageFloor(attacker, self["inst"], old_health)
        applyPendingTrueDamageLock(attacker, self["inst"])
        return unpack(result, 1, result.n)
    end
    self["GetBrambleFx"] = function(self, attacker, amount)
        if not HH_UTILS:NotIsDead(self["inst"]) then
            return false
        end
        if self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd"] then
            return false
        end
        --建筑不会受到反伤效果
        if self["inst"]:HasTag("structure") then
            return false
        end
        --反甲增加cd
        self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd"] = true
        if not self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd_task"] then
            self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd_task"] = self["inst"]:DoTaskInTime(0.3, function(hh_inst)
                hh_inst["hh_bramble_cd"] = false
                HH_UTILS:HHKillTask(hh_inst, "hh_bramble_cd_task")
            end)
        end
        if not HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number") then
            return false
        end
        --小于0不做处理
        if amount <= 0 then
            return false
        end
        if attacker and HH_UTILS:NotIsDead(attacker) then
            HH_UTILS:SpawnBrambleFx(attacker)
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") then
                if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:HasSpecialEffect("immuneBramble") then
                    return true
                end
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:GetHitByBrambleFxDamage(amount)
            end
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") then
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:GetHitByBrambleFxDamage(amount)
            end
            --处理各自的减伤
            amount = amount * self["externaldamagetakenmultipliers"]:Get()
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "inventory") then
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["inventory"]:ApplyDamage(amount, attacker)
            end
            if amount > 0 then
                self["inst"]["components"]["health"]:DoDelta(-amount, false, "hh_bramble_damage")
                self:SetTarget(attacker)
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end)

AddComponentPostInit("freezable", function(self)

    self["Freeze"] = function(self, ...)
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") then

local function draw(inst)
    if inst["components"]["drawable"] then
        local oldOnDrawnFn = inst["components"]["drawable"]["ondrawnfn"] or nil
        inst["components"]["drawable"]["ondrawnfn"] = function(_inst, image, src, atlas, bgimagename, bgatlasname, ...)
            if oldOnDrawnFn ~= nil then
                oldOnDrawnFn(_inst, image, src, atlas, bgimagename, bgatlasname, ...)
            end
            if HH_UTILS:IsHHType(image, "string") and
                    (mini_sign_liat[image] or TUNING["HH_SKIN_CONFIG"][image]) then
                --是我的物品
                if atlas == nil then
                    if mini_sign_liat[image] then
                        atlas = mini_sign_liat[image]
                    elseif TUNING["HH_SKIN_CONFIG"][image] then
                        --皮肤兼容
                        atlas = TUNING["HH_SKIN_CONFIG"][image]
                    end
                end
                local atlas_path = resolvefilepath_soft(atlas)
                if atlas_path then
                    _inst["AnimState"]:OverrideSymbol("SWAP_SIGN", atlas_path, string["format"]("%s.tex", image))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function AddSpecialEquipEffectFn(effect_id, data)
    if not (HH_UTILS:IsHHType(effect_id, "string") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(data, "table")) then
        print("增加词条错误，请按照文档进行正常操作参数")
```
