```lua
    end
    if HH_EQUIP_EFFECT[effect_id] then
        print("已存在相同的索引词条，请修改词条id进行添加")
        return
    end
    local effect_name = data["name"] or "词条前缀"
    HH_EQUIP_EFFECT[effect_id] = {
        ["id"] = start_id,
        ["name"] = effect_name,
        ["client_text"] = data["client_text"] or "新\n词条",
        ["desc"] = data["desc"] or "词条描述",
        ["check_desc"] = data["check_desc"], --扩展描述-可自定义显示(例如描述词条前置条件)
        ["ui_from_desc"] = data["ui_from_desc"], --扩展描述-用于帮助里面展示附魔石来源 非必填
        ["can_add"] = data["can_add"], --是否可以通过附魔卷轴附魔出来
        ["only_one"] = data["only_one"], --单个装备是否允许重复附魔
        ["only_compound"] = data["only_compound"] or false, --填true 该附魔只能合成台合成出来(等同稀有词条的概率)
        ["client_color"] = data["client_color"] or { 101 / 255, 255 / 255, 0 / 255, 1 }, --附魔石背景颜色
        ["is_special"] = data["is_special"] or false, --填true+上面can_add填false 该词条则不能通过正常途径获取 可以通过另一个接口进行生成
        ["value_range"] = data["value_range"], --如果词条带有(随机变化的)属性值则必填
        ["check_equip_can_add"] = data["check_equip_can_add"] or function(inst)
            --词条校验函数 一般用于校验词条是否能被装备附魔
            --ps：必须含有俩个返回值 1：是否符合条件(true/false) 2：如果第一个是false 需要写清楚不满足条件的原因
            return true, "满足条件"
        end,
        --下面俩个分别在装备新增/清除词条时执行 如果是定时任务类词条 记得在end_fn中清除掉对应任务
        ["start_fn"] = data["start_fn"] or function(inst)
            --inst->装备
        end,
        ["end_fn"] = data["end_fn"] or function(inst)
        end,
        --下面两个分别会在玩家穿戴/脱下装备时执行
        ["on_equip_fn"] = data["on_equip_fn"] or function(inst, owner, value)
            --inst->装备 owner->穿戴者 value->词条的属性值 如果属性值上面未定义范围 则算作nil
        end,
        ["un_equip_fn"] = data["un_equip_fn"] or function(inst, owner, value)
        end,
    }
    print(string["format"]("======>调用新增词条接口成功 词条id:%s 词条名字:%s<======", tostring(effect_id), tostring(effect_name)))
    start_id = start_id + 1
end
GLOBAL["AddSpecialEquipEffect"] = AddSpecialEquipEffectFn

local SUIGINTOU_MERCURY_SWORD_STONE_EFFECT = "suigintou_mercury_sword_stone"
local SUIGINTOU_BLACK_FEATHER_STONE_DROP_CHANCE = 0.001
local function isSuigintouPlayer(inst)
    if inst == nil or not inst:IsValid() then
        return false
    end
    local suigintou_check = (GLOBAL ~= nil and rawget(GLOBAL, "SGD_IsSuigintou")) or rawget(_G, "SGD_IsSuigintou")
    if type(suigintou_check) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(suigintou_check, inst)
        if ok and result then
            return true
        end
    end
    return inst["prefab"] == "ouroboros_suigintou"
            or inst["prefab"] == "suigintou"
            or inst:HasTag("ouroboros_suigintou")
            or inst:HasTag("suigintou")
end
local function addSuigintouStoneDropCandidate(candidates, player)
    if isSuigintouPlayer(player)
            and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(player, "hh_player")
            and HH_UTILS:NotIsDead(player)
    then
        candidates[player] = true
    end
end
local function getSuigintouStoneDropCandidates(victim, data)
    local candidates = {}
    if victim ~= nil and victim["HasTag"] ~= nil then
        local has_black_feather_mark = false
        if victim:HasTag("suigintou_sword_1_marked") then
            has_black_feather_mark = true
            addSuigintouStoneDropCandidate(candidates, victim["_suigintou_sword_1_marked_by"])
        end
        if victim:HasTag("suigintou_core_4_feather_protocol") then
            has_black_feather_mark = true
            addSuigintouStoneDropCandidate(candidates, victim["_suigintou_core_4_feather_protocol_by"])
        end
        if has_black_feather_mark and data ~= nil then
            addSuigintouStoneDropCandidate(candidates, data["attacker"])
            addSuigintouStoneDropCandidate(candidates, data["afflicter"])
        end
    end
    return candidates
end
local function getSuigintouDropDisplayName(inst, fallback)
    local strings_table = rawget(_G, "STRINGS")
    if inst ~= nil then
        if inst["GetDisplayName"] then
            local ok, name = pcall(inst["GetDisplayName"], inst)
            if ok and name ~= nil and name ~= "" then
                return name
            end
        end
        if inst["name"] ~= nil and inst["name"] ~= "" then
            return inst["name"]
        end
        if inst["prefab"] ~= nil and strings_table ~= nil and strings_table["NAMES"] ~= nil then
            local prefab_name = strings_table["NAMES"][string["upper"](inst["prefab"])]
            if prefab_name ~= nil and prefab_name ~= "" then
                return prefab_name
            end
        end
    end
    return fallback or "未知"
end
local function spawnSuigintouMercurySwordStone(victim, player)
    local stone = nil
    if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(victim, "lootdropper") then
        stone = victim["components"]["lootdropper"]:SpawnLootPrefab("hh_effect_stone")
    else
        stone = SpawnPrefab("hh_effect_stone")
        if stone ~= nil and victim ~= nil and victim["Transform"] ~= nil then
            stone["Transform"]:SetPosition(victim["Transform"]:GetWorldPosition())
        end
    end
    if stone ~= nil then
        stone["hh_effect"] = SUIGINTOU_MERCURY_SWORD_STONE_EFFECT
        if stone["HH_Update_Server"] then
            stone:HH_Update_Server()
        end
        HH_UTILS:UpdateSkinItem(player, stone)
        if TheNet and HH_EQUIP_EFFECT[SUIGINTOU_MERCURY_SWORD_STONE_EFFECT] then
            local victim_name = getSuigintouDropDisplayName(victim, "黑羽标记目标")
            local player_name = getSuigintouDropDisplayName(player, "未知参与者")
            local effect_name = HH_EQUIP_EFFECT[SUIGINTOU_MERCURY_SWORD_STONE_EFFECT]["name"]
            TheNet:Announce(string["format"]("黑羽裁决应声而落，%s从%s身上获得专属附魔石-%s",
                    tostring(player_name), tostring(victim_name), tostring(effect_name)))
        end
    end
end
local function tryDropSuigintouMercurySwordStone(victim, data)
    if victim == nil or victim["_hh_suigintou_mercury_stone_drop_checked"]
            or victim:HasTag("player")
            or not victim:IsValid()
    then
        return
    end
    victim["_hh_suigintou_mercury_stone_drop_checked"] = true
    local candidates = getSuigintouStoneDropCandidates(victim, data)
    for player in pairs(candidates) do
        local drop_chance = HH_UTILS:GetHHAdjustedChance(player, SUIGINTOU_BLACK_FEATHER_STONE_DROP_CHANCE, 1)
        if math["random"]() <= drop_chance then
            spawnSuigintouMercurySwordStone(victim, player)
        end
    end
end
AddPrefabPostInitAny(function(inst)
    if not TheWorld["ismastersim"] or inst["_hh_suigintou_mercury_stone_drop_listener"] then
        return
    end
    inst["_hh_suigintou_mercury_stone_drop_listener"] = true
    inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        if inst:IsValid()
                and not inst:HasTag("player")
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(inst, "health")
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(inst, "combat")
        then
            inst:ListenForEvent("death", tryDropSuigintouMercurySwordStone)
        end
    end)
end)

local function onkilled(inst, data)
    if not data or not data["victim"] then
        return
    end
    local victim = data["victim"]
    if victim:IsValid() and not victim:HasTag("player")
            and HH_UTILS:NotIsDead(inst)
            and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(inst, "follower")
            and inst["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(inst["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
    then
        local player = inst["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
        player["components"]["hh_player"]:DropSpecialGif(victim)
    end
end
AddComponentPostInit("follower", function(self)
    self["inst"]:ListenForEvent("killed", onkilled)
end)
```

```lua
AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
    local handler = sg.actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK]
    if handler == nil then
        return
    end

    local old_deststate = handler.deststate
    handler.deststate = function(inst, action, ...)
        local dest = old_deststate(inst, action, ...)

        if dest == "attack" and inst:HasTag(T.PRIMED_TAG) then
            inst:RemoveTag(T.PRIMED_TAG)
            if IsTearsWeapon(ServerWeapon(inst)) then
                return T.THRUST_WINDUP and SERVER_STATE_PRE or SERVER_STATE_MAIN
            end
        end

        return dest
    end
end)

        local oldhover=self.GetHoverTextOverride

            if self.inst==ThePlayer then
                if active and active.player==self.inst then return LABELS[active.mode] end
            end
            if oldhover then return oldhover(self,...) end
        end
        local old=self.OnControl
        self.OnControl=function(self,control,down,...)
            if self.inst==ThePlayer then
                local swallow=self._jahoda_swallow
                if swallow and swallow[control] then
                    if not down then swallow[control]=nil end
                    return true
                end
                local s=active
                if s~=nil and (control==CONTROL_PRIMARY or control==CONTROL_SECONDARY or control==CONTROL_CANCEL)then
                    if down then
                        self._jahoda_swallow=self._jahoda_swallow or {};self._jahoda_swallow[control]=true
                        if control~=CONTROL_PRIMARY then M.Cancel()
                        elseif OnHUD(self.inst) and Equipped(self.inst,s.lock)
                            and GetTime()>s.armed+FRAMES and not self.inst.HUD:HasInputFocus()
                            and TheInput:GetHUDEntityUnderMouse()==nil then
                            local pos=TheInput:GetWorldPosition()
                            if pos~=nil and(s.mode=="shock" or ValidPoint(self.inst,pos))then
                                local mode=s.mode;M.Cancel()
                                SendModRPCToServer(cast_rpc,mode,pos.x,pos.z)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return true
                end
            end
            return old(self,control,down,...)
        end
    end)
    TheInput:AddKeyDownHandler(KEY_R,function()
        local p=ThePlayer
        if not OnHUD(p) or not Equipped(p)then return end
        if p.HUD:IsSpellWheelOpen()then p.HUD:CloseSpellWheel();return end
        if p.HUD:HasInputFocus()then return end
        M.Cancel()
        local lock=p.replica.inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS)
        lock.components.spellbook:OpenSpellBook(p)
        local wheel=p.HUD.controls.spellwheel
        local mouse=TheInput:GetScreenPosition()
        -- Same centre-anchor/proportional conversion as vanilla
        -- pumpkin carving and skill-tree screens. GetWorldPosition excludes
        -- the screen anchor; UITransform:GetWorldScale is absent in this build.
        local w,h=TheSim:GetScreenSize()
        if w>0 and h>0 then
            local propscale=math.max(RESOLUTION_X/w,RESOLUTION_Y/h)
            local origin=wheel.parent:GetWorldPosition()
            local scale=wheel.parent:GetScale()
            if scale.x>0 and scale.y>0 then
                wheel:SetPosition(((mouse.x-w/2)*propscale-origin.x)/scale.x,
                    ((mouse.y-h/2)*propscale-origin.y)/scale.y,0)
            end
        end
    end)
end
```

```lua
AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self)
    local _Equip = self.Equip
    self.Equip = function(self, item, ...)
        if item ~= nil and item.prefab == "jzr_lotus" then
            return self:GiveItem(item)
        end
        return _Equip(self, item, ...)
    end

    local _GiveItem = self.GiveItem
    self.GiveItem = function(self, item, slot, src_pos, ...)
        if slot == nil and self.inst._jzr_picking and item ~= nil and item.prefab ~= "jzr_lotus"
            and item.components.inventoryitem ~= nil then
            for _, v in pairs(self.itemslots) do
                local c = v.prefab == "jzr_lotus" and v.components.container or nil
                if c ~= nil and c:IsOpenedBy(self.inst) and c:Has(item.prefab, 1) then
                    if c:GiveItem(item, nil, src_pos, false) or not item:IsValid() then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return _GiveItem(self, item, slot, src_pos, ...)
    end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("health", function(self)
    local _SetVal = self.SetVal
    self.SetVal = function(self, val, cause, afflicter, ...)
        local inst = self.inst
        local was = self.currenthealth
        if was == nil or was <= 0 or val > 0 or inst.Transform == nil or inst:HasTag("player") then
            return _SetVal(self, val, cause, afflicter, ...)
        end
        local x, y, z = inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
        local prefab, hostile, maxhealth = inst.prefab, inst:HasTag("hostile"), self.maxhealth or 0
        local ret = _SetVal(self, val, cause, afflicter, ...)
        if self.currenthealth <= 0 then
            OnCreatureDied(prefab, x, y, z, afflicter, hostile, maxhealth)
        end
        return ret
    end
end)
```

### 变体演进：null (Mod 3773139595)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3773139595 (`null`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3773139595)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:builder

AddComponentPostInit("builder", function(self)
    local old_EvaluateTechTrees = self.EvaluateTechTrees
    function self:EvaluateTechTrees(...)
        local active_terminal = self.inst.txk_ae_active_terminal
        local connector = active_terminal ~= nil and active_terminal:IsValid() and
            active_terminal.components.txk_ae_terminalconnector or nil
        local terminal_prototyper, terminal_trees

        -- 合成卡保留远端科技，同时接入玩家所在位置的可用科技站。
        if connector ~= nil and connector:HasCard("me_card_crafting") and
            self.inst.IsUsingTXKAppliedEnergistics ~= nil and
            self.inst:IsUsingTXKAppliedEnergistics()
        then
            self.override_current_prototyper = active_terminal
            local prototyper = active_terminal.components.prototyper
            local classified = self.inst.player_classified
            if (classified == nil or classified.iscraftingenabled:value()) and
                not active_terminal:HasOneOfTags(self.exclude_tags) and
                (prototyper.restrictedtag == nil or self.inst:HasTag(prototyper.restrictedtag)) and
                prototyper:CanUsePrototyper(self.inst)
            then
                -- 先让终端刷新自身科技，再准备仅供本次计算使用的副本。
                prototyper:TurnOn(self.inst)
                local trees = prototyper:GetTechTrees()
                local x, y, z = self.inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
                local nearby = TheSim:FindEntities(x, y, z, TUNING.RESEARCH_MACHINE_DIST,
                    { "prototyper" }, self.exclude_tags)
                for _, station in ipairs(nearby) do
                    local component = station.components.prototyper
                    if station ~= active_terminal and component ~= nil and
                        (component.restrictedtag == nil or self.inst:HasTag(component.restrictedtag)) and
                        component:CanUsePrototyper(self.inst)
                    then
                        for tech, level in pairs(component:GetTechTrees()) do
                            trees[tech] = math.max(trees[tech] or 0, level)
                        end
                    end
                end
                terminal_prototyper = prototyper
                terminal_trees = prototyper.trees
                prototyper.trees = trees
            end
        elseif self.override_current_prototyper ~= nil and
            self.override_current_prototyper.prefab == "txk_ae_terminalconnector"
        then
            self.override_current_prototyper = nil
        end

        -- 原版统一处理人物加成和客户端同步，计算后立即恢复共享终端的科技。
        local ret_tbl = {pcall(old_EvaluateTechTrees, self, ...)}
        if terminal_prototyper ~= nil then
            terminal_prototyper.trees = terminal_trees
        end
        if not ret_tbl[1] then
            error(ret_tbl[2], 0)
        end

        -- 下一次仍由原版检查距离与终端使用状态。
        local prototyper = self.current_prototyper
        if prototyper and prototyper.prefab == "txk_ae_terminalconnector" then
            self.override_current_prototyper = prototyper
        end

        return unpack(ret_tbl, 2)
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 终端打开时修改动作收集
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

AddComponentPostInit("playeractionpicker", function(self)
    local old_GetSceneActions = self.GetSceneActions
    function self:GetSceneActions(useitem, right, ...)
        local sorted_acts = old_GetSceneActions(self, useitem, right, ...) or {}
        local act = sorted_acts[1]

        if act and act.action == ACTIONS.RUMMAGE and self.inst:IsUsingTXKAppliedEnergistics() and CanTXKAEConnect(act.target) then
            table.remove(sorted_acts, 1)
        end

        return sorted_acts
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 这些函数需要获取terminalcontainers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function NeedTerminalContainers(self, fn_name)
    local old_fn = self[fn_name]
    if old_fn == nil then return end

    self[fn_name] = function(self, ...)
        local inventory = ThePlayer and ThePlayer.replica.inventory
        if inventory == nil then return old_fn(self, ...) end

        if inventory.txk_ae_need_terminal_containers == nil then
            inventory.txk_ae_need_terminal_containers = fn_name
        end

        -- 避免old_fn函数内部修改need_terminal_containers
        local ret_tbl = {old_fn(self, ...)}

        if inventory.txk_ae_need_terminal_containers == fn_name then
            inventory.txk_ae_need_terminal_containers = nil
        end

        return unpack(ret_tbl)
    end
end

AddClassPostConstruct("widgets/invslot", function(self)
    self.inst:DoStaticTaskInTime(0, function()
        NeedTerminalContainers(self, "TradeItem")
    end)
end)

AddClassPostConstruct("widgets/itemtile", function(self)
    local function UpdateEncodedPatternMark()
        if self.txk_ae_encoded_pattern_mark ~= nil then
            local configured = self.item ~= nil and self.item._me_pattern_configured ~= nil and
                self.item._me_pattern_configured:value()
            if configured then
                self.txk_ae_encoded_pattern_mark:Show()
            else
                self.txk_ae_encoded_pattern_mark:Hide()
            end
        end
    end

    if self.item ~= nil and self.item.prefab == "me_blank_pattern" and self.image ~= nil then
        self.txk_ae_encoded_pattern_mark = self.image:AddChild(Image("images/ui.xml", "checkmark.tex"))
        self.txk_ae_encoded_pattern_mark:SetScale(0.22)
        self.txk_ae_encoded_pattern_mark:SetTint(0.25, 1, 0.35, 1)
        self.txk_ae_encoded_pattern_mark:SetClickable(false)
        UpdateEncodedPatternMark()
        self.inst:ListenForEvent("me_pattern_configured_dirty", UpdateEncodedPatternMark, self.item)
    end

    self.inst:DoStaticTaskInTime(0, function()
        NeedTerminalContainers(self, "GetDescriptionString")
    end)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 背包修改
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

AddClassPostConstruct("components/inventory_replica", function(self)

    -- 目标容器IsFake处理
    local old_MoveItemFromAllOfSlot = self.MoveItemFromAllOfSlot
    function self:MoveItemFromAllOfSlot(slot, container)
        if container and container.IsTXKAEFake then
            if container.remote_shard_id ~= nil then
                SendModRPCToServer(
                    MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["CrossShardPutInventorySlot"],
                    container.remote_shard_id,
                    container.GUID,
                    slot,
                    false
                )
            elseif TheWorld.ismastersim then
                container = Ents[container.GUID]
                if container and container:IsValid() then
                    TerminalContainer.WithComponent(container, function()
                        TerminalContainer.MoveItemFromAllOfSlot(self.inst.components.inventory, slot, container)
                    end)
                end
            else
                local guid = container.GUID
                SendModRPCToServer(MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["Inventory:TXKAEMoveItemFromAllOfSlot"], slot, guid)
            end
            return
        end
        return old_MoveItemFromAllOfSlot ~= nil
            and old_MoveItemFromAllOfSlot(self, slot, container)
    end
    local old_MoveItemFromHalfOfSlot = self.MoveItemFromHalfOfSlot
    function self:MoveItemFromHalfOfSlot(slot, container)
        if container and container.IsTXKAEFake then
            if container.remote_shard_id ~= nil then
                SendModRPCToServer(
                    MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["CrossShardPutInventorySlot"],
                    container.remote_shard_id,
                    container.GUID,
                    slot,
                    true
                )
            elseif TheWorld.ismastersim then
                container = Ents[container.GUID]
                if container and container:IsValid() then
                    TerminalContainer.WithComponent(container, function()
                        TerminalContainer.MoveItemFromHalfOfSlot(self.inst.components.inventory, slot, container)
                    end)
                end
            else
                local guid = container.GUID
                SendModRPCToServer(MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["Inventory:TXKAEMoveItemFromHalfOfSlot"], slot, guid)
            end
            return
        end
        return old_MoveItemFromHalfOfSlot ~= nil
            and old_MoveItemFromHalfOfSlot(self, slot, container)
    end

    -- 目标物品IsFake处理
    local old_UseItemFromInvTile = self.UseItemFromInvTile
    function self:UseItemFromInvTile(item)
        if item and item.IsTXKAEFake then
            if TheWorld.ismastersim then
                item = Ents[item.GUID]
                if item and item:IsValid() then
                    TerminalContainer.UseItemFromInvTile(self.inst.components.inventory, item)
                end
            else
                local guid = item.GUID
                SendModRPCToServer(MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["Inventory:TXKAEUseItemFromInvTile"], guid)
            end
            return
        end
        return old_UseItemFromInvTile ~= nil
            and old_UseItemFromInvTile(self, item)
    end

    local old_DropItemFromInvTile = self.DropItemFromInvTile
    function self:DropItemFromInvTile(item, single)
        if item and item.IsTXKAEFake then
            if TheWorld.ismastersim then
                item = Ents[item.GUID]
                if item and item:IsValid() then
                    TerminalContainer.DropItemFromInvTile(self.inst.components.inventory, item, single)
                end
            else
                local guid = item.GUID
                SendModRPCToServer(MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["Inventory:TXKAEDropItemFromInvTile"], guid, single)
            end
            return
        end
        return old_DropItemFromInvTile ~= nil
            and old_DropItemFromInvTile(self, item, single)
    end

    -- 拥有材料判断
    local old_Has = self.Has
    function self:Has(prefab, amount, checkallcontainers, ...)
        local enough, num_found = old_Has(self, prefab, amount, checkallcontainers, ...)
        -- 主机会直接走inventory组件，在那里已经做了处理
        if TheWorld.ismastersim then
            return enough, num_found
        end

        if checkallcontainers then
            local txk_ae_terminalwidget = self.inst.HUD and self.inst.HUD.txk_ae_terminalwidget
            if txk_ae_terminalwidget and txk_ae_terminalwidget.isopen then
                local num_add = txk_ae_terminalwidget:CalcItemNum(prefab)
                num_found = num_found + num_add
                enough = enough or (num_found >= amount)
            end
        end

        return enough, num_found
    end

    -- 获取终端的容器
    local old_GetOpenContainers = self.GetOpenContainers
    function self:GetOpenContainers(...)
        local containers = old_GetOpenContainers ~= nil
            and old_GetOpenContainers(self, ...) or {}
        if self.txk_ae_need_terminal_containers == nil then
            return containers
        end

        local ret = shallowcopy(containers)
        local txk_ae_terminalwidget = self.inst.HUD and self.inst.HUD.txk_ae_terminalwidget
        if txk_ae_terminalwidget then
            for guid, container in pairs(txk_ae_terminalwidget.containers) do
                ret[container] = true
            end
        end
        return ret
    end

    -- 宝石核心兼容
    self.inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        NeedTerminalContainers(self, "FindCraftingItems")
    end)

    -- 两个新接口函数
    -- 移动单个active_item
    function self:TXKAEMoveItemFromOneOfActive(container)
        if container and container.IsTXKAEFake then
            if container.remote_shard_id ~= nil then
                SendModRPCToServer(
                    MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["CrossShardPutActive"],
                    container.remote_shard_id,
                    container.GUID,
                    true
                )
            elseif TheWorld.ismastersim then
                container = Ents[container.GUID]
                if container and container:IsValid() then
                    TerminalContainer.WithComponent(container, function()
                        self.inst.components.inventory:TXKAEMoveItemFromOneOfActive(container)
                    end)
                end
            else
                SendModRPCToServer(MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["Inventory:TXKAEMoveItemFromOneOfActive"], container.GUID)
            end
            return
        end
    end

    -- 移动全部active_item
    function self:TXKAEMoveItemFromAllOfActive(container)
        if container and container.IsTXKAEFake then
            if container.remote_shard_id ~= nil then
                SendModRPCToServer(
                    MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["CrossShardPutActive"],
                    container.remote_shard_id,
                    container.GUID,
                    false
                )
            elseif TheWorld.ismastersim then
                container = Ents[container.GUID]
                if container and container:IsValid() then
                    TerminalContainer.WithComponent(container, function()
                        self.inst.components.inventory:TXKAEMoveItemFromAllOfActive(container)
                    end)
                end
            else
                SendModRPCToServer(MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["Inventory:TXKAEMoveItemFromAllOfActive"], container.GUID)
            end
            return
        end
    end

    -- 预览activeitem，用于客机文本和图形提前显示
    function self:GetTXKAEActiveItemWithPreview()
        if TheWorld.ismastersim or self.classified == nil then
            return self:GetActiveItem()
        end
        return self.classified:GetTXKAEActiveItemWithPreview()
    end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("inventory",function(self)

    self.txk_ae_fake_opencontainers = {}

    -- hook opencontainers函数
    local function hook_opencontainers(fn_name)
        local old_fn = self[fn_name]
        if old_fn == nil then return end

        self[fn_name] = function(self, ...)
            local txk_ae_fake_opencontainers = shallowcopy(self.txk_ae_fake_opencontainers)
            local temporary_adapters = {}
            for k, _ in pairs(txk_ae_fake_opencontainers) do
                self.opencontainers[k] = true
                if k.components.container == nil and k.txk_ae_container_adapter ~= nil then
                    k.components.container = k.txk_ae_container_adapter
                    temporary_adapters[k] = true
                end
            end

            local ret_tbl = {old_fn(self, ...)}

            for k, _ in pairs(txk_ae_fake_opencontainers) do
                self.opencontainers[k] = nil
                if temporary_adapters[k] then
                    k.components.container = nil
                end
            end

            return unpack(ret_tbl)
        end
    end

    local hooklist = {
        "FindCraftingItems", -- 兼容宝石核心
        "GetCraftingIngredient",
        "GetItemByName",
        "RemoveItem",
    }

    -- 延迟以避免被覆盖
    self.inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        for i, fn_name in ipairs(hooklist) do
            hook_opencontainers(fn_name)
        end
    end)

    -- Crafting recipe checks call Has very frequently. Query remote containers
    -- directly and stop as soon as the requested amount is found, instead of
    -- injecting every terminal container into opencontainers for every recipe.
    local old_Has = self.Has
    function self:Has(prefab, amount, checkallcontainers, ...)
        local enough, num_found = old_Has(self, prefab, amount, checkallcontainers, ...)
        if enough or not checkallcontainers or next(self.txk_ae_fake_opencontainers) == nil then
            return enough, num_found
        end

        local terminal = self.inst.txk_ae_active_terminal
        local connector = terminal ~= nil and terminal:IsValid() and
            terminal.components.txk_ae_terminalconnector or nil
        local index = connector ~= nil and connector:GetStorageIndex() or nil
        if index == nil and TXKAppliedEnergisticsGetCrossShardSession ~= nil then
            local session = TXKAppliedEnergisticsGetCrossShardSession(self.inst)
            index = session ~= nil and session.storage_index or nil
        end
        if index ~= nil and index.GetCount ~= nil then
            local needed = math.max(amount - num_found, 0)
            num_found = num_found + math.min(index:GetCount(prefab), needed)
            return num_found >= amount, num_found
        end

        for inst in pairs(self.txk_ae_fake_opencontainers) do
            local container = TerminalContainer.Get(inst)
            if container ~= nil and not container.excludefromcrafting and not container.readonlycontainer then
                local needed = math.max(amount - num_found, 0)
                local _, found = container:Has(prefab, needed, true)
                num_found = num_found + math.min(found or 0, needed)
                if num_found >= amount then
                    return true, num_found
                end
            end
        end
        return false, num_found
    end

    -- 背包关闭时CloseTerminal
    local old_Close = self.Close
    function self:Close(keepactiveitem, ...)
        if self.isopen and self.inst:HasTag("player") and self.inst:IsUsingTXKAppliedEnergistics() then
            local playercontroller = self.inst.components.playercontroller
            if playercontroller then
                playercontroller:DoCloseTXKAETerminalAction()
            end
        end
        return old_Close(self, keepactiveitem, ...)
    end

    -- 两个新接口函数
    -- 移动单个active_item
    function self:TXKAEMoveItemFromOneOfActive(container)
        local item = self:GetActiveItem()
        if item ~= nil and container ~= nil then
            container = container.components.container
            if container ~= nil and
                container:IsOpenedBy(self.inst) and
                item.components.stackable ~= nil and
                item.components.stackable:IsStack() then

                container.currentuser = self.inst

                if container:CanTakeItemInSlot(item) then
                    local onestack = item.components.stackable:Get()
                    onestack.prevcontainer = nil
                    onestack.prevslot = nil
                    if not container:GiveItem(onestack) then
                        item.components.stackable:Put(onestack)
                    end
                end

                container.currentuser = nil
            end
        end
    end

    -- 移动全部active_item
    function self:TXKAEMoveItemFromAllOfActive(container)
        local item = self:GetActiveItem()
        if item ~= nil and container ~= nil then
            container = container.components.container
            if container ~= nil and container:IsOpenedBy(self.inst) then
                container.currentuser = self.inst

                if container:CanTakeItemInSlot(item) then

                    self:RemoveItem(item, true)
                    if not container:GiveItem(item, nil, nil, false) then
                        self:GiveActiveItem(item)
                    end
                end

                container.currentuser = nil
            end
        end
    end

end)

AddComponentPostInit("container",function(self)
    if self.txk_ae_remote_container_hooked then
        return
    end
    self.txk_ae_remote_container_hooked = true
    -- 远程开关容器
    self.txk_ae_fake_openlist = {}
    self.txk_ae_refresh_revision = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision or 0
    self.txk_ae_sent_revisions = {}
    self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent = {}
    self.txk_ae_dirty_slots = {}
    self.txk_ae_force_full_refresh = false

    function self:TXKAERemoteSubscribe(doer)
        local inventory = doer ~= nil and doer.components.inventory or nil
        if inventory == nil then
            return false
        end
        inventory.txk_ae_fake_opencontainers[self.inst] = true
        self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[doer] = true
        self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[doer] = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision
        self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent[doer] = false
        return true
    end

    function self:TXKAESendSnapshot(doer)
        if doer == nil or not doer:IsValid() or not self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[doer] then
            return false
        end
        local encodedata = TheSim:ZipAndEncodeString(json.encode(FakeContainer(self.inst)))
        SendModRPCToClient(CLIENT_MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["OpenTXKAEFakeContainer"], doer.userid, encodedata)
        self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[doer] = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision
        self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent[doer] = true
        return true
    end

    function self:TXKAERemoteOpen(doer)
        return self:TXKAERemoteSubscribe(doer) and self:TXKAESendSnapshot(doer)
    end

    self.txk_ae_old_close = self.Close
    function self:Close(doer, ...)
        if doer == nil then
            self:TXKAERemoteCloseAll()
        end
        return self.txk_ae_old_close(self, doer, ...)
    end

    local function CloseRemoteViewsOnRemove(component, old_callback, ...)
        component:TXKAERemoteCloseAll()
        if component.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task ~= nil then
            component.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task:Cancel()
            component.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task = nil
        end
        component.txk_ae_dirty_slots = {}
        component.txk_ae_force_full_refresh = false
        component.txk_ae_sent_revisions = {}

AddComponentPostInit("playeractionpicker", function(self)
    local old_GetSceneActions = self.GetSceneActions
    function self:GetSceneActions(useitem, right, ...)
        local sorted_acts = old_GetSceneActions(self, useitem, right, ...) or {}
        local act = sorted_acts[1]

        if act and act.action == ACTIONS.RUMMAGE and self.inst:IsUsingTXKAppliedEnergistics() and CanTXKAEConnect(act.target) then
            table.remove(sorted_acts, 1)
        end

        return sorted_acts
    end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("container",function(self)
    if self.txk_ae_remote_container_hooked then
        return
    end
    self.txk_ae_remote_container_hooked = true
    -- 远程开关容器
    self.txk_ae_fake_openlist = {}
    self.txk_ae_refresh_revision = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision or 0
    self.txk_ae_sent_revisions = {}
    self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent = {}
    self.txk_ae_dirty_slots = {}
    self.txk_ae_force_full_refresh = false

    function self:TXKAERemoteSubscribe(doer)
        local inventory = doer ~= nil and doer.components.inventory or nil
        if inventory == nil then
            return false
        end
        inventory.txk_ae_fake_opencontainers[self.inst] = true
        self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[doer] = true
        self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[doer] = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision
        self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent[doer] = false
        return true
    end

    function self:TXKAESendSnapshot(doer)
        if doer == nil or not doer:IsValid() or not self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[doer] then
            return false
        end
        local encodedata = TheSim:ZipAndEncodeString(json.encode(FakeContainer(self.inst)))
        SendModRPCToClient(CLIENT_MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["OpenTXKAEFakeContainer"], doer.userid, encodedata)
        self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[doer] = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision
        self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent[doer] = true
        return true
    end

    function self:TXKAERemoteOpen(doer)
        return self:TXKAERemoteSubscribe(doer) and self:TXKAESendSnapshot(doer)
    end

    self.txk_ae_old_close = self.Close
    function self:Close(doer, ...)
        if doer == nil then
            self:TXKAERemoteCloseAll()
        end
        return self.txk_ae_old_close(self, doer, ...)
    end

    local function CloseRemoteViewsOnRemove(component, old_callback, ...)
        component:TXKAERemoteCloseAll()
        if component.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task ~= nil then
            component.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task:Cancel()
            component.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task = nil
        end
        component.txk_ae_dirty_slots = {}
        component.txk_ae_force_full_refresh = false
        component.txk_ae_sent_revisions = {}
        component.txk_ae_snapshot_sent = {}

        -- A plain DST container generally has no removal callback. Preserve
        -- the prior behaviour of this hook in that case by closing the native
        -- container through the saved, unwrapped Close method.
        if old_callback ~= nil then
            return old_callback(component, ...)
        end
        return component.txk_ae_old_close(component, nil, ...)
    end

    self.txk_ae_old_onremoveentity = self.OnRemoveEntity
    self.OnRemoveEntity = function(component, ...)
        return CloseRemoteViewsOnRemove(component, component.txk_ae_old_onremoveentity, ...)
    end

    self.txk_ae_old_onremovefromentity = self.OnRemoveFromEntity
    self.OnRemoveFromEntity = function(component, ...)
        return CloseRemoteViewsOnRemove(component, component.txk_ae_old_onremovefromentity, ...)
    end

    function self:TXKAERemoteClose(doer)
        local inventory = doer and doer.components and doer.components.inventory or nil
        if inventory ~= nil and inventory.txk_ae_fake_opencontainers ~= nil then
            inventory.txk_ae_fake_opencontainers[self.inst] = nil
        end
        self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[doer] = nil
        self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[doer] = nil
        self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent[doer] = nil
    end

    function self:TXKAERemoteCloseAll()
        for doer in pairs(self.txk_ae_fake_openlist) do
            if doer and doer:IsValid() then
                self:TXKAERemoteClose(doer)
                -- 仅该情况下单独通知客机
                SendModRPCToClient(CLIENT_MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE]["CloseFakeContainer"], doer.userid, self.inst.GUID)
            end
        end
        self.txk_ae_fake_openlist = {}
        self.txk_ae_sent_revisions = {}
        self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent = {}
    end

    local function PushTerminalRefresh(slot, target_player, immediate, force_full)
        if target_player ~= nil then
            if not target_player:IsValid() or not self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[target_player] then
                return
            end
        elseif next(self.txk_ae_fake_openlist) == nil then
            return
        end

        local base_revision = target_player ~= nil and self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[target_player] or nil
        local slots = {}
        for dirty_slot in pairs(self.txk_ae_dirty_slots) do
            table.insert(slots, dirty_slot)
        end
        table.sort(slots)
        force_full = force_full or self.txk_ae_force_full_refresh
        local fake = not force_full and type(base_revision) == "number" and #slots > 0 and
            FakeContainerSlots(self.inst, slots, base_revision) or FakeContainer(self.inst)
        local rpc_name = fake ~= nil and fake.updates ~= nil and
            "RefreshFakeContainerSlots" or "RefreshFakeContainer"
        if fake == nil then
            return
        end
        local encodedata = json.encode(fake)
        encodedata = TheSim:ZipAndEncodeString(encodedata)

        local function SendRefresh(player)
            if player and player:IsValid() then
                if fake.updates ~= nil then
                    SendModRPCToClient(
                        CLIENT_MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE][rpc_name],
                        player.userid,
                        encodedata,
                        immediate == true
                    )
                else
                    SendModRPCToClient(
                        CLIENT_MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE][rpc_name],
                        player.userid,
                        encodedata,
                        slot or 0,
                        immediate == true
                    )
                end
            else
                self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[player] = nil
            end
        end
        if target_player ~= nil then
            SendRefresh(target_player)
            self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[target_player] = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision
        else
            for player in pairs(self.txk_ae_fake_openlist) do
                SendRefresh(player)
                self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[player] = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision
            end
        end
    end

    local function PushTerminalBatch(slots, force_full)
        local current_revision = self.txk_ae_refresh_revision or 0
        for player in pairs(self.txk_ae_fake_openlist) do
            if player ~= nil and player:IsValid() then
                if self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent[player] then
                    local base_revision = self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[player]
                    if type(base_revision) ~= "number" then
                        base_revision = current_revision
                        self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[player] = current_revision
                    elseif base_revision < current_revision then
                        local update = not force_full and
                            FakeContainerSlots(self.inst, slots, base_revision) or FakeContainer(self.inst)
                        if update ~= nil then
                            local rpc_name = update.updates ~= nil and
                                "RefreshFakeContainerSlots" or "RefreshFakeContainer"
                            local encoded = TheSim:ZipAndEncodeString(json.encode(update))
                            SendModRPCToClient(
                                CLIENT_MOD_RPC[RPC_NAMESPACE][rpc_name],
                                player.userid,
                                encoded,
                                0,
                                false
                            )
                            self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[player] = current_revision
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[player] = nil
                self.txk_ae_sent_revisions[player] = nil
                self.txk_ae_snapshot_sent[player] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    -- Interactive changes are confirmed to their actor immediately; all
    -- observers receive the coalesced authoritative snapshot below.
    self.txk_ae_terminal_refresh = function(inst, data)
        local own_connector = self.inst.components.txk_ae_terminalconnector
        if own_connector ~= nil and own_connector.QueueAutomationWake ~= nil then
            own_connector:QueueAutomationWake()
        end
        WakeConnectedTerminalAutomation(self.inst)

        self.txk_ae_refresh_revision = (self.txk_ae_refresh_revision or 0) + 1
        data = data or {}
        local slot = data.slot or self:GetItemSlot(data.item) or nil
        StorageIndex.NotifyContainerChanged(self.inst, slot)
        if type(slot) == "number" then
            self.txk_ae_dirty_slots[slot] = true
        else
            self.txk_ae_force_full_refresh = true
        end
        local actor = self.currentuser
        if actor ~= nil and self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[actor] then
            PushTerminalRefresh(slot, actor, true)
        end

        local has_local_listener = next(self.txk_ae_fake_openlist) ~= nil
        local has_cross_shard_listener =
            TXKAppliedEnergisticsHasCrossShardRefreshListener ~= nil and
            TXKAppliedEnergisticsHasCrossShardRefreshListener(self.inst)
        if not has_local_listener and not has_cross_shard_listener then
            self.txk_ae_dirty_slots = {}
            self.txk_ae_force_full_refresh = false
            return
        end

        if self.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task == nil then
            self.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task = self.inst:DoTaskInTime(6 * FRAMES, function()
                self.txk_ae_terminal_refresh_task = nil
                local slots = {}
                for dirty_slot in pairs(self.txk_ae_dirty_slots) do
                    table.insert(slots, dirty_slot)
                end
                table.sort(slots)
                local force_full = self.txk_ae_force_full_refresh
                self.txk_ae_dirty_slots = {}
                self.txk_ae_force_full_refresh = false
                PushTerminalBatch(slots, force_full)
                if TXKAppliedEnergisticsCrossShardRefreshContainer ~= nil then
                    TXKAppliedEnergisticsCrossShardRefreshContainer(self.inst, slots, force_full)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    self.inst:ListenForEvent("itemlose", self.txk_ae_terminal_refresh)
    self.inst:ListenForEvent("itemget", self.txk_ae_terminal_refresh)
    self.inst:ListenForEvent("stacksizechange", self.txk_ae_terminal_refresh)
    self.inst:ListenForEvent("txk_ae_refresh", self.txk_ae_terminal_refresh)

    -- 容器是否被打开
    local old_IsOpenedBy = self.IsOpenedBy
    function self:IsOpenedBy(player)
        if self.txk_ae_fake_openlist[player] then
            return true
        end
        return old_IsOpenedBy ~= nil
            and old_IsOpenedBy(self, player) or false
    end

    -- 记录widgetprefab
    local old_WidgetSetup = self.WidgetSetup
    function self:WidgetSetup(prefab, ...)
        self.txk_ae_widgetprefab = prefab or self.inst.prefab
        return old_WidgetSetup(self, prefab, ...)
    end

end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 终端打开状态
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- 青衢纳宝箱阵列会随成员数隐藏/恢复尾部格位。通知终端走完整刷新，
-- 使服务端索引、同世界假容器和跨世界快照同时采用新的有效容量。
local function RefreshNearbyHMRArrayTerminals(array)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim or array == nil or not array:IsValid() then
        return
    end

    local terminals = TheWorld.txk_ae_terminalconnectors
    if terminals == nil then
        return
    end

    for _, terminal in pairs(terminals) do
        local connector = terminal ~= nil and terminal:IsValid() and
            terminal.components.txk_ae_terminalconnector or nil
        if connector ~= nil and terminal:IsNear(array, TUNING.TXK_AE_LINKRADIUS) and
            connector.RefreshHMRArrayTopology ~= nil
        then
            connector:RefreshHMRArrayTopology()
        end
    end
end

AddComponentPostInit("hmrcontainermanager", function(self)
    if self.inst == nil or self.inst.prefab ~= "hmr_chest_store_array" or
        self.SetSlotDisplay == nil
    then
        return
    end

    local old_SetSlotDisplay = self.SetSlotDisplay
    function self:SetSlotDisplay(slots, ...)
        old_SetSlotDisplay(self, slots, ...)
        if TheWorld.ismastersim then
            self.inst:PushEvent("txk_ae_refresh")
            -- Defer until HMR has completed the member add/remove operation.
            -- This coalesces the initial nine SetSlotDisplay calls into one
            -- topology scan and also handles an array dissolving below nine.
            if self.inst.txk_ae_hmr_topology_task == nil then
                self.inst.txk_ae_hmr_topology_task = self.inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function(inst)
                    inst.txk_ae_hmr_topology_task = nil
                    RefreshNearbyHMRArrayTerminals(inst)
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

        end

            local using = inst.using_txk_ae:value()

            if player.HUD and not using then
```

- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3815691645)

local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:harvestable

AddComponentPostInit(
    "harvestable",
    function(self)
        local oldHarvest = self.Harvest
        self.Harvest = function(self, picker, ...)
            if picker and picker:HasTag("yamcheb") then
                if self:CanBeHarvested() then
                    local produce = self.produce
                    self.produce = 0

                    local pos = self.inst:GetPosition()

                    if self.onharvestfn ~= nil then
                        self.onharvestfn(self.inst, picker, produce)
                    end

                    if self.product ~= nil then
                        if picker ~= nil and picker.components.container ~= nil then
                            picker:PushEvent("harvestsomething", {object = self.inst})
                        end

                        for i = 1, produce, 1 do
                            local loot = SpawnPrefab(self.product)
                            if loot ~= nil then
                                if loot.components.inventoryitem ~= nil then
                                    loot.components.inventoryitem:InheritMoisture(TheWorld.state.wetness, TheWorld.state.iswet)
                                end
                                if picker ~= nil and picker.components.container ~= nil then
                                    picker.components.container:GiveItem(loot, nil, pos)
                                else
                                    LaunchAt(loot, self.inst, nil, 1, 1)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    self:StartGrowing()
                    return true
                end
            else
                return oldHarvest(self, picker, ...)
            end
        end
    end

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:pickable

AddComponentPostInit(
    "pickable",
    function(self)
        local oldPick = self.Pick
        self.Pick = function(self, picker, ...)
            if picker and picker:HasTag("yamcheb") then
				if self.canbepicked and self.caninteractwith then
					if self.transplanted and self.cycles_left ~= nil then
						self.cycles_left = math.max(0, self.cycles_left - 1)
					end

					if self.protected_cycles ~= nil then
						self.protected_cycles = self.protected_cycles - 1
						if self.protected_cycles <= 0 then
							self.protected_cycles = nil
							if self.inst.components.witherable ~= nil then
								self.inst.components.witherable:Enable(true)
							end
						end
					end

					local loot = nil
					if picker ~= nil and picker.components.container ~= nil and (self.product ~= nil or self.use_lootdropper_for_product ~= nil) then
						if self.droppicked and self.inst.components.lootdropper ~= nil then
							local pt = self.inst:GetPosition()
							pt.y = pt.y + (self.dropheight or 0)
							if self.use_lootdropper_for_product then
								self.inst.components.lootdropper:DropLoot(pt)
							else
								local num = self.numtoharvest or 1
								for i = 1, num do
									self.inst.components.lootdropper:SpawnLootPrefab(self.product, pt)
								end
							end
						else
							if self.use_lootdropper_for_product then
								loot = {}
								for _, prefab in ipairs(self.inst.components.lootdropper:GenerateLoot()) do
									table.insert(loot, self.inst.components.lootdropper:SpawnLootPrefab(prefab))
								end
								if not IsTableEmpty(loot) then
									picker:PushEvent("picksomething", { object = self.inst, loot = loot })
								end
								for i, item in ipairs(loot) do
									if item.components.inventoryitem ~= nil then
										picker.components.container:GiveItem(item, nil, self.inst:GetPosition())
									end
								end
							else
								loot = SpawnPrefab(self.product)
								if loot ~= nil then
									if loot.components.inventoryitem ~= nil then
										loot.components.inventoryitem:InheritMoisture(TheWorld.state.wetness, TheWorld.state.iswet)
									end
									if self.numtoharvest > 1 and loot.components.stackable ~= nil then
										loot.components.stackable:SetStackSize(self.numtoharvest)
									end
									picker:PushEvent("picksomething", { object = self.inst, loot = loot })
									picker.components.container:GiveItem(loot, nil, self.inst:GetPosition())
								end
							end
						end
					end

					if self.onpickedfn ~= nil then
						self.onpickedfn(self.inst, picker, loot)
					end

					self.canbepicked = false

					if self.baseregentime ~= nil and not (self.paused or self:IsBarren() or self.inst:HasTag("withered")) then
						if TheWorld.state.isspring then
							self.regentime = self.baseregentime * TUNING.SPRING_GROWTH_MODIFIER
						end

						if not self.useexternaltimer then
							if self.task ~= nil then
								self.task:Cancel()
							end
							self.task = self.inst:DoTaskInTime(self.regentime, OnRegen)
							self.targettime = GetTime() + self.regentime
						else
							self.stopregentimer(self.inst)
							self.startregentimer(self.inst, self.regentime)
						end
					end

					self.inst:PushEvent("picked", { picker = picker, loot = loot, plant = self.inst })

					return true
				end
            else
                return oldPick(self, picker, ...)
            end
        end
    end
```

```lua
local function InstallRubbleHook(inst)
    if not hooks.map
        or _G.TheWorld == nil
        or not _G.TheWorld.ismastersim then
        return false
    end

    local set_basement_tile = inst ~= nil and inst.SetBasementTile or nil
    if not hooks.rubble then
        local original_spawn_rubble = FindNamedUpvalue(set_basement_tile, "SpawnRubble")
        if type(original_spawn_rubble) == "function" then
            hooks.original_spawn_rubble = original_spawn_rubble
            hooks.rubble = ReplaceNamedUpvalue(
                set_basement_tile,
                "SpawnRubble",
                SpawnRubbleWithCorrectedPhase
            )
        end
    end

    if hooks.rubble
        and type(set_basement_tile) == "function"
        and inst._wallgrid_rubble_context_installed ~= true then
        inst.SetBasementTile = function(core, local_x, local_z, ...)
            local previous_context = active_rubble_context
            active_rubble_context =
            {
                core = core,
                local_x = local_x,
                local_z = local_z,
            }

            local ok, result = _G.pcall(
                set_basement_tile,
                core,
                local_x,
                local_z,
                ...
            )
            active_rubble_context = previous_context

            if not ok then
                _G.error(result, 0)
            end
            return result
        end
        inst._wallgrid_rubble_context_installed = true
    end

    if not hooks.rubble and not hooks.rubble_warning_printed then
        hooks.rubble_warning_printed = true
        print(PATCH_LOG_PREFIX .. "Collapse-effect hook was unavailable; wall correction remains active.")
    end

    return hooks.rubble and inst._wallgrid_rubble_context_installed == true
end

local function InstallFunctionHooks()
    local prefab = _G.Prefabs ~= nil and _G.Prefabs.basement or nil
    local constructor = prefab ~= nil and prefab.fn or nil
    local on_init = FindNamedUpvalue(constructor, "OnInit")

    if _G.TheWorld ~= nil
        and _G.TheWorld.ismastersim
        and not hooks.fertilizer_spawn
        and not InstallSafeBasementFertilizerSpawn(on_init)
        and not hooks.fertilizer_spawn_warning_printed then
        hooks.fertilizer_spawn_warning_printed = true
        print(PATCH_LOG_PREFIX
            .. "Safe basement fertilizer-spawn hook was unavailable.")
    end

    if hooks.disabled then
        return
    end

    if hooks.server
        and hooks.client
        and hooks.map
        and hooks.farm_map
        and hooks.precipitation_fx then
        return
    end

    InstallBlockedPrecipitationEffects(constructor)

    if type(on_init) == "function" then
        if not hooks.server then
            local original_server_rebuild = FindNamedUpvalue(on_init, "RebuildWalls")
            if hooks.original_server_rebuild == nil
                and type(original_server_rebuild) == "function" then
                hooks.original_server_rebuild = original_server_rebuild
            end
            if type(original_server_rebuild) == "function"
                and hooks.upstream_wall_animation == nil then
                hooks.upstream_wall_animation =
                    FindNamedUpvalue(original_server_rebuild, "PlayWallAnimation")
            end
            hooks.server = ReplaceNamedUpvalue(on_init, "RebuildWalls", RebuildServerWalls)
        end

        if not hooks.client then
            local original_client_rebuild = FindNamedUpvalue(on_init, "RebuildBasementClient")
            if hooks.original_client_rebuild == nil
                and type(original_client_rebuild) == "function" then
                hooks.original_client_rebuild = original_client_rebuild
            end
            if type(original_client_rebuild) == "function" then
                if hooks.upstream_wall_animation == nil then
                    hooks.upstream_wall_animation =
                        FindNamedUpvalue(original_client_rebuild, "PlayWallAnimation")
                end

                local function RebuildClientWithCorrection(inst)
                    if not hooks.map then
                        return original_client_rebuild(inst)
                    end

                    -- Basements 1.2.6 basement.lua:1123-1194 first refreshes
                    -- the client synthetic-tile registry on its legacy phase.
                    -- Preserve that phase for the upstream builder, then
                    -- replace its transient floor visuals at their final raw-
                    -- core phase before calculating the new child void masks.
                    RunWithLegacyMapQuery(original_client_rebuild, inst)
                    CorrectClientGeometry(inst)
                end

                hooks.client = ReplaceNamedUpvalue(
                    on_init,
                    "RebuildBasementClient",
                    RebuildClientWithCorrection
                )
            end
        end
    end

    if not hooks.map
        and _G.TheNet ~= nil
        and (_G.TheNet:IsDedicated() or hooks.client) then
        InstallMapQueryHook()
    end

    if hooks.map and not hooks.farm_map then
        InstallVirtualFarmMapHooks()
    end

    if not hooks.map then
        if hooks.server and type(hooks.original_server_rebuild) == "function" then
            if ReplaceNamedUpvalue(
                on_init,
                "RebuildWalls",
                hooks.original_server_rebuild
            ) then
                hooks.server = false
            end
        end
        if hooks.client and type(hooks.original_client_rebuild) == "function" then
            if ReplaceNamedUpvalue(
                on_init,
                "RebuildBasementClient",
                hooks.original_client_rebuild
            ) then
                hooks.client = false
            end
        end
        hooks.disabled = true
    end

    if not hooks.disabled
        and (not hooks.server or not hooks.client)
        and not hooks.warning_printed then
        hooks.warning_printed = true
        print(PATCH_LOG_PREFIX .. "Internal hooks were unavailable; event fallback is active.")
    end

    if not hooks.map and not hooks.map_warning_printed then
        hooks.map_warning_printed = true
        print(PATCH_LOG_PREFIX .. "Required hooks were unavailable; the patch is disabled.")
    end
end

local function CancelTask(inst, field_name)
    local task = inst ~= nil and inst[field_name] or nil
    if task ~= nil then
        task:Cancel()
        inst[field_name] = nil
    end
end

local function QueueCorrection(inst, field_name, delay, correction)
    if not IsValidEntity(inst) or inst[field_name] ~= nil then
        return
    end

    inst[field_name] = inst:DoTaskInTime(delay or 0, function(core)
        core[field_name] = nil
        correction(core)
    end)
end

local function CancelClientFloorRecovery()
    client_recovery.generation = client_recovery.generation + 1
    if client_recovery.task ~= nil then
        client_recovery.task:Cancel()
        client_recovery.task = nil
    end
    client_recovery.attempt = 0
    client_recovery.reason = nil
    client_recovery.hinted_core = nil
    client_recovery.active_core = nil
    client_recovery.missing_core = nil
    client_recovery.missing_observations = 0
end

local function ReportClientRecoveryTimeout()
    if hooks.client_recovery_warning_printed then
        return
    end
    hooks.client_recovery_warning_printed = true

    local player_x = "unavailable"
    local player_z = "unavailable"
    local player = _G.ThePlayer
    if IsValidEntity(player) and player.Transform ~= nil then
        local x, _, z = player.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
        player_x = tostring(x)
        player_z = tostring(z)
    end

    local core = client_recovery.hinted_core
    local live, total = 0, 0
    local tile_count = 0
    local core_guid = "none"
    local awake = false
    if IsValidEntity(core) then
        core_guid = tostring(core.GUID)
        awake = IsAwake(core)
        live, total = CountLiveClientFloor(core)
        local _, count = ReadUsableTileData(core)
        tile_count = count
    end

    print(PATCH_LOG_PREFIX .. _G.string.format(
        "Client floor recovery timed out: reason=%s player=%s,%s core=%s awake=%s tiledata=%d floor=%d/%d.",
        tostring(client_recovery.reason),
        player_x,
        player_z,
        core_guid,
        tostring(awake),
        tile_count,
        live,
        total
    ))
end

local RunClientFloorRecovery

local function ScheduleClientFloorRecovery(generation, delay)
    if generation ~= client_recovery.generation
        or _G.TheWorld == nil
        or not IsValidEntity(_G.TheWorld) then
        return
    end

    client_recovery.task = _G.TheWorld:DoTaskInTime(delay or 0, function()
        client_recovery.task = nil
        if generation == client_recovery.generation then
            RunClientFloorRecovery(generation)
        end
    end)
end

RunClientFloorRecovery = function(generation)
    if generation ~= client_recovery.generation
        or not hooks.map
        or _G.TheNet == nil
        or _G.TheNet:IsDedicated() then
        return
    end

    client_recovery.attempt = client_recovery.attempt + 1
    local player = _G.ThePlayer
    local core = nil
    if IsValidEntity(player)
        and player.Transform ~= nil
        and player.GetTimeAlive ~= nil
        and player:GetTimeAlive() > 0.5 then
        core = FindOccupiedClientCore(player, client_recovery.hinted_core)
    end

    if IsAwake(core) and ReadUsableTileData(core) ~= nil then
        client_recovery.active_core = core
        if generation ~= client_recovery.generation then
            return
        end

        -- The required Mod's OnEntityWake client path has already built the
        -- ordinary floor before core_ready is queued. Never run that global
        -- synthetic-tile builder a second time while live chunks exist: its
        -- second void-mask pass can leave valid entities fully obscured. Only
        -- an actually empty/invalid inst.tiles list is eligible for recovery.
        local live_before = CountLiveClientFloor(core)
        if live_before <= 0 then
            if client_recovery.missing_core ~= core then
                client_recovery.missing_core = core
                client_recovery.missing_observations = 0
            end
            client_recovery.missing_observations =
                client_recovery.missing_observations + 1

            -- Basements may schedule its own short client retry while waking.
            -- Require two consecutive missing observations before invoking the
            -- global synthetic-tile builder, so our fallback cannot race and
            -- duplicate that ordinary initialization.
            if client_recovery.missing_observations < 2 then
                client_recovery.active_core = nil
                ScheduleClientFloorRecovery(
                    generation,
                    CLIENT_RECOVERY_FAST_DELAY
                )
                return
            end
        else
            client_recovery.missing_core = nil
            client_recovery.missing_observations = 0
        end

        local recovered = CorrectClientGeometry(core)
        client_recovery.active_core = nil
        if generation ~= client_recovery.generation then
            return
        end

        if recovered then
            local live, total = CountLiveClientFloor(core)
            if not core._wallgrid_client_recovery_reported then
                core._wallgrid_client_recovery_reported = true
                print(PATCH_LOG_PREFIX .. _G.string.format(
                    "Client floor recovery completed: reason=%s core=%s attempts=%d action=%s floor=%d/%d.",
                    tostring(client_recovery.reason),
                    tostring(core.GUID),
                    client_recovery.attempt,
                    live_before > 0 and "verified" or "rebuilt",
                    live,
                    total
                ))
            end
            client_recovery.task = nil
            client_recovery.attempt = 0
            client_recovery.reason = nil
            client_recovery.hinted_core = nil
            client_recovery.missing_core = nil
            client_recovery.missing_observations = 0
            return
        end
    end

    if client_recovery.attempt >= CLIENT_RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS then
        ReportClientRecoveryTimeout()
        client_recovery.task = nil
        client_recovery.reason = nil
        client_recovery.hinted_core = nil
        client_recovery.active_core = nil
        client_recovery.missing_core = nil
        client_recovery.missing_observations = 0
        return
    end

    local delay = client_recovery.attempt < CLIENT_RECOVERY_FAST_ATTEMPTS
        and CLIENT_RECOVERY_FAST_DELAY
        or CLIENT_RECOVERY_SLOW_DELAY
    ScheduleClientFloorRecovery(generation, delay)
end

local function RequestClientFloorRecovery(reason, hinted_core)
    if not hooks.map
        or _G.TheNet == nil
        or _G.TheNet:IsDedicated()
        or _G.TheWorld == nil then
        return
    end

    CancelClientFloorRecovery()
    client_recovery.reason = reason or "unspecified"
    client_recovery.hinted_core = basement_cores[hinted_core]
        and hinted_core
        or nil
    ScheduleClientFloorRecovery(client_recovery.generation, 0)
end

local function QueueClientReadyCorrection(inst)
    RequestClientFloorRecovery("core_ready", inst)
end

local function InstallClientFloorLifecycleHooks()
    if _G.TheWorld == nil
        or _G.TheNet == nil
        or _G.TheNet:IsDedicated()
        or _G.TheWorld._wallgrid_client_lifecycle_hooks then
        return
    end

    _G.TheWorld._wallgrid_client_lifecycle_hooks = true
    _G.TheWorld:ListenForEvent("playeractivated", function(_, player)
        if player == nil or player == _G.ThePlayer then
            RequestClientFloorRecovery("playeractivated", nil)
        end
    end)
    _G.TheWorld:ListenForEvent("playerdeactivated", function(_, player)
        if player == nil or player == _G.ThePlayer then
            CancelClientFloorRecovery()
        end
    end)
    _G.TheWorld:ListenForEvent("onremove", CancelClientFloorRecovery)
end

local function CancelPendingCorrections(inst)
    CancelTask(inst, "_wallgrid_server_task")
    CancelTask(inst, "_wallgrid_client_task")
    CancelTask(inst, "_basement_reborn_farm_migration_task")
end

local function OnCoreRemoved(inst)
    basement_cores[inst] = nil
    core_phase_cache[inst] = nil
    if last_query_core == inst then
        last_query_core = nil
    end
    if last_weather_core == inst then
        last_weather_core = nil
    end
    if client_recovery.hinted_core == inst
        or client_recovery.active_core == inst then
        CancelClientFloorRecovery()
    end
    CancelPendingCorrections(inst)
end

AddSimPostInit(function()
    InstallFarmPlowTileArrivalCompatibility()
    ExtendBasementWorldState()
    InstallPrecipitationShelterHook()
    InstallSoilDrinkerEventRouter()
    InstallClientFloorLifecycleHooks()
end)

AddPrefabPostInit("farm_plow_item", InstallFarmPlowCompatibility)
AddPrefabPostInit("wall_basement", function(inst)
    -- The upstream wall has workable on both host and remote client. Removing
    -- its official MINE_workable tag also removes the normal mining prompt.
    ExpansionPolicy.InstallWall(inst, ALLOW_BASEMENT_EXPANSION)
end)
AddPrefabPostInit("farm_plow_item_placer", InstallFarmPlowPlacerCompatibility)
AddPrefabPostInit("basement_tile", StabilizeClientFloorPrefab)
AddPrefabPostInit("basement_voidtile", StabilizeClientFloorPrefab)
AddPrefabPostInit(
    "basement_background",
    InstallBasementBackgroundMousePassthrough
)

AddPrefabPostInit("basement", function(inst)
    basement_cores[inst] = true
    ExtendBasementWorldState()
    InstallPrecipitationShelterHook()
    InstallFunctionHooks()
    InstallRubbleHook(inst)
    if _G.TheWorld ~= nil and _G.TheWorld.ismastersim then
        ExpansionPolicy.InstallCore(inst, ALLOW_BASEMENT_EXPANSION, Geometry)
        QueueCorrection(
            inst,
            "_basement_reborn_farm_migration_task",
            0.2,
            MigrateLegacyFarmSoilGrid
        )
    end

    local original_wake = inst.OnEntityWake
    if type(original_wake) == "function" then
        inst.OnEntityWake = function(core, ...)
            original_wake(core, ...)

            if hooks.map
                and _G.TheWorld ~= nil
                and _G.TheWorld.ismastersim
                and not hooks.server then
                QueueCorrection(core, "_wallgrid_server_task", 0, RebuildServerWalls)
            end
            QueueClientReadyCorrection(core)
        end
    end

    local original_sleep = inst.OnEntitySleep
    if type(original_sleep) == "function" then
        inst.OnEntitySleep = function(core, ...)
            CancelPendingCorrections(core)
            return original_sleep(core, ...)
        end
    end

    inst:ListenForEvent("ontilechanged", function(core)
        if hooks.map
            and _G.TheWorld ~= nil
            and _G.TheWorld.ismastersim
            and not hooks.server then
            QueueCorrection(core, "_wallgrid_server_task", 0, RebuildServerWalls)
        end
        if hooks.map and not hooks.client then
            QueueCorrection(core, "_wallgrid_client_task", 0, CorrectClientGeometry)
        end
        RequestClientFloorRecovery("tiledata_changed", core)
    end)

    inst:ListenForEvent("onremove", OnCoreRemoved)

    if hooks.map
        and _G.TheWorld ~= nil
        and _G.TheWorld.ismastersim
        and not hooks.server then
        QueueCorrection(inst, "_wallgrid_server_task", 0, RebuildServerWalls)
    end
    QueueClientReadyCorrection(inst)
end)

```



### 变体演进：「残刃·无恃」 (Mod 3388543143)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3388543143 (`「残刃·无恃」`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3388543143)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat
-- 服务端专用：客户端不实例化combat组件，AddComponentPostInit只在服务端回调。
AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
    local OldCanBeAttacked = self.CanBeAttacked
    self.CanBeAttacked = function(self, attacker, ...)
        local target = self.inst
        if attacker ~= nil and attacker:IsValid() and attacker ~= target
            and target ~= nil and target:HasTag("player") and not target:IsInLimbo() then
            local px, _, pz = target.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
            -- 结界最大半径18，搜索20必覆盖到刀
            for _, rod in ipairs(GLOBAL.TheSim:FindEntities(px, 0, pz, 20, { "lightningrod" })) do
                local shield = rod.mdqr_shield
                if shield ~= nil and shield:IsValid() then
                    local r = shield.mdqr_blockradius or 6
                    local sx, _, sz = shield.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
                    if (px - sx) * (px - sx) + (pz - sz) * (pz - sz) <= r * r then
                        -- 玩家在结界内：攻击者在结界外则挡下（结界内刷出的怪/贴身目标不受影响）
                        local ax, _, az = attacker.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
                        if (ax - sx) * (ax - sx) + (az - sz) * (az - sz) > r * r then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return OldCanBeAttacked(self, attacker, ...)
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:mdqr

 AddPrefabPostInit("mdqr",function(inst)
    -- 武器/工具/划船/耐久/防水/保暖/作祟全是服务端组件：只在服务端添加。
    -- 客户端靠预制体里打好的 "weapon" tag（mdqr.lua）识别为武器，与官方spear一致。
    if not GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim then
        return
    end
    inst:AddComponent("weapon")
    inst.components.weapon:SetDamage(60)
    inst.components.weapon:SetRange(2,2)
    inst:AddComponent("tool")
    -- 砍树效率：默认斧头同款（不一刀秒），镶紫宝石后在MdqrApplyGemEffect改为一刀砍树（CHOP_EFF_ONEHIT）
    inst.components.tool:SetAction(ACTIONS.CHOP, CHOP_EFF_AXE)
    inst.components.tool:SetAction(ACTIONS.MINE, 2)
    -- 划船功能：oar组件 + 允许在水面使用
    inst:AddTag("allow_action_on_impassable")
    inst:AddComponent("oar")
    inst.components.oar.force = 0.8        -- 划船力度（与蛇皮桨malbatross同级）
    inst.components.oar.max_velocity = 5  -- 最大划船速度
    -- 锤子功能
    inst.components.tool:SetAction(ACTIONS.HAMMER)
    -- 铲子功能
    inst.components.tool:SetAction(ACTIONS.DIG)
    -- 移速1.5倍改为绿宝石解锁：基础1.0，镶嵌绿宝石后在 MdqrApplyGemEffect 中设为1.5
    if inst.components.equippable then inst.components.equippable.walkspeedmult = 1 end
    -- 基础耐久100：攻击/砍/挖/锤/铲每次成功动作耗1点（bufferedaction.lua:30成功后→OnUsedAsItem按消耗表扣）
    -- 耗尽不销毁：进入损坏状态（不能攻击/工具/划船/闪烁），每3秒回复1点；镶嵌黄宝石后整组移除=无限耐久
    inst:AddComponent("finiteuses")
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetMaxUses(100)
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetUses(100)
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetOnFinished(MdqrOnUsesFinished)
    -- 工具消耗走 bufferedaction.lua:30 的 OnUsedAsItem 消耗表（动作带invobject）；
    -- 攻击消耗由 weapon 组件自动处理（weapon.lua:111-120 每次命中-1），无需注册ATTACK
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetConsumption(ACTIONS.CHOP, 1)
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetConsumption(ACTIONS.MINE, 1)
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetConsumption(ACTIONS.HAMMER, 1)
    inst.components.finiteuses:SetConsumption(ACTIONS.DIG, 1)
    -- 耐久恢复任务改为"损坏时才启动"（onfinished/读档损坏时调MdqrStartRecover），不常驻
    -- 攻击特效按宝石解锁（2026-09-03）：红=攻击回血+8/次；蓝=攻击附加冰冻(+1冷凝值/次)；
    -- 攻击回复san已按用户要求整体取消
    local function onattack(weapon, attacker, target)
        if attacker == nil or target == nil then
            return
        end
        if inst:HasTag("mdqr_gem_red") and attacker.components.health ~= nil then
            attacker.components.health:DoDelta(8)
        end
        if inst:HasTag("mdqr_gem_blue")
            and target.components ~= nil and target.components.freezable ~= nil then
            target.components.freezable:AddColdness(1)
        end
    end
    inst.components.weapon:SetOnAttack(onattack)
    inst:AddComponent("waterproofer")
    inst.components.waterproofer:SetEffectiveness(1)
    inst:AddComponent("insulator")
    if "summer"=="summer" then  
        inst.components.insulator:SetSummer()
    else 
        inst.components.insulator:SetWinter()
    end 
    inst.components.insulator:SetInsulation(240)
    -- 作祟复活（橙宝石解锁）：onhaunt返回false则不触发INSTANT_REZ(hauntable.lua:88-93)
    inst:AddComponent("hauntable")
    inst.components.hauntable:SetHauntValue(TUNING.HAUNT_INSTANT_REZ)
    inst.components.hauntable.no_wipe_value = true   -- 不限复活次数
    inst.components.hauntable:SetOnHauntFn(function(i, doer)
        if not i:HasTag("mdqr_gem_orange") then
            return false
        end
        -- 复活惩罚：每次作祟复活后降低 20% 最大血量上限（作用于复活者doer，用原生penalty机制，自动封顶75%）
        if doer ~= nil and doer.components.health ~= nil then
            doer.components.health:DeltaPenalty(0.2)
        end
        MdqrStory.ChatFor(i, "revive")   -- 叙事：橙宝石复活触发（i是刀，作祟者复活时刀在身上）
        return true
    end)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:forest
-- 实际联机世界的 prefab 名分别是 forest / cave；保留 world 兼容特殊世界与测试环境。
AddPrefabPostInit("forest", MdqrInitUniqueWorld)
AddPrefabPostInit("cave", MdqrInitUniqueWorld)
AddPrefabPostInit("world", MdqrInitUniqueWorld)

-- 制作前检测：服务器最终校验，防止客户端标签延迟或连续点击绕过限制。
local function mdqr_canbuild(recipe, builder, pt, rotation, prototyper, skin)
    if GLOBAL.TheWorld.mdqr_unique_crafted == true or not builder:HasTag(MDQR_CRAFT_TAG) then
        if builder.components.talker ~= nil then
            builder.components.talker:Say("此世残刃已然有主，唯有分锋方可再得。")
        end
        return false
    end
    return true
end
```
