### 变体演进：language (Mod 3809795697)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3809795697 (`language`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3809795697)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playeractionpicker
-- 走官方 LeftClick/寻路/预测流程，日常鼠标操作不会出现 R。
AddComponentPostInit("playeractionpicker", function(self)
    local GetLeftClickActions = self.GetLeftClickActions
    self.GetLeftClickActions = function(self, position, target, ...)
        local skills = self.inst.replica.darius_skills
        if skills ~= nil and (self.inst == ThePlayer and skills:IsGuillotineTargeting()
            or TheWorld.ismastersim and CLIENT_REQUESTED_ACTION == ACTIONS.DARIUS_GUILLOTINE) then
            if skills:CanGuillotineTarget(target, false) then
                return { BufferedAction(self.inst, target, ACTIONS.DARIUS_GUILLOTINE) }
            end
            return {}
        end
        return GetLeftClickActions(self, position, target, ...)
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:cursable
-- 沿用 xiaomo 的芜猴诅咒免疫，仅对诺手生效。
AddComponentPostInit("cursable", function(self)
    local oldIsCursable = self.IsCursable
    function self:IsCursable(item)
        if self.inst.prefab == "darius" and item and item.components.curseditem
            and item.components.curseditem.curse == "MONKEY" then
            return false
        end
        return oldIsCursable(self, item)
    end

    local oldApplyCurse = self.ApplyCurse
    function self:ApplyCurse(item, curse)
        if self.inst.prefab == "darius" and (curse == "MONKEY"
            or item and item.components.curseditem and item.components.curseditem.curse == "MONKEY") then
            if item ~= nil and item.components.curseditem ~= nil then
                item:RemoveTag("applied_curse")
                item.components.curseditem.cursed_target = nil
            end
            return
        end
        return oldApplyCurse(self, item, curse)
    end

    local oldForceOntoOwner = self.ForceOntoOwner
    function self:ForceOntoOwner(item)
        if self.inst.prefab == "darius" and item and item.components.curseditem
            and item.components.curseditem.curse == "MONKEY" then
            return
        end
        return oldForceOntoOwner(self, item)
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat
-- 只在实际普攻的调用期间允许 W 强化，单纯查询伤害或其他技能不会消耗强化。
AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
    local oldGetAttacked = self.GetAttacked
    function self:GetAttacked(attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, ...)
        -- W 的武器加成、血怒、属性和本次攻击倍率已在调用方算完，只在最终收伤入口加一次。
        local skills = attacker ~= nil and attacker.components.darius_skills or nil
        if TUNING.DARIUS_W_HEALTH_DAMAGE and skills ~= nil and skills.decimatehit == nil
            and skills:IsCripplingAttack(self.inst, weapon) and type(damage) == "number" then
            local bleed = self.inst.components.darius_bleed
            local health = self.inst.components.health
            if bleed ~= nil and bleed:GetStacks(attacker) >= 5 and health ~= nil and not health:IsDead() then
                damage = damage + health.currenthealth * .01
            end
        end
        return oldGetAttacked(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, ...)
    end

    local oldDoAttack = self.DoAttack
    function self:DoAttack(target, weapon, projectile, ...)
        local skills = self.inst.components.darius_skills
        if skills == nil or not skills:IsCripplingStrikeReady() then
            return oldDoAttack(self, target, weapon, projectile, ...)
        end
        local attack = skills:BeginCripplingAttack(target or self.target, weapon or self:GetWeapon())
        local result = oldDoAttack(self, target, weapon, projectile, ...)
        if attack ~= nil then skills:EndCripplingAttack(attack) end
        return result
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:weapon

AddComponentPostInit("weapon", function(self)
    local oldGetDamage = self.GetDamage
    function self:GetDamage(attacker, target, ...)
        local damage, spdamage = oldGetDamage(self, attacker, target, ...)
        local skills = attacker ~= nil and attacker.components.darius_skills or nil
        if skills ~= nil and skills:IsCripplingAttack(target, self.inst) and type(damage) == "number" then
            damage = damage * (1 + TUNING.DARIUS_W_BONUS)
        end
        return damage, spdamage
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:freezable
-- 沿用 xd_server_only 的防冻结入口，仅在诺手 Q/E/R 的当前施法状态中生效。
AddComponentPostInit("freezable", function(self)
    local oldAddColdness = self.AddColdness
    function self:AddColdness(...)
        if self.inst.sg ~= nil and self.inst.sg.statemem.darius_controlimmune then return end
        return oldAddColdness(self, ...)
    end

    local oldFreeze = self.Freeze
    function self:Freeze(...)
        if self.inst.sg ~= nil and self.inst.sg.statemem.darius_controlimmune then return end
        return oldFreeze(self, ...)
    end
end)

```



### 变体演进：Mod 3772683476 (Mod 3772683476)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3772683476 (`Mod 3772683476`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3772683476)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:colourcube

AddComponentPostInit("colourcube", function(self, inst)
    if TheWorld.is_adventure then
        self:AddSeasonColourCube(AD_SEASON_COLOURCUBES)
        self.adventure_mode = true
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:moisture

AddComponentPostInit("moisture", function(self, inst)
    if not inst:HasTag("player") or not TheWorld:IsAdventurePreset("RAINY") then
        return
    end

    local _GetMoistureRateAssumingRain = self._GetMoistureRateAssumingRain
    function self:_GetMoistureRateAssumingRain()
        return _GetMoistureRateAssumingRain(self) * RAIN_MOISTURE_RATE_MULTIPLIER
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:weather

AddComponentPostInit("weather", function(self)
    if not TheWorld:IsAdventurePreset("RAINY") then
        return
    end

    local CalculateWetnessRate, scope_fn, index =
        ToolUtil.GetUpvalue(self.OnUpdate, "CalculateWetnessRate")
    if CalculateWetnessRate == nil then
        print("[weather] failed to find CalculateWetnessRate upvalue")
    else
        debug.setupvalue(scope_fn, index, function(temperature, preciprate)
            local rate = CalculateWetnessRate(temperature, preciprate)
            return rate > 0 and rate * RAIN_WETNESS_RATE_MULTIPLIER or rate
        end)
    end

    local hasfx = ToolUtil.GetUpvalue(self.OnUpdate, "_hasfx")
    if not hasfx then
        return
    end

    local rainfx = ToolUtil.GetUpvalue(self.OnUpdate, "_rainfx")
    if rainfx == nil then
        print("[weather] failed to find _rainfx upvalue")
        return
    end

    local OnUpdate = self.OnUpdate
    local LongUpdate = self.LongUpdate
    function self:OnUpdate(dt)
        OnUpdate(self, dt)
        rainfx.particles_per_tick = rainfx.particles_per_tick * RAIN_FX_MULTIPLIER
        rainfx.splashes_per_tick = rainfx.splashes_per_tick * RAIN_FX_MULTIPLIER
    end

    if LongUpdate == OnUpdate then
        self.LongUpdate = self.OnUpdate
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:worldreset

AddComponentPostInit("worldreset", function(self)
    if not TheWorld.ismastershard then
        return
    end

    -- Keep the vanilla countdown and replace only its terminal action.
    local WorldReset, OnUpdate, index = ToolUtil.GetUpvalue(self.OnUpdate, "WorldReset")
    if WorldReset == nil then
        return
    end

    debug.setupvalue(OnUpdate, index, function()
        if TheWorld.is_adventure then
            WorldResetFromSim()
            return
        end

        WorldReset()
    end)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:worldstate

AddComponentPostInit("worldstate", function(self, inst)
    local _watchers = ToolUtil.GetUpvalue(self.AddWatcher, "_watchers")
    if _watchers == nil then
        print("[worldstate] failed to find _watchers upvalue")
        return
    end

    local function GetFunctionInfo(fn)
        return debug ~= nil and debug.getinfo(fn, "Sln") or nil
    end

    local BuildCallbackEntry

    local function BuildListenerEntry(listener_inst, var, watcherfns)
        local entry = {
            inst = listener_inst,
            target = nil,
            fns = {},
            entries = {},
        }

        for i, raw in ipairs(watcherfns) do
            local callback = BuildCallbackEntry(raw[1], raw[2], i, listener_inst, var)
            entry.target = entry.target or callback.target
            table.insert(entry.fns, callback.fn)
            table.insert(entry.entries, callback)
        end

        return entry
    end

    BuildCallbackEntry = function(fn, target, index, listener_inst, var)
        local info = GetFunctionInfo(fn) or {}
        return {
            fn          = fn,
            target      = target,
            inst        = listener_inst,
            var         = var,
            source      = info.source,
            short_src   = info.short_src,
            linedefined = info.linedefined,
            lastlinedefined = info.lastlinedefined,
            name        = info.name,
            namewhat    = info.namewhat,
            what        = info.what,
            index       = index,
        }
    end

    function self:GetWorldStateWatchFns(var, listener_inst)
        local watchers = _watchers[var]
        if watchers == nil then
            return {}
        end

        if listener_inst ~= nil then
            local watcherfns = watchers[listener_inst]
            local out = {}
            if watcherfns ~= nil then
                for _, raw in ipairs(watcherfns) do
                    table.insert(out, raw[1])
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        local out = {}
        for watcher_inst, watcherfns in pairs(watchers) do
            table.insert(out, BuildListenerEntry(watcher_inst, var, watcherfns))
        end
        return out
    end

    function self:GetWorldStateWatchEntries(var, listener_inst)
        local watchers = _watchers[var]
        local out = {}
        if watchers == nil then
            return out
        end

        if listener_inst ~= nil then
            local watcherfns = watchers[listener_inst]
            if watcherfns ~= nil then
                for i, raw in ipairs(watcherfns) do
                    table.insert(out, BuildCallbackEntry(raw[1], raw[2], i, listener_inst, var))
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        for watcher_inst, watcherfns in pairs(watchers) do
            for i, raw in ipairs(watcherfns) do
                table.insert(out, BuildCallbackEntry(raw[1], raw[2], i, watcher_inst, var))
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    function self:GetWorldStateWatchFn(var, listener_inst, target, source_query, test_fn)
        local fallback = nil

        for _, entry in ipairs(self:GetWorldStateWatchEntries(var, listener_inst)) do
            if target == nil or entry.target == target then
                local source_match = source_query ~= nil and SourceMatches(entry.source, source_query)
                local test_match = test_fn ~= nil and test_fn(entry.fn, entry)

                if source_match or test_match then
                    return entry.fn
                elseif source_query == nil and test_fn == nil then
                    fallback = fallback or entry.fn
                end
            end
        end

        local watcherfns = listener_inst ~= nil
            and listener_inst.worldstatewatching ~= nil
            and listener_inst.worldstatewatching[var]
            or nil
        if watcherfns ~= nil and (source_query ~= nil or test_fn ~= nil) then
            for i, fn in ipairs(watcherfns) do
                if type(fn) == "function" then
                    local entry = BuildCallbackEntry(fn, nil, i, listener_inst, var)
                    local source_match = source_query ~= nil and SourceMatches(entry.source, source_query)
                    local test_match = test_fn ~= nil and test_fn(entry.fn, entry)

                    if source_match or test_match then
                        return entry.fn
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return fallback
    end

    function self:FindWorldStateWatchFn(...)
        return self:GetWorldStateWatchFn(...)
    end
end)
```

```lua
    if tophat_enhanced then
        AddPrefabPostInit("tophat", function(inst)
            if not TheWorld.ismastersim then

            -- 对魔术师高礼帽应用增强（只应用一次）
            local function apply_magician_buff(owner)
                if inst._magician_buff_applied then
                    return
                end
                inst._magician_buff_applied = true

                -- 冬保暖夏隔热（按季节自动切换，冬夏均为 120）
                if enable_tophat_insulation then
                    if inst.components.insulator == nil then
                        inst:AddComponent("insulator")
                        inst.components.insulator:SetInsulation(0)
                    end
                    local function update_insulation()
                        if TheWorld.state.issummer then
                            inst.components.insulator:SetSummer()
                        else
                            inst.components.insulator:SetWinter()
                        end
                        inst.components.insulator:SetInsulation(120)
                    end
                    update_insulation()
                    inst:WatchWorldState("issummer", update_insulation)
                    inst:WatchWorldState("iswinter", update_insulation)
                end

                -- 防水（默认 20% = 原版）
                if inst.components.waterproofer ~= nil then
                    inst.components.waterproofer:SetEffectiveness(tophat_waterproof / 100)
                end
            end

            -- 老麦佩戴不掉耐久
            if enable_tophat_durability and inst.components.fueled ~= nil then
                local ORIGINAL_DELTA_KEY = "_orig_tophat_fueled_delta"
                inst[ORIGINAL_DELTA_KEY] = inst.components.fueled.DoDelta
                local function ProxyDoDelta(self, delta, overtime, ignore_depleted_fn)
                    local owner = inst.components.inventoryitem and inst.components.inventoryitem.owner or nil
                    if inst:HasTag("magiciantool") and owner ~= nil and owner.prefab == "waxwell" and delta < 0 then
                        delta = 0
                    end
                    local original_func = inst[ORIGINAL_DELTA_KEY]
                    if original_func then
                        return original_func(self, delta, overtime, ignore_depleted_fn)
                    end
                end
                inst.components.fueled.DoDelta = ProxyDoDelta
                inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
                    if inst.components.fueled and inst.components.fueled.DoDelta ~= ProxyDoDelta then
                        inst.components.fueled.DoDelta = ProxyDoDelta
                    end
                end)
            end

            -- 触发方式1：PostInit时标签已存在（读档时帽子已是魔术师高礼帽）
            if inst:HasTag("magiciantool") then
                apply_magician_buff()
            end
            -- 触发方式2：Hook AddTag，捕获运行时 magiciantool 标签的添加
            local _orig_AddTag = inst.AddTag
            inst.AddTag = function(self, tag)
                _orig_AddTag(self, tag)
                if tag == "magiciantool" then
                    apply_magician_buff()
                end
            end
            -- 触发方式3：装备回调（增强）
            if inst.components.equippable ~= nil then
                local _old_onequip = inst.components.equippable.onequipfn
                inst.components.equippable.onequipfn = function(item, owner)
                    if _old_onequip ~= nil then
                        _old_onequip(item, owner)
                    end
                    if owner ~= nil and owner:HasTag("magician") then
                        apply_magician_buff(owner)
                    end
                end
                local _old_onunequip = inst.components.equippable.onunequipfn
                inst.components.equippable.onunequipfn = function(item, owner)
                    if _old_onunequip ~= nil then
                        _old_onunequip(item, owner)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
```

### 变体演进：饮食均衡测试前瞻版 (Mod 3803772794)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3803772794 (`饮食均衡测试前瞻版`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3803772794)

local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:builder
-- 强化 tag 其他角色也有，配方再限制成韦斯
AddComponentPostInit("builder", function(self)
    local old_KnowsRecipe = self.KnowsRecipe
    if old_KnowsRecipe ~= nil then
        self.KnowsRecipe = function(builder, recipe, ignore_tempbonus, cached_tech_trees)
            if type(recipe) == "string" then
                recipe = GLOBAL.GetValidRecipe(recipe)
            end
            if recipe ~= nil
                and recipe.builder_tag == "diet_hero_buff"
                and builder.inst.prefab ~= "wes" then
                return false
            end
            return old_KnowsRecipe(builder, recipe, ignore_tempbonus, cached_tech_trees)
        end
    end

    -- 让饱食度作为一种角色材料参与检查
    local old_HasCharacterIngredient = self.HasCharacterIngredient
    if old_HasCharacterIngredient ~= nil then
        self.HasCharacterIngredient = function(builder, ingredient)
            if ingredient ~= nil and ingredient.type == BALLOON_HUNGER_TYPE then
                local hunger = builder.inst.components.hunger
                if hunger == nil then
                    return false, 0
                end
                return hunger.current >= ingredient.amount, hunger.current
            end
            return old_HasCharacterIngredient(builder, ingredient)
        end
    end

    -- 制作完成时扣除饱食度（批量由 batchcraft 统一扣）
    local old_RemoveIngredients = self.RemoveIngredients
    if old_RemoveIngredients ~= nil then
        self.RemoveIngredients = function(builder, ingredients, recname, discounted)
            local recipe = GLOBAL.AllRecipes and GLOBAL.AllRecipes[recname] or nil
            local hunger_cost = 0
            for _, v in ipairs(recipe ~= nil and recipe.character_ingredients or {}) do
                if v.type == BALLOON_HUNGER_TYPE then
                    hunger_cost = hunger_cost + v.amount
                end
            end

            local skip = builder._nutritional_batch_skip
            local is_batch = skip ~= nil
                and skip.recipe == recname
                and GLOBAL.GetTime() - (skip.time or 0) <= 10

            old_RemoveIngredients(builder, ingredients, recname, discounted)

            if hunger_cost > 0 and not is_batch then
                local hunger = builder.inst.components.hunger
                if hunger ~= nil then
                    hunger:DoDelta(-hunger_cost)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

    AddPrefabPostInit("beebox", function(inst)
        local harvestable = inst.components.harvestable
        if harvestable ~= nil then

            -- 原版 SetMaxChildren 会立刻把 childreninside 填满；

            local old_SetMaxChildren = spawner.SetMaxChildren

                    self.maxchildren = MAX_BEES
                    if self.childreninside < BASE_BEES then
                        self.childreninside = math.max(0, BASE_BEES - self:CountChildrenOutside())
                    end
                    self:StartUpdate()
                else
                    old_SetMaxChildren(self, max)
                end
            end

            spawner.maxchildren = MAX_BEES
            spawner:StartUpdate()
        end
    end)

                    if comp.inst:HasTag("beebox") then
                        -- 收取蜂箱：养蜂帽 / 蜂王冠都不惊动蜜蜂

                    elseif comp.inst:HasTag("beehive") and IsCrown(hat) then

                    end

            end

    -- 蜂王冠全免疫：蜜蜂重新选目标时跳过没有主动攻击的戴冠者

        local old_CanTarget = self.CanTarget
        if old_CanTarget == nil then return end

        self.CanTarget = function(comp, target)
            if target ~= nil
                and comp.inst:HasTag("bee")
                and IsCrownWearer(target)
                and not HasBeeHostility(target)
            then
                return false
            end
            return old_CanTarget(comp, target)
        end
    end)

    -- 兜底：已经锁定了戴冠者的蜜蜂，定期取消目标
    AddPlayerPostInit(function(inst)
        inst:DoPeriodicTask(1, function(player)
            if not player:IsValid() then return end
            if not IsCrownWearer(player) or HasBeeHostility(player) then return end

            local x, y, z = player.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
            local bees = GLOBAL.TheSim:FindEntities(x, y, z, 30, { "bee" }, { "INLIMBO" })
            for _, bee in ipairs(bees) do
                local combat = bee.components.combat
                if combat ~= nil and combat.target == player then
                    combat:SetTarget(nil)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

AddComponentPostInit("finiteuses", function(self)
    local old_Use = self.Use
    if not old_Use then return end
    self.Use = function(inst_self, amount, ...)
        amount = amount or 1
        local ent = inst_self and inst_self.inst
        local inv = ent and ent.components and ent.components.inventoryitem
        local owner = inv and inv.owner
        local bal = owner and owner.components and owner.components.nutritionalbalance
        local mult = bal and bal.vitality_mult
        if mult and mult > 0 and math.random() < mult then return end
        return old_Use(inst_self, amount, ...)
    end
end)
```

### 变体演进：更爽的鱼人语音和行为 (Mod 3816520491)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3816520491 (`更爽的鱼人语音和行为`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================

local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:mermking
local function ApplyMermKingStorage()
    AddPrefabPostInit("mermking", function(inst)
        if not GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim then
            return
        end
        if not MERM_KING_STORAGE_ENABLED then
            return
        end

        -- 储物格（右键打开，手动放入）
        if inst.components.container == nil then
            inst:AddComponent("container")
            inst.components.container:WidgetSetup("chester")
        end

        -- 关键：阻止原版把「持物左键」识别成往容器里放东西（STORE），
        -- 这样持物左键会走 GIVE（喂食/交易/递交任务物品），而不是放容器。
        inst:AddTag("no_container_store")

        -- 保鲜（和鱼人同一个倍率）
        if inst.components.preserver == nil then
            inst:AddComponent("preserver")
        end
        inst.components.preserver:SetPerishRateMultiplier(MERM_PRESERVE_MULT)

        -- 左键喂食/交易/递交走原版 trader 逻辑，不再自动存进储物格；
        -- 储物格改为纯手动：右键打开后由玩家自己放入食物。

        -- 记录「点了饱食君主的沃特」，用于自动吃时保持技能加成（普通喂食/没技能的不记录）
        if inst.RefreshHungerParameters ~= nil then
            local old_refresh = inst.RefreshHungerParameters
            inst.RefreshHungerParameters = function(inst2, feeder)
                if feeder ~= nil
                    and feeder.components.skilltreeupdater ~= nil
                    and feeder.components.skilltreeupdater:CountSkillTag("merm_king_max_hunger") > 0 then
                    inst2._mermking_skilled_feeder = feeder
                end
                return old_refresh(inst2, feeder)
            end
        end

        -- 饿了自动食用
        inst:ListenForEvent("hungerdelta", function(inst2, data)
            local percent = data and data.newpercent
            if percent ~= nil and percent < 0.9 then
                TryEatFromStorage(inst2)
            end
        end)
    end)
```

### 变体演进：Title (Mod 2601796546)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 2601796546 (`Title`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 2601796546)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:healer
--无法治疗
AddComponentPostInit("healer",function(self)
	local old = self.Heal
	self.Heal = function(self,target)
		if target:HasTag("asakiri") and target.components.health ~= nil  and not target.components.health:IsDead() then
			if target.components.talker then
				target.components.talker:Say("它修复不了我的躯体。")
			end
			return false
		end
		return old(self,target)
	end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:maxhealer
--无法打针
AddComponentPostInit("maxhealer",function(self)
	local old = self.Heal
	self.Heal = function(self,target)
		if target:HasTag("asakiri") and target.components.health ~= nil  and not target.components.health:IsDead() then
			return false
		end
		return old(self,target)
	end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat

AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self, inst)
    local oldGetAttacked = self.GetAttacked
    function self:GetAttacked(attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage)
		if self.inst:HasTag("player") then
			if self.inst:HasTag("asakiri") then
				if self.inst.asa_invincible and self.inst.asa_invincible:value() then
					return
				end
				if self.inst.maxskill:value() == 2 then
					Asa_Repelling(inst, attacker, damage)
					damage = 0
				end
			end
			--面甲、无人机减伤
			local inv = self.inst.components.inventory
			if inv then
				if inv:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD) and inv:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD):HasTag("asa_vizard") then
					damage = damage * 0.8
				end
				if self.inst:HasTag("asa_shielded") then
					damage = damage * 0.4
					if (inv:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.NECK) and inv:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.NECK):HasTag("asa_shield_drone"))
							or (inv:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.BODY) and inv:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.BODY):HasTag("asa_shield_drone")) then
						local drone = inv:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.NECK) or inv:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.BODY)
						drone.components.fueled:DoDelta(- 1.5 * damage)
						SpawnPrefab("asa_shield_fx"):SetInit(self.inst, attacker)
						self.inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("asakiri_sfx/asakiri_sfx/equip2")
					end
				end
			end
		end
        return oldGetAttacked(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage)
	end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson

AddStategraphPostInit('wilson',function(sg)
	local old_broke = sg.events["toolbroke"].fn
    sg.events["toolbroke"] = EventHandler("toolbroke", function(inst, data,...)
		if data.tool:HasTag("asa_axe") then
			return
		end
		return old_broke(inst, data,...)
    end)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:hauntable
local gamemode = TheNet:GetServerGameMode()
AddComponentPostInit("hauntable",function(self)
	local old_DoHaunt = self.DoHaunt
	function self:DoHaunt(doer,...)
		if doer and doer.prefab == "asakiri" then
			if self.onhaunt ~= nil then
				self.haunted = self.onhaunt(self.inst, doer)
				if self.haunted then
				if doer ~= nil then
						if GetPortalRez(gamemode) and self.hauntvalue == TUNING.HAUNT_INSTANT_REZ and doer:HasTag("playerghost") then 
							doer:PushEvent("respawnfromghost", { source = self.inst })
						end
						if self.inst.prefab == "asa_shop" and doer:HasTag("playerghost") then
							doer:PushEvent("respawnfromghost", { source = self.inst })
						end
					end
					if self.cooldown_on_successful_haunt then
						self.cooldowntimer = self.cooldown or TUNING.HAUNT_COOLDOWN_MEDIUM
						self:StartFX(true)
						self:StartShaderFx()
						self.inst:StartUpdatingComponent(self)
					end
				else
					self.haunted = true
					self.cooldowntimer = self.cooldown or TUNING.HAUNT_COOLDOWN_SMALL
					self:StartFX(true)
					self:StartShaderFx()
					self.inst:StartUpdatingComponent(self)
				end
			end
		else
			old_DoHaunt(self,doer,...)
		end
	end

end)
```

### 变体演进：永恒新界-深渊 (Mod 3645181516)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3645181516 (`永恒新界-深渊`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3645181516)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)


    local old_attacked = sg.events["attacked"].fn
    sg.events["attacked"].fn = function (inst,data)
        if inst._stunprotecter~=nil and inst._stunprotecter:Get() then
            inst.sg:AddStateTag("nointerrupt")
        end
        old_attacked(inst,data)
    end
    
    local old_knockback = sg.events["knockback"].fn
    sg.events.knockback.fn = function(inst, data)
        if not inst.components.health:IsDead() then
            if inst.components.rider:IsRiding() and inst.components.rider:TryResist() then
                inst.sg:GoToState("repelled",{repeller =data.knocker, radius = data.radius})
            else
                old_knockback(inst,data)
            end
        end
    end


    ---TODO
    --[[sg.states["death_hosted"].events["animover"].fn = function (inst)
        if inst.AnimState:AnimDone() then
            inst.sg:GoToState("death",{hosted=true})
        end
    end]]

    sg.states["devoured"].timeline = {
        TimeEvent(0.5, function(inst)
            if inst.components.newcs_talisman~=nil then
                inst.components.newcs_talisman:TryKillThreat(inst.sg.statemem.attacker)
            end
        end),
    }

    local actionhandlers = sg.actionhandlers
    local Attack_Old = actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate

    actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate=function(inst, action)
        inst.sg.mem.localchainattack = not action.forced or nil
        local playercontroller = inst.components.playercontroller
        local attack_tag =
            playercontroller ~= nil and
            playercontroller.remote_authority and
            playercontroller.remote_predicting and
            "abouttoattack" or
            "attack"
        if not (inst.sg:HasStateTag(attack_tag) and action.target == inst.sg.statemem.attacktarget or inst.components.health:IsDead()) then
            local weapon = inst.components.combat ~= nil and inst.components.combat:GetWeapon() or nil
            if weapon~=nil then
                if weapon:HasTag("scythe_attack")  then
                    return  "scythe_attack"
                end    
            end
            
        end
        return  Attack_Old(inst,action)
    end    
    local function MakeWorkerHandler(action, prestate_tag)
    local old_deststate = actionhandlers[action].deststate
        actionhandlers[action].deststate = function(inst)
            -- 模组特性：激光工人
            if inst:HasTag("laserworker") and not inst.sg:HasStateTag(prestate_tag) then
                return "laserwork"
            end
            -- 回退到新源码逻辑（包括 beaver、spin 模块、原版动作）
            return old_deststate(inst)
        end
    end

    MakeWorkerHandler(ACTIONS.CHOP, "prechop")
    MakeWorkerHandler(ACTIONS.MINE, "premine")
    MakeWorkerHandler(ACTIONS.HAMMER, "prehammer")
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson_client

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson_client",function (sg)
    local actionhandlers = sg.actionhandlers
    local ClientAttack_Old = actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate
    actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate=function(inst, action)
        if not (inst.sg:HasStateTag("attack") and action.target == inst.sg.statemem.attacktarget or IsEntityDead(inst)) then
            local equip = inst.replica.inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS)
            if equip~=nil then
                if equip:HasTag("quick_attack") then
                    return "quick_attack"
                elseif equip:HasTag("scythe_attack") then
                    return  "scythe_attack"
                end
            end    
            
        end
        return  ClientAttack_Old(inst,action)
    end
end)


AddStategraphState("wilson",State{
    name = "scythe_attack",
    tags = {"attack", "notalking", "abouttoattack", "autopredict","nointerrupt"},

    onenter = function(inst)
        if inst.components.combat:InCooldown() then
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("abouttoattack")
            inst:ClearBufferedAction()
            inst.sg:GoToState("idle", true)
            return
        end
        inst.components.combat:StartAttack()
        inst.components.locomotor:Stop()
        inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("scythe_pre")
        inst.AnimState:PushAnimation("scythe_loop", false)
        local buffaction = inst:GetBufferedAction()
        local target = buffaction ~= nil and buffaction.target or nil
        
        inst.components.combat:SetTarget(target)
        inst.components.locomotor:Stop()
  

        if target ~= nil then
            inst.components.combat:BattleCry()
            if target:IsValid() then
                inst:FacePoint(target:GetPosition())
                inst.sg.statemem.attacktarget = target
                inst.sg.statemem.retarget = target
            end
        end
    end,

    timeline =
    {
        FrameEvent(12, function(inst) inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/wilson/attack_whoosh") end),
        FrameEvent(13, function(inst)
            inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/wilson/attack_whoosh")
            inst:PerformBufferedAction()
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("abouttoattack")
        end),
        FrameEvent(18, function(inst)
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("attack")
        end),
        FrameEvent(22, function(inst)
            inst.sg:GoToState("idle", true)
        end),
    },

    events =
    {   EventHandler("equip", function(inst) inst.sg:GoToState("idle") end),
        EventHandler("unequip", function(inst) inst.sg:GoToState("idle") end),
    },
    onexit = function(inst)
        inst.components.combat:SetTarget(nil)
        if inst.sg:HasStateTag("abouttoattack") then
            inst.components.combat:CancelAttack()
        end
    end,
})

AddStategraphState("wilson",State{
    name = "laserwork",
    tags = { "prehammer","premine","prechop", "working" },
    onenter = function(inst)
        inst.components.locomotor:Stop()
        inst.sg.statemem.action = inst:GetBufferedAction()
        inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("toolpunch")
        inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/wilson/attack_weapon", nil, nil, true)
    end,
    timeline =
    {
        TimeEvent(7 * FRAMES, function(inst)
            if inst.sg.statemem.action ~= nil then
                local target = inst.sg.statemem.action.target
                if target ~= nil and target:IsValid() then
                    if inst.sg.statemem.action.action == ACTIONS.MINE then
                        PlayMiningFX(inst, target)
                    elseif inst.sg.statemem.action.action == ACTIONS.HAMMER then
                        inst.sg.statemem.rmb = true
                        inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/wilson/hit")
                    end
                end
            end
            inst:PerformBufferedAction()
        end),

        TimeEvent(8 * FRAMES, function(inst)
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("prehammer")
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("premine")
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("prechop")
        end),

        TimeEvent(10 * FRAMES, function(inst)
            if inst.sg.statemem.action == nil or
                inst.sg.statemem.action.action == nil or
                inst.components.playercontroller == nil then
                return
            end
            if inst.sg.statemem.rmb then
                if not inst.components.playercontroller:IsAnyOfControlsPressed(
                        CONTROL_SECONDARY,
                        CONTROL_CONTROLLER_ALTACTION) then
                    return
                end
            elseif not inst.components.playercontroller:IsAnyOfControlsPressed(
                        CONTROL_PRIMARY,
                        CONTROL_ACTION,
                        CONTROL_CONTROLLER_ACTION) then
                return
            end
            if inst.sg.statemem.action:IsValid() and
                inst.sg.statemem.action.target ~= nil and
                inst.sg.statemem.action.target.components.workable ~= nil and
                inst.sg.statemem.action.target.components.workable:CanBeWorked() and
                inst.sg.statemem.action.target.components.workable:GetWorkAction() == inst.sg.statemem.action.action and
                CanEntitySeeTarget(inst, inst.sg.statemem.action.target) then
                --No fast-forward when repeat initiated on server
                inst.sg.statemem.action.options.no_predict_fastforward = true
                inst:ClearBufferedAction()
                inst:PushBufferedAction(inst.sg.statemem.action)
            end
        end),
    },

    events =
    {   
        EventHandler("unequip", function(inst) inst.sg:GoToState("idle") end),
        EventHandler("animover", function(inst)
            if inst.AnimState:AnimDone() then
                inst.sg:GoToState("idle")
            end
        end),
    },
})

AddStategraphState("wilson",State{
    name = "playerlunge",
    tags = { "charge",  "busy", "nointerrupt" ,"nopredict"},

    onenter = function(inst)
        inst.components.health:SetInvincible(true)
       
        inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("lunge_pst")
        
        inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/common/lava_arena/fireball")
        local x, y, z = inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
        local theta = inst.Transform:GetRotation() * DEGREES
        local cos_theta = math.cos(theta)
        local sin_theta = math.sin(theta)
        local map = TheWorld.Map
        local pt = Vector3(0, 0, 0)
        local success = false
        for i = 12.5, 7,-0.5 do
            pt.x = x + cos_theta * (i - 0.5)
            pt.z = z - sin_theta * (i - 0.5)
            if map:IsPassableAtPoint(pt:Get()) then
                pt.x = x + cos_theta * (i + 0.5)
                pt.z = z - sin_theta * (i + 0.5)
                if map:IsPassableAtPoint(pt:Get()) then
                    pt.x = x + cos_theta * i
                    pt.z = z - sin_theta * i
                    if not map:IsPointNearHole(pt) then
                        success = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not success then
            for i = 6.5, 0.5, -0.5 do
                pt.x = x + cos_theta * (i - 0.5)
                pt.z = z - sin_theta * (i - 0.5)
                if map:IsPassableAtPoint(pt:Get()) then
                    pt.x = x + cos_theta * (i + 0.5)
                    pt.z = z - sin_theta * (i + 0.5)
                    if map:IsPassableAtPoint(pt:Get()) then
                        pt.x = x + cos_theta * i
                        pt.z = z - sin_theta * i
                        if not map:IsPointNearHole(pt) then
                            success = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        inst.Physics:Stop()
        if success then
            x, y, z = pt:Get()
            inst.Physics:Teleport(x, y, z)
            local fx = SpawnPrefab("spear_wathgrithr_lightning_lunge_fx")
            fx.Transform:SetPosition(x, 0, z)
            fx.Transform:SetRotation(inst:GetRotation())

            inst.components.bloomer:PushBloom("lunge", "shaders/anim.ksh", -2)
            inst.components.colouradder:PushColour("lunge", 1, 1, 0, 0)
            inst.sg.statemem.flash = 1
        else
            inst.sg:GoToState("idle")
        end
    end,

    onupdate = function(inst)
        if inst.sg.statemem.flash and inst.sg.statemem.flash > 0 then
            inst.sg.statemem.flash = math.max(0, inst.sg.statemem.flash - .1)
            inst.components.colouradder:PushColour("lunge", inst.sg.statemem.flash, inst.sg.statemem.flash, 0, 0)
        end
    end,


    timeline =
    {
        TimeEvent(12 * FRAMES, function(inst)
            inst.components.bloomer:PopBloom("lunge")
        end),
    },

    events =
    {
        EventHandler("animover", function(inst)
            if inst.AnimState:AnimDone() then
                inst.sg:GoToState("idle")
            end
        end),
    },

    onexit = function(inst)

        inst.components.health:SetInvincible(false)
        inst.components.bloomer:PopBloom("lunge")
        inst.components.colouradder:PopColour("lunge")
    end,
})

            inst.sg.statemem.isteleporting = true
            inst.components.health:SetInvincible(true)
            if inst.components.playercontroller ~= nil then
                inst.components.playercontroller:Enable(false)
            end
            inst.DynamicShadow:Enable(false)
        end),
        TimeEvent(18 * FRAMES, function(inst)
            inst:Hide()
        end),
        TimeEvent(26 * FRAMES, function(inst)
            inst:ClearBufferedAction()
            if inst.sg.statemem.target ~= nil and inst.sg.statemem.teletarget~=nil 
                and inst.sg.statemem.target.components.teleporter:UseTemporaryExit(inst, inst.sg.statemem.teletarget) then
                inst:Hide()
                inst.sg.statemem.fx:KillFX()
            else
                inst.sg:GoToState("exittownportal")
            end
        end),
    },

    onexit = function(inst)
        inst.sg.statemem.fx:KillFX()

        if inst.sg.statemem.isphysicstoggle then
            ToggleOnPhysics(inst)
        end

        if inst.sg.statemem.isteleporting then
            inst.components.health:SetInvincible(false)
            if inst.components.playercontroller ~= nil then
                inst.components.playercontroller:Enable(true)
            end
            inst:Show()
            inst.DynamicShadow:Enable(true)
        end
    end,
})
```

```lua
AddComponentPostInit("skinner", function(self)
    local oldfn = self.SetSkinName
    if oldfn then
        function self.SetSkinName(s, skinname, ...)
            local old = s.skin_name
            local new = skinname
            if characterskins[old] and characterskins[old].clear_fn then characterskins[old].clear_fn(s.inst, old) end
            if characterskins[new] and characterskins[new].init_fn then characterskins[new].init_fn(s.inst, new) end
            oldfn(s, skinname, ...)
        end
    end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat
function dst_lan:_hookCombat()
    AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
        self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers = SourceModifierList(self.inst)
        self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period = self.min_attack_period
        local p = rawget(self, "_")["min_attack_period"]
        local old_on_map = p[2]
        p[2] = function(self, map)
            if old_on_map ~= nil then
                old_on_map(self, map)
            end
            if self.inst.replica.combat and self.inst.replica.combat.dstlan_atkperiodmult then
                self.inst.replica.combat.dstlan_atkperiodmult:set(self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get())
            end
        end

        function self:SetAttackPeriod(val)
            self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period = val
            self.min_attack_period = self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period / self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get()
        end

        function self:SetAtkPeriodModifier(source, mult, key)
            self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:SetModifier(source, mult, key)
            self.min_attack_period = self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period / self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get()
        end

        function self:RemoveAtkPeriodModifier(source, key)
            self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:RemoveModifier(source, key)
            self.min_attack_period = self.dstlan_orig_min_attack_period / self.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get()
        end
    end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson
function dst_lan:_hookSG()
    AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
        local old_onenter = sg.states["attack"].onenter
        sg.states["attack"].onenter = function (inst,...)
            local res = old_onenter ~= nil and {old_onenter(inst,...)} or {}
            local combat = inst.components.combat
            local timeout = (math.floor(13/(combat.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get())))*FRAMES
            inst.sg:SetTimeout(timeout)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(combat.dstlan_atkperiodmodifiers:Get())
            return unpack(res)
        end

        local old_ontimeout = sg.states["attack"].ontimeout
        sg.states["attack"].ontimeout = function (inst,...)
            inst:PerformBufferedAction()
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag('abouttoattack')
            return old_ontimeout(inst,...)
        end

        local old_onexit = sg.states["attack"].onexit
        sg.states["attack"].onexit = function (inst,...)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(1)
            return old_onexit(inst,...)
        end

    end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson_client
function dst_lan:_hookSGClient()
    AddStategraphPostInit("wilson_client", function(sg)
        local old_onenter = sg.states["attack"].onenter
        sg.states["attack"].onenter = function (inst,...)
            local res = old_onenter ~= nil and {old_onenter(inst,...)} or {}
            local timeout = (math.floor(13/inst.replica.combat.dstlan_atkperiodmult:value()))*FRAMES
            inst.sg:SetTimeout(timeout)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(inst.replica.combat.dstlan_atkperiodmult:value())
            return unpack(res)
        end

        local old_ontimeout = sg.states["attack"].ontimeout
        sg.states["attack"].ontimeout = function (inst,...)
            inst:PerformPreviewBufferedAction()
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag('abouttoattack')
            return old_ontimeout(inst,...)
        end

        local old_onexit = sg.states["attack"].onexit
        sg.states["attack"].onexit = function (inst,...)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(1)
            return old_onexit(inst,...)
        end

    end)
```

```lua
end)
AddComponentPostInit("reticule", function(self)
    function self:_ApplyParamsToEntity(inst)
        if inst ~= nil then
            inst.AnimState:ClearBloomEffectHandle()
            if inst.SetShape ~= nil then
                inst:SetShape(self.shape or "CIRCLE", self.radius, self.shape_param)
            elseif inst.SetRadius ~= nil and self.radius ~= nil then
                inst:SetRadius(self.radius)
            end
            if inst.SetSearchFn ~= nil then
                inst:SetSearchFn(self.search_fn)
            end
        end
    end

    function self:SetConfig(config)
        self.targetfn = nil
        self.mousetargetfn = nil
        self.updatepositionfn = nil
        self.shape = nil
        self.shape_param = nil
        self.radius = nil
        self.search_fn = nil

        config = config or {}
        for k, v in pairs(config) do
            self[k] = v
        end

        self:_ApplyParamsToEntity(self.reticule)
        if self.reticule ~= nil and self.UpdateColour ~= nil then
            self:UpdateColour()
        end
    end

    local _CreateReticule = self.CreateReticule
    function self:CreateReticule(...)
        _CreateReticule(self, ...)
        self:_ApplyParamsToEntity(self.reticule)
    end

    local _PingReticuleAt = self.PingReticuleAt
    function self:PingReticuleAt(pos)
        local old_SpawnPrefab = GLOBAL.SpawnPrefab
        GLOBAL.SpawnPrefab = function(prefab, ...)
            local inst = old_SpawnPrefab(prefab, ...)
            self:_ApplyParamsToEntity(inst)
            return inst
        end
        local ok, err = GLOBAL.pcall(_PingReticuleAt, self, pos)
        GLOBAL.SpawnPrefab = old_SpawnPrefab
        if not ok then
            GLOBAL.error(err)
        end
    end

    local _UpdatePosition = self.UpdatePosition
    function self:UpdatePosition(dt)
        _UpdatePosition(self, dt)
        if self.reticule ~= nil and self.reticule.prefab == "nikki_reticule" then
            self.reticule.AnimState:ClearBloomEffectHandle()
        end
    end
end)

if not GLOBAL.TheNet:IsDedicated() then
    GLOBAL.TheInput:AddKeyHandler(function(key, down)
        if not down then return end
        local player = GLOBAL.ThePlayer
        if not player or not player:IsValid() then return end
        if GLOBAL.TheFrontEnd:GetActiveScreen() ~= player.HUD then return end
        if player.replica.nikki_skill_trigger then
            player.replica.nikki_skill_trigger:CastKey(key)
        end
    end)

    AddClassPostConstruct("widgets/statusdisplays", function(self)
        if not self.owner:HasTag("nikki_framework") then return end

        local DEFAULT_BADGE_SPACING = 62
        local VERTICAL_MARGIN = 70

        self._nikki_badges = {}
        self._nikki_range_btn = nil

        -- ============================================================
        -- 辅助函数：生成切换回调（DRY）
        -- ============================================================
        local function make_toggle_callback()
            return function()
                local new_state = NikkiManager:ToggleSetting("show_range")
                local owner = self.owner
                if owner and owner:IsValid() then
                    owner:PushEvent("skill_range_toggle_changed", { new_state = new_state })
                end
                return new_state
            end
        end

        local function refresh_ui()
            local initial_checked = NikkiManager:GetSetting("show_range")
            local toggle_callback = make_toggle_callback()
            self:_Nikki_RefreshBadges()
            self:_Nikki_UpdateRangeButton(initial_checked, toggle_callback)
        end

        -- ============================================================
        -- 初始化：延迟一秒执行
        -- ============================================================
        self.inst:DoTaskInTime(1, refresh_ui)

        -- ============================================================
        -- 事件监听
        -- ============================================================
        if self.owner and self.owner:IsValid() then
            self.inst:ListenForEvent("nikki_state_dirty", function()
                self:_Nikki_RefreshBadges()
            end, self.owner)
            self.inst:ListenForEvent("skill_max_range_dirty", refresh_ui, self.owner)
        end

        -- ============================================================
        -- 私有方法
        -- ============================================================
        function self:_Nikki_CalcLayoutParams()
            local core_badges = { "brain", "stomach", "heart" }
            local groups = {}
            for _, badge in ipairs(core_badges) do
                local badge_widget = self[badge]
                if badge_widget and badge_widget:IsVisible() then
                    local x, y, _ = badge_widget:GetPositionXYZ()
                    if not groups[y] then
                        groups[y] = {}
                    end
                    table.insert(groups[y], x)
                end
            end

            if GLOBAL.next(groups) == nil then
                return DEFAULT_BADGE_SPACING, 0, 0
            end

            local main_y = 0
            local max_count = 0
            for y, xs in pairs(groups) do
                if #xs > max_count then
                    max_count = #xs
                    main_y = y
                end
            end

            local main_xs = groups[main_y]
            table.sort(main_xs)
            local leftmost_x = main_xs[1]

            local spacing = (#main_xs >= 2) and math.abs(main_xs[2] - main_xs[1]) or DEFAULT_BADGE_SPACING
            return spacing, leftmost_x - spacing, main_y
        end

        function self:_Nikki_UpdateRangeButton(initial_checked, toggle_callback)
            local owner = self.owner
            if not (owner and owner:IsValid()) then return end

            local range = owner.replica.nikki_skill and owner.replica.nikki_skill:GetMaxRange() or 0
            if range <= 0 then
                if self._nikki_range_btn then
                    self._nikki_range_btn:Hide()
                end
                return
            end

            -- 直接在这里创建按钮
            if not self._nikki_range_btn then
                local TEMPLATES = require("widgets/redux/templates")
                self._nikki_range_btn = self:AddChild(TEMPLATES.StandardCheckbox(
                    toggle_callback,
                    64,
                    initial_checked,
                    "切换射程指示器"
                ))
            end

            local _, start_x, y = self:_Nikki_CalcLayoutParams()
            self._nikki_range_btn:SetPosition(start_x, y - VERTICAL_MARGIN, 0)
            self._nikki_range_btn:Show()
        end

        function self:_Nikki_RefreshBadges()
            local owner = self.owner
            if not (owner and owner:IsValid() and owner.replica and owner.replica.nikki_state) then
                return
            end

            local spacing, start_x, y = self:_Nikki_CalcLayoutParams()

            local raw_ids = owner.replica.nikki_state:GetBadges()
            local res_ids = {}
            if type(raw_ids) == "table" then
                res_ids = raw_ids
            elseif type(raw_ids) == "string" and raw_ids ~= "" then
                res_ids = { raw_ids }
            end

            local count = #res_ids
            local NikkiBadge = require("widgets/nikki_badge")
            for i = 1, count do
                local badge = self._nikki_badges[i]
                if not badge then
                    badge = self:AddChild(NikkiBadge(owner))
                    self._nikki_badges[i] = badge
                end
                badge:SetPosition(start_x - spacing * (i - 1), y, 0)
                badge:SetRes(res_ids[i])
            end
            for i = count + 1, #self._nikki_badges do
                if self._nikki_badges[i] then
                    self._nikki_badges[i]:Close()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local default_config = require("defs/default_config")
NikkiManager:RegisterMod(default_config, env)


if not is_debug_mode then
    return
end

-- 实验性功能 未实装
AddClassPostConstruct("screens/playerinfopopupscreen", function(self)
    if self.owner and self.owner:HasTag("nikki_framework") then
        local Widget = require("widgets/widget")
        local ImageButton = require("widgets/imagebutton")

        local function MakeTabBtn(tabs_widget, pos, text, clickfn, flip)
            local btn = tabs_widget:AddChild(ImageButton("images/skilltree.xml",
                "tab_skills_unselected.tex", "tab_skills_unselected.tex", "tab_skills_over.tex",
                "tab_skills_unselected.tex", "tab_skills_over.tex"
            ))
            local size = { 142, 96 }
            if flip then size[1] = size[1] * -1 end
            btn:SetPosition(pos[1], pos[2])
            btn:ForceImageSize(size[1], size[2])
            btn:SetText(text)
            btn:SetTextSize(20)
            btn:SetFont(GLOBAL.HEADERFONT)
            btn:SetDisabledFont(GLOBAL.HEADERFONT)
            btn:SetTextColour(GLOBAL.UICOLOURS.GOLD)
            btn.scale_on_focus = false
            btn.clickoffset = GLOBAL.Vector3(0, 5, 0)
            btn:SetTextFocusColour(GLOBAL.UICOLOURS.GOLD)
            btn:SetTextSelectedColour(GLOBAL.UICOLOURS.GOLD)
            btn:SetTextDisabledColour(GLOBAL.UICOLOURS.GOLD)
            btn.text:SetPosition(flip and 2 or -2, -5)
            btn:SetOnClick(clickfn)
            return btn
        end

        -- 1. 自定义面板生成方法
        self.MakeNikkiStatus = function(self)
            if self.playeravatar then
                self.playeravatar:Kill()
                self.playeravatar = nil
            end
            if self.skilltree then
                self.skilltree:Kill()
                self.skilltree = nil
            end

            if not self.nikkistatus then
                local NikkiStatus = require("widgets/nikki_status")

                -- ===================================================
                -- 【核心改变】由 Screen 负责调用 Manager 获取数据切片
                -- ===================================================
                local status_data = NikkiManager:GetPlayerStatusSnapshot(self.data.inst)
                -- 将数据直接注入 Widget
                self.nikkistatus = self.root:AddChild(NikkiStatus(status_data))
                self.nikkistatus:SetPosition(0, -50)
            end

            if self.root.tabs then
                if self.root.tabs.playerAvatarPopup then self.root.tabs.playerAvatarPopup:Enable() end
                if self.root.tabs.skillTreePopup then self.root.tabs.skillTreePopup:Enable() end
                if self.root.tabs.nikkiStatusPopup then self.root.tabs.nikkiStatusPopup:Disable() end
            end
        end

        -- 2. 构建或重排 Tabs
        if not self.root.tabs then
            self.root.tabs = self.root:AddChild(Widget("tabs"))
            self.root.tabs:SetPosition(0, 0)

            local avatar_str = GLOBAL.STRINGS.SKILLTREE and GLOBAL.STRINGS.SKILLTREE.INFOPANEL or "玩家信息"
            self.root.tabs.playerAvatarPopup = MakeTabBtn(self.root.tabs, { -165, 220 }, avatar_str,
                function() self:MakePlayerAvatarPopup() end, true)
            self.root.tabs.nikkiStatusPopup = MakeTabBtn(self.root.tabs, { 165, 220 }, "状态效果",
                function() self:MakeNikkiStatus() end, false)

            self.root.tabs.playerAvatarPopup:Disable()
        else
            if self.root.tabs.playerAvatarPopup then self.root.tabs.playerAvatarPopup:SetPosition(-200, 220) end
            if self.root.tabs.skillTreePopup then self.root.tabs.skillTreePopup:SetPosition(0, 220) end
            self.root.tabs.nikkiStatusPopup = MakeTabBtn(self.root.tabs, { 200, 220 }, "状态效果",
                function() self:MakeNikkiStatus() end, false)

            if self.MakeSkillTree then
                local _MakeSkillTree = self.MakeSkillTree
                self.MakeSkillTree = function(self)
                    if self.nikkistatus then
                        self.nikkistatus:Kill()
                        self.nikkistatus = nil
                    end
                    _MakeSkillTree(self)
                    if self.root.tabs and self.root.tabs.nikkiStatusPopup then
                        self.root.tabs.nikkiStatusPopup:Enable()
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- 3. 重新对齐图层渲染层级
        if self.root.tabs then
            self.root.tabs:MoveToBack()
            if self.root.bg then
                self.root.bg:MoveToBack()
            end
        end

        -- 4. 拦截玩家头像面板刷新
        local _MakePlayerAvatarPopup = self.MakePlayerAvatarPopup
        self.MakePlayerAvatarPopup = function(self)
            if self.nikkistatus then
                self.nikkistatus:Kill()
                self.nikkistatus = nil
            end

            local temp_tabs = self.root.tabs
            self.root.tabs = nil
            _MakePlayerAvatarPopup(self)
            self.root.tabs = temp_tabs

            if self.root.tabs then
                if self.root.tabs.playerAvatarPopup then self.root.tabs.playerAvatarPopup:Disable() end
                if self.root.tabs.skillTreePopup then self.root.tabs.skillTreePopup:Enable() end
                if self.root.tabs.nikkiStatusPopup then self.root.tabs.nikkiStatusPopup:Enable() end
            end
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:stewer

AddComponentPostInit("stewer", function(self)
    local OldStartCooking = self.StartCooking
    function self:StartCooking(doer)
        if doer and doer:HasTag("sakuya") then
            if self.targettime == nil and self.inst.components.container ~= nil then
                self.chef_id = (doer ~= nil and doer.player_classified ~= nil) and doer.userid
                self.ingredient_prefabs = {}

                self.done = nil
                self.spoiltime = nil

                if self.onstartcooking ~= nil then
                    self.onstartcooking(self.inst)
                end

                for k, v in pairs (self.inst.components.container.slots) do
                    table.insert(self.ingredient_prefabs, v.prefab)
                end

                local cooktime = 1
                self.product, cooktime = cooking.CalculateRecipe(self.inst.prefab, self.ingredient_prefabs)
                local recipe = cooking.GetRecipe(self.inst.prefab, self.product)
                local productperishtime = recipe and recipe.perishtime or 0

                if productperishtime > 0 then
                    local spoilage_total = 0
                    local spoilage_n = 0
                    for k, v in pairs (self.inst.components.container.slots) do
                        if v.components.perishable ~= nil then
                            spoilage_n = spoilage_n + 1
                            spoilage_total = spoilage_total + v.components.perishable:GetPercent()
                        end
                    end
                    self.product_spoilage =
                        (spoilage_n <= 0 and 1) or
                        (self.keepspoilage and spoilage_total / spoilage_n) or
                        1 - (1 - spoilage_total / spoilage_n) * .5
                else
                    self.product_spoilage = nil
                end

                cooktime = TUNING.BASE_COOK_TIME * cooktime * self.cooktimemult
                cooktime = math.max(0, (cooktime * .5) - 8)
                self.targettime = GetTime() + cooktime
                if self.task ~= nil then
                    self.task:Cancel()
                end
                self.task = self.inst:DoTaskInTime(cooktime, dostew, self)

                self.inst.components.container:Close()
                self.inst.components.container:DestroyContents()
                self.inst.components.container.canbeopened = false
            end
        else
            return OldStartCooking(self, doer)
        end 
    end
    local OldHarvest = self.Harvest
    function self:Harvest(harvester)
        if harvester and harvester:HasTag("sakuya") and math.random() <= .25 then
            if self.done then
                if self.onharvest ~= nil then
                    self.onharvest(self.inst)
                end

                if self.product ~= nil then
                    local recipe = cooking.GetRecipe(self.inst.prefab, self.product)

                    if harvester ~= nil and
                        self.chef_id == harvester.userid and
                        recipe ~= nil and
                        recipe.cookbook_category ~= nil and
                        cooking.cookbook_recipes[recipe.cookbook_category] ~= nil and
                        cooking.cookbook_recipes[recipe.cookbook_category][self.product] ~= nil then
                        harvester:PushEvent("learncookbookrecipe", {product = self.product, ingredients = self.ingredient_prefabs})
                    end

                    local stacksize = recipe and recipe.stacksize or 1
                    GiveDoubledCookedProduct(self, harvester, self.product, stacksize * 2)
                    self.product = nil
                end

                if self.task ~= nil then
                    self.task:Cancel()
                    self.task = nil
                end
                self.targettime = nil
                self.done = nil
                self.spoiltime = nil
                self.product_spoilage = nil

                if self.inst.components.container ~= nil then
                    self.inst.components.container.canbeopened = true
                end

                return true
            end
        else
            return OldHarvest(self, harvester)
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
                local opalgem = #
                    inst.components.container:FindItems(function(item) return item.prefab == "opalpreciousgem_cracked" end)

                    "orangegem_cracked" end)

                        inst.shinefx2.entity:AddFollower()
                        inst.shinefx2.Follower:FollowSymbol(owner.GUID, "swap_object", 48, -102, 0)
                        inst.shinefx2.Transform:SetScale(0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
                    end
                end

                if item4 ~= nil and owner ~= nil and not inst.slot4_inserted then
                    if not item4.components.finiteuses then
                        item4:AddComponent("perishable")
                        item4.components.perishable.onperishreplacement = item4.prefab .. "_cracked"
                        item4:DoTaskInTime(0, function(item4) item4.components.perishable:Perish() end)
                    else
                        inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("hookline_2/creatures/boss/crabking/gem_place")

                        inst.shinefx_slot4 = SpawnPrefab(item4.prefab .. "_crabclaw")
                        inst.shinefx_slot4.gem = inst
                        --inst:ListenForEvent("onremove", onremovebody4, inst.shinefx_slot4)
                        inst.shinefx_slot4.entity:SetParent(owner.entity)
                        inst.shinefx_slot4.entity:AddFollower()
                        inst.shinefx_slot4.Follower:FollowSymbol(owner.GUID, "swap_object", 23, -61, 0.1)
                        inst.shinefx_slot4.Transform:SetScale(0.25, 0.25, 0.25)

                        inst.slot4_inserted = true

                        inst.shinefx2 = SpawnPrefab("crab_king_shine")
                        inst.shinefx2.entity:SetParent(owner.entity)
                        inst.shinefx2.entity:AddFollower()
                        inst.shinefx2.Follower:FollowSymbol(owner.GUID, "swap_object", 23, -61, 0)
                        inst.shinefx2.Transform:SetScale(0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
                    end
                end

                DamageCalculation(inst)
            end

            local function onequip(inst, owner)
                AddGem(inst)

                owner.AnimState:OverrideSymbol("swap_object", "swap_crabclaw", "swap_crabclaw")

                owner.AnimState:Show("ARM_carry")
                owner.AnimState:Hide("ARM_normal")

                if inst.components.container ~= nil then
                    inst.components.container:Open(owner)
                end
            end

            local equippable = inst.components.equippable
            if equippable then
                equippable:SetOnEquip(onequip)
            end
        end)

```

```lua

local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson
end

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:propagator

AddComponentPostInit("propagator", function(self)
    local oldAddHeat = self.AddHeat
    function self:AddHeat(amount, source, ...)
        if source ~= nil and source ~= self.inst and source.xiaomo_talisman_fire then
            return
        end
        return oldAddHeat(self, amount, source, ...)
    end

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:cursable

AddComponentPostInit("cursable", function(self)
	local oldIsCursable = self.IsCursable
	function self:IsCursable(item)
		if item and item.components.curseditem and item.components.curseditem.curse == "MONKEY"
            and (self.inst.prefab == "xiaomo" or self.inst.prefab == "mojiu") then
			return false
		end
		return oldIsCursable(self,item)
	end
	local oldApplyCurse = self.ApplyCurse
	function self:ApplyCurse(item)
		if item and item.components.curseditem and item.components.curseditem.curse == "MONKEY"
            and (self.inst.prefab == "xiaomo" or self.inst.prefab == "mojiu") then
			item:RemoveTag("applied_curse")
        	item.components.curseditem.cursed_target = nil
			return
		end
		return oldApplyCurse(self,item)
	end
	local oldForceOntoOwner = self.ForceOntoOwner
	function self:ForceOntoOwner(item)
		if item and item.components.curseditem and item.components.curseditem.curse == "MONKEY"
            and (self.inst.prefab == "xiaomo" or self.inst.prefab == "mojiu") then
			return
		end
		return oldForceOntoOwner(self,item)
	end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:health

AddComponentPostInit("health", function(self)
    local oldSetVal = self.SetVal
    function self:SetVal(val, cause, ...)
        local old_health = self.currenthealth
        local shield = self.inst.components.xiaomo_chenxing_shield
        if cause ~= "file_load" and val < old_health and shield ~= nil and shield.value > 0 then
            val = val + shield:Absorb(old_health - val)
        end
        local min_health = self.minhealth or 0
        if val <= min_health and not self.inst.xd_killself then
            local holywing = self.inst.xiaomo_holywing
            if holywing ~= nil
                and holywing:IsValid()
                and holywing.TriggerXiaomoHolyShield ~= nil
                and holywing:TriggerXiaomoHolyShield(self.inst) then
                val = old_health
            end
        end
        return oldSetVal(self, val, cause, ...)
    end

	local oldDoDelta = self.DoDelta
	function self:DoDelta(amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ignore_absorb,...)
        if amount and amount < 0 and self.xiaomo_abosorb ~= nil then
            amount = amount * (1 - self.xiaomo_abosorb)
        end
        -- 护甲结算后的每次扣血固定减免，不占用星阵护盾；强制处决仍按原逻辑处理。
        if amount ~= nil and amount < 0 and not ignore_absorb and cause ~= "file_load"
            and self.inst.xiaomo_bihufu_reduction ~= nil then
            amount = math.min(0, amount + self.inst.xiaomo_bihufu_reduction)
        end
        return oldDoDelta(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ignore_absorb, ...)
	end
	local old_DoFireDamage = self.DoFireDamage
	function self:DoFireDamage(amount,...)
		if isxiaomo(self.inst) then
			return
		end
		return old_DoFireDamage(self,amount,...)
	end
end)
```

- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3796155639)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:locomotor
-- 飞行时免疫地面减速（蜘蛛网、道路等）
AddComponentPostInit("locomotor", function(self)
    local _SetExternalSpeedMultiplier = self.SetExternalSpeedMultiplier
    function self:SetExternalSpeedMultiplier(source, key, m, ...)
        if m ~= nil and m < 1 and self.inst:HasTag("vex_flying") then
            return
        end
        return _SetExternalSpeedMultiplier(self, source, key, m, ...)
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:vex_shadow

AddPrefabPostInit("vex_shadow", function(inst)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
        inst.OnEntityReplicated = function(inst)
            if inst.replica and inst.replica.container then
                inst.replica.container:WidgetSetup("vex_shadow")
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:inventory
-- 在原版 GiveItem 执行前拦截：仅当主物品栏无可用格（含堆叠）且背包溢出也不可用时
AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self)
    local old_GiveItem = self.GiveItem
    function self:GiveItem(inst, slot, src_pos, ...)
        if slot == nil and inst ~= nil and inst:IsValid()
            and inst.components.inventoryitem ~= nil
            and self.inst:HasTag("vex")
            and self:GetNextAvailableSlot(inst) == nil then
            local overflow = self:GetOverflowContainer()
            if overflow == nil or overflow:IsFull() then
                local body = self:GetEquippedItem(GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.BODY)
                if body ~= nil and body.prefab == "vex_shadow" then
                    local storage = body._open_storage
                    if storage ~= nil and storage:IsValid()
                            and storage.components.container ~= nil then
                        -- 不用 IsFull 门禁(2026-10-09 实测):所有空格都占着时 IsFull 判"满",
                        -- 但同种物品仍可并堆——容器 GiveItem 自身先并堆;
                        -- drop_on_fail=false:真放不下才落回下方原版掉落路径
                        if storage.components.container:GiveItem(inst, nil, nil, false) then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return old_GiveItem(self, inst, slot, src_pos, ...)
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:builder
-- 继承到高一级模块),并从护甲升级槽正确取出(触发 itemlose 正常流程,避免乱序假移除)
AddComponentPostInit("builder", function(self)
    local old_RemoveIngredients = self.RemoveIngredients
    function self:RemoveIngredients(ingredients, recname, discounted)
        local owner = self.inst
        if not self.freebuildmode and owner ~= nil and owner:IsValid() and owner:HasTag("vex") then
            -- 阴郁度配方扣费（2026-09-30 用户要求：75阴郁度凝炼噩梦燃料；
            -- 校验在配方 canbuild 里，此处扣费——原版 RemoveIngredients 处理角色代价的同位置）
            if recname == "nightmarefuel" and owner.components.gloom ~= nil then
                owner.components.gloom:DoDelta(-TUNING.VEX_GLOOMCRAFT_NIGHTMARE_COST)
                print(string.format(">>> GloomCraft: nightmarefuel gloom -%d (current=%.0f)",
                    TUNING.VEX_GLOOMCRAFT_NIGHTMARE_COST, owner.components.gloom.current))
            end
            for _, ents in pairs(ingredients or {}) do
                for item, _ in pairs(ents) do
                    if item ~= nil and item:IsValid() and item:HasTag("vex_upgrade_storage")
                            and item.components.container ~= nil then
                        -- 内容先转 stash(原版稍后 DropEverything,先搬走就倒不出东西)
                        local stash = owner._vex_stash
                        if stash ~= nil and stash:IsValid() and stash.components.container ~= nil then
                            local src = item.components.container
                            local dst = stash.components.container
                            for slot = src:GetNumSlots(), 1, -1 do
                                local sit = src:GetItemInSlot(slot)
                                if sit ~= nil then
                                    src:RemoveItemBySlot(slot)
                                    if not dst:GiveItem(sit) then
                                        src:GiveItem(sit)  -- 极端装不下:留回饰品
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        -- 从护甲升级槽正确取出(若在槽中):先关容器清 HUD/opener 状态、
                        -- 清护甲侧引用,再移除(触发 itemlose 正常流程)
                        local armor = owner.components.inventory ~= nil
                            and owner.components.inventory:GetEquippedItem(GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.BODY) or nil
                        if armor ~= nil and armor.prefab == "vex_shadow" and armor.components.container ~= nil then
                            local slot = armor.components.container:GetItemSlot(item)
                            if slot ~= nil then
                                if item.components.container:IsOpen() then
                                    item.components.container:Close(owner)
                                end
                                if armor._open_storage == item then
                                    armor._open_storage = nil
                                end
                                armor.components.container:RemoveItem(item, true)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return old_RemoveIngredients(self, ingredients, recname, discounted)
    end

    -- 虚拟配料"vex_gloomcraft"仅用于配方显示(格温hundeng配料图集模式):
    -- 服务端 GetIngredients 剥离它——合成有效性检查不受影响
    -- (真正的阴郁度门控在 recipe.canbuild,扣费在 RemoveIngredients 上面)
    local old_GetIngredients = self.GetIngredients
    function self:GetIngredients(recname, ...)
        local ingredients, discounted = old_GetIngredients(self, recname, ...)
        if ingredients ~= nil then
            ingredients.vex_gloomcraft = nil
        end
        return ingredients, discounted
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:edible
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
AddComponentPostInit("edible", function(self)
    local _GetHunger = self.GetHunger
    local _GetSanity  = self.GetSanity
    local _GetHealth  = self.GetHealth

    function self:GetHunger(eater, ...)
        if eater and eater.prefab == "vex" and self.inst.components.perishable
            and self.inst.components.perishable:IsStale() then
            return self.hungervalue
        end
        return _GetHunger(self, eater, ...)
    end
    function self:GetSanity(eater, ...)
        if eater and eater.prefab == "vex" and self.inst.components.perishable
            and self.inst.components.perishable:IsStale() then
            return self.sanityvalue or 0
        end
        return _GetSanity(self, eater, ...)
    end
    function self:GetHealth(eater, ...)
        if eater and eater.prefab == "vex" and self.inst.components.perishable
            and self.inst.components.perishable:IsStale() then
            return self.healthvalue or 0
        end
        return _GetHealth(self, eater, ...)
    end
end)
```
