```lua
local SPIN_LOOP_ANIM_SPEED = 3
local SPIN_LOOP_COUNT = 3

local function ResetAnimSpeed(inst)
	inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(1)
end

local function StartSpinLoops(inst, play_sound)
	inst.sg.statemem.phase = "spin"
	inst.sg.statemem.spin_loops_left = SPIN_LOOP_COUNT
	inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(SPIN_LOOP_ANIM_SPEED)
	inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("wx_spin_attack_loop")
	if play_sound then
		inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/wilson/attack_weapon")
	end
end

-- animover 时调用：若还需继续转则返回 true
local function ContinueSpinLoops(inst)
	local left = (inst.sg.statemem.spin_loops_left or 1) - 1
	inst.sg.statemem.spin_loops_left = left
	if left > 0 then
		inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("wx_spin_attack_loop")
		return true
	end
	return false
end

AddStategraphState("wilson", State{
	name = "ms_tornado_pre",
	tags = { "busy", "nopredict", "nomorph", "ms_tornado" },

	onenter = function(inst)
		EnsureSpinAnimBuild(inst)
		inst.components.locomotor:Stop()
		inst:PerformBufferedAction()
		-- 抬手 → 加速多播几轮旋转 loop → 再换成龙卷风外观
		inst.sg.statemem.phase = "pre"
		inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("chop_pre")
	end,

	events =
	{
		EventHandler("animover", function(inst)
			if not inst.AnimState:AnimDone() then
				return
			end
			if inst.sg.statemem.phase == "pre" then
				StartSpinLoops(inst, true)
			elseif inst.sg.statemem.phase == "spin" then
				if ContinueSpinLoops(inst) then
					return
				end
				ResetAnimSpeed(inst)
				inst.sg.statemem.tornadoing = true
				SetupTornadoVisual(inst)
				inst.sg:GoToState("ms_tornado_loop")
			end
		end),
	},

	onexit = function(inst)
		ResetAnimSpeed(inst)
		if not inst.sg.statemem.tornadoing then
			ClearTornadoVisual(inst, false)
		end
	end,
})

AddStategraphState("wilson_client", State{
	name = "ms_tornado_pre",
	tags = { "busy", "nopredict", "nomorph", "ms_tornado" },
	server_states = { "ms_tornado_pre", "ms_tornado_loop" },

	onenter = function(inst)
		EnsureSpinAnimBuild(inst)
		inst.components.locomotor:Stop()
		inst.sg.statemem.phase = "pre"
		inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("chop_pre")
		inst:PerformPreviewBufferedAction()
		inst.sg:SetTimeout(5)
	end,

	events =
	{
		EventHandler("animover", function(inst)
			if not inst.AnimState:AnimDone() then
				return
			end
			if inst.sg.statemem.phase == "pre" then
				StartSpinLoops(inst, false)
			elseif inst.sg.statemem.phase == "spin" then
				ContinueSpinLoops(inst)
			end
		end),
	},

	onupdate = function(inst)
		if inst.sg:ServerStateMatches() then
			if inst.entity:FlattenMovementPrediction() then
				ResetAnimSpeed(inst)
				-- 服务端已进 loop 时切到客户端 loop，便于保留 overridelocomote
				if inst:HasTag("ms_tornado_active") then
					inst.sg:GoToState("ms_tornado_loop")
				else
					inst.sg:GoToState("idle", "noanim")
				end
			end
		elseif inst.bufferedaction == nil then
			inst.sg:GoToState("idle")
		end
	end,

	ontimeout = function(inst)
		inst:ClearBufferedAction()
		inst.sg:GoToState("idle")
	end,

	onexit = function(inst)
		ResetAnimSpeed(inst)
	end,
})

AddStategraphState("wilson", State{
	name = "ms_tornado_loop",
	-- 不加 busy：否则右键自身无法取消；nointerrupt 防止被全局 hit 抢走
	tags = { "nopredict", "nomorph", "ms_tornado", "canrotate", "overridelocomote", "nointerrupt" },

	onenter = function(inst)
		inst.sg.statemem.tornadoing = true
		inst.sg.statemem.aoe_dt = 0
		inst.sg.statemem.remotedir = nil
		inst.components.locomotor:Stop()
		inst.components.locomotor:Clear()
		if inst._ms_tornado_fx == nil then
			SetupTornadoVisual(inst)
		end
		SetTornadoRemoteOverride(inst, true)
		inst.sg:SetTimeout(TUNING.MOUNTAIN_TORNADO_SORBET.FORM_DURATION)
		DestroyStuff(inst)
	end,

	onupdate = function(inst)
		local speed = inst.components.locomotor:GetRunSpeed()
		local dir = GetLocalAnalogDir(inst)
		if dir ~= nil then
			inst.Transform:SetRotation(math.atan2(-dir.z, dir.x) * RADIANS)
			inst.Physics:SetMotorVel(speed, 0, 0)
		elseif inst.sg.statemem.remotedir ~= nil then
			inst.Transform:SetRotation(inst.sg.statemem.remotedir)
			inst.Physics:SetMotorVel(speed, 0, 0)
		else
			inst.Physics:Stop()
		end

		inst.sg.statemem.aoe_dt = inst.sg.statemem.aoe_dt + FRAMES
		if inst.sg.statemem.aoe_dt >= 0.25 then
			inst.sg.statemem.aoe_dt = 0
			DestroyStuff(inst)
		end
	end,

	ontimeout = function(inst)
		inst.sg.statemem.exiting_to_pst = true
		inst.sg:GoToState("ms_tornado_pst")
	end,

	events =
	{
		EventHandler("locomote", function(inst, data)
			if data ~= nil and data.remoteoverridelocomote then
				inst.sg.statemem.remotedir = data.dir
			end
			return true
		end),
		EventHandler("attacked", function(inst)
			if not inst.components.health:IsDead() then
				inst.sg.statemem.exiting_to_pst = true
				inst.sg:GoToState("ms_tornado_pst")
				return true
			end
		end),
	},

	onexit = function(inst)
		inst.Physics:Stop()
		SetTornadoRemoteOverride(inst, false)
		-- 正常进 pst 时留给收招状态处理外观；异常离开则立刻清掉
		if not inst.sg.statemem.exiting_to_pst then
			ClearTornadoVisual(inst, false)
		end
		-- 退出即进 CD，避免客户端在解除瞬间再次点到「化为龙卷风」
		StartCooldown(inst)
	end,
})

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:savedrotation

AddComponentPostInit("savedrotation", function(self)
	local old_onsave = self.OnSave
	function self:OnSave(...)
		SanitizeRotation(self.inst)
		if old_onsave ~= nil then
			return old_onsave(self, ...)
		end
		return { rotation = self.inst.Transform:GetRotation() }
	end

	local old_onload = self.OnLoad
	function self:OnLoad(data, ...)
		if old_onload ~= nil then
			old_onload(self, data, ...)
		elseif data ~= nil and data.rotation ~= nil and not IsBadRotation(data.rotation) then
			self.inst.Transform:SetRotation(data.rotation)
		end
		SanitizeRotation(self.inst)
	end

	self.inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function(inst)
		if inst:IsValid() then
			SanitizeRotation(inst)
		end
	end)
end)

-- Fix entities already in the running world before the next autosave
AddSimPostInit(function()
	if TheWorld ~= nil and TheWorld.ismastersim then
		TheWorld:DoTaskInTime(0, SanitizeAllSavedRotations)
		TheWorld:DoTaskInTime(1, SanitizeAllSavedRotations)
	end
end)
```

### 变体演进：movement_speed_limit (Mod 3822982881)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3822982881 (`movement_speed_limit`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3822982881)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:cursable

AddComponentPostInit("cursable", function(self)
    local OldForceOntoOwner = self.ForceOntoOwner
    function self:ForceOntoOwner(item, ...)
        local owner = self.inst
        if item == nil
            or not item:IsValid()
            or owner == nil
            or not owner:IsValid()
            or owner.components == nil
            or owner.components.inventory == nil
            or owner.components.health ~= nil and owner.components.health:IsDead()
        then
            return
        end

        if not self:IsCursable(item) then
            return
        end

        return OldForceOntoOwner(self, item, ...)
    end
end)

local function SnapshotOwnerListeners(owner, event, listener)
    local snapshot = {}
    local listeners = owner ~= nil and owner.event_listeners ~= nil
        and owner.event_listeners[event] or nil
    local callbacks = listeners ~= nil and listeners[listener] or nil
    if callbacks ~= nil then
        for _, fn in G.ipairs(callbacks) do
            snapshot[fn] = true
        end
    end
    return snapshot
end
```

```lua
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
	local handler = sg.actionhandlers[ACTIONS.CASTAOE]
	if handler ~= nil and type(handler.deststate) == "function" then
		local old_deststate = handler.deststate
		handler.deststate = function(inst, action, ...)
			if action.invobject ~= nil and (
				action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_life_rejuvenation_cursor")
				or action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_repair_magic_cursor")
				or action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_yishang_cursor")
			) then
				return LIFE_REJUV_CAST_STATE
			end
			if ZheiWanJiangWantsFastCast(inst, action) then
				return WANJIANG_FAST_CAST_STATE
			end
			return old_deststate(inst, action, ...)
		end
	end

	local emote_state = sg.states ~= nil and sg.states.emote or nil
	if emote_state ~= nil and type(emote_state.onenter) == "function" then
		local old_onenter = emote_state.onenter
		emote_state.onenter = function(inst, data)
			local is_xl = inst.prefab == "zhei_xinglan"
			local soundname = is_xl and ZheiXinglanCustomDanceSoundName(data) or nil
			-- data 可能为 nil（短接：soundname 为 nil 时不会读 data 字段）
			local want_dance_music = soundname ~= nil
				and data ~= nil
				and data.sound == nil
				and data.soundoverride == nil
			local want_carol_music = is_xl and ZheiXinglanIsCarolEmote(data)
			if want_dance_music then
				local track = ZheiXinglanPickDanceTrack()
				inst._zhei_dance_track = track
				-- DoEmoteSound 读 *soundoverride；本次表情内两字段都指向同一随机曲
				inst.dancesoundoverride = track
				inst.stepsoundoverride = track
				local newdata = {}
				for k, v in pairs(data) do
					newdata[k] = v
				end
				newdata.soundoverride = soundname
				newdata.soundlooped = true
				data = newdata
			elseif want_carol_music then
				-- 与 /dance 相同：每次 /carol 在 andreas / 浮光 间随机
				inst.carolsoundoverride = ZheiXinglanPickCarolTrack()
				local newdata = {}
				for k, v in pairs(data) do
					newdata[k] = v
				end
				newdata.soundoverride = "carol"
				newdata.soundlooped = true
				data = newdata
			end
			old_onenter(inst, data)
			-- 舞狮帽等会在 onenter 内替换 data 并丢掉 soundoverride；若仍在跳舞且未播上，补一次
			if want_dance_music and inst.sg ~= nil and inst.sg:HasStateTag("dancing") then
				ZheiXinglanEnsureDanceMusic(inst)
			end
			if want_carol_music and inst:IsValid() then
				local delay = (data ~= nil and type(data.sounddelay) == "number" and data.sounddelay > 0)
					and (data.sounddelay + 0.05)
					or 0.05
				inst:DoTaskInTime(delay, ZheiXinglanEnsureCarolMusic)
			elseif is_xl and inst:IsValid() then
				local delay = (data ~= nil and type(data.sounddelay) == "number" and data.sounddelay > 0)
					and (data.sounddelay + 0.05)
					or 0
				if delay > 0 then
					inst:DoTaskInTime(delay, ZheiXinglanUpdateEmoteMusicVolume)
				else
					ZheiXinglanUpdateEmoteMusicVolume(inst)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson_client", function(sg)
	local handler = sg.actionhandlers[ACTIONS.CASTAOE]
	if handler == nil or type(handler.deststate) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local old_deststate = handler.deststate
	handler.deststate = function(inst, action, ...)
		if action.invobject ~= nil and (
			action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_life_rejuvenation_cursor")
			or action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_repair_magic_cursor")
			or action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_yishang_cursor")
		) then
			return LIFE_REJUV_CAST_STATE
		end
		if ZheiWanJiangWantsFastCast(inst, action) then
			return WANJIANG_FAST_CAST_STATE
		end
		return old_deststate(inst, action, ...)
	end

	local state = sg.states[LIFE_REJUV_CAST_STATE]
	if state == nil then
		return
	end
	local old_onupdate = state.onupdate
	state.onupdate = function(inst)
		if inst._zhei_life_rejuv_casting then
			if inst.sg:ServerStateMatches() then
				inst._zhei_life_rejuv_casting = nil
				if inst.entity:FlattenMovementPrediction() then
					inst.sg:GoToState("idle", "noanim")
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if inst._zhei_repair_magic_casting then
			if inst.sg:ServerStateMatches() then
				inst._zhei_repair_magic_casting = nil
				if inst.entity:FlattenMovementPrediction() then
					inst.sg:GoToState("idle", "noanim")
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if inst._zhei_yishang_casting then
			if inst.sg:ServerStateMatches() then
				inst._zhei_yishang_casting = nil
				if inst.entity:FlattenMovementPrediction() then
					inst.sg:GoToState("idle", "noanim")
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if old_onupdate ~= nil then
			return old_onupdate(inst)
		end
	end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller", function(self)
	if self._zhei_life_rejuv_pc_patched then
		return
	end
	self._zhei_life_rejuv_pc_patched = true

	local old_GetGroundUseAction = self.GetGroundUseAction
	if type(old_GetGroundUseAction) == "function" then
		function self:GetGroundUseAction(position, spellbook)
			local rejuv = ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self)
			if rejuv ~= nil then
				spellbook = rejuv
			else
				local repair = ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self)
				if repair ~= nil then
					spellbook = repair
				else
					local yishang = ZheiGetYishangCursor(self)
					if yishang ~= nil then
						spellbook = yishang
					end
				end
			end
			return old_GetGroundUseAction(self, position, spellbook)
		end
	end

	local old_OnControl = self.OnControl
	if type(old_OnControl) == "function" then
		function self:OnControl(control, down)
			if down and control == CONTROL_CANCEL and self.inst ~= nil then
				if ZheiIsLifeRejuvCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortLifeRejuv(self.inst)
					return
				end
				if ZheiIsRepairMagicCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortRepairMagic(self.inst)
					return
				end
				if ZheiIsYishangCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortYishang(self.inst)
					return
				end
			end
			if down and control == CONTROL_PRIMARY and self:IsAOETargeting() then
				if ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastLifeRejuv(self) then
					return
				end
				if ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastRepairMagic(self) then
					return
				end
				if ZheiGetYishangCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastYishang(self) then
					return
				end
			end
			return old_OnControl(self, control, down)
		end
	end

	local old_CancelAOETargeting = self.CancelAOETargeting
	if type(old_CancelAOETargeting) == "function" then
		function self:CancelAOETargeting(...)
			local had_rejuv = ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self) ~= nil
			local had_repair = ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self) ~= nil
			local had_yishang = ZheiGetYishangCursor(self) ~= nil
			local suppress_rejuv = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_life_rejuv_suppress_server_clear
			local suppress_repair = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_repair_magic_suppress_server_clear
			local suppress_yishang = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_yishang_suppress_server_clear
			local ret = old_CancelAOETargeting(self, ...)
			if had_rejuv and not suppress_rejuv and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearLifeRejuv(self.inst)
			end
			if had_repair and not suppress_repair and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearRepairMagic(self.inst)
			end
			if had_yishang and not suppress_yishang and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearYishang(self.inst)
			end
			return ret
		end
	end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("playeractionpicker", function(self)
	if self._zhei_life_rejuv_pap_patched then
		return
	end
	self._zhei_life_rejuv_pap_patched = true

	local old_DoGetMouseActions = self.DoGetMouseActions

			local pc = self.inst.components.playercontroller
			local rejuv = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(pc) or nil
			if rejuv ~= nil then

			else
				local repair = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(pc) or nil
				if repair ~= nil then
					spellbook = repair
				else
					local yishang = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetYishangCursor(pc) or nil
					if yishang ~= nil then
						spellbook = yishang
					end
				end
			end
			-- 原版：IsAOETargeting 为真时若 reticule.targetpos 尚未就绪，会对 nil 调 :Get() 崩溃
			if position == nil and pc ~= nil and pc.IsAOETargeting ~= nil and pc:IsAOETargeting() then
				local aoepos = pc.GetAOETargetingPos ~= nil and pc:GetAOETargetingPos() or nil
				if aoepos == nil then

				end
			end
			return old_DoGetMouseActions(self, position, target, spellbook)
		end
	end
end)

GLOBAL.AddClientModRPCHandler(TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_RPC_NAMESPACE, "life_rejuvenation_target", function(cursor_guid)
	local player = GLOBAL.ThePlayer
	if player == nil or not player:IsValid() then
		return
	end

	player._zhei_life_rejuv_expected_guid = cursor_guid
	local cancel_fn = GLOBAL.ZheiLifeRejuvCancelClientTargeting
	if type(cancel_fn) == "function" then
		cancel_fn(player, true)
	end

	local resolve_fn = GLOBAL.ZheiLifeRejuvResolveLocalCursor

	local function ResolveCursor()
		if type(resolve_fn) == "function" then
			return resolve_fn(player, cursor_guid)
		end
		local Ents = GLOBAL.Ents or rawget(_G, "Ents")
		local cursor = (cursor_guid ~= nil and Ents ~= nil) and Ents[cursor_guid] or nil
		return cursor, "Ents"
	end

	local function TryStart(attempt)
		if not player:IsValid() then
			return
		end
		local pc = player.components.playercontroller
		if pc == nil then
			if attempt < 40 then
				player:DoTaskInTime(0, function() TryStart(attempt + 1) end)
			end
			return
		end
		local cursor, src = ResolveCursor()
		if cursor ~= nil and cursor:IsValid() and cursor.components.aoetargeting ~= nil then
			local start_fn = GLOBAL.ZheiLifeRejuvStartClientTargeting
			if type(start_fn) == "function" and start_fn(cursor, "RPC(" .. tostring(src) .. ")") then
				return
			end
			return
		end
		if attempt < 60 then
			player:DoTaskInTime(0, function() TryStart(attempt + 1) end)
		else
			ZheiRequestServerClearLifeRejuv(player)
		end
	end

	player:DoTaskInTime(0, function() TryStart(0) end)
end)

GLOBAL.AddClientModRPCHandler(TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_RPC_NAMESPACE, "starsky_map_pick_vis", function()
	local ThePlayer = GLOBAL.ThePlayer
	if ThePlayer ~= nil then

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson_client

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson_client", function(sg)
	local handler = sg.actionhandlers[ACTIONS.CASTAOE]
	if handler == nil or type(handler.deststate) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local old_deststate = handler.deststate
	handler.deststate = function(inst, action, ...)
		if action.invobject ~= nil and (
			action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_life_rejuvenation_cursor")
			or action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_repair_magic_cursor")
			or action.invobject:HasTag("zhei_xinglan_yishang_cursor")
		) then
			return LIFE_REJUV_CAST_STATE
		end
		if ZheiWanJiangWantsFastCast(inst, action) then
			return WANJIANG_FAST_CAST_STATE
		end
		return old_deststate(inst, action, ...)
	end

	local state = sg.states[LIFE_REJUV_CAST_STATE]
	if state == nil then
		return
	end
	local old_onupdate = state.onupdate
	state.onupdate = function(inst)
		if inst._zhei_life_rejuv_casting then
			if inst.sg:ServerStateMatches() then
				inst._zhei_life_rejuv_casting = nil
				if inst.entity:FlattenMovementPrediction() then
					inst.sg:GoToState("idle", "noanim")
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if inst._zhei_repair_magic_casting then
			if inst.sg:ServerStateMatches() then
				inst._zhei_repair_magic_casting = nil
				if inst.entity:FlattenMovementPrediction() then
					inst.sg:GoToState("idle", "noanim")
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if inst._zhei_yishang_casting then
			if inst.sg:ServerStateMatches() then
				inst._zhei_yishang_casting = nil
				if inst.entity:FlattenMovementPrediction() then
					inst.sg:GoToState("idle", "noanim")
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if old_onupdate ~= nil then
			return old_onupdate(inst)
		end
	end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller", function(self)
	if self._zhei_life_rejuv_pc_patched then
		return
	end
	self._zhei_life_rejuv_pc_patched = true

	local old_GetGroundUseAction = self.GetGroundUseAction
	if type(old_GetGroundUseAction) == "function" then
		function self:GetGroundUseAction(position, spellbook)
			local rejuv = ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self)
			if rejuv ~= nil then
				spellbook = rejuv
			else
				local repair = ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self)
				if repair ~= nil then
					spellbook = repair
				else
					local yishang = ZheiGetYishangCursor(self)
					if yishang ~= nil then
						spellbook = yishang
					end
				end
			end
			return old_GetGroundUseAction(self, position, spellbook)
		end
	end

	local old_OnControl = self.OnControl
	if type(old_OnControl) == "function" then
		function self:OnControl(control, down)
			if down and control == CONTROL_CANCEL and self.inst ~= nil then
				if ZheiIsLifeRejuvCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortLifeRejuv(self.inst)
					return
				end
				if ZheiIsRepairMagicCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortRepairMagic(self.inst)
					return
				end
				if ZheiIsYishangCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortYishang(self.inst)
					return
				end
			end
			if down and control == CONTROL_PRIMARY and self:IsAOETargeting() then
				if ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastLifeRejuv(self) then
					return
				end
				if ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastRepairMagic(self) then
					return
				end
				if ZheiGetYishangCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastYishang(self) then
					return
				end
			end
			return old_OnControl(self, control, down)
		end
	end

	local old_CancelAOETargeting = self.CancelAOETargeting
	if type(old_CancelAOETargeting) == "function" then
		function self:CancelAOETargeting(...)
			local had_rejuv = ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self) ~= nil
			local had_repair = ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self) ~= nil
			local had_yishang = ZheiGetYishangCursor(self) ~= nil
			local suppress_rejuv = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_life_rejuv_suppress_server_clear
			local suppress_repair = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_repair_magic_suppress_server_clear
			local suppress_yishang = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_yishang_suppress_server_clear
			local ret = old_CancelAOETargeting(self, ...)
			if had_rejuv and not suppress_rejuv and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearLifeRejuv(self.inst)
			end
			if had_repair and not suppress_repair and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearRepairMagic(self.inst)
			end
			if had_yishang and not suppress_yishang and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearYishang(self.inst)
			end
			return ret
		end
	end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("playeractionpicker", function(self)
	if self._zhei_life_rejuv_pap_patched then
		return
	end
	self._zhei_life_rejuv_pap_patched = true

	local old_DoGetMouseActions = self.DoGetMouseActions
	if type(old_DoGetMouseActions) == "function" then
		function self:DoGetMouseActions(position, target, spellbook)
			local pc = self.inst.components.playercontroller
			local rejuv = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(pc) or nil
			if rejuv ~= nil then
				spellbook = rejuv
			else
				local repair = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(pc) or nil
				if repair ~= nil then
					spellbook = repair
				else
					local yishang = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetYishangCursor(pc) or nil
					if yishang ~= nil then
						spellbook = yishang
					end
				end
			end
			-- 原版：IsAOETargeting 为真时若 reticule.targetpos 尚未就绪，会对 nil 调 :Get() 崩溃
			if position == nil and pc ~= nil and pc.IsAOETargeting ~= nil and pc:IsAOETargeting() then
				local aoepos = pc.GetAOETargetingPos ~= nil and pc:GetAOETargetingPos() or nil
				if aoepos == nil then
					return nil, nil
				end
			end
			return old_DoGetMouseActions(self, position, target, spellbook)
		end
	end
end)

			player:DoTaskInTime(0, function() TryStart(attempt + 1) end)
		else
			ZheiRequestServerClearYishang(player)
		end
	end

	player:DoTaskInTime(0, function() TryStart(0) end)
end)

GLOBAL.AddModRPCHandler(TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_RPC_NAMESPACE, "starsky_map_closed", function(player)
	if player == nil or not player:IsValid() or TheWorld == nil or not TheWorld.ismastersim then
		return
	end
	local world = TheWorld
	local delay = (GLOBAL.FRAMES ~= nil and 2 * GLOBAL.FRAMES) or (2 / 30)
	local captured_session = player._zhei_starsky_map_session or 0
	world:DoTaskInTime(delay, function()
		if world == nil or not world:IsValid() or player == nil or not player:IsValid() then
			return
		end
		-- 关图 RPC 排队期间若玩家又点了「选择星空基站」，会话号已增加；勿用旧关图播 MAP_CANCELLED / 清 map_armed（否则会大地图打不开+误播「选择已取消」）
		if (player._zhei_starsky_map_session or 0) > captured_session then
			player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
			return
		end
		if player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella ~= nil and player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella:IsValid() then
			local u = player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella
			local picked = u._zhei_starsky_pad_ready ~= nil and u._zhei_starsky_pad_ready:value()
			-- 选点已成功 / 即将成功：apply_starsky_map_pick 已设标记
			if picked or player._zhei_starsky_pick_committed then
				player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
				return
			end
			-- 2帧后仍未选点：云服上 MapAction 可能还在路上，再等一会儿
			-- 避免 starsky_map_closed RPC 抢在 MapAction 前到达导致清 map_armed →
			-- apply_starsky_map_pick 因 map_armed=false 失败
			world:DoTaskInTime(0.5, function()
				if world == nil or not world:IsValid() or player == nil or not player:IsValid() then
					return
				end
				if (player._zhei_starsky_map_session or 0) > captured_session then
					player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
					return
				end
				if player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella ~= nil and player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella:IsValid() then
					local u2 = player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella
					local picked2 = u2._zhei_starsky_pad_ready ~= nil and u2._zhei_starsky_pad_ready:value()
					if picked2 or player._zhei_starsky_pick_committed then
						player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
						return
					end
					local say = rawget(GLOBAL, "ZheiStarskyFlowSay")
					if say ~= nil then
						say(player, "MAP_CANCELLED")
					end
					if u2._zhei_starsky_map_armed ~= nil then
						u2._zhei_starsky_map_armed:set(false)
					end
				end
				player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
			end)
		else
			player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
		end
	end)
end)

-- 人物三维与等级 TUNING：须在 modimport 等级脚本之前，避免加载时读到未写入的配置
TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_HEALTH = 200
-- 等级满（与 ZHEI_XINGLAN_MAX_LEVEL 一致）时的生命上限；每升一级增量 = (此项 - HEALTH) / MAX_LEVEL
TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_MAX_HEALTH_CAP = 350
TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_HUNGER = 200
TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_SANITY = 150
-- 食物记忆（可配置关闭）：重复吃同种料理（调味按 basename）收益递减，最高档可负；约 3 天遗忘
-- 倍率下标 = 记忆次数（第 1 次吃倍率 1.0，不在表内；再吃读 [1]、[2]…）
do
	local fm = GetModConfigData("zhei_xinglan_food_memory")
	if fm == nil then

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playercontroller

AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller", function(self)
	if self._zhei_life_rejuv_pc_patched then
		return
	end
	self._zhei_life_rejuv_pc_patched = true

	local old_GetGroundUseAction = self.GetGroundUseAction
	if type(old_GetGroundUseAction) == "function" then
		function self:GetGroundUseAction(position, spellbook)
			local rejuv = ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self)
			if rejuv ~= nil then
				spellbook = rejuv
			else
				local repair = ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self)
				if repair ~= nil then
					spellbook = repair
				else
					local yishang = ZheiGetYishangCursor(self)
					if yishang ~= nil then
						spellbook = yishang
					end
				end
			end
			return old_GetGroundUseAction(self, position, spellbook)
		end
	end

	local old_OnControl = self.OnControl
	if type(old_OnControl) == "function" then
		function self:OnControl(control, down)
			if down and control == CONTROL_CANCEL and self.inst ~= nil then
				if ZheiIsLifeRejuvCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortLifeRejuv(self.inst)
					return
				end
				if ZheiIsRepairMagicCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortRepairMagic(self.inst)
					return
				end
				if ZheiIsYishangCastInProgress(self.inst) then
					ZheiRequestServerAbortYishang(self.inst)
					return
				end
			end
			if down and control == CONTROL_PRIMARY and self:IsAOETargeting() then
				if ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastLifeRejuv(self) then
					return
				end
				if ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastRepairMagic(self) then
					return
				end
				if ZheiGetYishangCursor(self) ~= nil and ZheiTryClientCastYishang(self) then
					return
				end
			end
			return old_OnControl(self, control, down)
		end
	end

	local old_CancelAOETargeting = self.CancelAOETargeting
	if type(old_CancelAOETargeting) == "function" then
		function self:CancelAOETargeting(...)
			local had_rejuv = ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(self) ~= nil
			local had_repair = ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(self) ~= nil
			local had_yishang = ZheiGetYishangCursor(self) ~= nil
			local suppress_rejuv = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_life_rejuv_suppress_server_clear
			local suppress_repair = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_repair_magic_suppress_server_clear
			local suppress_yishang = self.inst ~= nil and self.inst._zhei_yishang_suppress_server_clear
			local ret = old_CancelAOETargeting(self, ...)
			if had_rejuv and not suppress_rejuv and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearLifeRejuv(self.inst)
			end
			if had_repair and not suppress_repair and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearRepairMagic(self.inst)
			end
			if had_yishang and not suppress_yishang and self.inst ~= nil and self.inst:IsValid() then
				ZheiRequestServerClearYishang(self.inst)
			end
			return ret
		end
	end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("playeractionpicker", function(self)
	if self._zhei_life_rejuv_pap_patched then
		return
	end
	self._zhei_life_rejuv_pap_patched = true

	local old_DoGetMouseActions = self.DoGetMouseActions
	if type(old_DoGetMouseActions) == "function" then
		function self:DoGetMouseActions(position, target, spellbook)
			local pc = self.inst.components.playercontroller
			local rejuv = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetLifeRejuvCursor(pc) or nil
			if rejuv ~= nil then
				spellbook = rejuv
			else
				local repair = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetRepairMagicCursor(pc) or nil
				if repair ~= nil then
					spellbook = repair
				else
					local yishang = pc ~= nil and ZheiGetYishangCursor(pc) or nil
					if yishang ~= nil then
						spellbook = yishang
					end
				end
			end
			-- 原版：IsAOETargeting 为真时若 reticule.targetpos 尚未就绪，会对 nil 调 :Get() 崩溃
			if position == nil and pc ~= nil and pc.IsAOETargeting ~= nil and pc:IsAOETargeting() then
				local aoepos = pc.GetAOETargetingPos ~= nil and pc:GetAOETargetingPos() or nil
				if aoepos == nil then
					return nil, nil
				end
			end
			return old_DoGetMouseActions(self, position, target, spellbook)
		end
	end
end)

GLOBAL.AddClientModRPCHandler(TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_RPC_NAMESPACE, "life_rejuvenation_target", function(cursor_guid)
	local player = GLOBAL.ThePlayer
	if player == nil or not player:IsValid() then
		return
	end

	player._zhei_life_rejuv_expected_guid = cursor_guid
	local cancel_fn = GLOBAL.ZheiLifeRejuvCancelClientTargeting
	if type(cancel_fn) == "function" then
		cancel_fn(player, true)
	end

	local resolve_fn = GLOBAL.ZheiLifeRejuvResolveLocalCursor

	local function ResolveCursor()
		if type(resolve_fn) == "function" then
			return resolve_fn(player, cursor_guid)
		end
		local Ents = GLOBAL.Ents or rawget(_G, "Ents")
		local cursor = (cursor_guid ~= nil and Ents ~= nil) and Ents[cursor_guid] or nil
		return cursor, "Ents"
	end

	local function TryStart(attempt)
		if not player:IsValid() then
			return
		end
		local pc = player.components.playercontroller
		if pc == nil then
			if attempt < 40 then
				player:DoTaskInTime(0, function() TryStart(attempt + 1) end)
			end
			return
		end
		local cursor, src = ResolveCursor()
		if cursor ~= nil and cursor:IsValid() and cursor.components.aoetargeting ~= nil then
			local start_fn = GLOBAL.ZheiLifeRejuvStartClientTargeting
			if type(start_fn) == "function" and start_fn(cursor, "RPC(" .. tostring(src) .. ")") then
				return
			end
			return
		end
		if attempt < 60 then
			player:DoTaskInTime(0, function() TryStart(attempt + 1) end)
		else
			ZheiRequestServerClearLifeRejuv(player)
		end
	end

	player:DoTaskInTime(0, function() TryStart(0) end)
end)

	local delay = (GLOBAL.FRAMES ~= nil and 2 * GLOBAL.FRAMES) or (2 / 30)
	local captured_session = player._zhei_starsky_map_session or 0
	world:DoTaskInTime(delay, function()
		if world == nil or not world:IsValid() or player == nil or not player:IsValid() then
			return
		end
		-- 关图 RPC 排队期间若玩家又点了「选择星空基站」，会话号已增加；勿用旧关图播 MAP_CANCELLED / 清 map_armed（否则会大地图打不开+误播「选择已取消」）
		if (player._zhei_starsky_map_session or 0) > captured_session then
			player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
			return
		end
		if player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella ~= nil and player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella:IsValid() then
			local u = player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella
			local picked = u._zhei_starsky_pad_ready ~= nil and u._zhei_starsky_pad_ready:value()
			-- 选点已成功 / 即将成功：apply_starsky_map_pick 已设标记
			if picked or player._zhei_starsky_pick_committed then
				player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
				return
			end
			-- 2帧后仍未选点：云服上 MapAction 可能还在路上，再等一会儿
			-- 避免 starsky_map_closed RPC 抢在 MapAction 前到达导致清 map_armed →
			-- apply_starsky_map_pick 因 map_armed=false 失败
			world:DoTaskInTime(0.5, function()
				if world == nil or not world:IsValid() or player == nil or not player:IsValid() then
					return
				end
				if (player._zhei_starsky_map_session or 0) > captured_session then
					player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
					return
				end
				if player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella ~= nil and player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella:IsValid() then
					local u2 = player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella
					local picked2 = u2._zhei_starsky_pad_ready ~= nil and u2._zhei_starsky_pad_ready:value()
					if picked2 or player._zhei_starsky_pick_committed then
						player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
						return
					end
					local say = rawget(GLOBAL, "ZheiStarskyFlowSay")
					if say ~= nil then
						say(player, "MAP_CANCELLED")
					end
					if u2._zhei_starsky_map_armed ~= nil then
						u2._zhei_starsky_map_armed:set(false)
					end
				end
				player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
			end)
		else
			player._zhei_starsky_map_umbrella = nil
		end
	end)
end)

-- 人物三维与等级 TUNING：须在 modimport 等级脚本之前，避免加载时读到未写入的配置
TUNING.ZHEI_XINGLAN_HEALTH = 200
-- 等级满（与 ZHEI_XINGLAN_MAX_LEVEL 一致）时的生命上限；每升一级增量 = (此项 - HEALTH) / MAX_LEVEL
```

```lua
AddPrefabPostInit("metatron_cube", function(inst)
    inst:AddTag("quickcast")
    Metatron_ConfigureMeteorAoeItem(inst)
    Metatron_EnsureCubeSpellbook(inst)

    local old_CollectActions = inst.CollectActions
    if old_CollectActions == nil then
        return
    end
    inst.CollectActions = function(self, actiontype, ...)
        if actiontype == "POINT" then
            old_CollectActions(self, actiontype, ...)
            local doer, pos, actions, right = ...
            local requested = GLOBAL.CLIENT_REQUESTED_ACTION
            local pc = doer ~= nil and doer.components ~= nil and doer.components.playercontroller or nil
            -- 仅技能栏启动的本地选点或对应的服务端施法校验保留 CASTAOE。
            -- 普通右键不收集陨石动作，也不抢占尘降或场景交互。
            local casting = requested == GLOBAL.ACTIONS.CASTAOE
                or (requested == nil and pc ~= nil and pc:IsAOETargeting()
                    and pc.reticule.inst == self)
            if right and actions ~= nil and not casting then
                for i = #actions, 1, -1 do
                    if actions[i] == GLOBAL.ACTIONS.CASTAOE then
                        table.remove(actions, i)
                    end
                end
            end
            return
        end
        return old_CollectActions(self, actiontype, ...)
    end
end)
```

- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3680323787 (`晓美焰 时停修复 & DLC扩展补丁 v2.5`) 的生产级切面。

```lua
-- ============================================================================

-- 2. 拦截客户端动作生成器
AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller", function(self)
    local old_DoAction = self.DoAction
    self.DoAction = function(self, buffaction, ...)
        if buffaction and buffaction.action == GLOBAL.ACTIONS.ATTACK then
            local weapon = GetEquippedWeapon(self.inst)
            if weapon and weapon:HasTag("homura_bow") then
                return -- 强制吞噬动作
            end
        end
        if old_DoAction then
            return old_DoAction(self, buffaction, ...)
        end
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:homura_clientkey
-- 3. 注入快捷键按键伪装逻辑
AddComponentPostInit("homura_clientkey", function(self)
    self.custom_hotkey_down = false

    local old_IsPressing = self.IsPressing
    function self:IsPressing(key_type)
        if key_type == "raction" then
            local weapon = GetEquippedWeapon(self.inst)
            if weapon and weapon:HasTag("homura_bow") then
                return self.raction or self.custom_hotkey_down
            end
        end
        
        if old_IsPressing then 
            local success, res = GLOBAL.pcall(old_IsPressing, self, key_type)
            if success then return res end
            if key_type == "attack" then return self.attack end
            if key_type == "raction" then return self.raction end
            return false
        end
        return false
    end

    self.inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        if self.inst == GLOBAL.ThePlayer then
            GLOBAL.TheInput:AddKeyHandler(function(key, down)
                if key == HOTKEY then
                    local weapon = GetEquippedWeapon(self.inst)
                    if weapon and weapon:HasTag("homura_bow") then
                        if self.custom_hotkey_down ~= down then
                            self.custom_hotkey_down = down
                            if self.inst.components.playercontroller then
                                self.inst.components.playercontroller:OnControl(GLOBAL.CONTROL_SECONDARY, down)
                            end
                            if self.HandleRAction then
                                self:HandleRAction(down)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:homura_skill
-- A. 前摇设置：默认 0.5 秒，点技能后 0.15 秒 (缩短 70%)
AddComponentPostInit("homura_skill", function(self)
    local old_GetPreTime = self.GetPreTime
    self.GetPreTime = function(self)
        if self.inst.components.skilltreeupdater and self.inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("homura_timemagic_pre") then
            return 0.15
        else
            return 0.5
        end
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat

AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
    local old_calc_damage = self.CalcDamage
    self.CalcDamage = function(self, target, weapon, multiplier, ...)
        local damage, spdam = old_calc_damage(self, target, weapon, multiplier, ...)
        local attacker = self.inst

        if attacker and attacker:IsValid() and IsInSkillRange(attacker) then
            if not (weapon and weapon:HasTag("homuraTag_ranged")) then
                damage = damage * 1.1
            end
        end

        return damage, spdam
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:homura_projectile

AddComponentPostInit("homura_projectile", function(self)
    local old_Attack = self.Attack
    if old_Attack then
        self.Attack = function(self, target, ...)
            local attacker = self.player or (self.owner and self.owner.components.inventoryitem and self.owner.components.inventoryitem:GetGrandOwner())
            if attacker and attacker:IsValid() and IsInSkillRange(attacker) then
                local raw_dmg = self.damage1
                if raw_dmg then
                    self.damage1 = raw_dmg * 1.2
                    old_Attack(self, target, ...)
                    self.damage1 = raw_dmg
                    return
                end
            end
            return old_Attack(self, target, ...)
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
AddComponentPostInit("cursable", function(self)
    local OldForceOntoOwner = self.ForceOntoOwner
    function self:ForceOntoOwner(item, ...)
        local owner = self.inst
        if item == nil
            or not item:IsValid()
            or owner == nil
            or not owner:IsValid()
            or owner.components == nil
            or owner.components.inventory == nil
            or owner.components.health ~= nil and owner.components.health:IsDead()
        then
            return
        end

                                          
        if not self:IsCursable(item) then
            return
        end

        return OldForceOntoOwner(self, item, ...)
    end
end)

        if self._lazy_nine_actionbutton_backpack_route_patched then
            return
        end
        self._lazy_nine_actionbutton_backpack_route_patched = true

        local OldGetActionButtonAction = self.GetActionButtonAction
        function self:GetActionButtonAction(force_target)
            local buffered = OldGetActionButtonAction(self, force_target)
            local resolved = buffered ~= nil and buffered.action or nil
            if resolved ~= G.ACTIONS.PICKUP and resolved ~= G.ACTIONS.EQUIP then
                return buffered
            end

            local item = buffered.target
            if not IsGroundEnhancedBackpack(item) then
                item = buffered.invobject

            local inventory = GetNineBackpackPickupInventory(self.inst, item)
            if inventory == nil then

            local resolved_name = resolved == G.ACTIONS.EQUIP and "EQUIP" or "PICKUP"
            

            if not occupied then
                return buffered

            buffered.action = NineBackpackPickupAction
            buffered.target = item
            buffered.initialtargetowner = item.components ~= nil
                and item.components.inventoryitem ~= nil
                and item.components.inventoryitem.owner or nil
            if buffered.invobject == item then
                buffered.invobject = nil
                buffered.doerownsobject = false
            end
            buffered.distance = NineBackpackPickupAction.distance
            buffered.arrivedist = NineBackpackPickupAction.arrivedist

local function SnapshotOwnerListeners(owner, event, listener)
    local snapshot = {}
    local listeners = owner ~= nil and owner.event_listeners ~= nil
        and owner.event_listeners[event] or nil
    local callbacks = listeners ~= nil and listeners[listener] or nil
    if callbacks ~= nil then
        for _, fn in G.ipairs(callbacks) do
            snapshot[fn] = true
        end
    end
    return snapshot
end

local function SnapshotOwnerListeners(owner, event, listener)
    local snapshot = {}
    local listeners = owner ~= nil and owner.event_listeners ~= nil
        and owner.event_listeners[event] or nil
    local callbacks = listeners ~= nil and listeners[listener] or nil
    if callbacks ~= nil then
        for _, fn in G.ipairs(callbacks) do
            snapshot[fn] = true
        end
    end
    return snapshot
end

    end

    end
```

```lua
local function OpenFriendContainer(doer, target, container)
    local leader = doer.components ~= nil and doer.components.follower ~= nil
        and doer.components.follower:GetLeader() or nil
    local opened_by_leader = leader ~= nil and container:IsOpenedBy(leader)
    local own_overflow = target ~= nil and target.prefab == "beargerfur_sack"
        and doer.components ~= nil and doer.components.inventory ~= nil
        and doer.components.inventory:GetOverflowContainer() == container
    if not own_overflow and not opened_by_leader
        and not InventoryAI.CanReachContainer(doer, target) then return false end
    if opened_by_leader then return true end
    if not container:IsOpenedBy(doer) then
        doer:PushEvent("opencontainer", { container = target })
        container:Open(doer)
    end
    return container:IsOpenedBy(doer)
end

-- what stopped a world from starting again after the mod was removed.
AddPrefabPostInit("skeleton_player", function(inst)
    if not _G.TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
    local oldsave, oldload = inst.OnSave, inst.OnLoad
    inst.OnSave = function(self, data)
        local refs = oldsave ~= nil and oldsave(self, data) or nil
        if self._my_friend_remains then data.my_friend_remains = true end
        local remains = self.components.my_friend_remains
        if remains ~= nil then data.my_friend_remains_remaining = math.max(0, remains.expires - _G.GetTime()) end
        data.my_friend_remains_expired = self._my_friend_remains_expired or nil
        return refs
    end
    inst.OnLoad = function(self, data, ents)
        if oldload ~= nil then oldload(self, data, ents) end
        self._my_friend_remains_expired = data ~= nil and data.my_friend_remains_expired or nil
        if data ~= nil and data.my_friend_remains
            and not self._my_friend_remains_expired
            and self.components.my_friend_remains == nil then
            self:AddComponent("my_friend_remains")
            self.components.my_friend_remains:SetLifetime(data.my_friend_remains_remaining or 120)
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playercontroller

newcs_core.AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller", function(self)


    local CHARGE_COOLDOWN = 0.3  -- 动作（的最小触发间隔
    local SKILL_COOLDOWN = 0.3   -- 技能的最小触发间隔

    local old_activate = self.Activate
    local old_deactivate = self.Deactivate
    function self:Activate()
        old_activate(self)
        if self.handler~=nil then
            self.mabyss_keyhandler = TheInput:AddKeyHandler(function(key, down) self:NewCS_keyhandle(key, down) end )
            self.newcs_timers = {
                last_action_time = 0,
                last_skill_time = 0
            }
        end
    end
    function self:Deactivate()
        old_deactivate(self)
        if self.mabyss_keyhandler~=nil then
            self.mabyss_keyhandler:Remove()
            self.mabyss_keyhandler = nil
            self.newcs_timers = nil
        end
    end
    

    function self:NewCS_keyhandle(key,down)
        if IsPaused() or not down then
            return
        end
    
        local isenabled, ishudblocking = self:IsEnabled()
        if not isenabled or ishudblocking then
            return
        end

         local now = GetTime()
        -- 安全检查: 如果表或键不存在，默认为 0
        local last_action_time = self.newcs_timers.last_action_time or 0
        local last_skill_time = self.newcs_timers.last_skill_time or 0
        

        if key == newcs_core.KEY_MAP.CHARGE and (now - last_action_time)>CHARGE_COOLDOWN then
            self:NewCS_actionhandle()
        elseif key == newcs_core.KEY_MAP.SKILL and (now - last_skill_time)>SKILL_COOLDOWN then
            self:NewCS_skillhandle()
        end
    end

    function self:NewCS_Remote_actionhandle(position)
        if self.ismastersim and self:IsEnabled() and self.mabyss_keyhandler == nil then
            if self.inst:HasDebuff("buff_mooncurse") then
                return false
            end
            local act = GetActionForKeyhandle(self.inst,position)
            if act~=nil then
                self:DoAction(act)
            end
        end
    end


    function self:NewCS_actionhandle()
        local position
        if CHARGE_MODE then
            position = TheInput:GetWorldPosition()
        else
            local theta = self.inst.Transform:GetRotation()*DEGREES
            local offset = Vector3(8 * math.cos( theta ), 0, -8 * math.sin( theta ))    
            position = self.inst:GetPosition() + offset
        end
        
        local act = GetActionForKeyhandle(self.inst,position)
        if act == nil then
            return
        end
        if not self.ismastersim then
            
            local platform, pos_x, pos_z = self:GetPlatformRelativePosition(position.x, position.z)
            if self.locomotor == nil then
                if act.action.pre_action_cb ~= nil then
                    act.action.pre_action_cb(act)
                end
                SendModRPCToServer(GetModRPC("NewConstant","ActionHandle"),pos_x,pos_z,platform, platform ~= nil)
            elseif self:CanLocomote() then
                act.preview_cb = function()
                    SendModRPCToServer(GetModRPC("NewConstant","ActionHandle"),pos_x,pos_z,platform, platform ~= nil)
                end
            end
        end
        self.newcs_timers.last_action_time = GetTime()
        self:DoAction(act)
    end



    ---TODO
    function self:NewCS_skillhandle()
        if self.inst:HasTag("playerghost") then
            return
        end

        local position = TheInput:GetWorldPosition()
        local skill,item = GetSkillForKeyhandle(self.inst,position)
        if skill == nil then
            return
        end
        if not self.ismastersim then
            local platform, pos_x, pos_z = self:GetPlatformRelativePosition(position.x, position.z)
            SendModRPCToServer(GetModRPC("NewConstant","SkillHandle"),pos_x,pos_z,platform, platform ~= nil)
        else
            skill(item, self.inst,position)
        end
        self.newcs_timers.last_skill_time = GetTime()
    end


    function self:NewCS_Remote_skillhandle(position)
        if self.ismastersim and self:IsEnabled() and self.mabyss_keyhandler == nil then
            if self.inst:HasDebuff("buff_mooncurse") then
                return false
            end
            local skill,item = GetSkillForKeyhandle(self.inst,position)
            if skill~=nil then
                skill(item, self.inst,position)
            end
        end
    end
    
    self.remote_AOETARGET = false
    local AOE_code = ACTIONS.CASTAOE.code

    function self:IsAOETargeting()
        
        return (self.reticule ~= nil and self.reticule.inst.components.aoetargeting ~= nil) or self.remote_AOETARGET
    end
    local old_OnRemoteLeftClick = self.OnRemoteLeftClick

    function self:OnRemoteLeftClick(actioncode, ...)
        if actioncode == AOE_code then
            self.remote_AOETARGET = true
        end
        old_OnRemoteLeftClick(self,actioncode, ...)
        self.remote_AOETARGET = false
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat
newcs_core.AddComponentPostInit("combat",function (self,inst)
    local old_getatk = self.GetAttacked_Internal
    function self:GetAttacked_Internal(attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage,...)
        if self.inst.components.health and self.inst.components.health:IsDead() then
            return true
        end
        if attacker and attacker.components.truedamage~=nil then
           attacker.components.truedamage:DoAttack(self.inst) 
        end
        if self.hit_stuntime and self:InHitStun() then
            return false
        end
        return old_getatk(self,attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage,...)
    end    


    --UpvalueTracker.SetUpvalue(self.externaldamagemultipliers.RemoveModifier,RecalculateModifier,"RecalculateModifier")
    local modifier  = require("util/combatsourcemodifier")
    self.externaldamagemultipliers = modifier(inst)
    
    function self:InHitStun()
        return GetTime()<self.hit_stuntime + self.lastwasattackedtime
    end


    ---请输入非空实体，tag检测请在输入前完成
    function self:newcs_AOECheck(target)
        return  target.entity:IsValid() and target.entity:IsVisible()
            and target~=self.inst
            and target.replica.combat~=nil 
            and target.replica.health~=nil and not target.replica.health:IsDead()
    end

    ---must be a non-nil entity!!!
    function self:P_AOECheck(target)
        if not (target.entity:IsValid() and target.entity:IsVisible()) then
            return false
        end

        if target.replica.combat == nil or IsEntityDead(target, true) 
        or target:HasTag("noplayertarget") or self:IsAlly(target) then
            return false
        end

        --TODO  PVP???
        local sanity = self.inst.replica.sanity

        if sanity ~= nil and sanity:IsCrazy() or self.inst:HasTag("crazy") then
            --Insane attacker can pretty much attack anything
            return true
        end

        if target:HasAnyTag("shadowcreature", "nightmarecreature") and target:HasTag("locomotor") then
            local victim = target.replica.combat:GetTarget()

            if victim == nil or (victim~=self.inst and target.HostileToPlayerTest ~= nil 
            and not target:HostileToPlayerTest(victim)) then
                return false
            end
        end

        return true
    end
end)

newcs_core.AddComponentPostInit("sanity",function (self)
    self.soul_loss_rate = 1
    function self:GetSoulAttacked(attacker, damage)
        local old_san = self.current
        damage = damage * self.soul_loss_rate
        self:DoDelta(-damage)
        local new_san = self.current
        if new_san<=0 then
            self.inst.components.health:DoDelta(old_san-damage,nil,"SOUL_BREAK",nil,attacker,true)
        end
    end    
    
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:burnable

newcs_core.AddComponentPostInit("burnable", function(self)
    local function OnHealthErodeAway(inst)
        local self = inst.components.burnable
        self.fastextinguish = true
        self:KillFX()
    end
    local function OnKilled(inst)
        local self = inst.components.burnable
        if self ~= nil and self:IsBurning() and not self.nocharring then
            inst.AnimState:SetMultColour(.2, .2, .2, 1)
        end
    
        --@V2C: #HACK, sync up burn fx to health component's auto-ErodeAway
        if inst.components.health ~= nil and not inst.components.health.nofadeout then
            if self.task ~= nil then
                self.task:Cancel()
            end
            self.task = inst:DoTaskInTime(inst.components.health.destroytime or 2, OnHealthErodeAway)
        end
    end
    function self:Extinguish(resetpropagator, heatpct, smotherer)
        self:StopSmoldering(heatpct)
    
        if smotherer ~= nil then
            if smotherer.components.finiteuses ~= nil then
                smotherer.components.finiteuses:Use()
            elseif smotherer.components.stackable ~= nil then
                smotherer.components.stackable:Get():Remove()
            end
        end
    
        if self.burning then
            if self.task ~= nil then
                self.task:Cancel()
                self.task = nil
            end
    
            self.inst:RemoveEventCallback("death", OnKilled)
    
            if self.inst.components.propagator ~= nil then
                if resetpropagator then
                    self.inst.components.propagator:StopSpreading(true, heatpct)
                else
                    self.inst.components.propagator:StopSpreading()
                end
            end
    
            self.controlled_burn = nil
    
            self.burning = false
            self:KillFX()
            if self.inst.components.fueled ~= nil and not self.ignorefuel then
                self.inst.components.fueled:StopConsuming()
            end
            if self.onextinguish ~= nil then
                self.onextinguish(self.inst,smotherer)
            end
            self.inst:PushEvent("onextinguish",{resetpropagator=resetpropagator,smotherer=smotherer})
        end
    end
end)


newcs_core.AddComponentPostInit("spell",function (self)
    function self:OnStart()
        self.active = true
        if self.onstartfn ~= nil then
            self.onstartfn(self.inst)
        end
        if self.target and self.target.isplayer then
            self.target:PushEvent("onspell",{spell = self.inst, duration = self.duration})
        end
    end
    function self:OnFinish()
        if self.target and self.target.isplayer then
            self.target:PushEvent("endspell",self.inst)
        end
        if self.onfinishfn ~= nil then
            self.onfinishfn(self.inst)
        end
        
        self.inst:StopUpdatingComponent(self)
    
        if self.removeonfinish then
            self.inst:Remove()
        end
    end
    function self:ResumeSpell()
        if self.resumefn ~= nil then
            local timeleft = self.duration - self.lifetime
            self.resumefn(self.inst, timeleft)
            self.inst:StartUpdatingComponent(self)
            if self.target and self.target.isplayer then
                self.target:PushEvent("onspell",{spell = self.inst, duration = self.duration})
            end
        end
    end
end)

---免控

require("components/rooted")._ctor = function (self,inst)
    self.inst = inst
	self.sources = {}
    if not self.inst:HasTag("no_rooted") then
        if inst.Physics ~= nil then
            inst.Physics:Stop()
    
            --Generally, don't call SetTempMass0 outside of here.
            --A prefab's own internal logic should just manage Physics:SetMass.
            --Otherwise, just add and use the "rooted" component where needed.
            inst.Physics:SetTempMass0(true)
        end
        if inst.components.locomotor ~= nil then
            inst.components.locomotor:SetExternalSpeedMultiplier(inst, "rooted", 0)
        end
    end
    self._onremovesource = function(src)
		self.sources[src] = nil
		if next(self.sources) == nil then
			inst:RemoveComponent("rooted")
		end
	end

	inst:PushEvent("rooted")
end

newcs_core.AddComponentPostInit("colouradder",function (self)
    function self:ForceMultColor(r,g,b,a)
        self.inst.AnimState:SetMultColour(r, g, b, a)
	
        for k, v in pairs(self.children) do
            if k.OnSyncMultColour ~= nil then
                k:OnSyncMultColour(r,g,b,a)
            elseif k.AnimState~=nil then
                k.AnimState:SetMultColour(r, g, b, a)
            end
        end
    end

    function self:ClearMultColor()
        self.inst.AnimState:SetMultColour(1,1,1,1)
	
        for k, v in pairs(self.children) do
            if k.OnSyncMultColour ~= nil then
                k:OnSyncMultColour(1,1,1,1)
            elseif k.AnimState~= nil then
                k.AnimState:SetMultColour(1,1,1,1)
            end
        end
    end
end)
```

### 变体演进：【唐小可】【附魔-强化】 (Mod 3761589309)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3761589309 (`【唐小可】【附魔-强化】`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3761589309)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:health

HOOKS.AddComponentPostInit("health", function(self)
    self["hh_base_max"] = 0
    METHOD_WRAPPER.Wrap(self, "SetMaxHealth", "txk_fumo.health.base_max", function(previous, self, amount, ...)
        self["hh_base_max"] = amount
        previous(self, amount, ...)
        self["inst"]:PushEvent("hh_change_max_health")
    end)
    METHOD_WRAPPER.Wrap(self, "DoDelta", "txk_fumo.health.delta", function(previous, self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ...)
        --制裁效果
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number")
                and amount > 0
        then
            if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:HasSpecialEffect("healthSuppressNum") then
                amount = amount * 0.1
            end
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number")
                and amount > 0
        then
            if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:HasSpecialEffect("healthSuppressNum") then
                amount = amount * 0.1
            end
        end
        local result = previous(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ...)
        --攻击力大于0才能吸血
        if HH_UTILS:IsValidCombat(self["inst"]) then
            --吸血效果
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(afflicter, "hh_player") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(result, "number") and result < 0 then
                afflicter["components"]["hh_player"]:HandleBloodSuck(result)
            end
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(afflicter, "hh_monster") and HH_UTILS:IsHHType(result, "number") and result < 0 then
                afflicter["components"]["hh_monster"]:HandleBloodSuck(result)
            end
        end
        return result
    end)
    ----
    ---单独的真伤方法
    ---@param self:父类
    ---@param amount:伤害-必须为负值
    ---@param attacker:攻击者
    ---@param cause:伤害类型-中文显示
    ---
    self["DoHHDelta"] = function(self, amount, attacker, cause)
        if not HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number") or amount >= 0
                or not HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "combat")
        then
            return false
        end
        local old_percent = self:GetPercent()
        --官方限伤
        if self["maxdamagetakenperhit"] ~= nil and amount < self["maxdamagetakenperhit"] and not self["_ignore_maxdamagetakenperhit"] then
            amount = self["maxdamagetakenperhit"]
        end
        if HH_UTILS:IsHHType(cause, "string") then
            HH_UTILS:SpawnClientStrFx(self["inst"], cause)
        end
        local hh_cause = "hh_true_damage"
        self:SetVal(self["currenthealth"] + amount, hh_cause, attacker)
        --推送事件同步客机
        self["inst"]:PushEvent("healthdelta", {
            ["oldpercent"] = old_percent,
            ["newpercent"] = self:GetPercent(),
            ["overtime"] = nil,
            ["cause"] = hh_cause,
            ["afflicter"] = attacker,
            ["amount"] = amount
        })
        --实体死亡推送事件 用于兼容击杀掉落
        if self:IsDead() then
            attacker:PushEvent("killed", {
                ["victim"] = self["inst"],
                ["attacker"] = attacker
            })
            --兼容影怪san掉落
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "combat")
                    and self["inst"]["components"]["combat"]["onkilledbyother"]
            then
                self["inst"]["components"]["combat"]["onkilledbyother"](self["inst"], attacker)
            end
        end
        return true
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat

HOOKS.AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
    -- 普攻、范围攻击和伤害重定向都在新入口结算；GetAttacked 只负责转发。
    METHOD_WRAPPER.Wrap(self, "GetAttacked_Internal", "txk_fumo.combat.damage", function(previous, self, attacker, damage, ...)
        local hh_inst = self["inst"]
        if attacker and attacker["prefab"] == "abigail"
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "follower")
                and attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
        then
            --温蒂
            local wendy = attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            --随从享受人物固定增伤
            local extra_leader_damage = wendy["components"]["hh_player"]:DoAttackDamage(wendy, hh_inst, damage, true)
            damage = extra_leader_damage
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "hh_player") then
            damage = attacker["components"]["hh_player"]:DoAttackDamage(attacker, self["inst"], damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "hh_monster") then
            damage = attacker["components"]["hh_monster"]:DoAttackDamage(attacker, self["inst"], damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") then
            damage = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:GetBlockDamage(self["inst"], attacker, damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") then
            damage = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:GetBlockDamage(self["inst"], attacker, damage)
        end
        --随从强化
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker, "follower") and attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
        then
            local atk_leader = attacker["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            damage = atk_leader["components"]["hh_player"]:GetFollowerDamage(damage)
        end
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "follower") and self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
                and HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"], "hh_player")
        then
            local inst_leader = self["inst"]["components"]["follower"]["leader"]
            damage = inst_leader["components"]["hh_player"]:GetFollowerArmor(damage)
        end
        damage = math["max"](damage, 0)
        return previous(self, attacker, damage, ...)
    end)
    self["GetBrambleFx"] = function(self, attacker, amount)
        if not HH_UTILS:NotIsDead(self["inst"]) then
            return false
        end
        if self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd"] then
            return false
        end
        --建筑不会受到反伤效果
        if self["inst"]:HasTag("structure") then
            return false
        end
        --反甲增加cd
        self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd"] = true
        if not self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd_task"] then
            self["inst"]["hh_bramble_cd_task"] = self["inst"]:DoTaskInTime(0.3, function(hh_inst)
                hh_inst["hh_bramble_cd"] = false
                HH_UTILS:HHKillTask(hh_inst, "hh_bramble_cd_task")
            end)
        end
        if not HH_UTILS:IsHHType(amount, "number") then
            return false
        end
        --小于0不做处理
        if amount <= 0 then
            return false
        end
        if attacker and HH_UTILS:NotIsDead(attacker) then
            HH_UTILS:SpawnBrambleFx(attacker)
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") then
                if self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:HasSpecialEffect("immuneBramble") then
                    return true
                end
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_player"]:GetHitByBrambleFxDamage(amount)
            end
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_monster") then
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["hh_monster"]:GetHitByBrambleFxDamage(amount)
            end
            --处理各自的减伤
            amount = amount * self["externaldamagetakenmultipliers"]:Get()
            if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "inventory") then
                amount = self["inst"]["components"]["inventory"]:ApplyDamage(amount, attacker)
            end
            if amount > 0 then
                self["inst"]["components"]["health"]:DoDelta(-amount, false, "hh_bramble_damage")
                self:SetTarget(attacker)
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end)

HOOKS.AddComponentPostInit("freezable", function(self)
    METHOD_WRAPPER.Wrap(self, "Freeze", "txk_fumo.freezable.immunity", function(previous, self, ...)
        if HH_UTILS:HasComponents(self["inst"], "hh_player") then
```

### 变体演进：STREAMERMODE (Mod 3470314870)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3470314870 (`STREAMERMODE`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3470314870)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", SGWilsonPostInit)

local BEAM_SFX_ATTACKER = {
    wiku_none = fmodtable.miku_beam_attacker.track,
    ms_teto_kasane = fmodtable.teto_beam_attacker.track,
}
BEAM_SFX_ATTACKER.wiku_hires = BEAM_SFX_ATTACKER.wiku_none
BEAM_SFX_ATTACKER.wiku = BEAM_SFX_ATTACKER.wiku_none


local function SGWilsonPostInit(sg)
	local oldcast = sg.states["castspell"].onenter
	sg.states["castspell"].onenter = function(inst, ...)


		if oldcast then
			local staff = inst.components.inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS)
			if staff and staff.prefab == "wiku_microphone" then
				staff.castsound = inst.components.singinginspiration:GetPercent() > 0.01 and BEAM_SFX_ATTACKER[inst.AnimState:GetBuild()] or fmodtable.drain_0.track
			end



			oldcast(inst, ...)
		end

		if inst.prefab == "wiku" and inst.sg.statemem.stafffx then
			local x,y,z = inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
			inst.sg.statemem.stafffx.Transform:SetPosition(0,-.5,.1)
	
		end
	end
end

    AddPrefabPostInit("wanderingtrader", function(inst)
        if not TheWorld.ismastersim then return inst end

        local custom_wares = {
            [data.product] = {
                recipe = data.recipe_name,
                min = data.min or 1,
                max = data.max or 1,
                limit = data.limit or 1,


            },
        }

        local old_reroll = inst.RerollWares or function() end

        inst.RerollWares = function(inst, ...)
            old_reroll(inst, ...)
            inst:AddWares(custom_wares)
            if inst.AddPrototyper then
				inst:AddPrototyper()
			end
        end

        inst:DoTaskInTime(0.5, function()
            inst:RerollWares()
        end)
    end)
```

- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 2383756168 (`Starving Floor`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 2383756168)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playercontroller

AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller", function(self)
	overwrite(self, "Enable", function(self, switch)
		if switch == false then 
			return false 
		end 
	end)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:focalpoint

AddComponentPostInit("focalpoint", function(self)	
	self.StartFocusSource = NOTHING_FUNCTION
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:world
				
AddPrefabPostInit("world", function(TheWorld)
	if TheNet:IsDedicated() then 
		overwrite(GLOBAL, "c_regenerateworld", function()
			if #AllPlayers > 0 then 
				return false 
			end 
		end, nil, false)
	end
	
	local COMMANDS = {
		regenerate = function(self)
--			self.votetimeout = 480
		end, 
		rollback = true
	}
	
	for name, data in pairs(COMMANDS) do 
		local command = require"usercommands".GetCommandFromName(name)
		command.voteminpasscount = 1
		command.voteminstartage = 10
		
		if type(data) == "function" then 
			data(command)
		end 
	end 

	local getexectype = Hacker.GetUpvalue(require"usercommands".GetUserActions, 
		"getsomecommands", 
		"getexectype")

	local replacement = function(command, caller, ...)
		local guy = TheNet:GetClientTableForUser(caller.userid)
		if guy and guy.admin  and (COMMANDS[command.name] ~= nil) then 
			return COMMAND_RESULT.VOTE
		else 
			return getexectype(command, caller, ...)
		end  
	end
	
	Hacker.SetUpvalue(require"usercommands".GetUserActions, 
		replacement, 
		"getsomecommands", 
		"getexectype")
end)

	overwrite(self, "ShouldAggro", function(self, target, ignore_forbidden)
		if self.inst:HasOneOfTags{"companion", "shadowminion", "abigail"} then 
		
			if target and target:HasOneOfTags{"companion", "wall"} then 
				return false 
				
			elseif target and target:HasTag"player" and (not ignore_forbidden) then 
				return false 
			end 
		end 
	end)
end)

AddComponentPostInit("planarentity", function(self)
	overwrite(self, "AbsorbDamage", function(self, damage, attacker, weapon, spdmg)
		if self.inst:HasAnyTag{"companion", "wall"} 
		and attacker and attacker:HasTag"player" then  
			return damage, spdmg
		end 
	end)
end)

-- remember that this is less of a buff than for the purpose of delag
-- so they go off and die 
local function locomotor_retarget(inst)
	if inst.components.follower and inst.components.follower.leader then 
		return nil 
	else 
		local target = FindEntity(
			inst,
			ArenaRadius * 2, -- default is 4 and investigative is 6
			nil, 
			{ "_combat"}, 
			{
				"INLIMBO", 
				
				"player", 
				"companion", 
				"wall", 
				
				"shadow", 
				
				"lureplant", 
				"eyeplant", 
				"gnarwail", 
			}, 
			{"hostile", "sfhostile", "berrythief"})
		if target then 
			return target, true
		end 
	end 
end

-- for the one biome mobs we'll be adding
function SF.DoLocomotorRetargetAndAllyFixes(inst)
	DoAllyFix(inst)
	if inst.components.combat then 
		inst.components.combat:SetRetargetFunction(1, locomotor_retarget)
		inst.components.combat.SetRetargetFunction = function(inst)
			print("Denying combat:SetRetargetFunction on " .. tostring(inst))
		end	
		inst.components.combat:TryRetarget()
		-- (they keep their native keeptarget function)
	end 
end

for prefab, func in pairs{
	pigman = false, 
	bunnyman = false, 
	
	mermguard = function(inst)
		inst:AddTag"stronggrip" 
	end, 
	
	merm = function(inst)
		inst:AddTag"stronggrip" 
	end, 
} do 
	PrefabSpecialness(prefab, function(inst)
		DoLocomotorRetargetAndAllyFixes(inst)
		if func then 
			func(inst)
		end 
	end)
end

local function pigelite_startfollowing(inst, data)
--	print("startfollowing", inst, data and data.leader)
	if data and data.leader and data.leader.components.leader then 
		local pigelite_followers = {}
		for k in pairs(data.leader.components.leader.followers) do 
			if k == inst then 
				-- pass
			elseif (inst:HasTag"pigelite" and k:HasTag"pigelite") then  
				SetOwnerInstance(k, data.leader)
				if inst.components.follower then 
					inst.components.follower:SetLeader(nil)
				end 
			end  
		end
	end 
end

AddPrefabPostInitAny(function(inst)
	if inst:HasAnyTag{"pigelite"} then 
		inst:ListenForEvent("startfollowing", pigelite_startfollowing)
	end 
end)

local function pigelite_attacked(inst, data)
--	print("pigelite_attacked", inst, data and data.attacker)
	if data and data.attacker and data.attacker:HasTag"player" then 		
		if data.attacker == (inst.components.follower 
		and inst.components.follower.leader) then
			if inst.components.combat:HasTarget() then 
				inst.components.combat:DropTarget()
			else  
				data.attacker.components.leader:RemoveFollower(inst)
			end
		end 
		
	elseif data and data.attacker then 
		inst.components.combat:SetTarget(data.attacker)
	end 
end

local function pigelite_keeptarget(inst, target)
	return inst.components.combat
		and inst.components.combat:CanTarget(target) 
end

local function DoAllyFixAndOwnership(child, userid)
	if child.sfinfinityfn then 
		child:sfinfinityfn() 
	else 
		DoAllyFix(child)
	end
	
	if userid then 
		SetOwnerID(child, userid)
	end 
end

AddComponentPostInit("childspawner", function(self)	
-- this happens when the game reloads and they're spawned outside 
	overwrite(self, "DoTakeOwnership", function(self, child)
		if not child then 
			return 
			
		elseif (self.inst:HasTag"bedazzled" or GetOwnerID(self.inst)) then 
			DoAllyFixAndOwnership(child, GetOwnerID(self.inst))
		end
	end)
	
	-- why was this chunk commented out?
	local DoSpawnChild = self.DoSpawnChild
	self.DoSpawnChild = function(self, target, ...)
		if (GetOwnerID(self.inst) or self.inst:HasTag"bedazzled") 
		and target and target:HasTag"player" then 
			target = nil
		end 
		return DoSpawnChild(self, target, ...)
	end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("spawner", function(self)
	overwrite(self, "TakeOwnership", function(self, child)
		if GetOwnerID(self.inst) and child and child.components.follower then  
		
			DoAllyFixAndOwnership(child, GetOwnerID(self.inst))
		end 
	end)
end)	

AddComponentPostInit("leader", function(self)
--	print("leader")
	overwrite(self, "AddFollower", function(self, follower)
--		print("AddFollower", self.inst:HasTag"player", follower, follower:HasTag"sfhostile")
		if self.inst:HasTag"player" then 
			if follower and follower:HasTag"sfhostile" then 
				return false 
			else 
				DoAllyFixAndOwnership(follower, self.inst.userid)
			end 
		end 
	end)
end)

-- this chunk should be in the webber file, but kept here for unity
local function spider_mutate(inst)
	DoAllyFixAndOwnership(inst)
end	

AddPrefabPostInitAny(function(inst)
	if inst:HasTag"spider" then 
		inst:ListenForEvent("mutate", spider_mutate)
	end 
end)

-- for wurt
AddComponentPostInit("follower", function(self)
	overwrite(self, "SetLeader", function(self, leader)
		if leader and leader:HasTag"player" then 
			self.inst.old_leader = leader
		end 
	end)
end)

                end
```

```lua
            inst.components.workable.onfinish = function(inst, ...)

                    inst.components.container:DropEverything()
                end
                return old and old(inst, ...)
            end
        end

        inst:DoTaskInTime(0, autoaddfuel)
    end)
```

```lua
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:temperature
-- Items inside a closed Ice Furnace cool all the way to their minimum; the game's fridge branch stops at freezing
AddComponentPostInit("temperature", function(temperature)
	local old_OnUpdate = temperature.OnUpdate
	temperature.OnUpdate = function(self, dt, applyhealthdelta)
		local owner = self.inst.components.inventoryitem ~= nil and self.inst.components.inventoryitem.owner or nil
		if owner == nil or not (owner:HasTag("icefurnace") and owner:HasTag("fridge")) then
			return old_OnUpdate(self, dt, applyhealthdelta)
		end
		self.externalheaterpower = 0
		self.delta = 0
		self.rate = 0
		if self.settemp ~= nil or self.inst.is_teleporting or
			(self.inst.components.health ~= nil and self.inst.components.health:IsInvincible()) then
			return
		end
		local ratemult = owner.components.preserver ~= nil and owner.components.preserver:GetTemperatureRateMultiplier(self.inst) or 1
		self.rate = -TUNING.WARM_DEGREES_PER_SEC * ratemult
		self:SetTemperature(math.clamp(self.current + self.rate * dt, self.mintemp, self.maxtemp))
		if applyhealthdelta ~= false and self.inst.components.health ~= nil then
			if self.current < 0 then
				self.inst.components.health:DoDelta(-self.hurtrate * dt, true, "cold")
			elseif self.current > self.overheattemp then
				self.inst.components.health:DoDelta(-(self.overheathurtrate or self.hurtrate) * dt, true, "hot")
			end
		end
	end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("builder", function(builder)
	local old_DoBuild = builder.DoBuild
	builder.DoBuild = function(self, recname, pt, rotation, skin)
		if recname ~= "icefurnace" or not IsIceFurnaceSkin(skin) then
			return old_DoBuild(self, recname, pt, rotation, skin)
		end
		self.inst.icefurnace_build_skin = skin
		local built, reason = old_DoBuild(self, recname, pt, rotation, nil)
		self.inst.icefurnace_build_skin = nil
		return built, reason
	end
end)
```

```lua
    local old_StartCooking = self.StartCooking
    function self:StartCooking(doer,...)
        local nocook  = self.targettime == nil
        local old = old_StartCooking(self,doer,...)
        if nocook and self.targettime ~= nil and self.task ~= nil and doer and doer:HasTag("atri") then

	end
```
