### 变体演进：EGGMAN: The Inventor (Mod 3777841665)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3777841665 (`EGGMAN: The Inventor`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3777841665)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat

ENV.AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
    local inst = self.inst
    if inst == nil or not inst:HasTag("player") then return end
    if inst._eggshield_getattacked_patched then return end
    inst._eggshield_getattacked_patched = true

    local _OldGetAttacked = self.GetAttacked
    self.GetAttacked = function(combat_self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, ...)
        local target = combat_self.inst
        local health = target.components.health

        if damage == nil or damage <= 0 or health == nil or health:IsDead() then
            return _OldGetAttacked(combat_self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, ...)
        end

        -- Inmunidad post-explosión (0.15s), cubre el frame de transición
        -- shield_dead -> otra vez vulnerable.
        if target._eggshield_immune_until ~= nil and GetTime() < target._eggshield_immune_until then
            return
        end

        local shield = EggShieldRegistry.FindProtecting(target)
        if shield == nil then
            return _OldGetAttacked(combat_self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, ...)
        end

        shield:Explode(attacker, target)
        return -- golpe anulado por completo, nunca corre el GetAttacked original
    end
end)
```

```lua
AddPrefabPostInit("deepseek", function(inst)
	if TheWorld:HasTag("cave") then
		return
	end
	inst:AddTag("deepseek_swimmer")
	IgnoreLimits(inst)
	inst.Physics:SetCollisionCallback(OnCollide)
	inst:ListenForEvent("deepseekswimmingdirty", OnSwimmingDirty)
	inst:ListenForEvent("playeractivated", RefreshActionFilter)

	if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
		return
	end
	if inst.components.drownable ~= nil then
		inst.components.drownable.enabled = false
		inst.components.drownable.CheckDrownable = function(...)
		end
	end
	inst:DoPeriodicTask(0, CheckWater)
	inst:ListenForEvent("mounted", RefreshCollision)
	inst:ListenForEvent("dismounted", function(inst)
		-- 龙蝇等坐骑会在下骑回调里重新开启溺水；等本轮回调结束后恢复，避免依赖监听顺序。
		inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function(inst)
			RefreshCollision(inst)
		end)
	end)
	inst:ListenForEvent("death", function(inst)
		SetSwimming(inst, false)
	end)
	PatchHopping(inst, inst.components.locomotor)
end)
```

```lua
    local old_ATTACK = sg.actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate
    sg.actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate = function(inst, action,...)
    local weapon = inst.components.combat:GetWeapon()
    local is_riding = inst.components.rider:IsRiding()
    local is_dead = (inst.components.health and inst.components.health:IsDead()) or inst.sg:HasStateTag("dead") or inst:HasTag("playerghost")
    if weapon and weapon:HasTag("goldship_gun") and not is_ridingthen then
        if not weapon:HasTag("nouse") then 
           return "goldship_shoot"
        else
           return
        end   
    end 
        
    return old_ATTACK(inst, action,...)
    end
end)

    local old_ATTACK = sg.actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate
    sg.actionhandlers[ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate = function(inst, action,...)
    local weapon = inst.replica.combat:GetWeapon()
    local is_dead = inst.replica.health:IsDead()
    local is_riding = inst.replica.rider:IsRiding()

    if weapon and weapon:HasTag("goldship_gun") and not is_riding then 
        if not weapon:HasTag("nouse") then 
           return "goldship_shoot"
        else
           return
        end 
    end

    return old_ATTACK(inst, action,...)
    end
end)
```

```lua
AddComponentPostInit("resurrectable", function(self, inst)
    local original_FindClosestResurrector = self.FindClosestResurrector
    local original_CanResurrect = self.CanResurrect
    local original_DoResurrect = self.DoResurrect

    self.FindClosestResurrector = function(self)
        if IsServer and self.inst.components.inventory then
            local item = self.inst.components.inventory:GetEquippedItem(GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.NECK)
            if item and item.prefab == "amulet" then
                return item
            end
        end
        return original_FindClosestResurrector(self)
    end

    self.CanResurrect = function(self)
        if IsServer and self.inst.components.inventory then
            local item = self.inst.components.inventory:GetEquippedItem(GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.NECK)
            if item and item.prefab == "amulet" then
                return true
            end
        end
        return original_CanResurrect(self)
    end

    self.DoResurrect = function(self)
        self.inst:PushEvent("resurrect")
        if IsServer and self.inst.components.inventory then
            local item = self.inst.components.inventory:GetEquippedItem(GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.NECK)
            if item and item.prefab == "amulet" then
                self.inst.sg:GoToState("amulet_rebirth")
                return true
            end
        end
        return original_DoResurrect(self)
    end
end)

AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self, inst)
    local original_Equip = self.Equip
    self.Equip = function(self, item, old_to_active)
        if original_Equip(self, item, old_to_active) and item and item.components and item.components.equippable then
            local eslot = item.components.equippable.equipslot
            if self.equipslots[eslot] ~= item then
                if eslot == GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.BACK and item.components.container ~= nil then
                    self.inst:PushEvent("setoverflow", { overflow = item })
                end
            end
            return true
        else
            return
        end
    end

    self.GetOverflowContainer = function()
        if self.ignoreoverflow then
            return
        end
        local item = self:GetEquippedItem(GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.BACK)
        return item ~= nil and item.components.container or nil
    end
end)

AddPrefabPostInit("inventory_classified", function(inst)
    function GetOverflowContainer(inst)
        local item = inst.GetEquippedItem(inst, GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.BACK)
        return item ~= nil and item.replica.container or nil
    end

    function Count(item)
        return item.replica.stackable ~= nil and item.replica.stackable:StackSize() or 1
    end

    function Has(inst, prefab, amount)
        local count =
            inst._activeitem ~= nil and
            inst._activeitem.prefab == prefab and
            Count(inst._activeitem) or 0

        if inst._itemspreview ~= nil then
            for i, v in ipairs(inst._items) do
                local item = inst._itemspreview[i]
                if item ~= nil and item.prefab == prefab then
                    count = count + Count(item)
                end
            end
        else
            for i, v in ipairs(inst._items) do
                local item = v:value()
                if item ~= nil and item ~= inst._activeitem and item.prefab == prefab then
                    count = count + Count(item)
                end
            end
        end

        local overflow = GetOverflowContainer(inst)
        if overflow ~= nil then
            local overflowhas, overflowcount = overflow:Has(prefab, amount)
            count = count + overflowcount
        end

        return count >= amount, count
    end
```

```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3778622972)

local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:beefalo

        AddPrefabPostInit("beefalo", MVB_SetupBackpackMount)

        -- 牛悬停显示的名字：
        -- 客户端上"牛没被玩家改名"时 inst.name 是 prefab（named_replica 只在名字变化时才刷新，空名字不发事件），
        -- 悬停就会显示 "beefalo"。这里补一个 displaynamefn：有自定义名字用自定义的，否则用本地化名字。
        local function MVB_HookBeefaloName(inst, fallback)
            if inst.displaynamefn ~= nil then
                return
            end
            inst.displaynamefn = function(i)
                local rep = i.replica ~= nil and i.replica.named or nil
                local custom = rep ~= nil and rep._name ~= nil and rep._name:value() or nil
                if custom ~= nil and custom ~= "" then
                    return custom
                end
                return GLOBAL.STRINGS.NAMES[string.upper(i.prefab)] or fallback
            end
        end

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:grassgator_beef
        if GLOBAL.KnownModIndex ~= nil and GLOBAL.KnownModIndex:IsModEnabled("workshop-3688913682") then
            AddPrefabPostInit("grassgator_beef", MVB_SetupBackpackMount)
            AddPrefabPostInit("grassgator_beef", function(inst)
                MVB_HookBeefaloName(inst, "草鳄鱼坐骑")
            end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:mvb_beefalobackpack
            local BeefaloBackpacks = {}
            AddPrefabPostInit("mvb_beefalobackpack", function(inst)
                if GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim then
                    BeefaloBackpacks[inst] = true
                    inst:ListenForEvent("onremove", function()
                        BeefaloBackpacks[inst] = nil
                    end)
                end
            end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:messagebottleempty
        -- 空瓶：可对伏特羊装羊奶
        AddPrefabPostInit("messagebottleempty", function(inst)
            if not GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim or inst.components.bottler == nil then
                return
            end
            -- （S 类，version=1）：回调字段改用 MVB_AddCallbackField
            MVB_AddCallbackField(inst.components.bottler, "onbottlefn", "goat_milk", 1, function(inner)
                return function(bottle, target, doer)
                    if target ~= nil and target.prefab == "lightninggoat" then
                        local x, y, z = bottle.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
                        if bottle.components.stackable ~= nil then
                            bottle.components.stackable:Get():Remove()
                        else
                            bottle:Remove()
                        end
                        local milk = GLOBAL.SpawnPrefab("goatmilk")
                        if milk ~= nil then
                            if doer ~= nil and doer.components.inventory ~= nil then
                                doer.components.inventory:GiveItem(milk)
                            else
                                milk.Transform:SetPosition(x, y, z)
                            end
                        end
                        return true
                    end
                    if inner ~= nil then
                        local r = inner(bottle, target, doer)
                        return r
                    end
                    return false
                end
            end)
        end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:lightninggoat
        -- 伏特羊：可装瓶 + 命名 + 存档（绑定铃铛）
        AddPrefabPostInit("lightninggoat", function(inst)
            inst:AddTag("canbebottled")
            if not GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim then
                return
            end
            if inst.components.named == nil then
                inst:AddComponent("named")
            end
            -- （D 类，version=1）：统一存档分发器
            MVB_HookSaveLoad(inst, "voltgoat_bell", 1,
                function(goat, data)
                    data.mvb_bell_guid = goat.mvb_bell_guid
                    return data
                end,
                function(goat, data)
                    if data ~= nil and data.mvb_bell_guid ~= nil then
                        goat.mvb_bell_guid = data.mvb_bell_guid
                        if goat.components.herdmember ~= nil then
                            goat.components.herdmember:Enable(false)
                        end
                        if goat.components.knownlocations ~= nil then
                            goat.components.knownlocations:ForgetLocation("herd")
                        end
                        local function TryRelink()
                            if not goat:IsValid() then
                                return
                            end
                            local bell = GLOBAL.Ents ~= nil and GLOBAL.Ents[goat.mvb_bell_guid] or nil
                            if bell ~= nil and bell:IsValid() then
                                goat.mvb_bell = bell
                                bell.mvb_goat = goat
                            else
                                goat:DoTaskInTime(2, TryRelink)
                            end
                        end
                        goat:DoTaskInTime(0, TryRelink)
                    end
                end)
        end)

```

### 变体演进：雷德 (Mod 2955770972)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 2955770972 (`雷德`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 2955770972)

local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playercontroller

AddComponentPostInit("playercontroller", function(self)
	local old = self.DoActionAutoEquip
	function self:DoActionAutoEquip(buffaction,...)
		if buffaction and buffaction.action == ACTIONS.REID_FORGE then
			return
		end
		return old(self,buffaction,...)
	end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:health
AddComponentPostInit("health", function(self)
    local old_SetVal = self.SetVal
    function self:SetVal(val, cause, afflicter, ...)
        if not self.inst:HasTag("reid") then
            return old_SetVal(self, val, cause, afflicter, ...)
        end

        if self.inst.components.reidimmortality ~= nil --无敌期间免疫掉血
        and self.inst.components.reidimmortality.is_immortal 
        and val < self.currenthealth then
            return 
        end

        local max_health = self:GetMaxWithPenalty()
        local min_health = math.min(self.minhealth or 0, max_health)
        if val > 0 or min_health > 0 --没有死，或者有其他锁血机制，不触发技能树锁血
        or not self.inst.components.reidimmortality:CanUseImmortality() then --每次生命只有一次锁血机会
            return old_SetVal(self, val, cause, afflicter, ...)
        end

        self.inst.components.reidimmortality:Immortality()
    end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:reid
end
AddPrefabPostInit("reid", function(inst)   
    if inst.sg ~= nil then
        AddReidAttackSpeed(inst, inst.sg)
    end    
    local old_SetStateGraph = inst.SetStateGraph
    function inst:SetStateGraph(name, ...) --为了使sg变化时依然有加攻速效果（如从鬼魂变回来时）
        old_SetStateGraph(self, name, ...)
        AddReidAttackSpeed(self, self.sg)
        return self.sg
    end
end)

local function ReidImmune(sg)
    local old_attacked = sg.events.attacked.fn
    sg.events.attacked.fn = function(inst, data, ...)
        if inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("reid_resistance5") and inst.components.health:GetPercentWithPenalty() <= 0.5 then
            return
        end
        return old_attacked(inst, data, ...)
    end
end
```

```lua
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:xxtpack
-- 星小团背包：应用可配置保鲜模式（仅服务器）
AddPrefabPostInit("xxtpack", function(inst)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
    inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        ApplyContainerPreserve(inst, (GetModConfigData("xxtpack_preserve_mode") or "normal"))
    end)
end)

		if bird_no(inst) then
		   old(inst)
		end

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:critter_glomling
-- 仅对带有 tq_pet 标签的小格罗姆改名称/检查文本与外观
AddPrefabPostInit("critter_glomling", function(inst)
	local function ApplyTqOverrides()
		if not inst:HasTag("tq_pet") then
			return
		end

		-- 名称与检查文本
		inst.displaynamefn = function()
			return "兔球球"
		end
		if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.inspectable ~= nil then
			inst.components.inspectable.description = "兔子急了也会咬人"
		end

		-- 使用自定义 build：tq（不改 bank，沿用原版小格罗姆动画）
		if inst.AnimState ~= nil then
			inst.AnimState:SetBuild("tq")
		end

		-- 只保留 idle / walk 相关动画，其余动画强制切回 idle
		if inst.AnimState ~= nil then
			local as = inst.AnimState
			-- 固定允许的动画名列表（不再调用 HasAnimation，避免方法不存在崩溃）
			local allowed_list = { "idle_loop", "idle", "walk_pre", "walk", "walk_loop", "walk_pst" }
			-- 选一个 idle 动画名优先使用 idle_loop，其次 idle
			local idle_name = inst._tq_idle_anim or "idle_loop"
			if not as:IsCurrentAnimation("idle_loop") and not as:IsCurrentAnimation("idle") then
				-- 当前既不是 idle_loop 也不是 idle，就先记为 idle_loop，若后续不存在也只是动画不播放
				idle_name = "idle_loop"
			end
			inst._tq_idle_anim = idle_name

			-- 检查当前动画是否在允许列表里
			local allowed = false
			for _, name in ipairs(allowed_list) do
				if as:IsCurrentAnimation(name) then
					allowed = true
					break
				end
			end
			-- 如果不在允许列表中，则强制切回 idle（循环播放）
			if not allowed then
				as:PlayAnimation(inst._tq_idle_anim or "idle_loop", true)
			end
		end

		-- 兔球球静音：事件 + 每帧清理，彻底禁声
		MutePet(inst)

		-- 移除 talker，避免触发说话音效（使用安全移除，仅移除一次）
		if inst._tq_components_removed ~= true then
		if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.talker ~= nil then
				SafeRemoveComponent(inst, "talker")
			end
		end

		-- 不会饥饿：若有饥饿组件则关闭衰减
		if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.hunger ~= nil then
			local hunger = inst.components.hunger
			hunger:SetRate(0)
			hunger:SetPercent(1)
			if hunger.max ~= nil then
				hunger.current = hunger.max
			end
		end

		-- 不会腐烂/流失：若有 perishable 则阻止（与星际小宝一致）
		if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.perishable ~= nil then
			inst.components.perishable.StartPerishing = SPE_StopPerishingStart
			inst.components.perishable:StopPerishing()
			inst.components.perishable:SetPercent(1)
		end

		-- 不会睡觉：保留 sleeper 组件，通过 SleepTest 阻止进入睡眠
		if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.sleeper ~= nil then
			inst.components.sleeper:SetSleepTest(PetSleepTestAlwaysFalse)
		end

		-- 不可喂食 / 不可抚摸：移除相关组件（使用安全移除，仅移除一次）
		if inst._tq_components_removed ~= true then
		if inst.components ~= nil then
			if inst.components.trader ~= nil then
					SafeRemoveComponent(inst, "trader")
			end
			if inst.components.eater ~= nil then
					SafeRemoveComponent(inst, "eater")
			end
			-- 不能抚摸：直接移除 petable，保留 crittertraits 以避免 brain 崩溃
			if inst.components.petable ~= nil then
					SafeRemoveComponent(inst, "petable")
			end
			end
			-- 标记组件已移除，避免重复移除
			inst._tq_components_removed = true
		end

		-- 战斗能力：仅服务器端为兔球球添加贴身灼伤光环
		if TheWorld ~= nil and TheWorld.ismastersim then
			if inst._tq_aura_init ~= true then
				inst._tq_aura_init = true
				-- 使用自定义 brain，避免原 glomling 的逃跑逻辑
				inst:SetBrain(require "brains/tqbrain")
				-- 默认关闭嘲讽
				inst._tq_taunt_on = false
				-- 允许敌人将目标转到兔球球：添加可被攻击但无敌的体质
				if inst._tq_targetable_init ~= true then
					inst._tq_targetable_init = true
					if inst.components.health == nil then
						inst:AddComponent("health")
					end
					inst.components.health:SetMaxHealth(100)
					inst.components.health:SetPercent(1)
					inst.components.health:SetInvincible(true)
					if inst.components.combat == nil then
						inst:AddComponent("combat")
					end
					-- 一些检索会通过内部标记判断是否可作战目标
					if not inst:HasTag("_combat") then inst:AddTag("_combat") end
					if not inst:HasTag("_health") then inst:AddTag("_health") end
					if inst:HasTag("notarget") then inst:RemoveTag("notarget") end
				end
				-- follower.leader 守护：防止 leader 被解绑后导致快捷键误判
				-- 优化：频率 0.5s → 2.0s（leader 不会突然消失，2s 完全够用）
				if inst._tq_leader_guard ~= true then
					inst._tq_leader_guard = true
					inst:DoPeriodicTask(2.0, function(p)
						if p == nil or not p:IsValid() then return end
						if p.components == nil or p.components.follower == nil then return end
						local cur_leader = p.components.follower.leader
						if (cur_leader == nil or not cur_leader:IsValid()) and p._tq_owner ~= nil then
							local owner = p._tq_owner
							if owner:IsValid() and owner.components ~= nil
								and owner.components.health ~= nil
								and not owner.components.health:IsDead() then
								p.components.follower:SetLeader(owner)
								owner._tq_pet = p
							end
						end
					end)
				end
				-- 每秒对半径2.5内的指定目标造成5点伤害
				inst:DoPeriodicTask(1, function(i)
					if i.components ~= nil and i.components.health ~= nil and i.components.health:IsDead() then
						return
					end
					-- 只在有跟随者时工作
					local leader = i.components.follower ~= nil and i.components.follower.leader or nil
					if leader == nil or (leader.components ~= nil and leader.components.health ~= nil and leader.components.health:IsDead()) then
						return
					end
					-- 仅三类目标来源：玩家当前攻击目标 / 正在攻击玩家 / 正在攻击兔球球
					local leader_target = nil
					local primary = nil
					if leader.components ~= nil and leader.components.combat ~= nil then
						local lt = leader.components.combat.target
						if lt ~= nil and lt:IsValid() and lt.components ~= nil and lt.components.health ~= nil and not lt.components.health:IsDead() then
							leader_target = lt
							primary = lt
						end
					end
					-- 其次：正在攻击玩家的生物
					if primary == nil then
						primary = FindEntity(i, 10, function(e)
							return e ~= nil and e ~= i
								and e.components ~= nil
								and e.components.combat ~= nil
								and e.components.combat.target == leader
								and e.components.health ~= nil
								and not e.components.health:IsDead()
						end, nil, {"player", "companion", "wall", "INLIMBO", "tq_pet", "xjxb_pet"})
					end
					-- 再次：正在攻击兔球球的生物
					if primary == nil then
						primary = FindEntity(i, 10, function(e)
							return e ~= nil and e ~= i
								and e.components ~= nil
								and e.components.combat ~= nil
								and e.components.combat.target == i
								and e.components.health ~= nil
								and not e.components.health:IsDead()
						end, nil, {"player", "companion", "wall", "INLIMBO", "tq_pet", "xjxb_pet"})
					end
					-- 若有主要目标且距离不超过50，让兔球主动靠近；否则不追击，保持跟随玩家
					if primary ~= nil and i.components.locomotor ~= nil then
						local distsq = i:GetDistanceSqToInst(primary)
						if distsq ~= nil and distsq <= 50 * 50 then
							i.components.locomotor:GoToEntity(primary)
						end
					end
					-- 在半径2.5内对符合条件的单位造成伤害：
					-- 1）玩家当前攻击的目标
					-- 2）正在攻击玩家的单位
					local x, y, z = i.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
					local ents = TheSim:FindEntities(
						x, y, z, 2.5,
						nil,
						{"player", "companion", "wall", "INLIMBO", "tq_pet", "xjxb_pet"}
					)
					for _, e in ipairs(ents) do
						if e ~= nil and e ~= i and e.components ~= nil and e.components.health ~= nil and not e.components.health:IsDead() then
							local is_leader_target = (leader.components ~= nil and leader.components.combat ~= nil and leader.components.combat.target == e)
							local is_attacking_leader = (e.components.combat ~= nil and e.components.combat.target == leader)
							local is_attacking_tq = (e.components.combat ~= nil and e.components.combat.target == i)
							if is_leader_target or is_attacking_leader or is_attacking_tq then
								if e.components.combat ~= nil or e:HasTag("_combat") or e:HasTag("_health") then
									e.components.health:DoDelta(-15, false, "tq_aura", nil, i)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					-- 吸引仇恨：仅限三类对象（玩家攻击目标 / 正在攻击玩家 / 正在攻击兔球球），仅在开启嘲讽时执行
					if i._tq_taunt_on then
						local taunt_radius = 8
						local mobs = TheSim:FindEntities(x, y, z, taunt_radius, nil, {"player", "companion", "wall", "INLIMBO", "tq_pet", "xjxb_pet"})
						for _, m in ipairs(mobs) do
							if m ~= nil and m ~= i and m.components ~= nil and m.components.health ~= nil and not m.components.health:IsDead() and m.components.combat ~= nil then
								local tgt = m.components.combat.target
								local is_players_target = (leader_target ~= nil and m == leader_target)
								local is_targeting_leader = (tgt == leader)
								local is_targeting_tq = (tgt == i)
								if is_players_target or is_targeting_leader or is_targeting_tq then
									m.components.combat:SuggestTarget(i)
									if m.components.combat.target ~= i then
										m.components.combat:SetTarget(i)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 下一帧先应用一次，避免打标签时序问题
	inst:DoTaskInTime(0, ApplyTqOverrides)
	-- 周期性刷新，保证存档加载或其他代码改 build 后仍然保持兔球球外观
	-- 优化：0.1s → 1.0s（玩家根本看不出 1s 一次的切换）
	inst:DoPeriodicTask(1.0, ApplyTqOverrides)

	-- 持久化：保存/读取 tq_pet 标记
	local _old_OnSave = inst.OnSave
	inst.OnSave = function(inst, data)
		if _old_OnSave ~= nil then
			_old_OnSave(inst, data)
		end
		if inst:HasTag("tq_pet") then
			data.tq_pet = true
		end
	end

	local _old_OnLoad = inst.OnLoad
	inst.OnLoad = function(inst, data)
		if _old_OnLoad ~= nil then
			_old_OnLoad(inst, data)
		end
		if data ~= nil and data.tq_pet then
			inst:AddTag("tq_pet")
			ApplyTqOverrides()
		end
	end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:critter_perdling
end)
AddPrefabPostInit("critter_perdling", function(inst)
    -- 客户端：确保副本容器挂载自定义 widget
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
        inst.OnEntityReplicated = function(inst_)
            if inst_.replica ~= nil and inst_.replica.container ~= nil then
                inst_.replica.container:WidgetSetup("xjxb_container")
            end
        end
    end

    -- 持久化实体本体
    inst.persists = true

    -- 服务器：容器预创建（保证读档能恢复物品），默认不可打开，只有打上 xjxb_pet 后再开启
    if TheWorld ~= nil and TheWorld.ismastersim then
        if inst.components.container == nil then
            inst:AddComponent("container")
            inst.components.container:WidgetSetup("xjxb_container")
            inst.components.container.canbeopened = false
            inst.components.container.skipopensnd = true
            inst.components.container.skipclosesnd = true
        end
        -- 应用可配置保鲜模式
        ApplyContainerPreserve(inst, (GetModConfigData("xjxb_preserve_mode") or "normal"))
    end

    local function ApplyXjxbOverrides()
        if not inst:HasTag("xjxb_pet") then
            return
        end

        -- 名称与检查文本
        inst.displaynamefn = function() return "星际小宝" end
        if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.inspectable ~= nil then
            inst.components.inspectable.description = "迷路的小外星人"
        end

        -- 外观/静音/发光
        if inst.AnimState ~= nil then
            inst.AnimState:SetBuild("xjxb")
        end
        MutePet(inst)
        -- 处于隐藏（INLIMBO）或被收回（_xjxb_recalled）状态时不要启用 Light，避免光圈残留
        if inst:HasTag("INLIMBO") or inst._xjxb_recalled then
            if inst.Light ~= nil then inst.Light:Enable(false) end
        else
            if inst.Light == nil then inst.entity:AddLight() end
            inst.Light:Enable(true)
            inst.Light:SetRadius(3)
            inst.Light:SetFalloff(.8)
            inst.Light:SetIntensity(.6)
            inst.Light:SetColour(150/255, 200/255, 255/255)
        end
        -- 不会饥饿/腐烂/睡觉
        if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.hunger ~= nil then
            local hunger = inst.components.hunger
            hunger:SetRate(0)
            hunger:SetPercent(1)
            if hunger.max ~= nil then hunger.current = hunger.max end
        end
        if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.perishable ~= nil then
            inst.components.perishable.StartPerishing = SPE_StopPerishingStart
            inst.components.perishable:StopPerishing()
            inst.components.perishable:SetPercent(1)
        end
        if inst.components ~= nil and inst.components.sleeper ~= nil then
            inst.components.sleeper:SetSleepTest(PetSleepTestAlwaysFalse)
        end

        -- 服务器：把 brain 替换为专用 brain（仅在脑被原版脑恢复时执行一次），
        -- 防止 critter_perdling 原版 brain 中饥饿驱动的"停止跟随"行为。
        if TheWorld ~= nil and TheWorld.ismastersim and inst._xjxb_brain_set ~= true then
            inst._xjxb_brain_set = true
            inst:SetBrain(require "brains/xjxbpetbrain")
        end

        -- 服务器：follower.leader 守护 —— 防止饥饿/脑切换/外部代码把 leader 解绑
        -- 优化：频率 0.5s → 2.0s（leader 不会频繁丢失，2s 足够）
        if TheWorld ~= nil and TheWorld.ismastersim and inst._xjxb_leader_guard ~= true then
            inst._xjxb_leader_guard = true
            inst:DoPeriodicTask(2.0, function(p)
                if p == nil or not p:IsValid() then return end
                if p.components == nil or p.components.follower == nil then return end
                local cur_leader = p.components.follower.leader
                -- leader 丢失或失效时，按宠物上记录的 _xjxb_owner 自动恢复
                if (cur_leader == nil or not cur_leader:IsValid()) and p._xjxb_owner ~= nil then
                    local owner = p._xjxb_owner
                    if owner:IsValid() and owner.components ~= nil
                        and owner.components.health ~= nil
                        and not owner.components.health:IsDead() then
                        p.components.follower:SetLeader(owner)
                        owner._xjxb_pet = p
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        -- 服务器：允许打开容器
        if TheWorld ~= nil and TheWorld.ismastersim and inst.components.container ~= nil then
            inst.components.container.canbeopened = true
        end
    end

    -- 首帧与周期性校正（频率从 0.1s 调整为 1.0s）
    inst:DoTaskInTime(0, ApplyXjxbOverrides)
    inst:DoPeriodicTask(1.0, ApplyXjxbOverrides)

    -- 存读档：保留 xjxb_pet 标记（容器内容由组件自动序列化）
    local _old_OnSave = inst.OnSave
    inst.OnSave = function(inst, data)
        if _old_OnSave ~= nil then _old_OnSave(inst, data) end
        if inst:HasTag("xjxb_pet") then data.xjxb_pet = true end
    end
    local _old_OnLoad = inst.OnLoad
    inst.OnLoad = function(inst, data)
        if _old_OnLoad ~= nil then _old_OnLoad(inst, data) end
        if data ~= nil and data.xjxb_pet then
            inst:AddTag("xjxb_pet")
            ApplyXjxbOverrides()
        end
    end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:esctemplate
-- 赋予角色读书能力（读威克伯顿的书，并解锁书籍标签下的合成）
AddPrefabPostInit("esctemplate", function(inst)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
    if inst.components.reader == nil then
        inst:AddComponent("reader")
    end
    -- 允许在“书籍”标签下制作书本
    if not inst:HasTag("bookbuilder") then
        inst:AddTag("bookbuilder")
    end

    inst:DoTaskInTime(0, function()
        if inst == nil or not inst:IsValid() then return end
        local talker = inst.components and inst.components.talker or nil
        if talker == nil or talker._xxtpack_filter_applied then
            return
        end
        talker._xxtpack_filter_applied = true
        local _Say = talker.Say
        talker.Say = function(self, message, ...)
            local target_str = STRINGS and STRINGS.CHARACTERS and STRINGS.CHARACTERS.ESCTEMPLATE and STRINGS.CHARACTERS.ESCTEMPLATE.ANNOUNCE_INV_FULL or nil
            if type(message) == "string" then
                if message == (target_str or "") or message == "背包已经装满了" or message == "你的背包已经装满了" then
                    local backpack = FindXxtpackBackpack(inst)
                    if backpack ~= nil and backpack:IsValid() then
                        local container = backpack.components and backpack.components.container or nil
                        if container ~= nil then
                            local num_slots = container:GetNumSlots()
                            for slot = 1, num_slots do
                                local existing = container:GetItemInSlot(slot)
                                if existing == nil then
                                    return
                                end
                                local estack = existing.components and existing.components.stackable or nil
                                if estack ~= nil and not estack:IsFull() then
                                    return
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return _Say(self, message, ...)
        end
    end)
end)
```

### 变体演进：琪露诺 (Mod 3670256635)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3670256635 (`琪露诺`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3670256635)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:farming_manager

AddComponentPostInit("farming_manager", function(self)
    local oldaddsoilmoisture = self.AddSoilMoistureAtPoint
    if oldaddsoilmoisture == nil or self._cirno_safe_soilmoisture then
        return
    end

    self.AddSoilMoistureAtPoint = function(manager, x, y, z, moisture_delta, ...)
        if not IsFiniteNumber(x) or not IsFiniteNumber(y) or not IsFiniteNumber(z)
            or not IsFiniteNumber(moisture_delta) then
            return
        end
        local ok, result = pcall(oldaddsoilmoisture, manager, x, y, z, moisture_delta, ...)
        return ok and result or nil
    end
    self._cirno_safe_soilmoisture = true
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:cursable
------------------------------------------------------------------
AddComponentPostInit("cursable", function(self)--免疫猴子诅咒
    local oldapplycurse = self.ApplyCurse
    function self:ApplyCurse(item, curse)
        if self.inst:HasTag("cirno") then
            return
        end
        oldapplycurse(self, item, curse)
    end

    local OldIsCursable = self.IsCursable
    function self:IsCursable(item)
        if self.inst:HasTag("cirno") then
            return nil
        end
        return OldIsCursable(self, item)
    end

    local oldforceontoowner = self.ForceOntoOwner
    function self:ForceOntoOwner(item)
        if self.inst:HasTag("cirno") then
            return
        end
        oldforceontoowner(self, item)
    end
end)
```

### 变体演进：MineStarve 當個挨餓神 (Mod 3791478754)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3791478754 (`MineStarve 當個挨餓神`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3791478754)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:inventory

    AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(inventory)
        local old_apply_damage = inventory.ApplyDamage
        local old_unequip = inventory.Unequip
        local old_remove_item = inventory.RemoveItem
        local old_drop_item = inventory.DropItem

        local function IsLockedSevenCursesRing(self, item)
            local component = GetSevenCursesComponent(self.inst)
            return component ~= nil and component:IsActive() and
                item ~= nil and item:IsValid() and
                item.prefab == "mc_ring_seven_curses" and
                not item._mc_bound_ring_removing and
                self:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.MC_RING1) == item
        end

        function inventory:Unequip(equipslot, slip, force)
            local item = self:GetEquippedItem(equipslot)
            if IsLockedSevenCursesRing(self, item) then
                return nil
            end
            return old_unequip(self, equipslot, slip, force)
        end

        function inventory:RemoveItem(
            item,
            wholestack,
            checkallcontainers,
            keepoverstacked
        )
            if IsLockedSevenCursesRing(self, item) then
                return nil
            end
            return old_remove_item(
                self,
                item,
                wholestack,
                checkallcontainers,
                keepoverstacked
            )
        end

        function inventory:DropItem(
            item,
            wholestack,
            randomdir,
            pos,
            keepoverstacked
        )
            if IsLockedSevenCursesRing(self, item) then
                return nil
            end
            return old_drop_item(
                self,
                item,
                wholestack,
                randomdir,
                pos,
                keepoverstacked
            )
        end

        function inventory:ApplyDamage(damage, attacker, weapon, spdamage)
            local component = GetSevenCursesComponent(self.inst)
            if component == nil or not component:IsActive() or
                ((tonumber(damage) or 0) <= 0 and spdamage == nil) then
                return old_apply_damage(self, damage, attacker, weapon, spdamage)
            end

            local max_absorption = 0
            local damage_type_mult = 1
            local fully_resisted = false
            for _, item in pairs(self.equipslots) do
                if item.components.resistance ~= nil and
                    item.components.resistance:HasResistance(attacker, weapon) and
                    item.components.resistance:ShouldResistDamage() then
                    fully_resisted = true
                elseif item.components.armor ~= nil then
                    max_absorption = math.max(
                        max_absorption,
                        item.components.armor:GetAbsorption(attacker, weapon)
                    )
                end
                if item.components.damagetyperesist ~= nil then
                    damage_type_mult = damage_type_mult *
                        item.components.damagetyperesist:GetResist(attacker, weapon)
                end
            end

            local leftover, remaining_spdamage = old_apply_damage(
                self,
                damage,
                attacker,
                weapon,
                spdamage
            )
            -- Grue/environmental hits enter combat with no attacker. Leave
            -- those at normal strength while still weakening worn armour.
            local suffering_multiplier = attacker ~= nil and
                SUFFERING_MULTIPLIER or 1
            if suffering_multiplier ~= 1 then
                remaining_spdamage = SpDamageUtil.ApplyMult(
                    remaining_spdamage,
                    suffering_multiplier
                )
            end
            if fully_resisted or max_absorption <= 0 then
                return leftover * suffering_multiplier, remaining_spdamage
            end

            max_absorption = math.clamp(max_absorption, 0, 1)
            local post_resistance_damage
            if max_absorption <
                SEVEN_CURSES_TUNING.FULL_ABSORPTION_THRESHOLD then
                post_resistance_damage = leftover / (1 - max_absorption)
            else
                post_resistance_damage = damage * damage_type_mult
            end
            local weakened_absorption = max_absorption * ARMOR_EFFECTIVENESS
            local weakened_leftover = post_resistance_damage *
                (1 - weakened_absorption)
            return math.max(leftover, weakened_leftover) *
                suffering_multiplier, remaining_spdamage
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(combat)
        local old_get_attacked = combat.GetAttacked
        function combat:GetAttacked(attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage)
            if not ShouldReduceOutgoingDamage(attacker, self.inst) or
                attacker._mc_seven_curses_scaling_damage then
                return old_get_attacked(
                    self,
                    attacker,
                    damage,
                    weapon,
                    stimuli,
                    spdamage
                )
            end

            local multiplier = self.inst:HasTag("epic") and
                SEVEN_CURSES_TUNING.OUTGOING_EPIC_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER or
                SEVEN_CURSES_TUNING.OUTGOING_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER
            local scaled_spdamage = spdamage ~= nil and shallowcopy(spdamage) or nil
            scaled_spdamage = SpDamageUtil.ApplyMult(scaled_spdamage, multiplier)
            attacker._mc_seven_curses_scaling_damage = true
            local results =
            {
                pcall(
                    old_get_attacked,
                    self,
                    attacker,
                    damage ~= nil and damage * multiplier or nil,
                    weapon,
                    stimuli,
                    scaled_spdamage
                ),
            }
            attacker._mc_seven_curses_scaling_damage = nil
            if not results[1] then
                error(results[2], 0)
            end
            return unpack(results, 2)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("follower", function(follower)
        local old_set_leader = follower.SetLeader
        function follower:SetLeader(new_leader)
            local player = ResolvePlayer(new_leader)
            if player ~= nil and IsActivePlayer(player) and
                self.leader ~= new_leader and
                not IsFollowerExempt(self.inst, new_leader) then
                return false
            end
            return old_set_leader(self, new_leader)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("leader", function(leader)
        local old_add_follower = leader.AddFollower
        function leader:AddFollower(follower)
            local player = ResolvePlayer(self.inst)
            if player ~= nil and IsActivePlayer(player) and
                not IsFollowerExempt(follower, self.inst) then
                return false
            end
            return old_add_follower(self, follower)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("trader", function(trader)
        local old_able_to_accept = trader.AbleToAccept
        function trader:AbleToAccept(item, giver, count)
            if IsActivePlayer(giver) and IsRecruitableCreature(self.inst) and
                not IsInnateCompanion(self.inst) then
                return false
            end
            return old_able_to_accept(self, item, giver, count)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("domesticatable", function(domesticatable)
        local old_delta_domestication = domesticatable.DeltaDomestication
        function domesticatable:DeltaDomestication(delta, doer)
            if (tonumber(delta) or 0) > 0 and IsActivePlayer(doer) then
                return
            end
            return old_delta_domestication(self, delta, doer)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("brushable", function(brushable)
        local old_brush = brushable.Brush
        function brushable:Brush(doer, brush)
            if IsActivePlayer(doer) and
                self.inst.components.domesticatable ~= nil then
                return false
            end
            return old_brush(self, doer, brush)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("rideable", function(rideable)
        local old_test_rider = rideable.TestRider
        function rideable:TestRider(potential_rider)
            if IsActivePlayer(potential_rider) and
                not IsInnateCompanion(self.inst) then
                return false
            end
            return old_test_rider(self, potential_rider)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("sleepingbag", function(sleepingbag)
        local old_do_sleep = sleepingbag.DoSleep
        function sleepingbag:DoSleep(doer, ...)
            if IsActivePlayer(doer) then
                return false
            end
            return old_do_sleep(self, doer, ...)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("sleepingbaguser", function(sleepingbaguser)
        local old_should_sleep = sleepingbaguser.ShouldSleep
        function sleepingbaguser:ShouldSleep(...)
            if IsActivePlayer(self.inst) then
                return false
            end
            return old_should_sleep(self, ...)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("grogginess", function(grogginess)
        local old_knock_out = grogginess.KnockOut
        function grogginess:KnockOut(...)
            -- 保留困倦本身的效果，只阻止昏睡及其组件状态写入。
            if IsActivePlayer(self.inst) then
                return
            end
            return old_knock_out(self, ...)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("sleeper", function(sleeper)
        local old_go_to_sleep = sleeper.GoToSleep
        function sleeper:GoToSleep(...)
            if IsActivePlayer(self.inst) then
                return
            end
            return old_go_to_sleep(self, ...)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("wateryprotection", function(wateryprotection)
        local old_apply = wateryprotection.ApplyProtectionToEntity
        local old_spread = wateryprotection.SpreadProtectionAtPoint

        function wateryprotection:ApplyProtectionToEntity(entity, noextinguish)
            local component = GetSevenCursesComponent(entity)
            if not noextinguish and component ~= nil and component:IsActive() and
                ALLOWED_EXTINGUISHERS[self.inst.prefab] then
                return component:AllowExternalExtinguish(function()
                    return old_apply(self, entity, noextinguish)
                end)
            end
            return old_apply(self, entity, noextinguish)
        end

        function wateryprotection:SpreadProtectionAtPoint(
            x,
            y,
            z,
            distance,
            noextinguish
        )
            local results =
            {
                old_spread(self, x, y, z, distance, noextinguish),
            }
            if not noextinguish and
                PLAYER_IGNORING_EXTINGUISHERS[self.inst.prefab] then
                local radius = distance or self.protection_dist or
                    SEVEN_CURSES_TUNING.DEFAULT_WATER_PROTECTION_RADIUS
                local players = TheSim:FindEntities(
                    x,
                    y,
                    z,
                    radius,
                    { "player", ACTIVE_TAG },
                    { "playerghost", "INLIMBO" }
                )
                for _, player in ipairs(players) do
                    local component = GetSevenCursesComponent(player)
                    if component ~= nil and component:IsActive() then
                        component:AllowExternalExtinguish(function()
                            old_apply(self, player, false)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            return unpack(results)
        end
    end)

    AddComponentPostInit("lootdropper", function(lootdropper)
        local old_generate_loot = lootdropper.GenerateLoot
        function lootdropper:GenerateLoot(...)
            local loot = old_generate_loot(self, ...)
            local victim_health = self.inst.components.health
            local lucky_user = self:GetLuckyUser()
            local looting_level = GetCombinedLootingLevel(lucky_user)
            if looting_level > 0 and
                victim_health ~= nil and victim_health:IsDead() and
                not self.inst:HasAnyTag("structure", "wall") and
                not IsInnateCompanion(self.inst) and
                math.random() < SEVEN_CURSES_TUNING.LOOTING_CHANCE_PER_LEVEL *
                    math.min(
                        SEVEN_CURSES_TUNING.MAX_COMBINED_LOOTING_LEVEL,
                        looting_level
                    ) then
                local extra = ChooseRegularLoot(self)
                if extra ~= nil then
                    table.insert(loot, extra)
                end
            end
            return loot
        end
    end)

    AddPlayerPostInit(function(player)
        -- 七咒组件负责发布；物品栏与 Insight 只读取对应状态，不占用角色标签。
        player._mc_hidden_curse_active = net_bool(player.GUID, "mc_seven_curses.hidden_active")
        player._mc_ender_chest_open = net_bool(player.GUID, "mc_seven_curses.ender_open")
        if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
            return
        end

        if player.components.mc_seven_curses == nil then
            player:AddComponent("mc_seven_curses")
        end
        ConfigurePlayer(player)

        -- The authoritative join event runs after persisted player data has
        -- been restored on both hosted and dedicated servers. Resolve the
        -- world setting again so an existing world changed from disabled to
        -- enabled grants and equips the ring.
        if not player._mc_seven_curses_join_hooked then
            player._mc_seven_curses_join_hooked = true
            player:ListenForEvent("ms_playerjoined", function(_, joined_player)
                if joined_player == player then
                    ConfigurePlayer(player)
                end
            end, TheWorld)
        end

        if not player._mc_seven_curses_reroll_hooked then
            player._mc_seven_curses_reroll_hooked = true
            local old_save_for_reroll = player.SaveForReroll
            local old_load_for_reroll = player.LoadForReroll

            function player:SaveForReroll(...)
                local data = old_save_for_reroll(self, ...) or {}
                data.mc_seven_curses =
                    self.components.mc_seven_curses:GetRerollData()
                return next(data) ~= nil and data or nil
            end

            function player:LoadForReroll(data, ...)
                local results =
                {
                    old_load_for_reroll(self, data, ...),
                }
                if data ~= nil and data.mc_seven_curses ~= nil then
                    self.components.mc_seven_curses:LoadForReroll(
                        data.mc_seven_curses
                    )
                end
                return unpack(results)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat

    AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(combat)
        local old_get_attacked = combat.GetAttacked
        function combat:GetAttacked(attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage)
            if not ShouldReduceOutgoingDamage(attacker, self.inst) or
                attacker._mc_seven_curses_scaling_damage then
                return old_get_attacked(
                    self,
                    attacker,
                    damage,
                    weapon,
                    stimuli,
                    spdamage
                )
            end

            local multiplier = self.inst:HasTag("epic") and
                SEVEN_CURSES_TUNING.OUTGOING_EPIC_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER or
                SEVEN_CURSES_TUNING.OUTGOING_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER
            local scaled_spdamage = spdamage ~= nil and shallowcopy(spdamage) or nil
            scaled_spdamage = SpDamageUtil.ApplyMult(scaled_spdamage, multiplier)
            attacker._mc_seven_curses_scaling_damage = true
            local results =
            {
                pcall(
                    old_get_attacked,
                    self,
                    attacker,
                    damage ~= nil and damage * multiplier or nil,
                    weapon,
                    stimuli,
                    scaled_spdamage
                ),
            }
            attacker._mc_seven_curses_scaling_damage = nil
            if not results[1] then
                error(results[2], 0)
            end
            return unpack(results, 2)
        end
    end)

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:follower

    AddComponentPostInit("follower", function(follower)
        local old_set_leader = follower.SetLeader
        function follower:SetLeader(new_leader)
            local player = ResolvePlayer(new_leader)
            if player ~= nil and IsActivePlayer(player) and
                self.leader ~= new_leader and
                not IsFollowerExempt(self.inst, new_leader) then
                return false
            end
            return old_set_leader(self, new_leader)
        end
    end)

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:leader

    AddComponentPostInit("leader", function(leader)

        function leader:AddFollower(follower)
            local player = ResolvePlayer(self.inst)
            if player ~= nil and IsActivePlayer(player) and
                not IsFollowerExempt(follower, self.inst) then
                return false
            end
            return old_add_follower(self, follower)
        end
    end)
```

```lua
-- ============================================================================

local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
    local old_attack = sg.states["attack"]
    local old_onenter = old_attack.onenter
    old_attack.onenter = function(inst)
        if inst:HasTag("foolish") then
            local action = inst:GetBufferedAction()
            local target = action and action.target or nil
            
            if target and target.components.combat then
                if target.components.combat:HasTarget() or target:HasTag("hostile") or target:HasTag("hive") or target:HasTag("wall") or target:HasTag("tentacle_pillar") then
                    old_onenter(inst)
                else
                    inst:ClearBufferedAction()
                    inst.sg:GoToState("idle", true)
                    inst.components.talker:Say("I cannot harm the innocent.")
                end
            end
        else -- forgot about this else...
            old_onenter(inst)
        end
    end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat
local Damage_Mult = -0.25
AddComponentPostInit("combat",function(inst)
    if not GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim then
        return
    end
    local oldbonusdamagefn = inst.bonusdamagefn
    inst.bonusdamagefn = function(attacker, target, damage, weapon)
        local bonus = 0
        if oldbonusdamagefn then
            bonus = oldbonusdamagefn(attacker, target, damage, weapon) or 0
        end
        if target.prefab == Character and (attacker:HasTag("shadowcreature")) then
            bonus = bonus - (damage + bonus) * Damage_Mult
        end
        return bonus
    end
end)
```

### 变体演进：[DST]绯/Hinora (Mod 3697073747)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3697073747 (`[DST]绯/Hinora`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3697073747)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson
------------------ 主机 ---------------------------
AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
    for name, value in pairs(AttackSGList) do
        if sg.states[name] ~= nil then
            local old_attack_onenter = sg.states[name].onenter
            sg.states[name].onenter = function(inst)
                if old_attack_onenter ~= nil then
                    old_attack_onenter(inst)
                end
                if Check_Hinora(inst) then
                    if not (inst.components.rider ~= nil and inst.components.rider:IsRiding()) then
                        inst.sg.hinora_attackspeed = value
                        local weapon = inst.components.inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS)
                        if Check_Entity(weapon) and weapon:HasOneOfTags({"whip", "pocketwatch"}) then
                            inst.sg.hinora_attackspeed = Hinora_WhipAttackSpeedMult
                        end
                        inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(inst.sg.hinora_attackspeed)
                        local hinora_timeline = inst.sg.currentstate ~= nil and inst.sg.currentstate.timeline
                        if hinora_timeline ~= nil then
                            for _, v in pairs(hinora_timeline) do
                                v.hinora_time = v.time
                                v.time = v.time / inst.sg.hinora_attackspeed
                            end
                        end
                        if inst.sg.timeout ~= nil then
                            inst.sg:SetTimeout(inst.sg.timeout / inst.sg.hinora_attackspeed)
                        end
                    end
                    inst.sg.hinora_attackspeed = nil
                end
            end

            local old_attack_onexit = sg.states[name].onexit
            sg.states[name].onexit = function(inst)
                if old_attack_onexit ~= nil then
                    old_attack_onexit(inst)
                end
                if Check_Hinora(inst) then
                    inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(1)
                    local hinora_timeline = inst.sg.currentstate and inst.sg.currentstate.timeline
                    if hinora_timeline ~= nil then
                        for _, v in pairs(hinora_timeline) do
                            v.time = v.hinora_time or v.time
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:builder

AddComponentPostInit("builder", function(builder)
    local old_HasIngredients = builder.HasIngredients
    builder.HasIngredients = function(self, recipe, ...)
        if type(recipe) == "string" then 
            recipe = GetValidRecipe(recipe)
        end
        self.hinora_old_hasrecipe = deepcopy(recipe)
        if Check_ShadowHalveBuild(self.inst) and self.hinora_old_hasrecipe ~= nil
        and ShouldHalveList[self.hinora_old_hasrecipe.name] and not NoHalveList[self.hinora_old_hasrecipe.name] then
            for i, v in ipairs(self.hinora_old_hasrecipe.ingredients) do
                v.amount = math.max(1, RoundBiasedUp(v.amount * TUNING.HINORA_HALVEBUILD_MULT))
            end
            for i, v in ipairs(self.hinora_old_hasrecipe.character_ingredients) do
                v.amount = math.max(1, RoundBiasedUp(v.amount * TUNING.HINORA_HALVEBUILD_MULT))
            end
        end
        return old_HasIngredients(self, self.hinora_old_hasrecipe, ...)
    end

    local old_GetIngredients = builder.GetIngredients
    builder.GetIngredients = function(self, recname, ...)
        local recipe = AllRecipes[recname]
        self.hinora_old_getrecipe = deepcopy(recipe)
        if Check_ShadowHalveBuild(self.inst) and recipe ~= nil
        and ShouldHalveList[recipe.name] and not NoHalveList[recipe.name] then
            for i, v in ipairs(recipe.ingredients) do
                v.amount = math.max(1, RoundBiasedUp(v.amount * TUNING.HINORA_HALVEBUILD_MULT))
            end
            for i, v in ipairs(recipe.character_ingredients) do
                v.amount = math.max(1, RoundBiasedUp(v.amount * TUNING.HINORA_HALVEBUILD_MULT))
            end
        end
        local ingredients, discounted = old_GetIngredients(self, recname, ...)
        AllRecipes[recname] = self.hinora_old_getrecipe
        return ingredients, discounted
    end

    local old_RemoveIngredients = builder.RemoveIngredients
    builder.RemoveIngredients = function(self, ingredients, recname, discounted, ...)
        if self.freebuildmode then
            return
        end
        local recipe = AllRecipes[recname]
        self.hinora_old_removerecipe = deepcopy(recipe)
        if Check_ShadowHalveBuild(self.inst) and recipe ~= nil
        and ShouldHalveList[recipe.name] and not NoHalveList[recipe.name] then
            for i, v in ipairs(recipe.ingredients) do
                v.amount = math.max(1, RoundBiasedUp(v.amount * TUNING.HINORA_HALVEBUILD_MULT))
            end
            for i, v in ipairs(recipe.character_ingredients) do
                v.amount = math.max(1, RoundBiasedUp(v.amount * TUNING.HINORA_HALVEBUILD_MULT))
            end
        end
        old_RemoveIngredients(self, ingredients, recname, discounted, ...)
        AllRecipes[recname] = self.hinora_old_removerecipe
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:inventory_classified

AddPrefabPostInit("inventory_classified", function(inst)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
        local old_RemoveIngredients = inst.RemoveIngredients
        inst.RemoveIngredients = function(inst, recipe, ingredientmod, ...)
            local hinora_old_getremoverecipe = deepcopy(recipe)
            if Check_ShadowHalveBuild(inst._parent) and hinora_old_getremoverecipe ~= nil
            and ShouldHalveList[hinora_old_getremoverecipe.name] and not NoHalveList[hinora_old_getremoverecipe.name] then
                for i, v in ipairs(hinora_old_getremoverecipe.ingredients) do
                    v.amount = math.max(1, RoundBiasedUp(v.amount * TUNING.HINORA_HALVEBUILD_MULT))
                end
            end
            return old_RemoveIngredients(inst, hinora_old_getremoverecipe, ingredientmod, ...)
        end
        return inst
    end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:tophat
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
AddPrefabPostInit("tophat", function(inst)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
        return
    end
    local old_onPreBuilt = inst.onPreBuilt
    inst.onPreBuilt = function(inst, builder, materials, recipe, ...)
        if old_onPreBuilt ~= nil then

        end
        if recipe ~= nil and recipe.name == "hinora_tophat_magician" and inst.ConvertToMagician ~= nil then
```

### 变体演进：Arzu & Nawfal图奈同人模组 (Mod 3812078283)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3812078283 (`Arzu & Nawfal图奈同人模组`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3812078283)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson
local G = GLOBAL
AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
    local state = sg.states.attack
    if state == nil then return end
    local onenter, onexit = state.onenter, state.onexit
    state.onenter = function(inst, ...)
        onenter(inst, ...)
        local mult = inst._blp_attack_speed
        if mult and mult > 1 and inst.sg.timeout then
            inst.sg:SetTimeout(math.min(inst.sg.timeout, math.max(inst.sg.timeout / mult, 11 * G.FRAMES)))
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(mult)
            inst.sg.statemem.blp_fast = true
        end
    end
    state.onexit = function(inst, ...)
        if inst.sg.statemem.blp_fast then inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(1) end
        if onexit then return onexit(inst, ...) end
    end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:sgarzu
end
AddPrefabPostInit("sgarzu", function(inst)
    if not G.TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
	--给阿尔图加reader组件
	if inst.components.reader == nil then inst:AddComponent("reader") end
    inst.components.reader:SetSanityPenaltyMultiplier(C.arzu_read_sanity)
	
    inst.components.combat.damagemultiplier = C.arzu_damage
    inst.components.combat.externaldamagetakenmultipliers:SetModifier(inst, C.arzu_taken, "blp_innate")
    inst:AddComponent("planardefense")
    inst.components.planardefense:SetBaseDefense(C.arzu_planar)
    inst.components.combat.customdamagemultfn = function(attacker, target)
        local partner = R.Partner(attacker)
        local mult = ArmorBonus(attacker, partner)
        if partner and target and target:HasTag("epic") then mult = mult * C.partner_boss_bonus end
        return mult
    end
    ChainStats(inst, function(eater, health, hunger, sanity, food, feeder)
        if feeder and feeder ~= eater and feeder.prefab == "sgnawfal" then
            return Positive(health, C.nawfal_arzu_heal), Positive(hunger, C.nawfal_arzu_heal), Positive(sanity, C.nawfal_arzu_heal)
        end
        return health, hunger, sanity
    end)
    inst:DoPeriodicTask(1, PartnerTick, 1)
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:sgnawfal
end
AddPrefabPostInit("sgnawfal", function(inst)
    if not G.TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
    if inst.components.reader == nil then inst:AddComponent("reader") end
    inst.components.reader:SetSanityPenaltyMultiplier(C.nawfal_read_sanity)
    if inst.components.preserver == nil then inst:AddComponent("preserver") end
    inst.components.preserver:SetPerishRateMultiplier(function(owner, item)
        return item and (item.components.edible or item.components.healer) and C.nawfal_preserve or 1
    end)
    inst.components.combat.customdamagemultfn = function(attacker, target)
        if R.Partner(attacker) and target and target.components.combat and not target:HasTag("epic") and not target:HasTag("player") then
            return C.partner_monster_bonus
        end
        return 1
    end
    ChainStats(inst, function(eater, health, hunger, sanity, food, feeder)
        if feeder == nil or feeder == eater then
            return Positive(health, C.nawfal_self_heal), Positive(hunger, C.nawfal_self_heal), Positive(sanity, C.nawfal_self_heal)
        end
        return health, hunger, sanity
    end)
    local combat = inst.components.combat
    local attacked = combat.GetAttacked
    inst._blp_grudges = {}
    combat.GetAttacked = function(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...)
        local mult = 1
        local key = attacker and attacker.prefab
        local now = G.GetTime()
        if key and attacker ~= inst then
            local grudge = inst._blp_grudges[key]
            if grudge and now < grudge.active then
                mult = mult * C.grudge_mult
            elseif grudge == nil or now >= grudge.ready then
                inst._blp_grudges[key] = { active = now + C.grudge_active, ready = now + C.grudge_cooldown }
            end
        end
        if inst.components.health:GetPercent() < C.low_threshold then mult = mult * C.low_health_taken end
        if mult ~= 1 then
            damage = damage and damage * mult
            if spdamage then
                local scaled = {}
                for k, v in pairs(spdamage) do scaled[k] = v * mult end
                spdamage = scaled
            end
        end
        return attacked(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...)
    end
    local sanity = inst.components.sanity
    local recalc = sanity.Recalc
    sanity.Recalc = function(self, ...)
        self._blp_recalc = true
        local result = { recalc(self, ...) }
        self._blp_recalc = nil
        return G.unpack(result)
    end
    local delta = sanity.DoDelta
    sanity.DoDelta = function(self, amount, overtime, ...)
        if self._blp_recalc and amount and amount < 0 and self:GetPercent() < C.low_threshold then amount = amount * C.low_sanity_rate end
        return delta(self, amount, overtime, ...)
    end
    inst:DoPeriodicTask(1, NawfalTick, 1)
end)
AddComponentPostInit("healer", function(self)
    local heal = self.Heal
    self.Heal = function(healer, target, doer, ...)
        local mult = 1
        if doer and doer.prefab == "sgnawfal" then
            mult = target == doer and C.nawfal_self_heal or target and target.prefab == "sgarzu" and C.nawfal_arzu_heal or 1
        end
        if mult == 1 then return heal(healer, target, doer, ...) end
        local original = healer.health
        healer.health = original * mult
        local result = { heal(healer, target, doer, ...) }
        if healer.inst:IsValid() then healer.health = original end
        return G.unpack(result)
    end
end)
AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
    local state = sg.states.dolongaction
    if state == nil then return end
    local enter = state.onenter
    state.onenter = function(inst, timeout, ...)

        return enter(inst, timeout, ...)
    end
end)
local function Nurture(plant)
    if plant._blp_nurtured then return end
    plant._blp_nurtured = true
    local growable = plant.components.growable
    if growable and growable.targettime then
        growable:StartGrowingTask((growable.targettime - G.GetTime()) / C.nawfal_crop_speed)
    end
end
AddComponentPostInit("growable", function(self)
    local start = self.StartGrowing
    self.StartGrowing = function(growable, ...)
        local result = { start(growable, ...) }
        if growable.inst._blp_nurtured and growable.targettime then
            growable:StartGrowingTask((growable.targettime - G.GetTime()) / C.nawfal_crop_speed)
        end
        return G.unpack(result)
    end
    local save = self.OnSave
    self.OnSave = function(growable, ...)
        local data, refs = save(growable, ...)
        if growable.inst._blp_nurtured then
            data = data or {}
            data.blp_nurtured = true
        end
        return data, refs
    end
    local load = self.OnLoad
    self.OnLoad = function(growable, data, ...)
        if data and data.blp_nurtured then growable.inst._blp_nurtured = true end
        return load(growable, data, ...)
    end
end)
AddComponentPostInit("farmplanttendable", function(self)
    local tend = self.TendTo
    self.TendTo = function(tendable, doer, ...)
        local result = tend(tendable, doer, ...)
        if result and doer and doer.prefab == "sgnawfal" then Nurture(tendable.inst) end
        return result
    end
end)

    inst:ListenForEvent("on_planted", function(plant, data)

AddPlayerPostInit(function(inst)
```

```lua
AddComponentPostInit("ambientlighting", function(self, inst)
    local _realcolour = UpvalueHacker.GetUpvalue(self.LongUpdate, "_realcolour")

    function self:GetRealColour()
        return _realcolour.currentcolour.x, _realcolour.currentcolour.y, _realcolour.currentcolour.z
    end

    local _overridecolour = UpvalueHacker.GetUpvalue(self.OnUpdate, "DoUpdateFlash", "_overridecolour")
    local ComputeTargetColour = UpvalueHacker.GetUpvalue(self.OnUpdate, "DoUpdateFlash", "ComputeTargetColour")

    local function ComputeTargetColour_New(targetsettings, timeoverride, ...)
        if targetsettings == _overridecolour and ThePlayer and ThePlayer:HasTag("inside_interior") then
            if _overridecolour.currentcolourset.PHASE_COLOURS and _overridecolour.currentcolourset.PHASE_COLOURS.spring then
                local temp = _overridecolour.currentcolourset
                _overridecolour.currentcolourset = HC_NO_LIGHT_INTERIOR_COLOURS
                ComputeTargetColour(targetsettings, timeoverride, ...)
                _overridecolour.currentcolourset = temp
                return
            else
                local temp = _overridecolour.currentcolourset
                _overridecolour.currentcolourset = HC_INTERIOR_NIGHTVISION_COLOURS
                ComputeTargetColour(targetsettings, timeoverride, ...)
                _overridecolour.currentcolourset = temp
                return
            end
        end
        ComputeTargetColour(targetsettings, timeoverride, ...)
    end

    UpvalueHacker.SetUpvalue(self.OnUpdate, ComputeTargetColour_New, "DoUpdateFlash", "ComputeTargetColour")

    function self:HC_Refresh()
        ComputeTargetColour_New(_overridecolour, 0.1)
    end
end)

-- Disabling Wave Sound
AddComponentPostInit("ambientsound", function(self, inst)
    if TheNet:IsDedicated() then
        return
    end

    inst:DoTaskInTime(0.1, function()
        if not self.OnUpdate then
            return
        end
        
        local OriginalOnUpdate_Old = self.OnUpdate
        local waves_enabled = not inst:HasTag("cave")
        local was_in_interior = false
        
        function self:OnUpdate(dt)
            local is_in_interior = ThePlayer ~= nil and ThePlayer:GetIsInInterior()
            if is_in_interior ~= was_in_interior then
                was_in_interior = is_in_interior
                self:SetWavesEnabled(waves_enabled and not is_in_interior)
            end

            OriginalOnUpdate_Old(self, dt)
        end
    end)
end)
```

```lua
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:container
-- ========== 容器等级持久化（服务端） ==========
AddComponentPostInit("container", function(self)
    if not self.inst then return end
    if self.inst.prefab ~= "abigail_human" and not self.inst:HasTag("abi") then
        return
    end

    -- ===== OnSave: 记录超堆叠物品的真实数量 =====
    local old_OnSave = self.OnSave
    self.OnSave = function(self)
        local data, references = old_OnSave(self)
        if not data then data = {} end

        if data.items and self.slots then
            for k, v in pairs(data.items) do
                if v then
                    local item = self.slots[k]
                    if item and item:IsValid() and item.components.stackable then
                        local stacksize = item.components.stackable:StackSize()
                        local maxsize = item.components.stackable.originalmaxsize
                            or item.components.stackable.maxsize
                            or 1
                        if stacksize > maxsize then
                            v.overstacked_size = stacksize
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if self.inst._backpack_level and self.inst._backpack_level > 0 then
            data._backpack_level = self.inst._backpack_level
        end
        return data, references
    end

    -- ===== OnLoad: 先走原版加载，再恢复超堆叠数量 =====
    local old_OnLoad = self.OnLoad
    self.OnLoad = function(self, data, newents)
        if data and data._backpack_level
            and data._backpack_level > (self.inst._backpack_level or 0)
            and self.inst.ApplyBackpackLevel then
            self.inst:ApplyBackpackLevel(data._backpack_level)
        end

        -- 加载期间禁止超堆叠物品被丢出去
        local old_ignore = self.ignoreoverstacked
        self.ignoreoverstacked = true

        if old_OnLoad then
            old_OnLoad(self, data, newents)
        end

        -- 恢复真实堆叠数量
        if data and data.items then
            for k, v in pairs(data.items) do
                if v and v.overstacked_size then
                    local item = self:GetItemInSlot(k)
                    if item and item.components.stackable then
                        item.components.stackable:SetIgnoreMaxSize(true)
                        item.components.stackable:SetStackSize(v.overstacked_size)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        self.ignoreoverstacked = old_ignore
    end

    -- ===== 移除物品时禁止丢出超堆叠 =====
    local old_RemoveItem_Internal = self.RemoveItem_Internal
    self.RemoveItem_Internal = function(self, item, slot, wholestack, keepoverstacked)
        local old_ignore = self.ignoreoverstacked
        self.ignoreoverstacked = true
        local result = old_RemoveItem_Internal(self, item, slot, wholestack, keepoverstacked)
        self.ignoreoverstacked = old_ignore
        return result
    end
end)
```
