### 变体演进：让韦伯再次伟大 (Make Webber Great Again) (Mod 3740753241)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3740753241 (`让韦伯再次伟大 (Make Webber Great Again)`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3740753241)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddBrainPostInit:spiderqueenbrain
    -- 蜘蛛女王驯服专属行为树 (提前注册，以便后续被驻守节点覆盖优先级)
    AddBrainPostInit("spiderqueenbrain", function(brain)
        local GetLeader = function()
            return brain.inst.components.follower and brain.inst.components.follower.leader
        end
        
        local CanSpawnChild = function()
            local inst = brain.inst
            local leader = GetLeader()
            local is_auto_spawn = leader and leader._spider_queen_spawn_mode or false
            return is_auto_spawn
                and not inst.sg:HasStateTag("busy")
                and inst.components.incrementalproducer 
                and inst.components.incrementalproducer:CanProduce()
        end

        local tamed_behavior = GLOBAL.WhileNode(function() return GetLeader() ~= nil end, "Is Tamed",
            GLOBAL.PriorityNode({
                GLOBAL.IfNode(CanSpawnChild, "spawn in combat",
                    GLOBAL.ActionNode(function() brain.inst.sg:GoToState("poop_pre") return GLOBAL.SUCCESS end, "make child")
                ),
                GLOBAL.ChaseAndAttack(brain.inst, 15),
                GLOBAL.Follow(brain.inst, GetLeader, 4, 7, 12),
                GLOBAL.FaceEntity(brain.inst, GetLeader, GetLeader)
            }, 0.25)
        )

        if brain.bt and brain.bt.root and brain.bt.root.children then
            table.insert(brain.bt.root.children, 1, tamed_behavior)
        end
    end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:wilson
AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(sg)
    local baton_command = GLOBAL.State{
        name = "webber_baton_command",
        tags = { "canrotate", "notalking" },

        onenter = function(inst)
            -- ControllerAttackButton 在服务端生成的是原版 ATTACK 缓冲动作；
            -- 进入这个表现状态时立即结算一次，由 actions.lua 转成蜘蛛指挥。
            if inst.components and inst.components.inventory then
                inst:PerformBufferedAction()
            end
            inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("atk_pre")
            inst.AnimState:PushAnimation("atk", false)
        end,

        events = {
            GLOBAL.EventHandler("locomote", function(inst, data)
                local should_move = inst.components.locomotor:WantsToMoveForward()
                if should_move then
                    if data and data.dir then
                        inst.components.locomotor:SetMoveDir(data.dir)
                    end
                    inst.sg:GoToState("run_start")
                else
                    inst.sg:GoToState("idle")
                end
            end),
            GLOBAL.EventHandler("animqueueover", function(inst)
                if inst.AnimState:AnimDone() then
                    inst.sg:GoToState("idle")
                end
            end),
            GLOBAL.EventHandler("equip", function(inst) inst.sg:GoToState("idle") end),
            GLOBAL.EventHandler("unequip", function(inst) inst.sg:GoToState("idle") end),
        },
    }
    sg.states["webber_baton_command"] = baton_command

    if sg.actionhandlers[GLOBAL.ACTIONS.ATTACK] then
        local old_attack = sg.actionhandlers[GLOBAL.ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate
        sg.actionhandlers[GLOBAL.ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate = function(inst, action)
            local inventory = inst.components and inst.components.inventory
                or (inst.replica and inst.replica.inventory)
            local equip = inventory and inventory:GetEquippedItem(GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS)
            if GetModConfigData("cfg_spider_commander") and equip and equip:HasTag("spider_baton") then
                return "webber_baton_command"
            end
            return type(old_attack) == "function" and old_attack(inst, action) or old_attack
        end
    end

    -- 创建一个蜘蛛女王专用的攻击状态
    local spiderqueen_attack = GLOBAL.State{
        name = "attack_spiderqueen",
        tags = { "attack", "notalking", "abouttoattack", "autopredict", "nointerrupt", "busy" },

        onenter = function(inst)
            if inst.components.combat:InCooldown() then
                inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("abouttoattack")
                inst:ClearBufferedAction()
                inst.sg:GoToState("idle", true)
                return
            end

            -- 动态加速攻击动画，利用网络变量客户端也能正确读取
            local multiplier = 1.0
            if inst.replica.rider and inst.replica.rider:IsRiding() then
                local mount = inst.replica.rider:GetMount()
                if mount and mount.prefab == "spiderqueen" then
                    local tu = mount._sq_net_upgrades ~= nil and mount._sq_net_upgrades:value() or 0
                    multiplier = 1.0 + (tu * 0.01)
                end
            end
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(multiplier)

            -- 核心：通知客户端记录起手时间，阻止左键无限鬼畜重置动作
            if inst.components.combat.StartAttack then
                inst.components.combat:StartAttack()
            elseif inst.replica.combat then
                inst.replica.combat:StartAttack()
            end

            -- 播放攻击动作
            inst.AnimState:PlayAnimation("atk_pre")
            inst.AnimState:PushAnimation("atk", false)

            -- 播放女王咬人的巨兽音效
            inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/creatures/spiderqueen/attack")
            -- 补上女王的嘶吼声
            inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/creatures/spiderqueen/attack_grunt")
            inst.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/creatures/spiderqueen/swipe")

            -- 设置状态机超时时间（控制了你可以多快进行下一次攻击）
            -- 我们强制锁死在大概 1 秒多（35帧），展现巨兽的重量感
            inst.sg:SetTimeout(35 * GLOBAL.FRAMES)
        end,

        timeline =
        {
            -- 核心：在第 20 帧时强制结算伤害！完美对齐你的动画！
            GLOBAL.TimeEvent(20 * GLOBAL.FRAMES, function(inst)
                inst:PerformBufferedAction()
                inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("abouttoattack")
            end),
        },

        onexit = function(inst)
            inst.AnimState:SetDeltaTimeMultiplier(1.0)
        end,

        ontimeout = function(inst)
            inst.sg:RemoveStateTag("attack")
            inst.sg:AddStateTag("idle")
        end,

        events =
        {
            GLOBAL.EventHandler("equip", function(inst) inst.sg:GoToState("idle") end),
            GLOBAL.EventHandler("unequip", function(inst) inst.sg:GoToState("idle") end),
            GLOBAL.EventHandler("animqueueover", function(inst)
                if inst.AnimState:AnimDone() then
                    inst.sg:GoToState("idle")
                end
            end),
        },
    }
    
    -- 把我们写的状态塞进主角的脑子里
    sg.states["attack_spiderqueen"] = spiderqueen_attack
    
    -- 劫持主角的攻击判定逻辑
    if sg.actionhandlers[GLOBAL.ACTIONS.ATTACK] then
        local old_attack = sg.actionhandlers[GLOBAL.ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate
        sg.actionhandlers[GLOBAL.ACTIONS.ATTACK].deststate = function(inst, action)
            -- 检查是不是骑着蜘蛛女王
            if not inst.sg:HasStateTag("abouttoattack") then
                if inst.replica.rider ~= nil and inst.replica.rider:IsRiding() then
                    local mount = inst.replica.rider:GetMount()
                    if mount and mount.prefab == "spiderqueen" then
                        -- 检查是否在冷却中，如果在冷却，千万不要切状态，否则会导致抽搐！
                        local in_cooldown = false
                        if inst.components.combat then
                            in_cooldown = inst.components.combat:InCooldown()
                        elseif inst.replica.combat then
                            in_cooldown = inst.replica.combat:InCooldown()
                        end
                        
                        if not in_cooldown then
                            return "attack_spiderqueen"
                        else
                            -- 还在冷却，直接吞掉这个动作，防止动作被重置
                            return nil
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            -- 如果不是，就原封不动交还给官方逻辑处理
            return type(old_attack) == "function" and old_attack(inst, action) or old_attack
        end
    end
end)

if GetModConfigData("cfg_den_bedazzlement") then
    AddComponentPostInit("bedazzlement", function(self)
        local old_Stop = self.Stop
        self.Stop = function(self)
            -- 如果蜘蛛巢正在被刮胡刀降级，或者是被摧毁，则允许正常卸下装饰
            if self.inst.shaving or (self.inst.components.health and self.inst.components.health:IsDead()) then
                return old_Stop(self)
            end
            -- 否则（比如受到玩家或怪物的普通攻击时），拦截卸下装饰的逻辑
        end

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:combat
    AddComponentPostInit("combat", function(self)
        local old_ShouldAggro = self.ShouldAggro
        self.ShouldAggro = function(self, target, ignore_forbidden)
            if self.inst:HasTag("spider")
                and GetModConfigData("cfg_spider_attack_shadow")
                and target and target:HasTag("shadow")
                and self.inst.components.follower
                and self.inst.components.follower.leader
                and target.entity and target.entity:IsValid()
                and target.components.health
                and not target.components.health:IsDead() then
                return true
            end
            return old_ShouldAggro(self, target, ignore_forbidden)
        end

        -- 1. 允许暗影生物被蜘蛛“判定为可被攻击”
        local old_CanBeAttacked = self.CanBeAttacked
        self.CanBeAttacked = function(self, attacker)
            if GetModConfigData("cfg_spider_attack_shadow") and self.inst:HasTag("shadow") and attacker and attacker:HasTag("spider") then
                local leader = attacker.components.follower and attacker.components.follower.leader
                if leader ~= nil then
                    return true
                end
            end
            if old_CanBeAttacked then
                return old_CanBeAttacked(self, attacker)
            end
            return true
        end

        -- 2. 拦截合法目标判定（处理暗影生物免检与小弟被动防御姿态）
        local old_IsValidTarget = self.IsValidTarget
        self.IsValidTarget = function(self, target)
            if self.inst:HasTag("spider") then
                local stance = 2
                local leader = self.inst.components.follower and self.inst.components.follower.leader
                -- Wild den defenders must use native targeting, not follower stances.
                if leader == nil then
                    return old_IsValidTarget and old_IsValidTarget(self, target) or false
                end
                if leader then
                    stance = self.inst._spider_stance_override
                    if stance == nil then stance = leader._spider_stance or 2 end
                    
                    -- 防止蜘蛛（尤其是女王的 RetargetFn）误伤友军 (如切斯特、小高脚鸟等)
                    if target and target ~= self.inst._baton_target then
                        if target == leader then return false end
                        if self:IsAlly(target) then
                            -- 除非主人正在亲自打它，或者它正在打主人/自己，否则绝对不主动咬它
                            local leader_combat = leader.components.combat
                            if not (leader_combat and leader_combat.target == target) then
                                local target_combat = target.components.combat
                                if not (target_combat and (target_combat.target == leader or target_combat.target == self.inst)) then
                                    return false
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                -- 如果当前指挥特定兵种，未选中的兵种直接罢工不参与主动攻击
                if leader and target ~= self.inst._baton_target and leader._spider_command_group ~= "all" and not GLOBAL.IsSpiderInCommandGroup(self.inst, leader) then
                    if target then
                        local target_combat = target.components.combat
                        -- 只有当目标正在打我或者打主人的时候，才允许还击
                        if not (target_combat and (target_combat.target == self.inst or target_combat.target == leader)) then
                            return false
                        end
                    else
                        return false
                    end
                end

                -- 驻守距离限制：如果蜘蛛在驻守点，且目标距离自己过远（超过 30 距离），则忽略由于主人挨打带来的仇恨共享
                -- 除非目标直接在攻击这只蜘蛛自己
                if self.inst._rally_pos ~= nil and target and target ~= self.inst._baton_target then
                    local target_combat = target.components.combat
                    if self.inst:GetDistanceSqToInst(target) > 900 then
                        if not (target_combat and target_combat.target == self.inst) then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end

                -- 如果主人的姿态是 1（被动），除非是明确用指挥棒指派的目标，否则一律不打
                if stance == 1 then
                    if not target or (self.target ~= target and self.inst._baton_target ~= target) then
                        return false
                    end
                end

                -- 姿态 2 是中立：不主动索敌，但允许反击，以及协助主人当前
                -- 正在亲自攻击的目标。指挥棒明确指定的目标始终放行。
                if stance == 2 and target and self.inst._baton_target ~= target
                    and self.inst._webber_retaliation_target ~= target
                    and self.inst._webber_target_request_source ~= "retaliation"
                    and self.inst._webber_target_request_source ~= "assist" then
                    local target_combat = target.components and target.components.combat
                    local is_retaliating = target_combat and (target_combat.target == self.inst or target_combat.target == leader)
                    local is_assisting_leader = leader and leader.components.combat
                        and leader.components.combat.target == target
                    -- 已由指挥棒建立并保留的当前目标允许继续完成，不会因中立姿态被下一次校验打断。
                    if not is_retaliating and not is_assisting_leader and self.target ~= target then
                        return false
                    end
                end

                -- R键召回和右键驻守附加的 2秒 强制免战期，在此期间被打了也不会还手，方便拉脱仇恨
                if self.inst._force_passive_time and GLOBAL.GetTime() < self.inst._force_passive_time then
                    if not target or (self.target ~= target and self.inst._baton_target ~= target) then
                        return false
                    end
                end

                -- 暗影生物的特判：如果是被指挥去打，或者是中立/主动姿态且锁定了它，则绕过精神值检测
                if GetModConfigData("cfg_spider_attack_shadow") and target and target:HasTag("shadow") then
                    if target.entity:IsValid() and target.components.health and not target.components.health:IsDead() then
                        if self.inst.components.follower
                            and self.inst.components.follower.leader ~= nil then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if old_IsValidTarget then
                return old_IsValidTarget(self, target)
            end
            return false
        end

        -- 3. 拦截仇恨保持逻辑，防止蜘蛛在驻守时因为离玩家太远而强制丢失目标
        local old_SetKeepTargetFunction = self.SetKeepTargetFunction
        if old_SetKeepTargetFunction then
            self.SetKeepTargetFunction = function(self, fn)
                if self.inst:HasTag("spider") then
                    local old_fn = fn
                    fn = function(inst, target)
                        -- 指挥棒明确点名的目标不受原版跟随距离限制影响，
                        -- 否则部分蜘蛛在接敌后会被原版 keep-target 判定拉回主人身边。
                        if inst._baton_target == target then
                            if GetModConfigData("cfg_spider_attack_shadow")
                                and target:HasTag("shadow")
                                and inst.components.follower
                                and inst.components.follower.leader then
                                return inst.components.combat:IsValidTarget(target)
                            end
                            return inst.components.combat:CanTarget(target)
                        end
                        if inst._rally_pos ~= nil then
                            -- 如果正在驻守，只要没追出驻守点太远（距离平方<900，即30格内），就死咬不放，忽略主人的距离限制
                            return inst.components.combat:CanTarget(target) and inst:GetDistanceSqToPoint(inst._rally_pos:Get()) <= 900
                        end
                        if old_fn then
                            return old_fn(inst, target)
                        end
                        return inst.components.combat:CanTarget(target)
                    end
                end
                return old_SetKeepTargetFunction(self, fn)
            end
        end

        -- All native and mod targeting paths share the same order arbitration.
        local old_SetTarget = self.SetTarget
        self.SetTarget = function(self, target, ...)
            return GLOBAL.SetWebberSpiderCombatTarget(self, target, old_SetTarget, ...)
        end

        -- 指挥棒目标期间暂停原版自动重选目标，避免蜘蛛在攻击过程中
        -- 被附近的小怪、召唤物或 RetargetFn 抢走目标。
        local old_TryRetarget = self.TryRetarget
        if old_TryRetarget then
            self.TryRetarget = function(self, ...)
                local forced = self.inst._baton_target
                if forced and forced:IsValid()
                    and not (forced.components.health and forced.components.health:IsDead()) then
                    if self.target ~= forced then
                        self:SetTarget(forced)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local previous = self.inst._webber_target_request_source
                self.inst._webber_target_request_source = "auto"
                local result = old_TryRetarget(self, ...)
                self.inst._webber_target_request_source = previous
                return result
            end
        end
    end)

```

```lua

AddBrainPostInit("birdbrain", function(brain)
    local root = PriorityNode({
        WhileNode(function() return brain.inst.components.hauntable ~= nil and brain.inst.components.hauntable.panic end, "PanicHaunted",
            ActionNode(function() return FlyAway(brain.inst) end)),
        IfNode(function() return ShouldFlyAway(brain.inst) end, "Threat Near",
            ActionNode(function() return FlyAway(brain.inst) end)),
        EventNode(brain.inst, "threatnear",
            ActionNode(function() return FlyAway(brain.inst) end)),
        EventNode(brain.inst, "gohome",
            ActionNode(function() return FlyAway(brain.inst) end)),
    }, 0.25)

    brain.bt = BT(brain.inst, root)
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:birdspawner
--艾丽妮附近的鸟在通过birdspawner生成时有25%概率被替换为雪雀
AddComponentPostInit("birdspawner", function(self)
    local oldSpawnBird = self.SpawnBird
    self.SpawnBird = function(self, spawnpoint, ignorebait, ...)
        local irene = FindIreneInRange(spawnpoint, 16)
        if spawnpoint ~= nil and TheWorld.Map:IsPassableAtPoint(spawnpoint:Get()) and irene ~= nil and math.random() < 0.25 then
            local prefab = "robin_winter"

            local bird = SpawnPrefab(prefab)
            if math.random() < .5 then
                bird.Transform:SetRotation(180)
            end

            if bird:HasTag("bird") then
                spawnpoint.y = 15
            end

            --see if there's bait nearby that we might spawn into
            --but if it's a corpse, i don't think they'll care for any bait :)
            local found_bait = false
            if bird.components.eater and not ignorebait then
                local bait = TheSim:FindEntities(spawnpoint.x, 0, spawnpoint.z, 15, nil, BAIT_CANT_TAGS)
                for k, v in pairs(bait) do
                    local x, y, z = v.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
                    if bird.components.eater:CanEat(v) and not v:IsInLimbo() and
                        v.components.bait and
                        not (v.components.inventoryitem and v.components.inventoryitem:IsHeld()) and
                        not IsDangerNearby(x, y, z) and
                        (bird.components.floater ~= nil or TheWorld.Map:IsPassableAtPoint(x, y, z)) then
                        spawnpoint.x, spawnpoint.z = x, z
                        bird.bufferedaction = BufferedAction(bird, v, ACTIONS.EAT)
                        found_bait = true
                        break
                    elseif v.components.trap and
                        v.components.trap.isset and
                        (not v.components.trap.targettag or bird:HasTag(v.components.trap.targettag)) and
                        not v.components.trap.issprung and
                        math.random() < TUNING.BIRD_TRAP_CHANCE and
                        not IsDangerNearby(x, y, z) then
                        spawnpoint.x, spawnpoint.z = x, z
                        found_bait = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            
            bird.Physics:Teleport(spawnpoint:Get())

            return bird
        end

        return oldSpawnBird(self, spawnpoint, ignorebait, ...)
    end
end)

--这里，是为了艾丽妮的天赋无视部分减伤
local Health = require "components/health"
local oldDoDelta = Health.DoDelta
local function deltamodifierfn(inst, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ignore_absorb)
    local self = inst.components.health
    if not self then return amount end
    local attacker = self.temp_attacker
    if not attacker then return amount end
    if amount and amount >= 0 then return amount end
    local percent = attacker.irene_attack_ignore_absorb or 0.1
    if self.origin_amount then --amount<0 -1 self.origin_amount = -2  delta - 1
        local delta = self.origin_amount - amount
        return amount + percent * delta
    end
    return amount
end
function Health:DoDelta(amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ignore_absorb)
    local attacker = afflicter and type(afflicter) == "table" and afflicter or nil
    if attacker and attacker.irene_attack_ignore_absorb then
        ignore_invincible = true
        local olddeltamodifierfn = self.deltamodifierfn
        self.deltamodifierfn = deltamodifierfn
        self.origin_amount = amount
        self.temp_attacker = attacker
        local result = oldDoDelta(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ignore_absorb)
        self.temp_attacker = nil
        self.deltamodifierfn = olddeltamodifierfn
        return result
    end

    return oldDoDelta(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ignore_absorb)
end

local cooking = require("cooking")

local function dospoil(inst, self)
    self.task = nil
    self.targettime = nil
    self.spoiltime = nil

    if self.onspoil ~= nil then
        self.onspoil(inst)
    end
end

local function dostew(inst, self)
    self.task = nil
    self.targettime = nil
    self.spoiltime = nil

    if self.ondonecooking ~= nil then
        self.ondonecooking(inst)
    end

    if self.product == self.spoiledproduct then
        if self.onspoil ~= nil then
            self.onspoil(inst)
        end
    elseif self.product ~= nil then
        local recipe = cooking.GetRecipe(inst.prefab, self.product)
        local prep_perishtime = (recipe ~= nil and (recipe.cookpot_perishtime or recipe.perishtime)) or 0
        if prep_perishtime > 0 then
			local prod_spoil = self.product_spoilage or 1
			self.spoiltime = prep_perishtime * prod_spoil
			self.targettime =  GetTime() + self.spoiltime
			self.task = self.inst:DoTaskInTime(self.spoiltime, dospoil, self)
		end
    end

    self.done = true
end

AddComponentPostInit("stewer", function(self)
    local OldStartCooking = self.StartCooking
    function self:StartCooking(doer)
        if doer and doer:HasTag("irene") then
            if self.targettime == nil and self.inst.components.container ~= nil then
                self.chef_id = (doer ~= nil and doer.player_classified ~= nil) and doer.userid
                self.ingredient_prefabs = {}

                self.done = nil
                self.spoiltime = nil

                if self.onstartcooking ~= nil then
                    self.onstartcooking(self.inst)
                end

                for k, v in pairs (self.inst.components.container.slots) do
                    table.insert(self.ingredient_prefabs, v.prefab)
                end

                local cooktime = 1
                self.product, cooktime = cooking.CalculateRecipe(self.inst.prefab, self.ingredient_prefabs)
                local productperishtime = cooking.GetRecipe(self.inst.prefab, self.product).perishtime or 0

                if productperishtime > 0 then
                    local spoilage_total = 0
                    local spoilage_n = 0
                    for k, v in pairs (self.inst.components.container.slots) do
                        if v.components.perishable ~= nil then
                            spoilage_n = spoilage_n + 1
                            spoilage_total = spoilage_total + v.components.perishable:GetPercent()
                        end
                    end
                    self.product_spoilage =
                        (spoilage_n <= 0 and 1) or
                        (self.keepspoilage and spoilage_total / spoilage_n) or
                        1 - (1 - spoilage_total / spoilage_n) * .5
                else
                    self.product_spoilage = nil
                end

                cooktime = TUNING.BASE_COOK_TIME * cooktime * self.cooktimemult
                cooktime = math.max(0, cooktime - (doer:HasTag("irene_buildermax") and 7.5 or 5))
                self.targettime = GetTime() + cooktime
                if self.task ~= nil then
                    self.task:Cancel()
                end
                self.task = self.inst:DoTaskInTime(cooktime, dostew, self)

                self.inst.components.container:Close()
                self.inst.components.container:DestroyContents()
                self.inst.components.container.canbeopened = false
            end
        else
            return OldStartCooking(self, doer)
        end 
    end
    local OldHarvest = self.Harvest
    function self:Harvest(harvester)
        if harvester and harvester:HasTag("irene") and math.random() <= (harvester:HasTag("irene_buildermax") and .35 or .15) then
            if self.done then
                if self.onharvest ~= nil then
                    self.onharvest(self.inst)
                end

                if self.product ~= nil then
                    local loot = SpawnPrefab(self.product)
                    if loot ~= nil then
                        local recipe = cooking.GetRecipe(self.inst.prefab, self.product)

                        if harvester ~= nil and
                            self.chef_id == harvester.userid and
                            recipe ~= nil and
                            recipe.cookbook_category ~= nil and
                            cooking.cookbook_recipes[recipe.cookbook_category] ~= nil and
                            cooking.cookbook_recipes[recipe.cookbook_category][self.product] ~= nil then
                            harvester:PushEvent("learncookbookrecipe", {product = self.product, ingredients = self.ingredient_prefabs})
                        end

                        local stacksize = recipe and recipe.stacksize or 1
                        local lootcount = loot.components.stackable ~= nil and 1 or 2

                        local function FinishLoot(item)
                            if item == nil then
                                return
                            end
                            if item.components.stackable ~= nil then
                                item.components.stackable:SetStackSize(stacksize * 2)
                            end
                            if self.spoiltime ~= nil and item.components.perishable ~= nil then
                                local spoilpercent = self:GetTimeToSpoil() / self.spoiltime
                                item.components.perishable:SetPercent(self.product_spoilage * spoilpercent)
                                item.components.perishable:StartPerishing()
                            end
                            if harvester ~= nil and harvester.components.inventory ~= nil then
                                harvester.components.inventory:GiveItem(item, nil, self.inst:GetPosition())
                            else
                                LaunchAt(item, self.inst, nil, 1, 1)
                            end
                        end

                        FinishLoot(loot)
                        for i = 2, lootcount do
                            FinishLoot(SpawnPrefab(self.product))
                        end
                    end
                    self.product = nil
                end

                if self.task ~= nil then
                    self.task:Cancel()
                    self.task = nil
                end
                self.targettime = nil
                self.done = nil
                self.spoiltime = nil
                self.product_spoilage = nil

                if self.inst.components.container ~= nil then
                    self.inst.components.container.canbeopened = true
                end

                return true
            end
        else
            return OldHarvest(self, harvester)
        end
    end
end)

local oceancreatures_prefabs = {"gnarwail", "penguin", "lightcrab", "merm", "merm_lunar", "merm_shadow", "merm_king", "shark", "crabking", "otter", "wavyjones", "waveyjones_hand", "waterplant", "frog", "squid", "cookiecutter"}
for i, oceancrature in pairs(oceancreatures_prefabs) do
    AddPrefabPostInit(oceancrature,function(inst)
        inst:AddTag("irene_oceancreature")
    end)
end

local function ResetDamage(inst, force)
    if inst.components.weapon then
        if inst.components.weapon._irene_old_damage or (force and type(inst.components.weapon.damage) == "number") then
            inst.components.weapon.damage = inst.components.weapon._irene_old_damage or inst.components.weapon.damage * 1.05
            if force then
                inst.components.weapon._irene_old_damage = inst.components.weapon.damage
            end
        end
    end
end

local function OnLoadInGame(inst)
    if inst.components.timer and inst.components.timer:TimerExists("irene_repairkit_repaired") then
        ResetDamage(inst, true)
    end
end

local function OnTimerDone(inst, data)
    if data and data.name then
        if data.name == "irene_repairkit_repaired" then
            ResetDamage(inst)
        end
    end
end

AddPrefabPostInitAny(function(inst)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
        return inst
    end

    if inst.components.fueled then
        if inst.components.insulator then
            inst:AddTag("irene_repairableitem")
            if not inst.components.timer then
                inst:AddComponent("timer")
            end
        end
    end

    if inst:HasTag("irene_repairableitem") then
        if inst.components.finiteuses then
            local old_use = inst.components.finiteuses.Use
            inst.components.finiteuses.Use = function(self, numuses)
                if numuses and numuses > 0 then
                    if inst.components.timer and inst.components.timer:TimerExists("irene_repairkit_repaired") then
                        numuses = math.ceil(numuses * .85)
                    end
                end

                -- 如果旧函数存在，则调用它
                if old_use then
                    old_use(self, numuses)
                end
            end
        end
        if inst.components.fueled then
            local old_dodelta = inst.components.fueled.DoDelta
            inst.components.fueled.DoDelta = function(self, amount, doer)
                if amount and amount < 0 then
                    amount = math.ceil(amount * .85)
                end
                if old_dodelta then
                    old_dodelta(self, amount, doer)
                end
            end
        end
        inst:ListenForEvent("timerdone", OnTimerDone)
        inst:DoTaskInTime(0, OnLoadInGame)
    end
end)

--催眠相关
AddComponentPostInit("grogginess", function(self)
	local oldAddGrogginess = self.AddGrogginess
	function self:AddGrogginess(grogginess, knockoutduration, ...)
        local irene = FindIreneInRange(self.inst, 8)
        if irene and irene:HasTag("irene_lanternpassiveactived") then
            if irene.irene_lanternsanitylevel2 then
                return
            elseif irene.irene_lanternsanitylevel1 then
                if grogginess > 0 then
                    grogginess = math.max(0, grogginess - 2)
                end
            end
        end
		return oldAddGrogginess(self, grogginess, knockoutduration, ...)
	end
end)

AddStategraphPostInit("wilson", function(self)
    local talk = self.states.talk

    local _onenter = talk.onenter
    talk.onenter = function(inst, noanim)
        if inst:HasTag("irene") and not (inst:HasTag("mime") or (inst.sg and inst.sg:HasStateTag("notalking"))) then
            --print("条件合法，进入音效判断")
            if math.random() <= TUNING.IRENE_VOICE_RATE and not inst:HasTag("playerghost") then
                --print("尝试播放艾丽妮的音效")
                if inst.sg and inst.sg.statemem and inst.sg.statemem.talktask ~= nil then
                    inst.sg.statemem.talktask:Cancel()
                    inst.sg.statemem.talktask = nil
                end
                inst.SoundEmitter:KillSound("irene_talk")
                --inst.SoundEmitter:KillSound("talk")
                PlayIrenePlayerVoice(inst, "irene_talk", TUNING.IRENE_VOICE_VOLUME, "irene_talk")
            else
                --print("概率判定失败或鬼魂状态不播放艾丽妮的音效")
                --pass
            end
        end
        return _onenter(inst, noanim)
    end

    local _onexit = talk.onexit
    talk.onexit = function(inst, instant)
        if inst:HasTag("irene") then
            --inst.SoundEmitter:KillSound("irene_talk")
        end
        return _onexit(inst, instant)
    end
end)

local compatible_item1 = {
	"greenamulet"
}

for k,v in pairs(compatible_item1) do
	AddPrefabPostInit(v,function(inst)  
        inst:AddTag("irene_green_amulet")
		local old_onequipfn = inst.components.equippable and inst.components.equippable.onequipfn 
		if old_onequipfn then
			inst.components.equippable.onequipfn = function(inst,owner,...)
				old_onequipfn(inst,owner,...)
				if not owner:HasTag("irene") then return end
				local zy1 = owner.components.builder.ingredientmod or 1
				local zy2 = owner.components.irene_builder.ingredientmod or 1
				owner.components.builder.ingredientmod = math.min(zy1,zy2)
			end
		end
		local old_onunequipfn = inst.components.equippable and inst.components.equippable.onunequipfn 
		if old_onunequipfn then
			inst.components.equippable.onunequipfn = function(inst,owner,...)
				old_onunequipfn(inst,owner,...)
				if not owner:HasTag("irene") then return end
				if owner.components.irene_builder.ingredientmod ~= nil then
					owner.components.builder.ingredientmod = owner.components.irene_builder.ingredientmod
				end
			end
		end
    end)
end

local function IsCloth(recipe)
    if recipe.filter ~= nil then
        for k, v in pairs(recipe.filter) do
            if v == "CLOTHING" then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    for k, v in pairs(CRAFTING_FILTERS.CLOTHING.recipes) do
        if v == recipe.product then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

AddClassPostConstruct("widgets/redux/craftingmenu_ingredients",
    function(CraftingMenuIngredients, owner, max_ingredients_wide, recipe, extra_quantity_scale)
        local oldSetRecipe = CraftingMenuIngredients.SetRecipe
        function CraftingMenuIngredients:SetRecipe(recipe)
            if self.owner:HasTag("irene") and IsCloth(recipe) then
                local oldIngredientMod = self.owner.replica.builder.IngredientMod
                local totalamount = self.owner:HasTag("irene_buildermax") and 0.5 or 0.75
                function self.owner.replica.builder:IngredientMod()
                    return totalamount
                end
                oldSetRecipe(self, recipe)
                self.owner.replica.builder.IngredientMod = oldIngredientMod
            else
                oldSetRecipe(self, recipe)
            end
        end
        CraftingMenuIngredients:SetRecipe(recipe) -- 刷新一次UI
    end)

                if inst.sg and inst.sg.statemem and inst.sg.statemem.talktask ~= nil then
                    inst.sg.statemem.talktask:Cancel()
                    inst.sg.statemem.talktask = nil
                end
                inst.SoundEmitter:KillSound("irene_talk")
                --inst.SoundEmitter:KillSound("talk")
                PlayIrenePlayerVoice(inst, "irene_talk", TUNING.IRENE_VOICE_VOLUME, "irene_talk")
            else
                --print("概率判定失败或鬼魂状态不播放艾丽妮的音效")
                --pass
            end
        end
        return _onenter(inst, noanim)
    end

    local _onexit = talk.onexit
    talk.onexit = function(inst, instant)
        if inst:HasTag("irene") then
            --inst.SoundEmitter:KillSound("irene_talk")
        end
        return _onexit(inst, instant)
    end
end)
```

```lua
AddPrefabPostInit("reskin_tool", function(inst)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
         return inst
    end

    if inst.components.spellcaster.spell then  

        local can_cast_fn_old = inst.components.spellcaster.can_cast_fn
        inst.components.spellcaster:SetCanCastFn(function(doer, target, pos, ...)
            if target ~= nil and target.components.eyjafjallaskinner then
                return true
            end

            if can_cast_fn_old ~= nil then
                return can_cast_fn_old(doer, target, pos, ...)
            end
        end)

        local spell_old = inst.components.spellcaster.spell
        inst.components.spellcaster:SetSpellFn(function(tool, target, pos, ...)
            if target ~= nil and target.components.eyjafjallaskinner then
                local fx = SpawnPrefab("explode_reskin")
                fx.Transform:SetScale(1, 1, 1)
                local fx_pos_x, fx_pos_y, fx_pos_z = target.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
                fx.Transform:SetPosition(fx_pos_x, fx_pos_y, fx_pos_z)
                target.components.eyjafjallaskinner:ChangeSkin()
                return true
            end
            if spell_old ~= nil then
                return spell_old(tool, target, pos, ...)
            end
        end)
    end
end)
```

```lua
AddPrefabPostInit("bearger", function(inst) -- Preventing Bearger disarm
	if not GLOBAL.TheWorld.ismastersim then
		return
	end
	if TUNING.FTWINONA_GRIP then
		local listeners = inst.event_listeners.onhitother
		local listener_fns = listeners[inst]
		local old = listener_fns[1]
		listener_fns[1] = function(inst, data)
			local other = data.target
			if other and other.prefab == "winona" then
				return
			end
			return old(inst, data)
		end
	end
end)

-- 切面钩子：AddStategraphPostInit:moose

AddStategraphPostInit("moose", function(sg) -- Preventing moose/goose disarm
	if TUNING.FTWINONA_GRIP then
		local disarm_state = sg.states.disarm
		local old = disarm_state.timeline[5].fn
		disarm_state.timeline[5].fn = function(inst)
			local target = inst.components.combat.target
			if target and target.prefab == "winona" then
				inst.CanDisarm = false
				return	
			end
			old(inst)
		end
	end
end)
```

```lua
    for _, state_name in ipairs(no_sleep_states) do
        local state = sg.states[state_name]
        if state and state.onenter then

            state.onenter = function(inst, ...)

                    inst.sg:GoToState("idle")

                    return
                end

        end
    end
```

```lua
-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:krieg

AddPrefabPostInit("krieg", function(inst)
    if not TheWorld.ismastersim then
        return inst
    end

    inst.components.inventory.ApplyDamage  = function(self, damage, attacker, weapon, spdamage, ...)
        return damage, spdamage
    end 

    local _getAttacked = inst.components.combat.GetAttacked
    inst.components.combat.GetAttacked = function(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...)
        if inst.sg:HasStateTag("krieg_trans") then
            return
        end    
        local abs = 0.6
        if inst:HasTag("is_were") and inst.skill1[1] > 0 then --
        abs = abs + (inst.skill1[1] * 0.02)
        end

        if inst.kr_fire_time and inst.kr_fire_time > 0 and inst.krieg_fake_fire and inst.krieg_fake_fire:IsValid() and inst.skill3[2] > 0 then
        abs = abs + (inst.skill3[2] * 0.02)
        end

        if inst:HasTag("is_wereRRR") then
        abs = abs + 0.1
        end    

        if attacker and attacker == inst then
        abs = 0
        AddKrVision(inst)    
        end

        --print(abs)    

        if abs > 0 then
        damage = damage - (damage * abs)
        end
        return _getAttacked(self, attacker, damage, weapon, stimuli, spdamage, ...)  
    end

    local _getHealth = inst.components.health.DoDelta 
    inst.components.health.DoDelta = function(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ignore_absorb, ...)
        if inst.sg:HasStateTag("krieg_trans") and amount < 0 then
            return
        end 

        if (self.currenthealth + amount) <= 0 and (inst.use_bomb_task or inst.skill2[1] > 0) and (cause == nil or cause ~= "bomb_kill") then  --amount < 0 and
            if inst.use_bomb_task == nil and inst.skill2[1] > 0 then
                inst:UseBomb(true)
            end    
            amount = 0
            self.currenthealth = 1
        end

        return _getHealth(self, amount, overtime, cause, ignore_invincible, afflicter, ignore_absorb, ...) 
    end 

    inst.components.cursable.ApplyCurse = function(s, it, cur,...)
    if it and it:AddTag("applied_curse") then
        it:RemoveTag("applied_curse")
    end
    if it.components.curseditem then
        it.components.curseditem.target = nil
    end
    if it.findplayertask then
        it.findplayertask:Cancel()
        it.findplayertask = nil
    end
    end 

    local OldAddColdness = inst.components.freezable.AddColdness
    inst.components.freezable.AddColdness = function(self, coldness, freezetime, nofreeze, ...)
        if OnUseBomb(inst) or inst.sg:HasStateTag("krieg_trans") then
            coldness = -100
        end  
        return OldAddColdness(self, coldness, freezetime, nofreeze, ...)
    end

    local OldAddGrogginess = inst.components.grogginess.AddGrogginess --ThePlayer.components.grogginess:AddGrogginess(-10, 10)
    inst.components.grogginess.AddGrogginess = function(self, grogginess, knockoutduration, ...)  --ThePlayer.components.grogginess:SubtractGrogginess(10)
        if OnUseBomb(inst) or inst.sg:HasStateTag("krieg_trans") then
            self:SubtractGrogginess(30)
            return
        end  
        return OldAddGrogginess(self, grogginess, knockoutduration, ...)
    end

    local OldStick = inst.components.pinnable.Stick
    inst.components.pinnable.Stick = function(self, goo_build, splashfxlist, ...)
        if OnUseBomb(inst) or inst.sg:HasStateTag("krieg_trans") then
            return
        end  
        return OldStick(self, goo_build, splashfxlist, ...)
    end

    inst:ListenForEvent("pinned", function(inst)
        if OnUseBomb(inst) or inst.sg:HasStateTag("krieg_trans") then
        inst.components.pinnable:Unstick() 
        end
    end)

    inst:DoPeriodicTask(0.05, DropTarget) 
end)
```

```lua
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:playeractionpicker
-- their normal priority.
AddComponentPostInit("playeractionpicker", function(self)
    if self._derfei_ground_teleport_wrapper ~= nil then
        return
    end

    local old_get_right_click_actions = self.GetRightClickActions
    local wrapper = function(picker, position, target, spellbook, ...)
        local actions = old_get_right_click_actions(picker, position, target, spellbook, ...)
        -- Vanilla normally returns a table, but keep the hook safe for other
        -- component patches that intentionally return nil to defer handling.
        actions = actions or {}
        local teleport = GetGroundTeleportAction(picker.inst, position, target)
        if teleport ~= nil then
            local only_ignorable = #actions > 0
            for _, action in ipairs(actions) do
                if not IsGroundTeleportIgnorableAction(action.action) then
                    only_ignorable = false
                    break
                end
            end

            if #actions == 0 or only_ignorable then
                return { teleport }
            end
        end
        return actions
    end

    self._derfei_ground_teleport_wrapper = wrapper
    self.GetRightClickActions = wrapper
end)
```

### 变体演进：Language (Mod 3668914451)
- **变体场景与切面**：收录来自工坊 Mod 3668914451 (`Language`) 的生产级切面。
- **核心切面代码**：
```lua
-- ============================================================================
-- 生产级架构复刻切面范式 (提取自 Mod 3668914451)
-- ============================================================================
local GLOBAL = GLOBAL

-- 切面钩子：AddPrefabPostInit:moonrock_wheel
if TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 0 then
	AddPrefabPostInit("moonrock_wheel",SetupCommandWheel)
elseif TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 1 then
	AddPlayerPostInit(SetupCommandWheel)
	--AddPlayerPostInit(SetupMountedCommandWheel)
elseif TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 2 then
	AddPrefabPostInit("moonrockidol",SetupCommandWheel)
elseif TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 3 then
	AddPrefabPostInit("lunar_seed",SetupCommandWheel)
end
local function giveitem(inst)
	local num = 1
	if inst.components.allskillwheelhandler ~= nil then
		num = inst.components.allskillwheelhandler.stocksize
	end
	for i = 1,num,1 do
		local item = nil
		if TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 0 and TUNING.ASWCONSUME == 0 then
			item = SpawnPrefab("moonrock_wheel")
		elseif TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 2
		then
			item = SpawnPrefab("moonrockidol")
		elseif TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 3
		then
			item = SpawnPrefab("lunar_seed")
		end
		if item ~= nil then
			item.Transform:SetPosition(inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition())
		end
	end
	if inst and inst.woby and inst.woby.components and inst.woby.components.container then
		inst.woby.components.container:DropEverything()
	end
end
-------------------blink for wortox
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function IsSoul(item)
    return item.prefab == "wortox_soul"
end

local function IsSoulJar(item)
    return item.prefab == "wortox_souljar"
end
local function PutSoulOnCooldown(item, cooldowntime, overridepercent)
    if not IsSoul(item) then
        return
    end

    if item.components.rechargeable ~= nil then
        item.components.rechargeable:Discharge(cooldowntime)
        if overridepercent then
            item.components.rechargeable:SetPercent(overridepercent)
        end
    else
        item:AddTag("nosouljar")
    end
end

local function RemoveSoulCooldown(item)
    if not IsSoul(item) then
        return
    end

    if item.components.rechargeable ~= nil then
        item.components.rechargeable:SetPercent(1)
    else
        item:RemoveTag("nosouljar")
    end
end
local function GetStackSize(item)
    return item.components.stackable ~= nil and item.components.stackable:StackSize() or 1
end

local function CheckSoulsRemoved(inst)
    inst._checksoulstask = nil
    if inst.wortox_needstreeinit then
        -- Reschedule.
        inst._checksoulstask = inst:DoTaskInTime(0, CheckSoulsRemoved)
        return
    end
    if count == 0 then
        inst:FinishPortalHop()
    end
    

end

local function CheckSoulsRemovedAfterAnim(inst, anim)
    if inst.AnimState:IsCurrentAnimation(anim) then
        inst._checksoulstask = inst:DoTaskInTime(inst.AnimState:GetCurrentAnimationLength() - inst.AnimState:GetCurrentAnimationTime() + 2 * FRAMES, CheckSoulsRemoved)
    else
        CheckSoulsRemoved(inst)
    end
end

local function SortByStackSize(l, r)
    return GetStackSize(l) < GetStackSize(r)
end
local function GetSouls(inst)
    local souls = inst.components.inventory:FindItems(IsSoul)
    local count = 0
    for i, v in ipairs(souls) do
        count = count + GetStackSize(v)
    end
    return souls, count
end
--------------------------------------------
local function OnSoulHop(inst)
    if inst._checksoulstask ~= nil then
        inst._checksoulstask:Cancel()
    end
    inst._checksoulstask = inst:DoTaskInTime(.5, CheckSoulsRemovedAfterAnim, "wortox_portal_jumpout")
end

local function SetNetvar(inst)
    if inst.player_classified ~= nil then
        assert(inst._freesoulhop_counter >= 0 and inst._freesoulhop_counter <= 7, "Player _freesoulhop_counter out of range: "..tostring(inst._freesoulhop_counter))
        inst.player_classified.freesoulhops:set(inst._freesoulhop_counter)
    end
end

local function ClearSoulhopCounter(inst)
    inst._freesoulhop_counter = 0
    inst._soulhop_cost = 0
    SetNetvar(inst)
end

local function FinishPortalHop(inst)
    if inst.finishportalhoptask ~= nil then
        inst.finishportalhoptask:Cancel()
        inst.finishportalhoptask = nil
        inst.finishportalhoptaskmaxtime = nil
    end
    if inst._freesoulhop_counter > 0 then
        if inst.components.inventory ~= nil then
            inst.components.inventory:ConsumeByName("wortox_soul", math.max(math.ceil(inst._soulhop_cost), 1))
        end
        ClearSoulhopCounter(inst)
    end
    inst:RemoveDebuff("wortox_soulecho_buff")
    --inst:DoCheckSoulsAdded()
end

local function GetHopsPerSoul(inst)
    local soulsperhop = TUNING.WORTOX_FREEHOP_HOPSPERSOUL
    local skilltreeupdater = inst.components.skilltreeupdater
    if skilltreeupdater and skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wortox_liftedspirits_3") then
        soulsperhop = soulsperhop + TUNING.SKILLS.WORTOX.WORTOX_FREEHOP_HOPSPERSOUL_ADD
    end
    return soulsperhop
end

local function GetSoulEchoCooldownTime(inst)
    local cooldowntime = TUNING.WORTOX_FREEHOP_TIMELIMIT
    local skilltreeupdater = inst.components.skilltreeupdater
    if skilltreeupdater and skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wortox_liftedspirits_2") then
        cooldowntime = cooldowntime * TUNING.SKILLS.WORTOX.WORTOX_FREEHOP_TIMELIMIT_MULT
    end
    return cooldowntime
end

local function TryToPortalHop(inst, souls, consumeall)
    local invcmp = inst.components.inventory
    if invcmp == nil then
        return false
    end

    souls = souls or 1
    local _, soulscount = inst:GetSouls()
    if soulscount < souls then
        return false
    end

    inst._freesoulhop_counter = inst._freesoulhop_counter + souls
    inst._soulhop_cost = inst._soulhop_cost + souls

    if not consumeall and inst._freesoulhop_counter < inst:GetHopsPerSoul() then
        inst._soulhop_cost = inst._soulhop_cost - souls -- Make it free.
        local cooldowntime = inst:GetSoulEchoCooldownTime()
        local skilltreeupdater = inst.components.skilltreeupdater
        if skilltreeupdater and skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wortox_liftedspirits_1") then
            inst:AddDebuff("wortox_soulecho_buff", "wortox_soulecho_buff", {duration = cooldowntime,})
        end
        invcmp:ForEachItem(PutSoulOnCooldown, cooldowntime)
        if inst.finishportalhoptask ~= nil then
            inst.finishportalhoptask:Cancel()
            inst.finishportalhoptask = nil
            inst.finishportalhoptaskmaxtime = nil
        end
        inst.finishportalhoptask = inst:DoTaskInTime(cooldowntime, inst.FinishPortalHop)
        inst.finishportalhoptaskmaxtime = cooldowntime
    else
        invcmp:ForEachItem(RemoveSoulCooldown)
        inst:FinishPortalHop()
    end
    SetNetvar(inst)

    return true
end
local function OnFreesoulhopsChanged(inst, data)
    inst._freesoulhop_counter = data and data.current or 0
end
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function IsNotBlocked(pt)
    return TheWorld.Map:IsPassableAtPoint(pt:Get()) and not TheWorld.Map:IsGroundTargetBlocked(pt)
end
local function CanBlinkTo(inst, pt)
    local x, y, z = inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
    return IsNotBlocked(pt) and IsTeleportingPermittedFromPointToPoint(x, y, z, pt.x, pt.y, pt.z) -- NOTES(JBK): Keep in sync with blinkstaff. [BATELE]
end

local function CanBlinkFromWithMap(inst, pt)
    local x, y, z = inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
    return IsTeleportingPermittedFromPointToPoint(x, y, z, pt.x, pt.y, pt.z)
end

local function ReticuleTargetFn(inst)
    return ControllerReticle_Blink_GetPosition(inst, IsNotBlocked)
end

local function CanSoulhop(inst, souls)
    if inst:HasTag("soulstealer") and inst.replica.inventory:Has("wortox_soul", souls or 1) then
        local rider = inst.replica.rider
        if rider == nil or not rider:IsRiding() then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local EMPTY_TABLE = {}
local function GetDoubleClickActions(inst, pos, dir, target)
	--Assumes we can only ride our own woby!
	if not inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("walter_woby_dash") then
		return EMPTY_TABLE
	end
	local rider = inst.replica.rider
	local mount = rider and rider:GetMount() or nil
	if mount and mount:HasTag("woby") then
		local pos2
		if dir then
			pos2 = inst:GetPosition()
			pos2.x = pos2.x + dir.x * 10
			pos2.y = 0
			pos2.z = pos2.z + dir.z * 10
		elseif target then
			pos2 = target:GetPosition()
			pos2.y = 0
		end
		return { ACTIONS.DASH }, pos2
	end
	return EMPTY_TABLE
end
local function HasWhistleAction(inst)
	if inst.woby_commands_classified then
		if inst.woby_commands_classified:IsOutForDelivery() then
			--Going to dest, or putting items into boxes
			--Command wheel is blocked, so no range on recall action
			return true
		end
		local woby = inst.woby_commands_classified:GetWoby()
		if TheWorld.ismastersim then
			if woby and not (inst.HUD and not woby:IsInLimbo() and woby:IsNear(inst, 16)) then
				return true
			end
		elseif inst.HUD and (woby == nil or woby:HasTag("INLIMBO") or not woby:IsNear(inst, 16)) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function GetPointSpecialActions(inst, pos, useitem, right)
    if right and useitem == nil then
	-----------------wilson
		if useitem == nil then
			local inventory = inst.replica.inventory
			if inventory ~= nil then
				useitem = inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS)
			end
		end
		if useitem and
			useitem.prefab == "torch" and
			inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wilson_torch_7") and
			useitem:HasTag("special_action_toss")
		then
			return { ACTIONS.TOSS }
		end
		------------------------winona
		if useitem == nil then
			local inventory = inst.replica.inventory
			if inventory ~= nil then
				useitem = inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD)
			end
		end
		if useitem and
			useitem.prefab == "roseglasseshat" and
			useitem:HasTag("closeinspector")
		then
			--match ReticuleTargetFn
			if usereticulepos then
				local pos2 = Vector3()
				for r = 2.5, 1, -.25 do
					pos2.x, pos2.y, pos2.z = inst.entity:LocalToWorldSpace(r, 0, 0)
					if CLOSEINSPECTORUTIL.IsValidPos(inst, pos2) then
						return { ACTIONS.LOOKAT }, pos2
					end
				end
			end

			--default
			if CLOSEINSPECTORUTIL.IsValidPos(inst, pos) then
				return { ACTIONS.LOOKAT }
			end
		end
		----------woby
		if right and
		useitem == nil and
		inst.components.playercontroller and
		inst.components.playercontroller.isclientcontrollerattached and
		HasWhistleAction(inst)
		then
			return { ACTIONS.WHISTLE }
		end
		-------------------------wortox
        local canblink
        if inst.checkingmapactions then
            canblink = inst:CanBlinkFromWithMap(inst.checkingmapactions_pos or inst:GetPosition())
        else
            canblink = inst:CanBlinkTo(pos)
        end
        if canblink and inst.CanSoulhop and inst:CanSoulhop() then
            return { ACTIONS.BLINK }
        end
		---------------------------wx78
		local actions = {}
		if right and useitem == nil then
			if inst.checkingmapactions then
				if inst.components.skilltreeupdater then
					if inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wx78_remotebodyswap") then
						table.insert(actions, ACTIONS.SWAPBODIES_MAP)
					end
					if inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wx78_scoutdrone_1") then
						table.insert(actions, ACTIONS.MAPSCOUTSELECT_MAP)
					end
				end
			else
				if inst.components.playercontroller ~= nil and inst.components.playercontroller.isclientcontrollerattached then
					if inst.CollectUpgradeModuleActions then
						inst:CollectUpgradeModuleActions(actions)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return actions
    end
    return {}
end

local function OnSetOwner(inst)
    if inst.components.playeractionpicker ~= nil then
		--if inst.components.playeractionpicker.pointspecialactionsfn == nil then
			inst.components.playeractionpicker.pointspecialactionsfn = GetPointSpecialActions
		--end
		--if inst.components.playeractionpicker.doubleclickactionsfn == nil then
			inst.components.playeractionpicker.doubleclickactionsfn = GetDoubleClickActions
		--end
    end
	--if TheWorld.ismastersim then
    --    inst.wx78_classified.Network:SetClassifiedTarget(inst)
    --end
end
local function wxOnSetOwner(inst)
	if TheWorld.ismastersim then
        inst.wx78_classified.Network:SetClassifiedTarget(inst)
    end
end

	inst._spells[1] = SPACER_SPELL
	j = j + 1

	for i, v in ipairs(SPELLS_RIGHT) do
		--if v.skill == nil or skilltreeupdater:IsActivated(v.skill) then
			inst._spells[j] = v
		--else
			--inst._spells[j] = BLANK_SPELL
		--end
		j = j + 1
	end

	for i = j, 5 do
		inst._spells[j] = BLANK_SPELL
		j = j + 1
	end

	inst._spells[j] = SPACER_SPELL
	j = j + 1

	for i, v in ipairs(SPELLS_LEFT) do
		--if v.skill == nil or skilltreeupdater:IsActivated(v.skill) then
			inst._spells[j] = v
			j = j + 1
		--end
	end

	if j <= 10 then
		local shift = 11 - j
		for i = j - 1, 7, -1 do
			inst._spells[i + shift] = inst._spells[i]
		end
		for i = 7, 7 + shift - 1 do
			inst._spells[i] = BLANK_SPELL
		end
	end
end

local function EnableMountedCommands(inst, enable)
	if enable then
		inst.components.spellbook:SetItems(inst._spells)
		inst.components.spellbook:SetBgData(SPELLBOOK_WBG)
		inst:AddTag("onridewoby")
	else
		if inst.HUD and inst.HUD:GetCurrentOpenSpellBook() == inst then
			inst.HUD:CloseSpellWheel()
		end
		if TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 1 
		and not (inst.replica.rider and inst.replica.rider:IsRiding())
		then
			inst.components.spellbook:SetItems(SPELLS)
			inst.components.spellbook:SetBgData(SPELLBOOK_BG)
		else
			inst.components.spellbook:SetItems(EMPTY_TABLE)
		end
		inst:RemoveTag("onridewoby")
	end
end

local function DoUpdateMountCommandsTask(inst)
	inst._updatemountcommandstask = nil
	local rider = inst.replica.rider
	local mount = rider and rider:GetMount() or nil
	EnableMountedCommands(inst, mount ~= nil and mount:HasTag("woby"))
end

local function OnIsRiding_Client(inst)
	--V2C: mount is classified whereas isriding is not, so they will not sync at the same time
	if inst._updatemountcommandstask then
		inst._updatemountcommandstask:Cancel()
		inst._updatemountcommandstask = nil

local function giveitem(inst)
	local num = 1
	if inst.components.allskillwheelhandler ~= nil then
		num = inst.components.allskillwheelhandler.stocksize
	end
	for i = 1,num,1 do
		local item = nil
		if TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 0 and TUNING.ASWCONSUME == 0 then
			item = SpawnPrefab("moonrock_wheel")
		elseif TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 2
		then
			item = SpawnPrefab("moonrockidol")
		elseif TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 3
		then
			item = SpawnPrefab("lunar_seed")
		end

			item.Transform:SetPosition(inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition())
		end
	end
	if inst and inst.woby and inst.woby.components and inst.woby.components.container then
		inst.woby.components.container:DropEverything()
	end
end

local function IsSoul(item)
    return item.prefab == "wortox_soul"
end

local function IsSoulJar(item)
    return item.prefab == "wortox_souljar"
end
local function PutSoulOnCooldown(item, cooldowntime, overridepercent)
    if not IsSoul(item) then
        return
    end

    if item.components.rechargeable ~= nil then
        item.components.rechargeable:Discharge(cooldowntime)
        if overridepercent then
            item.components.rechargeable:SetPercent(overridepercent)
        end
    else
        item:AddTag("nosouljar")
    end
end

local function RemoveSoulCooldown(item)
    if not IsSoul(item) then
        return
    end

    if item.components.rechargeable ~= nil then
        item.components.rechargeable:SetPercent(1)
    else
        item:RemoveTag("nosouljar")
    end
end
local function GetStackSize(item)
    return item.components.stackable ~= nil and item.components.stackable:StackSize() or 1
end

local function CheckSoulsRemoved(inst)
    inst._checksoulstask = nil
    if inst.wortox_needstreeinit then
        -- Reschedule.
        inst._checksoulstask = inst:DoTaskInTime(0, CheckSoulsRemoved)
        return
    end
    if count == 0 then
        inst:FinishPortalHop()
    end
    

end

local function CheckSoulsRemovedAfterAnim(inst, anim)
    if inst.AnimState:IsCurrentAnimation(anim) then
        inst._checksoulstask = inst:DoTaskInTime(inst.AnimState:GetCurrentAnimationLength() - inst.AnimState:GetCurrentAnimationTime() + 2 * FRAMES, CheckSoulsRemoved)
    else
        CheckSoulsRemoved(inst)
    end
end

local function SortByStackSize(l, r)
    return GetStackSize(l) < GetStackSize(r)
end
local function GetSouls(inst)
    local souls = inst.components.inventory:FindItems(IsSoul)
    local count = 0
    for i, v in ipairs(souls) do
        count = count + GetStackSize(v)
    end
    return souls, count
end
--------------------------------------------
local function OnSoulHop(inst)
    if inst._checksoulstask ~= nil then
        inst._checksoulstask:Cancel()
    end
    inst._checksoulstask = inst:DoTaskInTime(.5, CheckSoulsRemovedAfterAnim, "wortox_portal_jumpout")
end

local function SetNetvar(inst)
    if inst.player_classified ~= nil then
        assert(inst._freesoulhop_counter >= 0 and inst._freesoulhop_counter <= 7, "Player _freesoulhop_counter out of range: "..tostring(inst._freesoulhop_counter))
        inst.player_classified.freesoulhops:set(inst._freesoulhop_counter)
    end
end

local function ClearSoulhopCounter(inst)
    inst._freesoulhop_counter = 0
    inst._soulhop_cost = 0
    SetNetvar(inst)
end

local function FinishPortalHop(inst)
    if inst.finishportalhoptask ~= nil then
        inst.finishportalhoptask:Cancel()
        inst.finishportalhoptask = nil
        inst.finishportalhoptaskmaxtime = nil
    end
    if inst._freesoulhop_counter > 0 then
        if inst.components.inventory ~= nil then
            inst.components.inventory:ConsumeByName("wortox_soul", math.max(math.ceil(inst._soulhop_cost), 1))
        end
        ClearSoulhopCounter(inst)
    end
    inst:RemoveDebuff("wortox_soulecho_buff")
    --inst:DoCheckSoulsAdded()
end

local function GetHopsPerSoul(inst)
    local soulsperhop = TUNING.WORTOX_FREEHOP_HOPSPERSOUL
    local skilltreeupdater = inst.components.skilltreeupdater
    if skilltreeupdater and skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wortox_liftedspirits_3") then
        soulsperhop = soulsperhop + TUNING.SKILLS.WORTOX.WORTOX_FREEHOP_HOPSPERSOUL_ADD
    end
    return soulsperhop
end

local function GetSoulEchoCooldownTime(inst)
    local cooldowntime = TUNING.WORTOX_FREEHOP_TIMELIMIT
    local skilltreeupdater = inst.components.skilltreeupdater
    if skilltreeupdater and skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wortox_liftedspirits_2") then
        cooldowntime = cooldowntime * TUNING.SKILLS.WORTOX.WORTOX_FREEHOP_TIMELIMIT_MULT
    end
    return cooldowntime
end

local function TryToPortalHop(inst, souls, consumeall)
    local invcmp = inst.components.inventory
    if invcmp == nil then
        return false
    end

    souls = souls or 1
    local _, soulscount = inst:GetSouls()
    if soulscount < souls then
        return false
    end

    inst._freesoulhop_counter = inst._freesoulhop_counter + souls
    inst._soulhop_cost = inst._soulhop_cost + souls

    if not consumeall and inst._freesoulhop_counter < inst:GetHopsPerSoul() then
        inst._soulhop_cost = inst._soulhop_cost - souls -- Make it free.
        local cooldowntime = inst:GetSoulEchoCooldownTime()
        local skilltreeupdater = inst.components.skilltreeupdater
        if skilltreeupdater and skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wortox_liftedspirits_1") then
            inst:AddDebuff("wortox_soulecho_buff", "wortox_soulecho_buff", {duration = cooldowntime,})
        end
        invcmp:ForEachItem(PutSoulOnCooldown, cooldowntime)
        if inst.finishportalhoptask ~= nil then
            inst.finishportalhoptask:Cancel()
            inst.finishportalhoptask = nil
            inst.finishportalhoptaskmaxtime = nil
        end
        inst.finishportalhoptask = inst:DoTaskInTime(cooldowntime, inst.FinishPortalHop)
        inst.finishportalhoptaskmaxtime = cooldowntime
    else
        invcmp:ForEachItem(RemoveSoulCooldown)
        inst:FinishPortalHop()
    end
    SetNetvar(inst)

    return true
end
local function OnFreesoulhopsChanged(inst, data)
    inst._freesoulhop_counter = data and data.current or 0
end
----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function IsNotBlocked(pt)
    return TheWorld.Map:IsPassableAtPoint(pt:Get()) and not TheWorld.Map:IsGroundTargetBlocked(pt)
end
local function CanBlinkTo(inst, pt)
    local x, y, z = inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
    return IsNotBlocked(pt) and IsTeleportingPermittedFromPointToPoint(x, y, z, pt.x, pt.y, pt.z) -- NOTES(JBK): Keep in sync with blinkstaff. [BATELE]
end

local function CanBlinkFromWithMap(inst, pt)
    local x, y, z = inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
    return IsTeleportingPermittedFromPointToPoint(x, y, z, pt.x, pt.y, pt.z)
end

local function ReticuleTargetFn(inst)
    return ControllerReticle_Blink_GetPosition(inst, IsNotBlocked)
end

local function CanSoulhop(inst, souls)
    if inst:HasTag("soulstealer") and inst.replica.inventory:Has("wortox_soul", souls or 1) then
        local rider = inst.replica.rider
        if rider == nil or not rider:IsRiding() then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local EMPTY_TABLE = {}
local function GetDoubleClickActions(inst, pos, dir, target)
	--Assumes we can only ride our own woby!
	if not inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("walter_woby_dash") then
		return EMPTY_TABLE
	end
	local rider = inst.replica.rider
	local mount = rider and rider:GetMount() or nil
	if mount and mount:HasTag("woby") then
		local pos2
		if dir then
			pos2 = inst:GetPosition()
			pos2.x = pos2.x + dir.x * 10
			pos2.y = 0
			pos2.z = pos2.z + dir.z * 10
		elseif target then
			pos2 = target:GetPosition()
			pos2.y = 0
		end
		return { ACTIONS.DASH }, pos2
	end
	return EMPTY_TABLE
end
local function HasWhistleAction(inst)
	if inst.woby_commands_classified then
		if inst.woby_commands_classified:IsOutForDelivery() then
			--Going to dest, or putting items into boxes
			--Command wheel is blocked, so no range on recall action
			return true
		end
		local woby = inst.woby_commands_classified:GetWoby()
		if TheWorld.ismastersim then
			if woby and not (inst.HUD and not woby:IsInLimbo() and woby:IsNear(inst, 16)) then
				return true
			end
		elseif inst.HUD and (woby == nil or woby:HasTag("INLIMBO") or not woby:IsNear(inst, 16)) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function GetPointSpecialActions(inst, pos, useitem, right)
    if right and useitem == nil then
	-----------------wilson
		if useitem == nil then
			local inventory = inst.replica.inventory
			if inventory ~= nil then
				useitem = inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS)
			end
		end
		if useitem and
			useitem.prefab == "torch" and
			inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wilson_torch_7") and
			useitem:HasTag("special_action_toss")
		then
			return { ACTIONS.TOSS }
		end
		------------------------winona
		if useitem == nil then
			local inventory = inst.replica.inventory
			if inventory ~= nil then
				useitem = inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HEAD)
			end
		end
		if useitem and
			useitem.prefab == "roseglasseshat" and
			useitem:HasTag("closeinspector")
		then
			--match ReticuleTargetFn
			if usereticulepos then
				local pos2 = Vector3()
				for r = 2.5, 1, -.25 do
					pos2.x, pos2.y, pos2.z = inst.entity:LocalToWorldSpace(r, 0, 0)
					if CLOSEINSPECTORUTIL.IsValidPos(inst, pos2) then
						return { ACTIONS.LOOKAT }, pos2
					end
				end
			end

			--default
			if CLOSEINSPECTORUTIL.IsValidPos(inst, pos) then
				return { ACTIONS.LOOKAT }
			end
		end
		----------woby
		if right and
		useitem == nil and
		inst.components.playercontroller and
		inst.components.playercontroller.isclientcontrollerattached and
		HasWhistleAction(inst)
		then
			return { ACTIONS.WHISTLE }
		end
		-------------------------wortox
        local canblink
        if inst.checkingmapactions then
            canblink = inst:CanBlinkFromWithMap(inst.checkingmapactions_pos or inst:GetPosition())
        else
            canblink = inst:CanBlinkTo(pos)
        end
        if canblink and inst.CanSoulhop and inst:CanSoulhop() then
            return { ACTIONS.BLINK }
        end
		---------------------------wx78
		local actions = {}
		if right and useitem == nil then
			if inst.checkingmapactions then
				if inst.components.skilltreeupdater then
					if inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wx78_remotebodyswap") then
						table.insert(actions, ACTIONS.SWAPBODIES_MAP)
					end
					if inst.components.skilltreeupdater:IsActivated("wx78_scoutdrone_1") then
						table.insert(actions, ACTIONS.MAPSCOUTSELECT_MAP)
					end
				end
			else
				if inst.components.playercontroller ~= nil and inst.components.playercontroller.isclientcontrollerattached then
					if inst.CollectUpgradeModuleActions then
						inst:CollectUpgradeModuleActions(actions)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return actions
    end
    return {}
end

local function OnSetOwner(inst)
    if inst.components.playeractionpicker ~= nil then
		--if inst.components.playeractionpicker.pointspecialactionsfn == nil then
			inst.components.playeractionpicker.pointspecialactionsfn = GetPointSpecialActions
		--end
		--if inst.components.playeractionpicker.doubleclickactionsfn == nil then
			inst.components.playeractionpicker.doubleclickactionsfn = GetDoubleClickActions
		--end
    end
	--if TheWorld.ismastersim then
    --    inst.wx78_classified.Network:SetClassifiedTarget(inst)
    --end
end

    end

local function RefreshSpells(inst)
	--local skilltreeupdater = inst.components.skilltreeupdater
	local j = 1

	inst._spells[1] = SPACER_SPELL
	j = j + 1

	for i, v in ipairs(SPELLS_RIGHT) do
		--if v.skill == nil or skilltreeupdater:IsActivated(v.skill) then
			inst._spells[j] = v
		--else
			--inst._spells[j] = BLANK_SPELL
		--end
		j = j + 1
	end

	for i = j, 5 do
		inst._spells[j] = BLANK_SPELL
		j = j + 1
	end

	inst._spells[j] = SPACER_SPELL
	j = j + 1

	for i, v in ipairs(SPELLS_LEFT) do
		--if v.skill == nil or skilltreeupdater:IsActivated(v.skill) then
			inst._spells[j] = v
			j = j + 1
		--end
	end

	if j <= 10 then
		local shift = 11 - j
		for i = j - 1, 7, -1 do
			inst._spells[i + shift] = inst._spells[i]
		end
		for i = 7, 7 + shift - 1 do
			inst._spells[i] = BLANK_SPELL
		end
	end
end

local function EnableMountedCommands(inst, enable)
	if enable then
		inst.components.spellbook:SetItems(inst._spells)
		inst.components.spellbook:SetBgData(SPELLBOOK_WBG)
		inst:AddTag("onridewoby")
	else
		if inst.HUD and inst.HUD:GetCurrentOpenSpellBook() == inst then
			inst.HUD:CloseSpellWheel()
		end
		if TUNING.ASWTRIGGER == 1 
		and not (inst.replica.rider and inst.replica.rider:IsRiding())
		then
			inst.components.spellbook:SetItems(SPELLS)
			inst.components.spellbook:SetBgData(SPELLBOOK_BG)
		else
			inst.components.spellbook:SetItems(EMPTY_TABLE)
		end
		inst:RemoveTag("onridewoby")
	end
end

local function DoUpdateMountCommandsTask(inst)
	inst._updatemountcommandstask = nil
	local rider = inst.replica.rider
	local mount = rider and rider:GetMount() or nil
	EnableMountedCommands(inst, mount ~= nil and mount:HasTag("woby"))
end

local function OnIsRiding_Client(inst)
	--V2C: mount is classified whereas isriding is not, so they will not sync at the same time
	if inst._updatemountcommandstask then
		inst._updatemountcommandstask:Cancel()
		inst._updatemountcommandstask = nil
	end
	if inst.replica.rider:IsRiding() then
		inst._updatemountcommandstask = inst:DoStaticTaskInTime(0, DoUpdateMountCommandsTask)
	else
		EnableMountedCommands(inst, false)
```

```lua
AddComponentPostInit("armor", function(self)
    local oldTakeDamage = self.TakeDamage
    function self:TakeDamage(damage_amount, ...)
        local owner = self.inst.components.inventoryitem and self.inst.components.inventoryitem.owner
        if owner and owner.sg and owner.sg:HasStateTag("xichun_nostun") then
            damage_amount = 0
        end
        return oldTakeDamage(self, damage_amount, ...)
    end
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 切面钩子：AddComponentPostInit:stewer

AddComponentPostInit("stewer", function(self)
    local old_StartCooking = self.StartCooking
    function self:StartCooking(doer, ...)
        local level_component = doer ~= nil and
            doer.components.xichun_level or nil
        local level = level_component ~= nil and
            level_component:GetLevel() or 0
        local was_idle = self.targettime == nil
        local old_cooktimemult = self.cooktimemult

        if was_idle and level >= 2 then
            self.cooktimemult = old_cooktimemult * (1 - .1 * level)
        end

        local result = old_StartCooking(self, doer, ...)
        self.cooktimemult = old_cooktimemult

        if was_idle and self:IsCooking() and level_component ~= nil then
            level_component:AddExperience("wisdom", 4)

            if level >= 2 then
                local remaining = self:GetTimeToCook()
                if remaining > 0 then
                    self:LongUpdate(math.min(level, remaining))
                end
            end
        end

        return result
    end

    local old_Harvest = self.Harvest
    function self:Harvest(harvester, ...)
        local level_component = harvester ~= nil and
            harvester.components.xichun_level or nil
        local level = level_component ~= nil and
            level_component:GetLevel() or 0
        local product = self.done and self.product or nil
        local recipe = product ~= nil and
            cooking.GetRecipe(self.inst.prefab, product) or nil
        local spoiltime = self.spoiltime
        local product_spoilage = self.product_spoilage
        local time_to_spoil = spoiltime ~= nil and self:GetTimeToSpoil() or nil

        local succeeded = old_Harvest(self, harvester, ...)
        if succeeded and level_component ~= nil then
            level_component:AddExperience("wisdom", 4)

            if level >= 2 and math.random() < .1 * level then
                GiveCookedProduct(
                    self,
                    harvester,
                    product,
                    recipe,
                    spoiltime,
                    product_spoilage,
                    time_to_spoil
                )
            end
        end
        return succeeded
    end
end)
```
